fbc625e4cc: Mountain Shadow Hostel is a well-established hostel in downtown Rossland, BC, operating for over two decades and serving travellers drawn to Red Mountain Resort and the surrounding mountain terrain. It offers both private rooms and co-op dorm options, with a full kitchen, laundry, and a snowboard/ski maintenance area catering to outdoor adventurers. Its central location puts guests within walking distance of grocery stores and local amenities.
8a6c294dda: Baker House is a University of the Fraser Valley residence building on the Abbotsford campus that opens to guest and group accommodation during the summer months. As a university dorm repurposed for travellers, it offers an affordable base in the Fraser Valley for cyclists passing through the region. Its seasonal availability and institutional setting make it a distinctive option compared to conventional hotels or B&Bs.
11c6a949c7: Sunstone is one of three modernized A-frame cottages at Nectar Yoga Retreat, a wellness retreat set on 20 acres of forested land on Bowen Island—a 20-minute BC Ferries crossing from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver. Warm pine-clad interiors and a nature-immersive setting distinguish the retreat, and every stay includes daily breakfast, yoga, and meditation. Bowen Island itself offers mountain biking and hiking, making this a tranquil base for cyclists exploring the island.
20981da456: An eco retreat glamping cabin in the Fraser Valley near Chilliwack, listed on Airbnb as 'Eco Retreat Cabin #3 The Rodfathers.' The property appears to be a standalone cabin-style accommodation rather than a traditional guesthouse or hotel.
ccb0f55eff: Built in 1911 by Captain Henry Pybus, St Clair Hotel-Hostel is one of Vancouver's oldest heritage buildings and the city's first concrete structure, originally designed to welcome travelers arriving by train and ship. It operates today as a nautical-themed hostel in downtown Vancouver, offering private rooms across several configurations — single, double, twin, triple, and family quad — with shared washrooms and a kitchenette. Located steps from SkyTrain, beaches, parks, and city attractions, it caters to budget-conscious travelers seeking private accommodation in the urban core.
7c22ed264e: Queens Hotel bills itself as the only hotel in Queensborough, a historic neighborhood of New Westminster, and occupies a quiet residential setting that buffers highway noise. The boutique property offers multiple room types from twin beds to family suites, all with premium Serta pillowtop mattresses and strong Wi-Fi throughout, and is notably pet-friendly with selected pet-friendly rooms. It sits close to the Q to Q Ferry to downtown New Westminster, the Queensborough Landing Outlet Mall, and a cluster of restaurants within walking distance, with a covered patio and BBQ available on-site.
c32fa0d194: O Canada House is a meticulously restored 1897 Queen Anne-style Victorian home in Vancouver's West End, awarded the City of Vancouver Heritage Award of Honour in 1997 for its interior and exterior restoration. The house has notable historical significance as the site where Ewing Buchan penned one of the first English versions of Canada's National Anthem in 1908. Guests stay in individually decorated suites filled with Victorian antiques, steps from downtown attractions, restaurants, and the seawall.
90a4b6bd9e: Anchors Inn is a small waterfront property in Ucluelet offering two cozy cabins and a one-bedroom suite, all pet-friendly and self-catering, operating since 2003. The suite features a full kitchen, propane fireplace, private deck with barbecue, and access to a hot tub. The property sits near the beach in a historically notable neighbourhood associated with pioneering botanist George Fraser.
6e61f1f132: Tyrol Lodge is a chalet-style accommodation on Alta Lake Road in Whistler, BC, situated near the shores of Alta Lake in one of Canada's premier mountain resort communities. The Alta Lake corridor is popular with cyclists using the Valley Trail and the Sea-to-Sky corridor. No current website content is available to characterize the property further.
fa19c90b2a: West Coast Suites at UBC are the campus's most premium offering—modern Signature Studio and One-Bedroom suites with fully equipped kitchens, available year-round on the University of British Columbia's forested Point Grey campus. The property is sustainably heated by biomass generation and hydro electricity, and sits about 20–25 minutes from downtown Vancouver by car or transit. For touring cyclists, the location provides a quiet, scenic base with direct access to Pacific Spirit Regional Park trails and the broader Metro Vancouver cycling network.
c3be5c0a96: A Snug Harbour Inn is a six-room luxury oceanfront bed and breakfast perched on an 85-foot cliff in Ucluelet, surrounded by old-growth forest and dramatic Pacific coastline on the west coast of Vancouver Island. The inn sits directly on the Wild Pacific Trail with access from the end of the driveway and is a short drive from Pacific Rim National Park and Long Beach. It caters exclusively to adult guests, with a private beach, communal hot tub, and a Great Room featuring a wall of ocean-facing windows.
e5bde05aec: Van Horne Guesthouse is a single self-contained 400 sq ft apartment suite in Field, BC, situated in the heart of Yoho National Park in the Canadian Rockies. The property is run by francophone hosts with over 30 years of Rocky Mountain guiding experience, offering a private entrance, full kitchen, and satellite TV. Field sits at the gateway to Takakkaw Falls, Emerald Lake, and Lake O'Hara, making it a natural base for cyclists exploring the Icefields Parkway corridor.
2ff92d7c2c: A purpose-built, fully licensed luxury waterfront B&B situated on the shores of the Esquimalt Lagoon Migratory Bird Sanctuary in Colwood, on the western beaches of greater Victoria. The property offers three self-contained private-entrance studio suites on the second floor, each with individual climate control, and sits on an ocean lagoon with a private dock, kayaks, and canoes available to guests. The website features dedicated pages for arriving by bicycle and an on-site EV charging station, signaling a cyclist- and adventure-traveller-aware operation.
2306baf593: Princess and the Pea Bed & Breakfast is a small, owner-operated B&B in Langley, BC, run by Sharon & Wally Martin. Its storybook name hints at a cozy, attentive hosting style typical of independent B&Bs in the Fraser Valley. Touring cyclists riding through Langley on routes connecting the Lower Mainland to the Interior would find it a locally rooted alternative to chain accommodation.
9721cb3498: Alfred House is a grand 4-bedroom Queen Anne style heritage home built in 1905, set within Ruckle Heritage Farm — the oldest operating family farm in BC's Gulf Islands and now part of a Class A provincial park. Guests rent the entire house via Airbnb and enjoy sweeping pastoral views, handcrafted period woodwork, and access to on-site farm-to-table meals and picnic baskets. Accredited by the BC Accommodations Association, it offers a genuinely immersive heritage experience for cyclists exploring Salt Spring Island.
327013114e: At the Beach Retreat is a single-suite luxury waterfront bed and breakfast perched directly on the shores of Burrard Inlet in Port Moody, featuring a private hot tub, cedar sauna, gas fireplace, and gourmet breakfast delivered to the suite each morning. The property sits on a sandy beach with dock access and is steps from the TransLink 181 bus route, which connects to the SkyTrain and West Coast Express at Moody Centre Station. Newport Village's restaurants and the Port Moody Ale Trail are close by, with hiking trails also accessible from the area.
4e3cb6b5d4: Up the Creek Backpacker's Lodge is a family-run cedar house hostel on BC's Sunshine Coast, operating since 2004 and situated 14 km from the Langdale ferry terminal — making it a natural stopover for cyclists arriving by BC Ferries from Vancouver. It explicitly caters to cyclists with loaner bikes and a dedicated cyclist camping area, and sits a short 10-minute walk from the heart of Roberts Creek village. The lodge has a warm, nature-focused character and is well-reviewed for cleanliness and hospitality.
5f8ddcef0b: Kicking Horse Hostel is a budget hostel situated in Golden, BC, a mountain town that serves as a gateway to Yoho National Park, Kicking Horse Mountain Resort, and a network of world-class cycling trails. Golden sits at the confluence of several major touring routes through the Canadian Rockies, making it a natural overnight stop for long-distance cyclists. The hostel's location on Station Avenue places it within the small downtown core.
666280fde2: A free, unlocked wilderness hut at 870 m elevation in the Sea to Sky corridor near Squamish, operated by the 99 Trials Association — a non-profit motorcycle trials club active since 2016. The one-storey wooden cabin offers a basic fireplace shelter for trail users but has no drinking water, toilets, shower, or mattresses. Touring cyclists passing through the area may use it as an emergency or overnight stop on backcountry routes, though facilities are extremely minimal.
63ea69678d: An unlocked, open-access wilderness shelter near Squamish operated by the 99 Trials Association, a non-profit motorcycle trials club advocating for trails throughout the Sea to Sky corridor. The one-storey wood cabin sits at 467m elevation and offers basic refuge with a fireplace, but no running water, toilets, mattresses, or shower facilities. No reservation is required and the door is never locked, making it available on demand to anyone who reaches it.
e657b19700: A glamping cabin located at Tamihi Meadows in the Chilliwack area, listed exclusively on Airbnb. The property sits near the Chilliwack River valley, a popular area for outdoor recreation east of Chilliwack.
c501184f3e: Saturna Lodge is a guest house situated on Saturna Island, one of the more remote Southern Gulf Islands of British Columbia, located on the traditional W̱SÁNEĆ homelands of the SENĆOŦEN speaking people. The island is accessible only by BC Ferries or small aircraft, making it a distinctive destination for cyclists touring the Gulf Islands by ferry. The lodge's website sections for rates, reservations, and reviews suggest it operates as a small, full-service lodging.
bc9e1a77e2: Forest Heaven Hideaway is a guest house in Roberts Creek on British Columbia's Sunshine Coast, situated on Joe Road. The property is notable for accepting Bitcoin, Lightning Network, and on-chain cryptocurrency payments — an unusual option for small accommodation in the region. Beyond OSM tags, no further detail about the property or its facilities is currently verifiable.
f67ecc027b: A converted former guest house for Highland Valley Copper Mines, this 4,700-square-foot bungalow sits on 25 acres just outside Logan Lake in BC's Highland Valley. With four en-suite bedrooms and a hot tub, it caters to outdoor enthusiasts drawn to the area's fishing, ATV trails, and horseback riding — they even offer equine experiences on-site. Logan Lake is located south of Kamloops via Hwy 97C, making it a potential stop for cyclists traversing the Interior.
0413205144: Miller Retreats is a chalet-style accommodation on Bowen Island, a small island community accessible by ferry from Horseshoe Bay near Vancouver. Its location on Miller Road places it within the quiet rural interior of the island, which is popular with cyclists seeking an escape from the Lower Mainland.
3d68cdc536: Jasper is a modernized 1960s-style A-frame cottage on the forested 20-acre grounds of Nectar Yoga Retreat on Bowen Island, a 20-minute BC Ferries crossing from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver. The retreat blends Scandinavian-inspired simplicity with wellness programming; every stay includes daily breakfast and yoga and meditation lessons. In 2025 the property added the Mist Thermal Sanctuary offering sauna and cold plunge experiences in the heart of the forest.
ac631c3b14: Hostel is temporarily closed for renovations (hihostels.ca). HI Victoria is a Hostelling International hostel situated in Victoria's downtown core on Yates Street, offering budget shared accommodation within walking distance of the Inner Harbour and the BC Ferries terminal at Swartz Bay via transit. As part of the global HI network it historically attracted backpackers and cycle tourers passing through southern Vancouver Island. Its central location would give cyclists convenient access to provisioning, the waterfront Galloping Goose trailhead, and onward island connections.
afbed445cd: HI Vancouver Downtown is a Hostelling International hostel located in Vancouver's West End, a flat, bike-friendly neighbourhood close to Stanley Park and the downtown core. As part of the HI Canada network, it caters to budget-conscious travellers and is well-positioned along popular urban cycling routes. The hostel occupies a dedicated building on a quiet residential street just blocks from the seawall.
ea0d95af19: The Francis Boutique Inn is an adult-only luxury boutique hotel perched on a private half-acre treed hillside in the heart of Ucluelet, with individual private outdoor entrances for each suite and harbour views. Named after Captain Peter Francis, an original pioneer of the Ucluth Peninsula, it was voted #1 Small Hotel in Canada in 2019. Its central location puts guests within a one-minute walk of restaurants, a grocery store, cafes, a bakery, and the harbour-front — a convenient base for rides along the Wild Pacific Trail and into Pacific Rim National Park.
e0bbdfa278: A family-owned guest house on Salt Spring Island run by the Brown family since 2003, offering six main guest house rooms plus cottage and studio suites set amidst gardens with cascading wisteria. Located a 10-minute walk from Ganges Village, it is well-positioned for cyclists arriving by ferry or exploring the island. The property is all on one level and provides covered, lockable bicycle storage.
3fd3c08a30: Whistler Lodge Hostel is a historic 19+ adventure hostel originally built in 1965 by UBC's Varsity Outdoor Club, now independently operated near the base of Whistler Mountain in the Nordic neighbourhood. After a major restoration in 2015 it blends authentic ski-lodge character with modern amenities, offering mixed dorms, two-bed nook dorms, and a lockable private room. Touring cyclists are well placed here: Creekside Gondola is a five-minute walk, Whistler Village is a short bus ride away, and the lodge features a large shared kitchen, outdoor deck with fire pit, and secure storage for bikes.
077b1f7ea0: Eagle's Nest Guest Suite is a private vacation rental suite perched atop a bluff on the Paragon Estate between Peachland and Summerland, offering sweeping views of Okanagan Lake and access to a shared 300-foot private lakefront. The suite sleeps up to four guests across King and Queen bedrooms plus a pull-out sofa, and is booked exclusively through Airbnb. The Okanagan Rail Trail and Peachland Rotary Trail are accessible in the area, making this a scenic base for cycle touring.
a1a7febd31: Southside Lodge is a small hostel-style accommodation operated by Whistler Snowboard Tours, situated in Whistler Creekside approximately 400m from the Creekside Gondola. Running since 1993 under the ownership of Maxwell, it positions itself as an affordable, no-frills base for accessing Whistler Blackcomb. Touring cyclists passing through Whistler would find it a conveniently located and budget-conscious overnight option near the Creekside village.
7255f257d7: A waterfront international hostel right across from the Westview Ferry Terminal in Powell River, explicitly welcoming cyclists touring the Sunshine Coast. Guests enjoy a sun deck with views across Georgia Strait to Vancouver Island's glaciers, a full common kitchen, and large common room. The location beside the Sunshine Coast Connector ferry stop makes it a natural hub for multi-day cycle touring itineraries.
01fa784089: Turtle Hostel occupies a historic Victorian character house in downtown Victoria, BC, offering budget dorm beds and private rooms a short walk from the Inner Harbour, Chinatown, and multiple transit connections. As a multicultural, independently run hostel it draws long-term travellers and those island-hopping by ferry. The central location means most of Victoria's attractions are reachable on foot or by bus within minutes.
5fc9d5845c: Vancouver Traveller Bed & Breakfast is a family-run, low-carbon-footprint B&B custom-built in 2016 and operated by sisters Linda and Jenny in Vancouver's West Side. The house uses geothermal in-floor heating and cooling, and every guest room features an en-suite bathroom, sofa bed for a third guest, and cross-ventilation windows. Hosts pride themselves on deep local knowledge and a warm, personal atmosphere in a pet-free and smoke-free home.
c38122d2ed: Angela's B&B is self-described as Rossland's original bed and breakfast, a long-standing establishment in this mountain town well known for cycling. Rossland sits at the confluence of popular Kootenay touring routes and is home to extensive trail networks, making it a natural overnight stop for touring and mountain cyclists alike. The property is centrally located on Spokane Street within the compact town core.
da8e00fbd0: A budget hostel in the heart of downtown Kelowna offering five room styles from mixed-gender dorms to private queen rooms, all with bedding included. Located on Bernard Avenue, it is a 6-minute walk to the Okanagan Lake waterfront and steps from Safeway and the Towne Centre Mall. Guests share a fully equipped self-catering kitchen, a lounge with games, and free on-site parking.
0f6553f088: A converted church turned spacious log lodge on the south shore of Cormorant Island, overlooking Johnstone Strait with views of passing orcas and the Vancouver Island mountains. Reached by a 35-minute ferry from Port McNeill, the island offers self-guided biking, cultural attractions like the U'Mista Cultural Centre, and whale-watching tours. The lodge lists biking among its recommended self-guided activities and provides guests with a free colour map of the island.
514a437ff0: Cirrhosis of the River is a self-catering glamping cabin near Chilliwack, British Columbia, listed on Airbnb as 'Eco Retreat Cabin 1.' It appears to be part of a small eco-retreat property with at least one bookable cabin unit. As an Airbnb-only listing with no traditional front desk or staff, the experience would be independently managed by the host.
3d0715d3b2: Art and Sould Bed & Breakfast is a guest house situated in Nanoose Bay on Vancouver Island, a scenic stretch of BC's cycling coast between Parksville and Nanaimo. As a B&B it would typically offer overnight accommodation with breakfast included, making it a potential rest stop for cyclists touring the Island. Website content was unavailable at time of review, so specific offerings could not be confirmed.
6c43257503: Cambie Lodge is a bed-and-breakfast guest house located in the Cambie corridor neighbourhood of Vancouver, steps from the main street grid and transit connections. As a small, owner-operated B&B it offers a more personal stay than a hotel for cyclists arriving in or departing the city. Its proximity to the central Vancouver cycling network makes it a potential base for multi-day touring.
2b258e8b21: Ocean Mist Guesthouse is a craftsman-style owner-operated property near the tip of the Ucluelet peninsula offering two self-contained private suites — the ground-floor Blue Heron Room and the second-storey Uncle John Room. Each suite features a kitchenette, private ensuite, covered cedar deck, and dedicated exterior entrance, making it well suited for a quiet, self-sufficient coastal stay. The property sits a five-minute walk from the Wild Pacific Trail Lighthouse Loop and roughly fifteen minutes from Pacific Rim National Park's Long Beach unit.
56f0e15f93: Painted Turtle Guesthouse, also known as HI Nanaimo, is a Hostelling International hostel situated on Bastion Street in downtown Nanaimo on Vancouver Island. Its central location places touring cyclists within easy reach of the Nanaimo waterfront, ferry terminals, and the Trans Canada Trail network. As an HI-affiliated property, it is part of a global network of budget traveller hostels with a long tradition of welcoming bicycle tourists.
068a28ba46: The Evergreen Bed & Breakfast is a family-run, top-rated inn in Hope, BC, owned by Christian and Miyuki since 2016 and in continuous operation since 1997. It offers three individually styled rooms featuring soaker tubs and 4K smart TVs, and sits within easy walking distance of Hope's town centre shops and restaurants. The property operates exclusively on a self check-in model, giving guests code-based keyless entry and flexible arrival — a practical feature for cyclists finishing a long day on the road.
c8afd0f03c: Woodlands Guesthouse is a guest house listed in OpenStreetMap at 1237 Adams Road in the Vancouver area of British Columbia. Its Squarespace website has expired, leaving no current public information about the property's offerings or character. A touring cyclist considering this stop would need to contact the property directly via phone or email to verify it remains in operation.
baf22b7120: Pacific Spirit Hostel is a budget-friendly hostel on the University of British Columbia campus, offering private single and double rooms with shared washrooms and a shared lounge. Situated at the western edge of Vancouver near Pacific Spirit Regional Park, multiple beaches, and the famous Stanley Park seawall loop, it is a natural stop for cyclists touring the city's coastal routes. The 24-hour front desk and direct access to the UBC bus exchange make it a practical and scenic base for cycle touring.
da7c693dd9: The Modern Cabin is a standalone 1,000 sq.ft. vacation rental cabin at Hummingbird Oceanside Suites on Bowen Island, reachable via BC Ferries from Horseshoe Bay with a 15-minute bike ride from Snug Cove terminal. The cabin sleeps up to six guests in two bedrooms plus a sofa bed, with sweeping views of Howe Sound and the North Shore Mountains from huge windows. Shared property amenities include a wood barrel sauna, a wooden staircase to the ocean, a communal fire pit, and a lawn games field with BBQ.
2f68073416: The Cabin at Sweetwater Lane Farm is a 1,400 sq ft, three-bedroom vacation cabin on a functioning 7-acre permaculture homestead near Mount Currie, sleeping up to six guests. The property features a private hydrotherapy suite with hot tub, cold plunge, and cedar barrel sauna, plus unobstructed views of Mount Currie (t'szil). Owners Gus and Jocelyn live 150 metres from the cabin and offer guided farm tours so guests can meet resident donkeys, Highland cattle, and milk cows.
9538c86387: C&N Backpackers is a budget hostel on the wild west coast of Vancouver Island, offering dorm and private rooms steps from the Wild Pacific Trail and Ucluelet's surf beaches. It sits within easy reach of whale-watching tours, the Ucluelet Aquarium, and a lively local music scene, making it a natural base for adventurers exploring the Pacific Rim area. The hostel has negotiated discounts with local surf and tour operators, which may appeal to cyclists combining a ride with ocean activities.
7f2df45456: The Balfour is a heritage bed and breakfast housed in a 1902 mansion in Vancouver's historic Shaughnessy neighbourhood, featuring handpainted ceilings and faux-finished walls that preserve the character of the original building. Guests can explore surrounding landscaped gardens or walk to the Van Dusen Botanical Garden and Queen Elizabeth Park. The property offers a mix of rooms with full ensuite and semi-private bathrooms, and is well-positioned for transit access to downtown Vancouver.
3a561b5629: Tantalus View Retreat is a hand-crafted, off-grid chalet built entirely by log artisan Warren Brubacher, perched alone on a rock bluff above Swift Creek with a panorama of the Tantalus Mountain Range and glaciers. Sitting between Vancouver and Whistler, it runs on renewable energy and offers a private hot tub, creekside sauna, and cold plunge tub in a single-unit rental designed as a secluded nature sanctuary. Mountain biking is cited among the many adventure options within half an hour, though the chalet is reached via a luggage cable tram up the bluff from a Forest Service Road.
89ef39aa27: A beachfront cottage resort on Vancouver Island's east coast between Courtenay and Campbell River, set against old-growth coastal forest. The resort has about 20 individual 2- and 3-bedroom cottages with full kitchens, bathrooms, and gas or wood-burning fireplaces. Originally a 1920s Comox Logging camp turned family resort, it sits on a sandy beach with tidal pools, forest trails, and a resident harbour seal colony.
0b7d4214d5: C&N Backpackers Central Station is an OSM-tagged hostel near Vancouver's Main Street, operated under the C&N Backpackers brand. The operator also runs a hostel in Ucluelet on Vancouver Island. No current web presence for the Vancouver location could be confirmed.
fce5972d0c: Inn Field Guesthouse is a self-contained lower-level suite in the small mountain village of Field, British Columbia, situated within Yoho National Park. The suite sleeps up to four guests with a full kitchen, queen bed, and pull-out couch — offering independent travellers a home-base feel rather than a hotel stay. It is a 3–5 minute walk from downtown Field and a 20-minute drive from Lake Louise, making it a practical staging point for cyclists exploring the Kicking Horse corridor.
ccb92cf253: Adela's is an award-winning bed and breakfast in West Kelowna, opened in 2017 by on-site hosts Jessie and Jay, who serve a hot breakfast daily from their own home. The property offers three guest rooms with private bathrooms and views of the surrounding mountains and valley, situated minutes from Okanagan wineries, hiking trails, and beaches. Cyclists will find it a welcoming and well-equipped base, with the hosts explicitly advertising secure storage for bikes alongside ski and luggage storage.
551f408459: Wolverine Chalet is a recently renovated luxury 9-bedroom private chalet on Tyaughton Lake, part of the Tyax Lodge & Heliskiing property near Gold Bridge in the Southern Chilcotin Range. The chalet accommodates up to 18 guests and is rented as a whole unit, with access to Tyax Lodge amenities including spa, dining, and lake activities when the lodge is open. The remote location at the end of an 8-kilometre lakeside road offers a genuine wilderness setting, though the property is oriented toward group retreats, heliskiing, and mountain biking rather than cycle touring.
ae04ccb363: Himwitsa Lodge is an accommodation property in downtown Tofino operating under the House of Himwitsa complex, which also includes a First Nations art gallery and a smoked fish store. Located on Main Street, it sits at the heart of one of BC's most popular coastal destinations on the west coast of Vancouver Island. The lodge's affiliation with the Indigenous-owned House of Himwitsa gives it a culturally distinctive character compared to typical Tofino hotels.
fab77db6f4: Prior Castle Inn is a guest house situated in Victoria, BC, occupying a three-storey building on St. Charles Street. Its castle-inspired name suggests a heritage or character property, which may appeal to cyclists looking for a distinctive stay in the city. No further details could be confirmed as the website is currently unreachable.
4da327726b: Across the Creek Cabins is a family-operated property consisting of four self-contained cabins on 10 acres of private land at the gateway to Wells Gray Provincial Park, roughly 25 km from downtown Clearwater. Each open-concept studio cabin is fully equipped with a kitchen, queen bed, sofa-bed, three-piece bathroom, and a private outdoor patio overlooking forested surroundings. The property has deep roots in the Smith family going back to the 1970s and sits just off the main road to Helmcken Falls, making it a convenient base for exploring one of BC's premier wilderness parks.
8c7a12b155: Greenwood Country Inn is a chalet-style bed and breakfast in Pemberton, BC, operated by Margit de Haan, who brings over 20 years of international hospitality experience and speaks both English and German. The inn offers four individually themed guest rooms — Dove Tail, Humming Bird, Love Bird, and Dream Suite — featuring mountain and valley views from multiple decks. It sits about 25 minutes from the Whistler/Blackcomb area, making it a potential rest stop for cyclists travelling through the Pemberton Valley.
581cfdcbd0: The Riding Fool is a cyclist-focused hostel in historic downtown Cumberland on Vancouver Island, a community internationally recognized for its world-class mountain bike trail network in the Comox Valley. It offers 8 private rooms with shared bathrooms, a full common kitchen with BBQ, and a social lounge with woodstove — purpose-built for adventure travellers arriving by bike. All of Cumberland's restaurants and shops are walkable from the front door, and Strathcona Provincial Park is a short drive away.
2cd4ff0ea0: Birchwood Bed and Breakfast is a guest house situated along Clearwater Valley Road in Clearwater, BC, a community that serves as the gateway to Wells Gray Provincial Park — a destination popular with touring cyclists exploring the Thompson-Okanagan region. As a B&B, it would offer overnight accommodation with breakfast in a residential-style setting. The property's location near the Wells Gray corridor makes it a plausible staging point for multi-day cycling routes through the area.
d6d37c91b1: Whaler's Guesthouse & Tofino Hostel is a boutique waterfront hostel and guesthouse perched on the edge of Clayoquot Sound with views of Meares Island and Lone Cone Mountain. Operating under the Hostelling International brand, it offers both private ocean-view rooms and shared hostel rooms steps from downtown Tofino's restaurants and amenities. The property rents bikes and surfboards on-site, making it a natural base for exploring Pacific Rim National Park.
8e715d470c: Quarrystone House is a bed and breakfast on five rural acres atop a Salt Spring Island ridgeline, with four private guest rooms in a building separate from the main farmhouse, each offering 180-degree ocean and sunset views from a private balcony or patio. Rooms include a private entrance, ensuite bathroom, two-person jacuzzi tub, gas fireplace, fridge, microwave, and coffee maker, with a three-course country breakfast served each morning at the main house. The property's pastoral setting — bordered by rolling sheep fields to the east and ocean views to the west — makes it a distinctive rural retreat on an island known for outdoor recreation.
342dd88025: Birds of a Feather is a purpose-built, licensed-since-1997 luxury waterfront B&B situated on the Esquimalt Lagoon Migratory Bird Sanctuary in Colwood, just west of Victoria. Three self-contained studio suites on the upper floor each feature private entrances, ocean lagoon views, gas fireplaces, and radiant heated floors. The property explicitly caters to guests arriving by bicycle and kayak, and offers hosted day trips and boat tours of the Gulf Islands.
f4fe9d6a9d: Crystal's View Bed & Breakfast is a boutique B&B in North Vancouver founded in 1998, offering ocean-view suites (Queen, Deluxe, and Luxury tiers) described as having a European flair. It is centrally located on a quiet residential crescent minutes from Grouse Mountain, Capilano Suspension Bridge, Lonsdale Quay, and Lynn Canyon. A member of the BC Innkeepers Guild and Canada Select, it holds a 4.9-star rating from over 631 verified customer reviews.
38329198a6: Skyline House Vacation Rental is a family-operated luxury vacation suite in the mountain village of Valemount, 35 km from Mount Robson and 120 km from Jasper National Park. The self-contained suite occupies a locked, separate entrance at the side of the host's home and features two king-bedded rooms with private ensuites, a chef's kitchen, and a private landscaped yard with a fire table. Guests and reviewers consistently describe it as an excellent base for cycling, hiking, and mountain adventures in the region.
9dae294cef: Built in 1904 and reopened as a premier bed and breakfast in 2006, Barclay House is a restored Victorian home in Vancouver's West End offering six individually themed suites, several featuring clawfoot tubs and custom international furnishings. The property sits within walking distance of Stanley Park, the Seawall, and English Bay — some of the finest urban cycling in Canada. A full hot breakfast is included each morning, and free reserved parking in the lane behind the building is available for each room.
fd947ebe7e: The Cambie Seymour Hostel is a century-old building in the heart of downtown Vancouver, one block from the Granville Entertainment Strip and within walking distance of major SkyTrain connections. With 74 beds in small dorms and private rooms, it draws budget backpackers and international travelers. Three on-site or attached bars and 24-hour staffing give it a social, urban character.
fba733850f: Maple Beach Bed and Breakfast is a guest house located in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood on Maple Street, a short distance from the waterfront. As a bed and breakfast, it offers a more personal hosting experience than a hotel. Its location near the Seaside Greenway and Point Grey cycling routes makes it a convenient base for touring cyclists exploring the city.
856f8d4c1a: The Trailer Trash Tacky Shack is a quirky, self-described cabin-style Airbnb rental in Chilliwack, British Columbia. Its deliberately irreverent name suggests a characterful, rustic aesthetic that may appeal to cyclists looking for something offbeat. As an Airbnb property, it operates without traditional front-desk staff, and host-specific amenity details were not recoverable from the fetched content.
53678025f5: Hiellen Village Longhouses is an Indigenous-owned campground on the northern tip of Haida Gwaii, operated by the Old Massett Village Council on traditional Haida lands, steps from North Beach. The site offers six small cedar longhouses (each sleeping up to 4 with indoor bathroom, gas stovetop, and wood-burning fireplace), a group longhouse sleeping 20+, and tent and RV sites. Built using wood milled locally by community apprentices, all profits are reinvested into the Old Massett Village Council to support local employment and cultural preservation.
02060d41f4: Salish Sea Beach House is a B&B situated on Lochside Drive in Sidney, BC, directly alongside the Lochside Regional Trail — a primary cycling corridor on the Saanich Peninsula. The property overlooks Bazan Bay toward James Island and San Juan Island, with 10,000 sq ft of exclusive beachfront access for guests. Host Shelley offers a single 'Solaris Suite,' set within half an acre of English gardens with walking paths and mature Arbutus trees.
63d9b29ace: The Gastown Hostel, part of The Cambie Hostels group, occupies a century-old building in Vancouver's historic Gastown neighbourhood and has been welcoming international travelers for decades. Guests share access to full kitchens, communal lounges, and multiple on-site bars including The Cambie Bar & Grill and Malone's Taphouse. A fob-secured single entrance and 24-hour front desk give the property a notably secure feel for a social hostel.
833855069e: Horseshoe Bay Motel is a small oceanside motel in the picturesque village of Horseshoe Bay, a 1-minute walk from the BC Ferries terminal and positioned on the Trans-Canada Highway corridor between Vancouver and Whistler. Touring cyclists will find it a natural staging point for ferry crossings or the Sea to Sky route, with express bus connections to downtown Vancouver steps away. The motel offers queen and double rooms with village, ocean, or mountain views, free WiFi, and free self-parking.
c89551226d: Dreamcatcher Hostel is a well-kept hostel in Golden, BC — a hub for cycling, hiking, and mountain adventure — offering private en-suite rooms, family rooms, and six-bed dorms with privacy curtains and personal lockers. The hostel prides itself on cleanliness, enforcing a strict no-shoe policy, and has a communal kitchen, garden with BBQ, and a boot drying room to handle the inevitable wet-gear days. Touring cyclists will appreciate the explicit secure bike and gear storage, laundry facilities, and the welcoming community atmosphere.
9ee6f7035a: A 20-chalet oceanfront resort on Vancouver Island's Highway 19A between Campbell River and Courtenay/Comox, with views across the Georgia Strait. Each standalone chalet has a full kitchen, private deck with gas BBQ, and spa tub. The resort sits directly on the Island Highway cycling corridor, with restaurants and a grocery store nearby.
f4d526b53b: Xenia Centre is a 38-acre nature sanctuary on Bowen Island celebrating over 30 years of land stewardship, offering unique wooden cottages surrounded by old-growth forest and protected government lands. The centre specialises in healing, creativity, and personal transformation retreats, reachable by BC Ferry from Horseshoe Bay or by seaplane. It is a quiet, contemplative destination well off the beaten tourist track.
6283fef047: Jade is one of three modern Scandinavian-inspired deluxe cottages at Nectar Yoga Retreat, a wellness retreat centre spread across 20 forested acres on Bowen Island. The cottage sleeps 1–2 guests and features a covered cedar porch, reading nook, and an indoor/outdoor ensuite shower. Reaching the retreat requires a 20-minute BC Ferries crossing from Horseshoe Bay, placing guests in a quiet island setting where mountain biking and hiking are among the local activities.
cbd86c4815: Sasquatch Crossing Eco Lodge is an Indigenous-owned and operated historic property on 87 acres in Sts'ailes territory near Harrison Mills, BC. Originally constructed in 1903 as Fenn Lodge and acquired by the Sts'ailes First Nation in 2009, the lodge runs largely on creek-powered hydro-electric energy and offers seven uniquely themed guest rooms. Touring cyclists will find it a scenic base for the Harrison Valley with mountain biking, birding, and Harrison Hot Springs all within easy range.
9caef45441: Sahhali on the Bluffs is a vacation rental property perched on a bluff on Pender Island, offering a cottage and several suites with 180-degree views of the Salish Sea toward Vancouver Island and the San Juan Islands. The property is accessible by BC Ferries and sits on one of the island's highest vantage points, in a peaceful setting where guests commonly spot orcas, humpback whales, and bald eagles. Pender Island is a popular Gulf Islands cycling destination, and the cottage listing specifically mentions hiking and cycling as local activities.
df364c03ef: Ocean Breeze is a boutique European-style bed and breakfast on the North Shore of Vancouver, operating since 1992 with waterfront views of Vancouver Harbour. The property is 11 minutes from downtown Vancouver via the scenic SeaBus and sits within walking distance of craft breweries, restaurants, and the Shipyards Night Market. All rooms include private bathrooms and the B&B serves a full hot breakfast with specialty items like smoked salmon omelettes, eggs benedict, and blueberry pancakes.
fefeb1b3a1: The Cranberry Arms is a historic neighbourhood pub and hotel in Cedar, south of Nanaimo, with roots going back to 1878 when the property was won in a card game by Irish immigrants. Newly renovated rooms sit above a lively community pub that hosts regular events including karaoke, sports nights, and charity fundraisers. The hotel offers five rooms ranging from a full suite with kitchen to standard queen rooms, and a shared non-smoking balcony for guests.
4f2e522229: Seaview Cottage is an Airbnb-listed guest house situated at Cates Hill on Bowen Island, a small island community in Howe Sound reached by BC Ferries from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver. Bowen Island's relatively quiet roads and scenic coastal terrain make it a popular cycling destination, with the compact Snug Cove village—including a grocery store and pub—near the ferry terminal. The property is tagged in OpenStreetMap as a guest house, though no details about its layout, capacity, or cyclist-specific facilities could be verified from the available sources.
196e53459f: Twin Peaks Resort is a guest house located in Valemount, British Columbia, a small mountain community in the Robson Valley region. Valemount sits at the junction of several major cycling routes and serves as a gateway to Mount Robson Provincial Park, making it a natural overnight stop for touring cyclists. The resort's location on Jack Adams Road places it within the town, convenient to local services.
7ab87e7105: An award-winning Edwardian mansion from 1905, fully restored and operating as a luxury B&B with nine individually appointed guest suites featuring antiques, fireplaces, and Jacuzzi tubs. Located in a quiet residential neighbourhood just four blocks from downtown Victoria's Inner Harbour. Registered Heritage Property with a Canada Select 5 Star Rating.
574f519d62: Marina House B&B is a guest house situated on Marine Drive in Gibsons, a scenic coastal community on the Sunshine Coast of British Columbia. The property's name and waterfront address suggest a setting near Gibsons Harbour, a natural stopping point for cyclists touring the Sunshine Coast. No additional details about the property's offerings could be verified due to website inaccessibility.
8d44a4222b: Bearspaw Inn Bed & Breakfast is a guest house listed in OpenStreetMap on Goold Road in Houston, BC, a small community in the Bulkley-Nechako region along Highway 16. No verified website or contact information is available to confirm current operations or amenities. Touring cyclists passing through the Houston area would need to verify the property directly before relying on it as a stop.
34949ecc4d: Opal is one of three modernized A-frame cottages at Nectar Yoga Retreat, a wellness and yoga destination set on 20 acres of forested land on Bowen Island. Reaching the property requires a 20-minute BC Ferries crossing from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver. All cottage stays include daily breakfast and yoga and meditation sessions as part of the retreat experience.
a9a4467bca: Edgemount Guesthouse is a single private suite added onto a historic home in Field, BC, situated within Yoho National Park just 27 km from Lake Louise. The self-contained second-floor suite features an open-concept layout with a full kitchen, queen bed, claw-foot bath, and a balcony with BBQ and mountain views. Field is an exceptional staging point for cyclists exploring the surrounding national parks, with access to the Icefields Parkway, Banff, and the UNESCO World Heritage landscapes of Yoho.
f1430c7ac7: A standalone forest cottage on the 20-acre Nectar Yoga Retreat property on Bowen Island, a 20-minute ferry ride from Horseshoe Bay. The cottage sleeps 1–2 guests and includes daily breakfast, yoga, and meditation. The retreat sits in a forested setting with alder groves and is part of a wellness-focused property that also includes a thermal sanctuary.
6de8b11cf1: Mariner's Loft is a complex of seven spacious ocean-view vacation rental condos perched above Ganges Harbour on Salt Spring Island. Units are two- and three-bedroom with full kitchens, in-suite laundry, and self-check-in, located in the walkable heart of Ganges village near shops, restaurants, and the famous Saturday Market. Select suites are dog-friendly, and the property offers private parking.
00847712e3: Wildernest is a secluded vintage Airstream B&B perched on the forested slopes of Bowen Island, a 20-minute ferry ride from West Vancouver. The 1971 Airstream Landyacht 'Moonshot' sits on over an acre of land bordering the 450-hectare Bowen Island Eco Reserve, offering a rustic-luxe retreat for couples. Snug Cove with its ferry terminal and restaurants is a short distance away, though the property is reached via a short illuminated foot trail from the parking area.
7e3bb10a0b: Mariner's Lookout is a fully furnished one-bedroom vacation rental suite on the second floor of a private home, overlooking Comox Bay, the Beaufort Range, and the ever-changing harbour scene including Goose Spit Park. Run by Henrie (artist and gardener) and Pat (retired tugboat captain), longtime Comox Valley residents who are fluent in English and French and eager to share local knowledge. The property is a 10-minute walk from downtown Comox, the marina, and restaurants, with beach and forest trails accessible directly from the neighbourhood.
af0cbc5ff8: Bona Manzi is a self-contained cottage on Bowen Island, British Columbia, listed on Airbnb and marketed for its ocean views and peaceful setting. The property is a separate cottage rather than a room within a host's home. Bowen Island is a short ferry ride from Horseshoe Bay near Vancouver, making it a possible stopover for cyclists exploring the Sunshine Coast or Sea to Sky corridor.
34945b4d8f: Dancing Bear Inn is a characterful hostel occupying a heritage building on Nelson's historic Baker Street, featuring hardwood floors, bay windows, exposed beams, an antique fireplace, and a sunny BBQ patio. It positions itself as a home base for backcountry explorers and adventurers in the Kootenay region, with staff who can help plan both front-country and backcountry excursions. The surrounding downtown is walkable and sits within a few blocks of grocery stores, restaurants, coffee shops, and outdoor gear shops.
ead9fc8ff1: Cedar Beach Ocean Lodge is a small bed and breakfast with two rooms located on Thetis Island, a quiet Gulf Island accessible by BC Ferries from Chemainus. Its name suggests a beachside or ocean-view setting on Clam Bay Road. Thetis Island's car-light, rural character makes it a tranquil stop for cyclists exploring the Gulf Islands.
5085320473: HI Whistler is a Hostelling International hostel situated in Whistler, BC, one of Canada's most celebrated mountain resort communities and a hub for trail cycling, ski touring, and the Sea-to-Sky corridor. As part of the HI Canada network, it offers budget-friendly shared accommodation appealing to independent travellers and adventure seekers. Touring cyclists riding the Sea-to-Sky route or exploring Whistler's extensive trail system would find it a practical, centrally located base.
9522a12534: WOODS on Pender is a luxury glamping resort set on 7.3 wooded acres of Pender Island, offering three distinct accommodation styles: vintage Airstreams, rustic cabins, and motel rooms. Completely revitalized in 2015 from the former Inn on Pender Island, the property pairs a modern camp aesthetic with on-site dining, a CAMP Store, and a Nordic Spa. It is reached via BC Ferries to Otter Bay Terminal, roughly a 10-minute ride from the property, making it a natural destination stay on a Gulf Islands cycling tour.
a5c0041bdf: Tofino Paddler's Inn is a nearly century-old historic harbourfront guest house — the town's original hotel — perched above Tofino Sea Kayaking on the downtown waterfront of Clayoquot Sound. With only five small rooms and shared washrooms and kitchen, the inn cultivates a communal atmosphere for adventurers and kayakers. Guests receive a discount on sea kayaking tours run from the shop directly below.
b659594376: Ocean Island Inn is a lively hostel occupying a historic 4-storey character building in the heart of downtown Victoria, celebrated in Lonely Planet and praised widely for its community atmosphere. It offers an unusually generous amenity package—free breakfast and dinner daily, a social lounge, and 24-hour front desk—alongside dedicated secure bike storage and an in-house bike rental operation. Its central location puts touring cyclists within easy reach of Victoria's waterfront routes, shops, and transit connections.
58099f50d6: The Hummingbird Suite is a self-contained one-bedroom rental with a private entrance, fully equipped kitchen, and a pull-out couch for extra guests, situated in the tiny mountain village of Field at the heart of Yoho National Park. Field sits on the Trans-Canada Highway corridor and the Kicking Horse River valley, making it a natural overnight stop for cyclists crossing the Rockies. The suite appears to be a single-unit property, suggesting a quiet, home-style stay rather than a traditional inn.
b695128e71: HI Penticton is a Hostelling International hostel situated in Penticton, BC, a South Okanagan town flanked by Okanagan and Skaha Lakes that serves as a natural staging point for touring cyclists tackling the Kettle Valley Rail Trail and the surrounding wine-country routes. As part of the HI Canada network, it offers affordable shared accommodation in a region that draws cyclists from across the continent. Its downtown Ellis Street location puts guests within easy reach of the waterfront and local services.
4b99d9ca2c: Bodega Ridge is a 22-acre cabin resort on the wild north end of Galiano Island, featuring rustic log cabins with wood-burning fireplaces, soaker tubs, and cedar decks overlooking arbutus forest and the Salish Sea. The property has grown from a 1980s horse ranch into a full destination with on-site dining at Lola restaurant (currently temporarily closed and relocating) and The Pink Geranium Café and General Store. It is a popular base for island exploration, retreats, and destination weddings.
1a3c7be6ed: Breezy Bay Bed & Breakfast is a guest house located near Sidney, BC, on the Saanich Peninsula — a region popular with touring cyclists for its rolling rural roads, ferry connections to the Gulf Islands, and proximity to Victoria. The property brands itself around outdoor adventure, suggesting an orientation toward active guests. The website is sparse on operational detail, so prospective cycling guests should contact the property directly to confirm facilities.
445e15c9b9: North Coast Trail Backpackers Hostel is a budget hostel in Port Hardy, BC, serving as a natural base for hikers and cyclists tackling the remote North Coast Trail on the northern tip of Vancouver Island. Port Hardy is a common start or end point for the Inside Passage ferry route, making this hostel a strategic stop for cycle tourists traveling between the BC mainland and Vancouver Island. The hostel is within the small Port Hardy town core.
be11aa071f: The Homestead Tofino is a self-catering oceanfront vacation home perched on a rocky point above Duffin Passage, a two-minute walk from downtown Tofino. The property sleeps up to 10 guests across five bedrooms and three bathrooms, with a private hot tub, fire pit, deck, and a dedicated storm-watch room designed for watching dramatic Pacific weather. It is managed by long-time Airbnb Superhost Cheryl, who has hosted international guests from this winter home for over seven years.
1198b185ac: The Seabreeze is a custom-built craftsman-style guest house in Richmond, BC, perched on a quiet cul-de-sac overlooking the Pacific Ocean and Gulf Islands. It offers three rooms with private en-suite bathrooms, jacuzzi soaker tubs, and ocean-view balconies, with a continental breakfast included in the rates. The property sits directly alongside the Richmond Dyke trails, with historic Steveston Village a short distance away.
8dee2a55cd: The Caboose is a private 1-bedroom cottage on Bowen Island, managed by the Bowen Island Concierge rental agency, offering ocean and mountain views alongside a fireplace and full kitchen. It holds a perfect 5.00-star rating across 7 reviews and is described by guests as spotless, private, and welcoming. Bowen Island itself is a small island community reachable by ferry from Horseshoe Bay, making this a scenic off-route option for touring cyclists exploring the lower Sunshine Coast corridor.
49c40bfc0f: Vernon Hostel is a centrally located budget hostel in Vernon, BC, offering shared-bathroom rooms with linens and towels included. Guests have access to a shared kitchen, a lounge with TV and billiards, and on-site laundry. The property sits near Kalamalka Lake Provincial Park and is a convenient base for cycling routes to Silver Star Mountain Resort (19 km) and the broader Okanagan region.
71018ec3c1: Big Bar Guest Ranch is a rural guest ranch located along Big Bar Road outside Clinton in British Columbia's interior. Situated in the rugged Fraser River canyon region, it offers a remote backcountry experience for travellers. Its OSM listing categorises it as a guest house, suggesting overnight accommodation for visiting cyclists passing through this sparsely serviced stretch of BC.
5ac2350909: Point Grey Guest House is a family-run guest house that has welcomed travellers to Vancouver's Point Grey neighbourhood since 1990, known for its warm, home-like atmosphere and host who personally assists with travel logistics. The property offers standard rooms and a self-contained Iona Garden Suite with a private entrance, outdoor patio, and fully equipped kitchen. Its central location puts guests a 10-minute walk from Point Grey Village's shops, restaurants, and grocery stores, with the beach reachable on foot in 20 minutes.
ce1a996771: Cowichan River Lodge is a boutique private lodge perched on the banks of the Cowichan River, one of Canada's first Heritage-designated rivers and among North America's top-rated trout rivers. The property is rented exclusively as a full lodge for groups, making it suited to cycling clubs, family gatherings, or corporate retreats rather than individual walk-in guests. Host John helps guests connect with local outdoor pursuits including fishing, mountain biking, and wider exploration of the Cowichan Valley.
94f9a1324f: Kilby Lodge is a guest house situated in Agassiz, BC, near the historic Kilby General Store and the confluence of the Fraser and Harrison rivers. The property sits in the rural Fraser Valley, a region popular with cyclists riding the Lougheed Highway corridor or connecting to Harrison Hot Springs. It holds a dedicated website and direct contact details, suggesting an actively managed accommodation.
12fe1f181b: Boho House is a self-catering vacation rental listed on Airbnb on Bowen Island, BC, a short ferry ride from West Vancouver. The Airbnb listing title references a 'Sanctuary Home & Spa' experience, suggesting a wellness-oriented property. As an unstaffed short-term rental, it likely functions as a self-check-in home rather than a traditional guest house with cycling support services.
d92857e128: South Swell Cabins is a collection of eight individually named oceanfront cabins nestled along Spring Cove on the rugged West Coast of Vancouver Island in Ucluelet. The property sits steps from the Wild Pacific Trail and a direct kayak/paddleboard launch, with the cedar barrel sauna and foreshore trail adding to its coastal character. A touring cyclist would find it an atmospheric and well-located base, within walking distance of Ucluelet's restaurants, breweries, and groceries.
554c42ad55: Wells Gray Guest Ranch is a Western-style guest ranch situated on Clearwater Valley Road, the primary corridor leading into Wells Gray Provincial Park — one of BC's most dramatic wilderness destinations. The ranch operates as an all-in-one booking platform for accommodations, horseback riding, and dining, including an on-site saloon. Its position on the Valley Road makes it a natural staging point for cyclists exploring the park.
df2e0ebb5e: A heritage-listed 1905 Victorian Arts and Crafts bed and breakfast in Victoria's James Bay neighbourhood, steps from the Inner Harbour. The property is chef-owned and operated by culinary instructor Vanessa von Schellwitz, whose elaborate gourmet breakfasts are the centrepiece of the stay. Two themed guest rooms — including a family suite sleeping up to five — feature antique clawfoot baths and private semi-entrances that keep guests out of the family living areas.
4170bc529f: The Earth Club Factory — operating as the Denman Island Guesthouse — is a 20-bed hostel, bistro, art gallery, and performance venue housed in a 110-year-old farmhouse on Denman Island, one of BC's northern Gulf Islands. Operating for over 25 years, it blends budget accommodation (dorms, private rooms, seasonal cabins, and on-site camping) with a thriving community hub for music, organic food, and local culture. The website specifically highlights Denman and Hornby as cycling destinations and notes that many summer visitors arrive by bike.
e80ee8dd1d: A premium adult-only bed and breakfast in Harrison Hot Springs, housed in a custom-built post-and-beam lodge designed and constructed by owners Kristy and Roy Molnar over seven years. The lodge is known for its complimentary home-cooked brunches made from locally sourced and garden-grown ingredients. Situated near Harrison Lake, it serves as a base for hiking, kayaking, fishing, and exploring the eastern Fraser Valley.
928f83b936: Harrison Hammond House is a 25-acre rural farmstay at the confluence of the Harrison and Fraser rivers near Harrison Mills, about 1.5 hours east of Vancouver. The property offers mountain views, a hot tub, wood-burning fireplace, and organic gardens, alongside an unusual secondary use as a musician's rehearsal studio. Touring cyclists are well-placed to access the Harrison Hot Springs corridor, Kilby Museum, and river kayaking routes from this secluded base.
74f2603800: Blue Bear Bed and Breakfast is a guest house situated in Tofino, on Vancouver Island's wild west coast — one of BC's premier cycling destinations. Located on Tonquin Park Road, it sits near Tonquin Beach and the old-growth forest trails that attract visitors to this remote surf town. Touring cyclists finishing or starting the Pacific Coast route would find Tofino a logical base, and a B&B of this type typically offers a more personal stay than a motel.
5b86f6fd7e: Nowhere Special is a modern, social hostel-style lodge sitting at the base of RED Mountain Resort in Rossland, BC, a community celebrated for both its world-class skiing and its extensive mountain-bike trail network. The lodge is purpose-built for groups, offering crew-style rooms sleeping 2–10 guests, a fully equipped community kitchen, shared laundry, and a lively outdoor gathering area with fire pit and gas grills. Rossland's renowned singletrack starts virtually at the door, and a free shuttle connects guests to the town's restaurants, brewery, and shops in about five minutes.
5b52d12105: Invermere Hostel is a year-round, 24-hour hostel a short walk from Windermere Lake, James Chabot Beach, and the Columbia River in Invermere, BC. It offers a range of room types from four-person dorms to private queen rooms, making it a flexible option for budget-minded touring cyclists passing through the Columbia Valley. The hostel sits near the town centre and is a stop on the Invermere/Panorama free winter shuttle route.
777dd7e5f0: Rodee Homestay is a four-room bed and breakfast on Stevenson Road in West Kelowna, operated by Rodica Grecu, offering mountain and lake views from rooms and a deck overlooking the Okanagan vineyards. The property serves daily American breakfast alongside Romanian and French cuisine with BBQ facilities, and welcomes pets at no extra charge. Most rooms are on the ground floor and wheelchair accessible, and the homestay is within 8 km of Kelowna.
e7c22d88df: Windsor House is a bed and breakfast located at 325 West 11th Avenue in Vancouver, a two-storey residential-style property in a walkable South Cambie neighbourhood. As a small guest house, it would offer touring cyclists a more personal, home-style stay compared to larger hotels. The surrounding Mount Pleasant and Cambie corridor area provides easy access to urban cycling infrastructure.
c8dc95c347: Purcell House Hostel, also known as HI Cranbrook, is a Hostelling International-affiliated property located on the College of the Rockies campus in Cranbrook, BC. Operating seasonally (summer only per OSM), it occupies what appears to be a student residence building and serves as the primary budget accommodation option in this East Kootenay gateway city. Its campus setting on College Way places it away from the town centre but within reach of the Cranbrook trail network.
585aa15d3f: The Hampton Inn by Hilton Vancouver-Airport/Richmond is a full-service airport hotel located in Richmond, BC, convenient to Vancouver International Airport and positioned along the Vancouver Crossing Loop cycling route. As part of the Hampton Inn brand, it offers consistent mid-scale hotel amenities in a suburban setting near the airport's southern approach. Touring cyclists finishing or starting near YVR will find it a practical overnight option with easy access to the flat cycling infrastructure of Richmond.
211d53ec46: Amethyst is a Scandinavian-inspired deluxe cottage at Nectar Yoga Retreat, a wellness retreat set on 20 acres of forested land on Bowen Island, reachable by a 20-minute ferry from Horseshoe Bay. It is one of three gemstone-named deluxe cottages, sleeping 1-2 guests with a covered cedar porch overlooking a maple and alder grove. Every stay includes daily breakfast, yoga, and meditation sessions, giving the property a structured retreat character rather than a drop-in lodging feel.
d5be90faeb: Spinnakers Guesthouses sit on the grounds of Spinnakers Gastro Brewpub, Canada's first licensed in-house brewpub, which has been operating since 1984 in Victoria's Vic West neighbourhood. The accommodation offers Heritage Houses, Garden Suites, and a Bungalow steps from the waterfront sea walk along Lime Bay, with check-in handled through the on-site Provisions Store. Guests have immediate access to a full-service brewpub restaurant and a provisions shop stocked with baked goods, bottled beer, and local treats.
fc6e954797: Raging Elk is a long-running adventure hostel in downtown Fernie, BC, operated by outdoor enthusiasts Joe and Sadie Howse, offering dorm beds, private rooms, family rooms, and unique deluxe pod-style accommodation. Situated within walking distance of downtown with mountain biking and hiking trails right outside the door, it serves as a well-equipped base camp for cyclists exploring the Fernie area. The property includes an onsite bar (Kodiak Lounge), sauna, games room, and dedicated cycling infrastructure that goes well beyond typical hostel offerings.
856a3b0571: HI Vancouver Jericho Beach is a Hostelling International hostel situated steps from Jericho Beach on Vancouver's west side, placing guests directly on the seaside cycling corridor that connects to the Spirit Trail and the Arbutus Greenway. As part of Canada's largest hostel network, it offers budget accommodation in a low-rise setting surrounded by parkland rather than the dense downtown core. Touring cyclists arriving from the Sea to Sky corridor or the BC Ferries terminals at Tsawwassen or Horseshoe Bay will find it a convenient and affordable base on the western edge of the city.
2fcb5f60d6: Stoneshire Guesthouse is a self-contained vacation rental property in Clearwater, BC, offering two suites — the Obsidian Suite (sleeps 2) and the Basalt Suite (sleeps 5) — each with a private kitchen and bathroom. It sits in the gateway community to Wells Gray Provincial Park, making it a natural stopping point for cyclists exploring the Trophy Mountain and Helmcken Falls corridors. The property is operated under the broader 'Stay Clearwater' hospitality group, which also manages Fieldstone Guesthouse and River's Edge Retreat.
50f537c98f: Blue Grouse Country Inn is a four-room, first-class guest house established in 2001 on 26 treed acres within Wells Gray Park near Clearwater, BC. Each room features en-suite bath, satellite TV, bar fridge, and in-room coffee bar, while a shared kitchen and outdoor BBQ support self-catering guests. The inn is affiliated with BC Backcountry Adventures Ltd. and sits close to Helmcken Falls, Moul Falls, and extensive hiking and mountain biking trails throughout the park.
2524374717: Tofino Swell Lodge is a three-generation family-run guest house on Olsen Road, operating since 1984, with seven private rooms featuring views of Clayoquot Sound. Guests share a communal living and kitchen area designed for socializing with fellow travellers. The lodge emphasizes immersive coastal experiences including fishing, natural hot springs, and scenic boat tours.
34dedca1cd: Ponderosa Coach House is a self-catering vacation rental unit perched atop a bluff on a private waterfront estate between Peachland and Summerland, overlooking Okanagan Lake. Bookable through Airbnb and managed by FreedomStay Properties, it sleeps up to three guests in a Queen bedroom plus a double pull-out sofa, with two outdoor decks offering panoramic lake and mountain views. It is part of a larger estate that includes several other rental units and a 300-foot private lakefront.
8143123483: Ashby House is a heritage bed and breakfast housed in a 3-story wood-frame Victorian home built in 1899 in Vancouver's West End, and is listed as a heritage site. Marketed as "Vancouver's Funkiest Accommodation," it sits on Bute Street close to the seawall cycling network, English Bay, and the dense dining and grocery options of the West End. The building's late-19th-century character sets it apart from standard urban hotels, making it a distinctive overnight option for visitors exploring the city by bike.
d535c4f24b: Quartz is one of three Scandinavian-inspired deluxe cottages at Nectar Yoga Retreat, a wellness sanctuary nestled on 20 forested acres on Bowen Island, a 20-minute ferry ride from Horseshoe Bay. The cottage sleeps 1-2 guests and features a covered cedar porch, reading nook, ensuite bathroom with indoor and outdoor shower, and a stay package that includes daily breakfast, yoga, and meditation. Bowen Island itself offers mountain biking, hiking, kayaking, and a tight-knit island community for cyclists exploring the region.
20f5d180cf: Squamish Adventure Inn is a waterfront hostel and hotel-style property in Squamish, BC — Canada's Outdoor Recreation Capital — sitting at the midpoint of the Sea-to-Sky corridor between Vancouver and Whistler. Guests choose from hotel-style rooms with private entrances and ensuite bathrooms, private rooms, dorms, or suites with private kitchens, all sharing a waterfront BBQ patio and a large communal kitchen. The inn offers complimentary cruiser bikes for guests plus on-site rentals of kayaks, bikes, and SUPs, and connects guests with local tour operators at discount rates.
4255308c6f: University-operated suite-style accommodation on the UBC campus, surrounded by forests and ocean views on Vancouver's west side. Suites come with full kitchens and the property is pursuing LEED Gold certification with carbon-neutral building operations powered by biomass and hydro electricity. A major bus exchange on campus connects to downtown Vancouver in about 25 minutes.
c15b89a13e: The Wild Turkey Inn is a restored 1890 Victorian heritage home in Rossland, BC, originally commissioned for the first Bank of Montreal manager in town during the height of the Red Mountain gold rush, and still showcasing eleven-foot ceilings, original fir floors, and period craftsmanship. Offered exclusively as a whole-house private stay for groups and families, it sits three blocks from downtown Rossland and ten minutes from RED Mountain Ski Resort, in a town that has reinvented itself as a Western Canadian hub for skiing and mountain biking. Owner-hosts Shauna and Mike live on site and are available to share local knowledge, making it a characterful and personal base for exploring the Kootenays.
d7e5dcde59: Eagle Rock Bed and Breakfast is a small, adult-only luxury retreat in Chemainus, BC, positioned steps from a pebble beach with ocean views along Vancouver Island's coast. It offers two private rooms (a king and a queen) and serves hearty gourmet breakfasts. The property markets itself as a serene, exclusive escape, appealing to cyclists looking for a quieter, upscale overnight stop on the Island.
6bcbac0e42: Gage Suites is a UBC campus accommodation offering studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom self-contained suites available year-round, situated on the sprawling UBC campus roughly 25 minutes from downtown Vancouver by transit. The suites feature full kitchens and laundry facilities, making them well-suited for multi-night touring stays. UBC building operations are carbon neutral with heating and power supplied by biomass generation and hydroelectricity, and select Gage Suites are pursuing LEED Gold certification.
58403e5bfc: A lakefront resort on spring-fed Tuc-el-Nuit Lake in Oliver, BC that has operated since the 1930s. The 5-acre property offers suites, cabanas, and RV/campsites with a 500-foot private beach. They actively promote cycling getaways with wine-touring planning services through the South Okanagan wine country.
4fe198df69: Oceanfront Suites at Cowichan Bay is an all-suite waterfront hotel perched in the seaside village of Cowichan Bay with panoramic views of the bay and Mount Tzouhalem. The property offers spacious one- and two-bedroom suites with full kitchens, an indoor heated pool, hot tub, sauna, and fitness centre. An on-site restaurant, The Cook and Butcher by Cow Cafe, and 24-hour guest services make it a comfortable base for exploring the Cowichan Valley's wine and cycling routes.
f6818ca1cb: Snugglers Cottage is a self-contained vacation rental house situated in Snug Cove on Bowen Island, a short ferry ride from Horseshoe Bay on BC's Lower Mainland. The island is a popular cycling day-trip and overnight destination, and the cottage offers a private residential-style stay. As an Airbnb listing it operates without on-site staff, with all arrangements handled through the platform and the host remotely.
ff065b7665: The Fish & Chicks is a glamping cabin retreat in Chilliwack, BC, listed on Airbnb as 'Eco Retreat Cabin 2, The Fish N Chicks,' suggesting at least two cabin units on the property. It is situated in the Fraser Valley and offers a nature-focused cabin experience. The property is booked exclusively through Airbnb with no direct contact channel available.
3d1fe23778: Knouff Lake Wilderness Resort was established in 1904 and is one of the oldest four-season resorts in BC, situated near Kamloops and Sun Peaks. The resort offers rustic log cabins with wood-burning cook stoves, RV and tent camping, and lake-based activities including fishing and paddling. Access is via 14.6 km of dirt road with a gated entry, and there is no cell service on site.
fee228e02a: Queen Mary Lake Cabin is a BC Parks wilderness hut situated in Height of the Rockies Provincial Park in the Kootenays region of British Columbia. It offers basic backcountry shelter for those venturing deep into a remote mountain wilderness area. For touring cyclists exploring multi-day routes through the park, this cabin represents one of the few overnight options in the backcountry.
3f3950a2da: Upnit Lodge is a waterfront lodge in Bamfield, BC, owned and operated by the Huu-ay-aht First Nation on their traditional territory along Barkley Sound. The lodge sits steps from the West Coast Trail and is a well-known start or end point for multi-day wilderness treks, with room types ranging from single-bed suites to a 10-person suite with kitchenette. Guests can arrive by floatplane or boat directly to the on-site marina, and a nearby restaurant and pub (Malsit Public House) rounds out the amenities.
a89ab9b40c: Farm Cabin is a remote wilderness hut in the McGregor Mountains of British Columbia, operated by the Prince George Backcountry Recreation Society and reachable only by a 5 km non-motorized trail that takes 2–6 hours to hike in summer or 4–8 hours to ski/snowshoe in winter. The self-maintained cabin sleeps four and is stocked with a wood stove, firewood, sleeping mattresses, and a propane two-burner stove. Advance bookings are managed online through PGBRS.org up to four months ahead.
f5a9b4b4c0: Green Coast Lodge is a 6-room, 13-acre oceanside property in Lawn Hill on Graham Island, Haida Gwaii, operated by Green Coast Kayaking, which has been running guided Gwaii Haanas kayak expeditions since 1981. Situated directly on Hwy 16 about 20 km north of Skidegate, it offers accommodation styles ranging from private ensuite queen rooms to hostel-style bunks, all sharing kitchen facilities. The property sits steps from the Hecate Strait and includes established forest trails, a creekside setting, and on-site rental bikes for exploring nearby logging roads and scenic highway.
d96f11dcdf: All Seasons Roost B&B is a guest house located on Timberlane Road in the Courtenay-Comox area of Vancouver Island, BC. It is listed in OpenStreetMap as a guest_house under the tourism category, suggesting accommodation for travellers passing through this cycling-friendly region of eastern Vancouver Island.
ad49469021: Beaverfoot Lodge is a 97-year-old heritage log building nestled between Yoho National Park and Lake Louise, approximately 40 km from the town of Golden in a remote mountain setting. The property offers lodge guest rooms, rustic cabins, and camping and RV sites, and is a cultural heritage landmark of the Golden region. It operates as a boutique resort and events venue, with a focus on wellness retreats, yoga, and sustainable living as part of the broader Eightfold Mountain Village development.
4328b21945: A family-run bed and breakfast on a one-acre property just 2 km from Clearwater, gateway to Wells Gray Provincial Park. Two accommodation options: a spacious suite sleeping four and a rustic forest cabin sleeping two, both with their own patio, gazebo, and BBQ. The owners partner with Wells Gray Outfitters to offer bike rental packages for exploring the area.
5000ea476f: Mountain Thyme Getaway is a 1940s Miner's Cottage set in the historic Wells/Barkerville area of the Cariboo, sleeping up to 8 guests in a heritage setting from the gold-rush era. Located along the Barkerville Highway, it sits near Barkerville Historic Town, one of BC's most storied destinations. The property caters to couples, families, and groups seeking an authentic small-town experience in a remote region of the Interior.
62740a2b31: Connor Lake Cabin is a BC Parks wilderness hut located in Height of the Rockies Provincial Park in the Kootenays, one of BC's largest and most remote wilderness parks. As a backcountry shelter, it offers touring cyclists a basic overnight refuge deep in the Rockies, well away from road services. The OSM position is noted as approximate, so route-planning should account for some uncertainty in its exact location.
f30c5f92d5: Lake Shore is a rustic log chalet within Knouff Lake Wilderness Resort, one of British Columbia's oldest resorts, established in 1904 and situated on a remote lake roughly 45 minutes from Kamloops via a 14.6 km dirt road. The four-season resort offers historic log cabins equipped with cast iron wood cook stoves, plus RV and tent camping, boat rentals, and guided fishing on a lake that holds a North American fly-fishing record. Biking is listed among the summer activity offerings, making it a potential backcountry destination for adventurous touring cyclists.
527a5792b1: Terra Nostra Guest Ranch sits on the shores of Clearwater Lake in the remote Chilcotin, accessible off Highway 20 between Williams Lake and Bella Coola near Tweedsmuir Provincial Park. The property offers a range of rustic accommodation from a renovated log saddle cabin to campsites and a wilderness cabin, with a strong focus on horseback riding, backcountry hiking, canoeing, and winter activities including ski touring and heli-skiing. The ranch markets primarily to German-speaking European travellers seeking a wilderness ranch experience far from tourist crowds.
53df4f1e67: Cedar Song B&B and Cottage is a custom-built cedar home on 5 forested acres in Errington, between Qualicum Beach and Parksville on central Vancouver Island, offering two en-suite guest rooms and a fully self-contained 1,100 sq ft cottage. Host Anneke Van Vugt is an experienced tour operator and longtime tour guide, well placed to advise guests on the surrounding region. The property sits near hiking trails and the Englishman River, making it a peaceful rural base for cyclists touring the central Island corridor.
e2a4b86df1: Cahilty Lodge is a 168-room condominium-style hotel and the first accommodation built at Sun Peaks Resort, situated centrally in the ski and bike village just steps from shops and restaurants. Rooms range from traditional lodge rooms with two queen beds to spacious three-bedroom suites, all with heated tile bathroom floors. The lodge is well-suited to self-supported touring cyclists with dedicated secure parkade bike storage and coin-operated guest laundry on-site.
0bdbc6c683: A handcrafted log-home guest house in the Robson Valley near Tete Jaune Cache, offering two private suites each with en-suite bathroom and kitchenette. Situated between three mountain ranges and just a 10-minute drive from Mt. Robson, the highest peak in the Canadian Rockies. The area offers mountain biking and hiking, and the property can serve as a base for cyclists travelling the Yellowhead Highway corridor.
a9dda13a6f: Cougar Mountain Lodge & Resort sits outside Valemount in the Robson Valley, surrounded by 360-degree views of the Rocky, Cariboo, and Monashee Mountains. The property offers main lodge rooms and individual mini chalets accommodating groups of one to twelve, with self-catering facilities available. Valemount is an established mountain biking destination, and the lodge explicitly markets mountain bike storage as a service.
a615f7e0a0: Port O'Pierre is a pet-friendly, rustic cottage in Port Renfrew managed by Handsome Dan Enterprises, sleeping up to 4 guests in a queen bedroom and pull-out sofa, with a gas fireplace, fully equipped kitchen, outdoor BBQ, and wood-burning fire pit. It sits at the edge of the wild southern tip of Vancouver Island, a 10-minute walk from the Pacific Gateway Marina and surrounded by world-class hiking, kayaking, and storm-watching at Botanical Beach and Avatar Grove. An optional adjacent Bunkhouse can extend capacity to 7 guests, making it a practical base for groups or families on multi-day tours.
97c488cbf4: Kokanee Glacier Cabin is a remote backcountry alpine hut operated by the Alpine Club of Canada in the Kokanee Glacier area of British Columbia's Kootenay region. With a capacity of 13 guests and a mandatory reservation system, it serves mountaineers and wilderness travelers seeking a basecamp in the Selkirk Mountains. As a classic ACC hut, it offers basic wilderness shelter well beyond road access, making it an adventurous destination for self-sufficient cycle-tourers willing to venture into the alpine.
deed18fe57: Victory Cove Seaside Cottages is a remote wilderness fishing and nature retreat founded in 2017, situated on a float in the sheltered waters of Victory Bay on the Work Channel Inlet in Northwest British Columbia. The property offers a range of accommodations from bunkhouse rooms to nine-person chalets, alongside guest moorage, guided fishing charters, and daily complimentary coffee. The inlet is a rich marine ecosystem frequented by humpback whales, orcas, black bears, and bald eagles, making it a true off-grid basecamp for adventure.
2db9a60b33: Knouff Lake Wilderness Resort is one of BC's oldest resorts, established in 1904 on a remote fly-fishing lake about 45 minutes from Kamloops. The resort offers rustic log cabins with cast iron wood cook stoves, RV and tent camping, and lists biking among its summer activities. Access requires 14.6 km on a dirt road with no cell service available on site.
