bdc98b661b: Vidette Lake Nature Retreat is an off-grid wilderness escape on the southern edge of the Cariboo Plateau, occupying the site of a historic gold mine. It offers six distinct rustic cabin accommodations — from the Hudson Bay Cottage to the Box Car Cabin — plus a communal space, with access to 16 lakes, a 200-foot waterfall, and extensive hiking. Reached via 56km of Deadman Vidette Road from Highway 1, this is a genuine backcountry destination that also hosts retreats, spiritual events, and guided tours of the 'Centre of the Universe' vortex.
5a943fdd8c: Misty River Lodge is a mountain lodge and guest house at the gateway to the Columbia Valley in Radium Hot Springs, BC, framed by the Purcell and Rocky Mountain ranges. It offers several distinct suite types — including a glamping family suite sleeping up to six, a cross suite, and a whitetail suite — each with private bathrooms and varying kitchenette configurations. A shared full kitchen stocked with pots, pans, and utensils is available to all guests, making it a practical base for self-sufficient travelers exploring the Kootenays.
b5383800fd: A bed and breakfast located in Port Alberni in the heart of Vancouver Island, BC. The property operates as a small guesthouse with a Facebook presence showing recent activity and a small but engaged following. Port Alberni sits at the head of the Alberni Inlet and is a common stopping point for cyclists crossing Vancouver Island on routes such as Highway 4.
5195617c32: Outdoor Lovers Bed & Breakfast is a family-run B&B in Port Alberni overlooking the historic Alberni Inlet, operated by Bill and Milly since 2018 and positioned midway on the Highway 4 corridor between Nanaimo and Tofino. The property offers three distinct rooms with full breakfast (including vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free, and lactose-free options), a front balcony with inlet views, and a poolside pergola with koi pond. It sits at the gateway to Stamp River Provincial Park, Cathedral Grove, and day-trip access to Pacific Rim National Park, making it a natural base for cyclists touring Vancouver Island's west coast.
9424ea1f24: Stone Haven Inn B&B is a small, family-owned bed and breakfast located in Valemount, a mountain town on the Yellowhead Highway corridor near Mount Robson Provincial Park — a natural overnight stop for cyclists touring the Yellowhead or headed to or from the Rockies. The property operates primarily through Airbnb and maintains an active, welcoming social media presence. Its rural Sawyer Road location places it slightly outside the village centre.
c1f0bf10df: A three-generation family-run lodge and campground at Historic Mile 375 of the Alaska Highway, Tetsa River Lodge has been welcoming travellers since 1942 and is widely celebrated as the 'Cinnamon Bun Centre of the Galactic Cluster.' Five self-catering rustic cabins, 30 RV sites with power and water, and open tent camping occupy a quiet wilderness setting alongside the Tetsa River. An on-site gift shop and café offers freshly baked cinnamon buns, artisan meats, homemade bread, and daily soup — all made on premises.
0c940029a0: Midgeley Cabin is a primitive, unlocked wilderness hut in BC's Kootenays (Creston Valley area), maintained in connection with the Trails for Creston Valley Society trail network. It requires no reservation and is freely accessible to the public, making it a potential emergency or overnight refuge for backcountry cyclists on remote routes. The shelter is truly bare-bones — no mattresses, toilets, running water, or any utility services.
96e8d1d41a: Tunkwa Lake Resort is a lakeside resort located near Tunkwa Lake in the Thompson-Okanagan region of British Columbia, a area known for fishing and outdoor recreation. The resort sits in a scenic interior plateau setting that would appeal to touring cyclists exploring the back roads between Logan Lake and Kamloops. Details about facilities and services are unavailable due to website access issues.
b1e664f6e5: Fish Lake Cabin is a fee-based backcountry wilderness hut situated within Top of the World Provincial Park in BC's Kootenay region. It offers remote overnight shelter for adventurers accessing the park's high-elevation terrain. Cyclists considering a stop here should plan for full self-sufficiency, as it is a primitive backcountry structure managed by BC Parks.
c82331acf8: A free, reservation-free wilderness hut in the Okanagan & Thompson backcountry, operated by the Osprey Snowheelers snowmobile club. The shelter features a fireplace but has no drinking water, no mattresses, and no internet. Publicly accessible with no fee, it offers a basic roofed rest point in a remote setting.
bdde6d1a3f: Ripple Ridge Cabin is a backcountry wilderness hut in the Kootenays, situated within the Ripple Ridge Recreation Site and managed by the volunteer Ripple Ridge Recreation Association in partnership with Recreation Sites and Trails BC. It sits about 3.2 km from the Kootenay Pass parking area and is one of two cabins (the other being Lightning Strike Cabin) located just 50 metres apart at high elevation. Reservation is required and summer access via the Maryland FSR is subject to snow until early July, making this a destination suited to self-sufficient adventure cyclists rather than casual touring.
a2265a6f13: Quaaout Lodge & Spa at Talking Rock Golf Resort is an Indigenous-owned resort on the shores of Little Shuswap Lake, developed by the Skwlāx te Secwepemcúl̓ecw (Little Shuswap Lake Band) and opened in 1991. The property features the Talking Rock Golf Course, Jack Sam's Restaurant, and is situated near the Adams River salmon run and Tsútswecw Provincial Park. A May 2022 fire destroyed the guest room wing; a rebuild is committed to but accommodation is not currently available.
6b4c643322: Great Bear Chalet is an intimate, all-inclusive wilderness retreat on the banks of the Atnarko River inside Tweedsmuir Provincial Park, accommodating a maximum of four guests in two private queen-bedroom suites with ensuites. The property operates entirely off-grid and is best known for guided grizzly bear viewing, eco-river drifts, and interpretive hikes through one of BC's most significant salmon and grizzly habitats. Hosts and accredited guides Jefferson and Bindi Bray have been immersing guests in this ecosystem for over 20 years.
3010386ed5: Jags Beanstalk is a family-run oceanfront guest house in Skidegate on Haida Gwaii, offering 12 thoughtfully appointed rooms with private ensuites, mini kitchens, and — in some rooms — sweeping ocean views. Rooted in community since its origins as a garden shop in 1996, the property pairs comfortable lodging with an attached coffee shop serving 49th Parallel espresso and housemade baked goods, including cinnamon buns guests call worth the trip alone. It sits along BC-16 in Skidegate, making it a natural hub for exploring Gwaii Haanas National Park Reserve, old-growth forests, and Haida cultural heritage sites on this remote northern archipelago.
d850773ade: Whatshan Lake Retreat is listed in OpenStreetMap as a chalet-style accommodation in the Arrow Lakes area of BC's Okanagan & Thompson region. The remote lakeside setting would appeal to touring cyclists seeking off-the-beaten-path lodging. No current business information could be verified due to the domain being compromised.
9c69acc8f1: The Bill Putnam (Fairy Meadow) Hut is an Alpine Club of Canada backcountry hut situated at 2050m elevation in the Selkirk Mountains of British Columbia. It is a fee-based wilderness hut historically used by mountaineers and ski tourers accessing the Fairy Meadow area. Access is remote and non-motorized, making it a niche but potentially adventurous option for backcountry cyclists.
7599b2f021: Estuary House Reflexology B&B sits between Courtenay and Comox on Vancouver Island, with a southern exposure overlooking the Comox Estuary and the Comox Glacier. The property offers queen-sized beds and en suite private bathrooms, with valley farmland to the rear. The inclusion of reflexology services suggests a wellness-oriented hospitality experience for guests.
b9576d8145: Mountain View Cabins is a remote, rustic cabin retreat nestled in the Blaeberry Valley about 20 minutes northwest of Golden, BC, surrounded by Rocky Mountain and Selkirk Mountain scenery. The property offers individual cabins (each with two queen beds, heater, and private washroom) as well as budget 'bunkies' with glamping-style amenities including shared kitchen access, BBQs, and a communal fire pit. Guests are encouraged to unplug and enjoy the natural setting, with a viewpoint trail and campfire area on site.
e28ce1f540: Mount Washington Chalet is listed as a guest house on Cruikshank Ridge in the Mount Washington Alpine Resort area on Vancouver Island, BC. The resort area is a known ski and outdoor recreation destination, making a chalet-style accommodation plausible. However, the business's website is currently an unconnected Wix domain stub, leaving its current operational status unverifiable.
35c661c354: Radium Chalet is a chalet-style accommodation in the Radium Hot Springs area of the Kootenays, British Columbia. Located on Madsen Road, it sits near the hot springs and the entrance to Kootenay National Park, a region popular with touring cyclists riding the Columbia Valley or Banff-to-Radium routes. No current web presence could be verified to provide further detail.
3d1cc7b22f: Elk Lakes Cabin is a backcountry wilderness hut operated by the Alpine Club of Canada, situated in the Kootenays region of British Columbia near Elk Lakes Provincial Park. It offers mattresses and requires advance reservation, serving as a remote overnight refuge for mountain travellers. Touring cyclists venturing into this high-alpine area would find a staffed-organization-managed hut with basic sleeping infrastructure in a spectacular wilderness setting.
85542d25dd: Big Bar Guest Ranch is an authentic working ranch in BC's Cariboo region, operating since 1936 and offering hand-built cabins and lodge rooms amid wide open grasslands near Clinton. The ranch actively promotes mountain biking on forest singletrack alongside horseback riding and fishing, making it a natural stop for touring cyclists exploring this remote stretch of the Cariboo. Day visitors are also welcome to stop in for a meal or coffee at the lodge.
c52e9a896a: Alouette Cabin is a fee-based wilderness hut operated by BC Parks within Golden Ears Provincial Park, one of BC's largest and most popular parks located roughly an hour east of Vancouver. The cabin offers basic backcountry shelter with a fireplace and toilets in the park's rugged, mountainous interior. Cyclists considering a stay should note that Golden Ears' backcountry terrain is described by BC Parks as extremely rugged, and no cell service is available in most areas of the park.
6ca569073c: Helmcken Falls Holiday Resort is a wilderness resort established in 1952 and situated inside Wells Gray Provincial Park, offering log cabins, chalets, heritage rooms, RV sites, and tent camping across 20 acres of forest. Its central location places guests 15–20 minutes from major park attractions including Helmcken, Dawson, and Spahats Falls. An on-site restaurant and lounge, camping store, and friendly front-desk staff make it a self-contained base for multi-day backcountry touring in one of BC's most spectacular parks.
facaba79fc: Chims Motel & Guest House is an accommodation property on Vancouver Island near Port Alberni, a gateway to the Island's west coast and a potential stop on routes such as the Pacific Marine Circle Route. The property operates a dedicated email address (sleep@chims.ca) and accepts cash, Visa, and Mastercard, consistent with a small owner-operated establishment. No further detail about the property's layout, facilities, or cyclist services could be retrieved from the available website content.
c311857864: Cornerstones is a provincially registered, adult-oriented bed and breakfast in the heart of Qualicum Beach, recognized by TripAdvisor as one of the top 1% of inns and B&Bs worldwide and one of the top 25 in Canada. The property offers three spacious suites with private en-suites, daily full breakfasts using locally sourced ingredients, and a guest lounge with a fireplace and kitchenette. Its central location gives cyclists immediate access to Qualicum Beach's downtown, beach, trail systems, and parks, with 24/7 keyless entry and concierge services including shuttle arrangements to ferry terminals.
cc97c696fe: Cedar Wood Lodge is Alberni Valley's self-described only four-star accommodation, offering 8 guestroom suites with private en-suite spa tubs, gas fireplaces, and air conditioning, run by hosts Tom and Marla Housholder who relocated from Utah in 2004 to build the property. Situated on BC Highway 4 in Port Alberni, it serves as a comfortable base for exploring the Alberni Inlet, Harbour Quay, and area trails, with a full continental breakfast buffet and packed lunches available on request. Conference and catering facilities round out a property that blends leisure hospitality with practical amenities.
246857e488: Swift Creek Cabins are remote backcountry wilderness cabins operated by Headwaters Outfitting near Valemount, BC, sitting in subalpine terrain close to Mount Robson Provincial Park. The self-catered cabins are wood-heated, propane-lit, and designed for small groups pursuing backcountry skiing in winter or alpine hiking in summer. Guests must sign a wilderness release waiver on arrival, reflecting the genuinely remote and rugged nature of the location.
e2da2e643e: Knouff Lake Wilderness Resort, established in 1904, is one of the oldest resorts in BC, situated on Knouff Lake roughly 45 minutes from Kamloops. The family-run resort offers rustic log cabins with cast iron wood cook stoves, RV/tent camping, and fishing in a lake that holds a North American fly fishing record. Access requires a 14.6 km dirt road off Tod Heffley Louis Creek Road, making it a remote wilderness destination rather than a roadside stop.
9ed7cc3e8c: Telegraph Cove Resort is a historic seasonal destination on the northeast coast of Vancouver Island, built around a restored 1912 sawmill village centred on an 800-foot boardwalk with heritage cabins used as guest accommodation. Founded in 1979, the resort offers houses, cabins, RV and tent camping, a full marina, and was home to British Columbia's first commercial whale-watching operation. A major fire on December 31, 2024 destroyed the restaurant, pub, and several landmark buildings; the resort is rebuilding and welcoming guests again for the 2026 season.
8dbfdc22eb: Mount Robson Lodge is a family-owned cabin resort established in 1978, set 5 km west of the Mount Robson Provincial Park entrance on Yellowhead Highway 16, with direct views of BC's highest peak and a short walk to the Fraser River. Self-contained rustic cabins each sleep up to four guests and include a kitchenette, making the property a practical base for multi-day touring along the Yellowhead corridor. The lodge also operates Mount Robson Whitewater Rafting, so cyclists seeking an adventure rest day have options directly on site.
5fbbf64993: The Log Cabin & Bunkhouse is a seasonal retreat on the DeeKayTee Ranch, a family-run working farm in the Comox Valley north of Courtenay on Vancouver Island, operating since 1926. The bunkhouse sits in a forested setting with panoramic mountain views and offers a quiet, private escape on an active beef, poultry, and produce farm. Guests can browse the on-farm market for locally raised meats, eggs, jams, and baked goods.
33e3daaf40: Knouff Lake Wilderness Resort is a historic 4-season resort established in 1904, situated on Knouff Lake about 45 minutes from Kamloops. 'Royal' is one of several rustic log cabins on the property, each equipped with a wood burning cook stove, propane heater, full-size fridge, and electric cook-top. The resort is reached via 14.6 km of dirt road, in a remote wilderness setting focused primarily on fishing and outdoor recreation.
ae6b24fd2d: Raven's River Rest is an Indigenous-owned riverside cabin and healing retreat situated along the Somass River within the traditional Tseshaht Territory near Port Alberni. Created by a Tseshaht couple on ancestral land, it offers guests access to salmon fishing, swimming, and berry picking alongside traditional healing ceremonies, Reiki, and herbal remedy workshops. A touring cyclist staying here would experience a deeply nature-connected, culturally distinctive escape far removed from standard hotel accommodation.
874f28cc53: Knouff Lake Wilderness Resort is a historic 4-season resort established in 1904, situated on Knouff Lake roughly 45 minutes from Kamloops. 'Lake Side' is one of the resort's small rustic log cabins featuring a cast iron wood cook stove, propane heater, and basic kitchen amenities. The resort is accessed via 14.6 km of dirt road, making it extremely remote and better suited to motorized visitors than touring cyclists.
f89abef96d: Qaayuuk Fishing and Lodge is an Indigenous-owned floating wilderness lodge nestled in the pristine waters of Kyuquot Sound on Vancouver Island's remote west coast, owned and operated by Russell Hanson since 2024. The 10-bedroom lodge accommodates up to 18 guests and offers guided salmon and halibut fishing, locally sourced seafood meals, and access via a 30-minute water taxi ride from Fair Harbour or direct floatplane to the dock. It represents a rare opportunity to experience deep wilderness hospitality rooted in generations of commercial fishing expertise.
01ccb45de2: Lake Wood (Lakewood) is one of several rustic cabins at Knouff Lake Wilderness Resort, a historic 4-season resort established in 1904 on Knouff Lake, about 45 minutes from Kamloops. The small cabin sleeps up to 4 and features a cast iron wood cook stove, propane heater, full-size fridge, and electric cook-top, with a shared bathhouse a short walk away. The resort is remote, accessed via 14.6 km of dirt road, and caters primarily to fishing, boating, and outdoor recreation enthusiasts.
de2c0af1cb: Bella's Beachfront B&B is a small, intimate oceanfront guest suite in Comox on the Georgia Strait, offering front-row views of eagles, herons, seals, and cruise ships passing to and from Alaska. The private suite includes direct deck access without entering the main house, a soaker tub, and a kitchenette with microwave and fridge. The Comox Valley puts kayaking, whale watching, and skiing on Mount Washington within easy reach of touring cyclists.
e489e8d984: A bed and breakfast perched on Thacker Mountain with panoramic views of the Cascade Mountains and the town of Hope below. The property overlooks Hope Golf and Country Club and is about a 30-minute walk or 5-minute drive from downtown Hope. Each room includes a full hot or continental breakfast and a private deck.
082f0f2302: An off-grid outdoor learning centre and retreat facility on Powell Lake, at the junction of the Sunshine Coast Trail and the Powell Forest Canoe Route. The centre offers cabin accommodations for up to 60 overnight guests, with catered meals and a wide range of guided outdoor activities including hiking, canoeing, and kayaking. It primarily hosts school groups, weddings, and corporate retreats, though individual adventurers are also welcomed.
51e4af0306: Rose Cottage is a small bed-and-breakfast guest house in Valemount, BC, set in the Robson Valley surrounded by the Rocky, Monashee, and Cariboo mountain ranges. It offers three rooms each with a private washroom and an included breakfast, and sits within easy reach of Mount Robson Provincial Park, Jasper National Park, and Valemount's well-regarded mountain biking network. The location makes it a plausible overnight stop on a touring or bikepacking route through the central BC interior.
4476d8c323: Hišimy̓awiƛ (5040 Alpine Hut) is a backcountry alpine hut on Vancouver Island operated by the Alpine Club of Canada's Vancouver Island Chapter, bearing both its Indigenous name and a reference to the 5040 peak. It sits in remote mountain terrain, making it an unusual and adventurous overnight option for cyclists exploring the island's backcountry. A fee applies for stays, consistent with ACC hut booking practices.
48cbd9078c: Four Winds B&B is a small guest house on Saturna Island, one of BC's Southern Gulf Islands, accessible only by ferry or floatplane. Suites include in-room kitchenettes, smart TVs, and ocean views, making it a self-sufficient base for island exploration. A sister property, Sandy Bay B&B, is within walking distance, and the island has a pub, café, and general store nearby.
bc78fce02b: Hemlock Hut is a 225 sq. ft. off-grid backcountry ski hut perched at 2,000 m in the Selkirk Mountains outside Revelstoke, operated by Revelstoke Backcountry Guides on a private tenure and reached exclusively by helicopter from Glacier Helicopters. The hut sleeps up to four guests on an exclusive buyout basis and features a wood stove, propane cookstove, solar power, and a custom wood-burning sauna used as a daily ritual after skiing. All trips are fully guided (ACMG) and catered, with guests and guide sharing custodial duties such as hauling water and stoking fires.
f844c34444: Red Goat Lodge is a wilderness resort perched alongside Eddontenajon Lake in the remote Iskut Valley of Northern BC, 3 km south of Iskut on the Cassiar Highway. The property offers fully furnished cabins with kitchenettes and private baths, motel-style rooms with in-floor boiler heating, and a lakeside campground with power and water hookups — an unusually complete set of options for this stretch of remote highway. Canoe rentals, shuttle services, and floatplane connections to wilderness canoe routes make it a genuine basecamp in the heart of the northwest BC lakes district.
1a6eb9caf4: Sandy Bay B&B is a small waterfront bed and breakfast on Saturna Island with two rooms featuring ensuite bathrooms, separate entrances, and a private dining and sitting area overlooking a quiet sandy beach. Room #2 includes an adjoining room for families or larger groups. Saturna Island is promoted by its own tourism association as a cycling destination with peaceful, low-traffic roads — making this property a natural base for cycle touring in the Southern Gulf Islands.
5852e7980b: Dunne-Za Lodge is a lakefront retreat on the northwest shore of Moberly Lake, owned and operated by the West Moberly First Nations community. The property offers four self-contained cabins and an upper lodge suite, with a large green space leading to the water, a small beach, and a trail to an eagle nesting area. It is a culturally rooted destination that hosts events celebrating Dunne-za and Cree traditions, making it a distinctive stop for cyclists exploring northern BC.
a9b46d9d9e: Bayview Garden is a small oceanfront guesthouse in K'il Kun - Sandspit on Moresby Island, the only community on Moresby Island and the gateway to Gwaii Haanas National Park Reserve. Built around a WWII-era military police building from the Alliford Bay Seaplane base, it offers private rooms in a shared facility with a fully equipped guest kitchen and common lounge areas overlooking Shingle Bay. The owner, Flavien, is himself a cycling enthusiast and manages the local Visitor Centre, making this a well-connected base for exploring Haida Gwaii.
56d8228b19: Three self-catering log cabins set in a remote, scenic location 12km south of Atlin with views over glaciers, mountains, and lakes. The property also rents canoes and kayaks for exploring the surrounding waterways. Atlin itself is a tiny historic gold rush town at the end of a spur road off the Alaska Highway, making this a true wilderness destination.
85aee6542e: Creekside Cabin is a free-use wilderness hut located in the Chilliwack Lake area of BC's Fraser Valley, managed under the BC Parks system. Tagged with a fireplace and no fee, it offers basic backcountry shelter for overnight travellers exploring the S⨱ótsaqel/Chilliwack Lake Park area. As a wilderness hut, it is a primitive but functional overnight option for cycle tourists venturing into this remote provincial park corridor.
afd1bbd24c: Cona Vacation Getaways is a small family-run vacation rental management company based in the Comox Valley, named after nearby Strathcona Provincial Park. Founded in 2008 as a backpacker's hostel in downtown Courtenay, it has grown to manage a portfolio of ski chalets and lodges concentrated around Mt. Washington. The owners hold backgrounds in eco-tourism and outdoor leadership and describe themselves as passionate outdoor enthusiasts.
05349dbac8: Chateau Norm Vacation Rentals is a collection of four oceanfront vacation rental units on the remote Haida Gwaii archipelago, situated halfway between the BC Ferries terminal and the Village of Daajing Giids. The property markets itself as an 'adult summer camp' with an oceanfront hot tub, beach access, fossil hunting, and a large fenced yard stocked with outdoor games. Guests can borrow e-bicycles, a canoe, a kayak, or a paddleboard — all gear included — making it a practical and adventurous base for exploring this culturally significant and geographically isolated coastline.
eec637da7e: Knouff Lake Wilderness Resort is one of British Columbia's oldest resorts, established in 1904 and running year-round on a remote lake roughly 45 minutes from Kamloops. The resort offers historic log cabins with cast-iron wood cook stoves alongside RV and tent campsites, set within a wilderness landscape that supports fishing, hiking, and biking. Access requires 14.6 km of unpaved dirt road from Knouff Lake Road, making this a genuinely off-the-beaten-path destination for self-sufficient adventurers.
e1cae646e3: Klippers Guest Suites are spacious, self-contained three-bedroom units on a working certified organic farm in Cawston, BC's Similkameen Valley, with each suite offering a private entrance, full kitchen, and scenic farmland views. The property is part of a larger agri-tourism destination that includes the Row Fourteen farm-to-table restaurant, Untangled Craft Cider, and a CSA operation, and guests can request fresh organic produce brought directly to their suite. It sits within easy reach of Okanagan and Similkameen wine-route cycling, with popular destinations like Osoyoos, Penticton, and Naramata nearby.
16c15e6135: A two-suite B&B set on 2.3 acres in the rural Hyde Creek community near Port McNeill, offering sweeping ocean views of Broughton Strait and a three-minute walk to a wildlife-rich beach frequented by orcas, eagles, and dolphins. The property is run exclusively by Rolf Hicker, an award-winning professional wildlife and nature photographer with over 35 years of experience, who offers private custom photo tours — grizzly watching, whale watching, Cape Scott — available only to his guests. It sits at the gateway to the Broughton Archipelago and is within easy reach of Telegraph Cove and Port Hardy.
5910031754: Gwaii Naay Island House is the first Haida-owned hotel in New Masset, BC, opened in 2018 in a beautifully renovated historic Red Cross Hospital building. Owner-operator Elsie Gale, a Haida textile weaver and cultural specialist, weaves Haida language, art, and tradition into the everyday guest experience. With six rooms ranging from twin-bed shared-bath options to deluxe suites with soaker tubs, plus a separate tiny home with inlet views, it offers a genuine cultural home base for exploring Haida Gwaii's wild landscapes.
331379a180: Copper Beech House is a heritage inn in Masset on the north coast of Haida Gwaii, set in a historic 1914 house overlooking Delkatla Inlet and managed by Canadian poet and writer Susan Musgrave. The property is celebrated for its eccentric literary character—walls hung with Haida art and bookshelves stocked by celebrated guests including Margaret Atwood, David Suzuki, and Douglas Coupland. It has been featured in Vogue and National Geographic, making it one of the most distinctive and storied places to stay in remote British Columbia.
3dfb3c907d: Knight Inlet Lodge is an Indigenous-owned remote floating resort deep in the Great Bear Rainforest of British Columbia, owned by five partner First Nations and operated since the early 1990s. The lodge is accessible only by floatplane from Campbell River and offers multi-night grizzly bear viewing and whale watching packages in one of the last intact temperate rainforests on earth. Guest rooms feature queen beds, private en-suite bathrooms with heated floors, and views of the inlet, paired with fine West Coast seafood dining from locally harvested ingredients.
e31a8f41a7: Stafford House B&B is a guest house on Vancouver Island or the Gulf Islands region of British Columbia, listed in OSM with a Stafford Avenue address. No website content was retrievable, so specific details about the property's character or offerings are unavailable. Touring cyclists passing through the area may find it worth contacting directly to confirm availability and any bike-friendly arrangements.
cd792e7955: Eagle Bluff Bed & Breakfast is a waterfront B&B established in 1990 in Prince Rupert's historic Cow Bay district, offering six uniquely appointed guest rooms and harbour and mountain views from a signature western cedar oceanside deck. An on-site chef-manager prepares a full home-cooked breakfast served in a second-floor dining room overlooking the ocean. Situated at the northern BC ferry terminal connecting to Haida Gwaii and the Alaska Marine Highway, it is a natural staging point for cyclists making long-haul coastal connections.
c37c629129: Nemiah Valley Lodge is an Indigenous-owned, off-grid wilderness retreat operated by the Xeni Gwet'in community of the Tŝilhqot'in Nation, set among the mountains and lakes of BC's remote Chilcotin region. The lodge offers modern log cabin lodging alongside all-inclusive adventure and wellness packages featuring guided hiking, fishing, and equine programs rooted in Xeni culture. Its extreme remoteness—accessible by a single road into Nemiah Valley—makes it a rare destination-class stop in an otherwise very sparse stretch of Central Interior BC.
a2af65e166: The Guesthouse at Crowsnest Vineyards is a family-run 3-star, 7-room bed and breakfast set among the vineyards and orchards of the Similkameen Valley, right on the Crowsnest Highway #3 just south of Cawston. A continental breakfast of fruits, breads, charcuterie, and coffee is included with each stay, and guests have access to an on-site restaurant, winery, tasting bar, and bakery. The rural vineyard setting and views from above the orchard make it a distinctive and self-contained stop for anyone cycling the Similkameen.
f5fd09a6c7: Copper Fern Guest House is a self-contained 780 sq. ft. suite on a private lane just five minutes from downtown Courtenay in the Comox Valley on Vancouver Island. Hosts Chris and Molly are long-time local residents who greet guests with homemade muffins, granola, and fresh eggs and can point cyclists toward favourite trails, beaches, and restaurants. The suite is designed to be wheelchair accessible and sleeps up to four, offering a quiet garden retreat away from traffic.
ba9de87397: Mt. Washington Guesthouse is a self-catering vacation rental property managed by Cona Vacation Getaways, a family-run boutique company operating multiple chalets and lodges near Mount Washington Alpine Resort on Vancouver Island. The company was founded by two avid outdoor enthusiasts with a background in eco-tourism and began as a backpacker's hostel in Courtenay before expanding into vacation rental management. The Mount Washington area offers both alpine and Nordic terrain and is a destination for mountain biking, making this rental a possible base for cycle-touring or trail riders.
282a0d0bd1: Berkie's is a licensed bed and breakfast in Port Alberni hosted by Bob and Yvonne Rogers, who emphasize home cooking and personalized hospitality in a residential setting. Port Alberni sits at the mid-island crossroads for cyclists heading to Tofino and Ucluelet (1.5 hours away) and serves as a base for exploring the salmon-rich Alberni Valley, Stamp Falls, Della Falls, and the Frances Barkley cruise through Barkley Sound. The property is within walking distance of Save-On Foods, a liquor store, a pharmacy, and other everyday conveniences.
ed6e94464a: A hostel and guesthouse housed in a beautifully converted 1912 Methodist church in Port Alberni's Uptown Art District. The venue doubles as a live music hall that hosts over 100 touring musicians per year, giving overnight guests a unique cultural experience. Accommodation ranges from shared dorm-style bunk rooms to a private 1000-square-foot guesthouse suite, all with keypad self-check-in.
02c83f55ba: Kye Bay BnB is a quiet seaside bed and breakfast near Comox on Vancouver Island, offering three individually themed private suites—Starfish Cove, Driftwood Cove, and Beachcombers Cove—each with its own private locked entrance and full ensuite bathroom. The property sits a 2–3 minute walk from a wildlife-rich beach and is a 10-minute drive from the town of Comox, making it a tranquil base for exploring the Comox Valley. Guests receive a full hot home-cooked breakfast served on the garden patio or in-room, with food allergy accommodations available.
b894c1d148: Stone Tree Cottage is a private, self-catered 750 sq ft vacation cottage in Courtenay's Comox Valley, set within one acre of owner-cultivated botanical gardens that back onto a 20-acre nature park with walking trails. The fenced and gated property offers genuine seclusion, with two bedrooms and a fully equipped kitchen for self-sufficient stays. It sits minutes from downtown Courtenay, making it a quiet base from which to explore the wider Comox Valley by bike.
c26ffb18c1: Royston House B&B is a carriage-house loft suite set on 2+ park-like acres in the seaside community of Royston, just outside Courtenay on Vancouver Island. The property fronts directly onto the Royston Waterfront Trail along Comox Bay, and is recognised as a Canadian Wildlife Certified Backyard Habitat with woodlands, ponds, and deer trails. Guests stay in a self-contained suite with a private entrance and covered ocean-view deck, and breakfast is served in a glass-enclosed plant solarium.
ffc3d92a96: Coquihalla Lakes Lodge is a self-catered wilderness cabin resort set at 1200m in the Cascade Mountains, halfway between Hope and Merritt on the Coquihalla Highway. The property borders Coquihalla Summit Park and Crown land, with lakeside cabins sleeping up to 8 people. Offered activities include mountain biking, hiking, boating, fishing, and ATV riding, making it a base for multi-sport backcountry trips.
036ab48cec: Frog Hollow Emergency Shelter is a free, publicly accessible wilderness cabin in the Manning Provincial Park area of British Columbia, operated by the Summit Seekers Snowmobile Club. As an unstaffed emergency shelter, it provides basic refuge for backcountry travelers caught in difficult conditions. Touring cyclists traversing remote routes in the Okanagan highlands may find it a useful last-resort overnight option.
2215d12974: Skidegate Inlet Retreat is a Haida-owned-and-operated property in Queen Charlotte on Graham Island, offering two self-contained suites — the Eagle Suite (sleeps 6) and the Raven Suite (sleeps 4) — with panoramic views over Skidegate Inlet and authentic Indigenous art throughout. The retreat sits on a hillside between the inlet and cedar forests, within walking distance of the marina, restaurants, and the farmers market, making it a comfortable base for exploring Haida Gwaii by bicycle. Host Robert is available to help guests connect with local adventure operators and cultural sites including the Ḵay Llnagaay Heritage Centre.
235fd83cfb: Mount 7 Lodges is a collection of three private luxury wilderness chalets perched above Golden, BC, offering 360-degree views of the Canadian Rockies and Purcell Mountains. The property sits near Kicking Horse Mountain Resort in one of BC's premier outdoor adventure towns, making it a natural base for exploring the region. Each self-contained lodge sleeps between two and eight guests, with one lodge (Red Fox) designed to universal accessibility standards.
e46cc4bfb9: Copes' Islander is a family-run oceanfront B&B on the Comox Peninsula of Vancouver Island, operated by hosts Mike and Patti since 1996, with direct beach access and sweeping views of the ocean and Coast Mountains. The property sits minutes from the Comox (Little River) BC Ferries terminal, making it a convenient stop for cyclists travelling between Vancouver Island and the Sunshine Coast. Patti's elaborately prepared breakfasts are a noted highlight of the stay.
4e96031858: The Johnson Yew and Arbutus Cabins are two adjoining modern log cabins opened in 2009 at Loon Lake Lodge & Retreat Centre, a UBC-operated wilderness retreat facility nestled in the Malcolm Knapp Research Forest roughly 50 km east of Vancouver. Together the cabins sleep up to 48 guests in shared bunkroom-style rooms, each with a writing desk and WiFi, and both buildings are connected on the ground floor with lounge areas and fireplaces. The broader Loon Lake property offers hiking, waterfront activities, sauna, and on-site dining, making it a full-service but group-oriented destination.
16e537613a: A luxury wilderness lodge in Bella Coola on BC's Central Coast, nestled between the Coastal Mountains within the Great Bear Rainforest. The property offers 10 spacious guest rooms with mountain views and private bathrooms, plus a common area with complimentary coffee and tea. A rare full-service accommodation option for cyclists reaching the end of Highway 20.
5c21e56419: McMurdo Cabin is a rustic backcountry wilderness hut in the Northern Purcell Mountains, one of five remote huts maintained by the Columbia Valley Hut Society, a non-profit founded in 1983. The area around the cabin offers wildlife viewing, high country travel in summer, and ski touring in winter. Access requires backcountry travel with variable hiking distances depending on route-finding and seasonal road conditions.
3817ba4e8b: Scott Duncan Hut is an Alpine Club of Canada backcountry wilderness hut situated at 2682 metres elevation in British Columbia, making it one of the higher-elevation ACC huts in the region. Operated by the ACC and requiring a fee, it serves as a base for mountaineering and alpine objectives in a remote setting. Touring cyclists who venture into this terrain would find basic backcountry shelter in an exceptional mountain environment.
50682e3a9b: A Days Inn by Wyndham franchise hotel located in Victoria's Uptown area along Gorge Road East, part of one of North America's largest economy hotel chains. Positioned a short distance from central Victoria, it offers a familiar mid-range lodging option for cyclists touring Vancouver Island. As a branded chain property, it provides predictable standards and loyalty program integration for Wyndham Rewards members.
ee13373220: Sunwolf Riverside Resort offers 13 contemporary riverside cabins nestled in old-growth forest halfway between Vancouver and Whistler, making it a natural stop on the Sea-to-Sky cycling corridor. The property includes Fergie's Cafe, an on-site brunch restaurant that has won Best Breakfast from locals every year since 2015, drawing on locally sourced ingredients. The resort is family-owned, pet-friendly, and holds a Sustainable Tourism Certification.
bf779c5f8e: Sooke Harbour House is a boutique oceanfront hotel and resort perched at the edge of the Strait of Juan de Fuca on Whiffin Spit Road in Sooke, BC. The property features individually designed rooms and suites with West Coast styling, an on-site restaurant, cafe, and wine cellar, and has recently undergone a change of ownership and revival under Catalog Hospitality. For touring cyclists approaching from the Galloping Goose Trail or the southern tip of Vancouver Island, it represents a notable endpoint or overnight destination with ocean-view rooms and on-site dining.
d4c4782a44: A four-story Sheraton-brand hotel in Victoria's McCallum area offering standard mid-range accommodation. As an established chain property, it provides reliable service; specific bike storage and tour-friendly services require direct inquiry.
a540199118: The Ramada by Wyndham Surrey/Langley is a mid-scale chain hotel situated on Highway 10 in Surrey, within the broader Langley/Surrey corridor of the Fraser Valley. As part of the Wyndham hotel family, guests can earn loyalty points on stays. Its highway-adjacent location makes it a practical overnight stop for cyclists passing through the Metro Vancouver suburbs on longer tours.
da23fd208d: The Prestige Prince George Lodge is part of a family-owned BC hospitality chain with 19 properties across 14 destinations in the province. Sitting on the Cariboo Highway in Prince George, it serves as a gateway stop for cyclists travelling through Northern BC. All Prestige properties are noted as dog-friendly and participate in the chain's loyalty rewards program.
6ab3c7b306: WorldMark Victoria is a Club Wyndham vacation ownership resort in the heart of Victoria, BC, steps from the Inner Harbour and the city's Victorian-era architecture. It holds an RCI Gold Crown Resort award and is managed by Wyndham Vacation Clubs. The resort offers suite-style accommodations and is noted for no air conditioning and limited parking, with 24-hour front desk service.
18fcf9f3f3: The Shepherd's Inn is a family-owned roadside complex on the Alaska Highway at Mile 72, roughly 42 km northwest of Fort St. John, billing itself as 'An Oasis on The Alaska Highway.' The property combines a motel, full-service restaurant with to-go orders, a convenience store, and a fueling station under one roof. For northbound or southbound Alaska Highway tourers, it is a rare multi-service stop in a long, remote stretch of highway.
b61d1e550e: A full-service Delta Hotels property located at Songhees Road near Victoria's waterfront. As a resort-class accommodation with spa services, it provides standard hotel amenities for traveling cyclists. The location offers access to Victoria's downtown and waterfront areas.
ef9b539f23: Comfort Suites Kelowna is an 83-suite all-suite hotel on Highway 97 North, conveniently situated about 10 minutes from Kelowna Airport and close to downtown, beaches, and the Okanagan wine country. The property features an indoor pool with a 40-foot waterslide, a 24-hour fitness centre, and a complimentary hot breakfast buffet, making it a comfortable base for multi-day touring. It is pet-friendly and offers a range of suite types including wheelchair-accessible and family configurations.
193a7b1928: Kings Motor Inn is an affordable highway motel on the Trans-Canada in Kamloops offering a range of room types including kitchenette options with mountain views. Guests have access to an indoor pool, a BBQ area, and 24-hour front desk service. It is a dog-friendly property positioned as a convenient stopover for travelers passing through Kamloops.
7abacb0542: Rosellen Suites is a boutique extended-stay hotel in Vancouver's West End, steps from Stanley Park and the Seawall — one of North America's premier urban cycling routes. Spacious suites from 600 to 1,900 square feet come with full kitchens, making meal prep practical for touring cyclists on multi-day itineraries. The quiet residential setting on Barclay Street puts cyclists within easy reach of English Bay, the Seawall, and the restaurant strips of Denman and Davie Streets.
b9e57021a5: Super 8 Kelowna is a Wyndham-branded motel situated on Highway 97 North, a major arterial route through Kelowna and a key corridor for cyclists touring the Okanagan. As part of a large national chain, it offers standardized roadside motel accommodations in a commercially dense area with numerous services nearby.
e8f19c3b09: A three-level Sandman Hotels property in central Squamish, offering standard hotel accommodations with air conditioning and Wi-Fi. As a branded chain hotel, it provides reliable lodging for touring cyclists passing through the area, though specific bicycle storage policies require direct inquiry.
4985b15048: Bathgate Resort & Marina is an accommodation facility with marina amenities located in Egmont, BC. It offers overnight lodging with WiFi for guests, positioned as a stopping point for travelers including cycling tourists.
4f8ade3936: Alpine Inn is a motel in Valemount, a small community on the Yellowhead Highway in central BC. It provides overnight accommodation to travelers passing through this region and may serve as a stopping point for touring cyclists.
62f837df3f: A full-service waterfront resort set on a secluded stretch of Okanagan Lake shoreline, roughly midway between Penticton and Kelowna in the heart of BC wine country. Accommodation is offered in fully outfitted suite-style rooms with gourmet kitchens, and on-site facilities include iKhaya Day Spa, boat rentals, and complimentary kayak and stand-up paddleboard use. It sits along the popular Naramata Bench and South Okanagan cycling corridor, making it a comfortable base for multi-day touring cyclists.
e6a7f9d564: Legends Whistler is a slopeside condominium-style lodge in Whistler's quieter Creekside neighbourhood, offering one- to three-bedroom suites with full kitchens just steps from the Creekside Gondola to Whistler Blackcomb. Some suites overlook the 'Dave Murray' ski run, venue for the 2010 Winter Olympic Alpine events. The Creekside location gives touring cyclists a calmer base than the main village while remaining close to local dining and gondola access.
e5bedf45c0: Middle Beach Lodge sits on 40 acres of secluded West Coast oceanfront near Tofino, featuring two lodges, twenty rustic self-contained cabins, and newer treehouse accommodations perched above the rainforest. The property includes nearly a mile of private beach, rocky headlands, hand-cut forest walking trails, and an on-site lounge serving lunch and dinner. Ocean kayaking excursions are offered, making it a scenic base for exploring the Pacific Rim coast.
082fb5ecec: Rosewood Inn is a VI Resorts timeshare vacation club property housed in a historically preserved building steps from Victoria's Inner Harbour. Each unit is unique in style and décor, and the location puts cyclists within easy reach of heritage home neighbourhoods, Beacon Hill Park, and the Galloping Goose Trail. The Royal BC Museum and Fisherman's Wharf are also nearby on foot.
e51d0eaeb4: A boutique oceanfront hotel set along the rugged sandstone shores of Galiano Island in BC's Gulf Islands, just a 5-minute walk from the ferry terminal — making it easy to arrive without a car. The property includes the Atrevida Restaurant & Orca Lounge serving contemporary West Coast cuisine, and the Madrona Del Mar Spa. Smart car and van rentals are available on-site for touring the island's winding roads.
3a6d6222fa: Tyax Lodge & Chalets is a remote wilderness lodge and wedding venue set on Tyaughton Lake in the Southern Chilcotin Range, north of Whistler near Gold Bridge, BC — a region well known for its mountain biking. The property offers lodge rooms, three self-catered private chalets (4-, 6-, and 9-bedroom), a campground, gourmet dining, a full spa, and heli-skiing, making it one of the more complete wilderness destinations in the BC interior. It has been nominated for Canada's Leading Wilderness Resort 2025 at the World Travel Awards.
9b8445bc48: A motel in Vernon offering overnight accommodation. Located on 35 Street, it serves travelers and tourists passing through the community.
5179a76087: Moberly Lodge is a log-lodge-and-cabins property set on 12 acres near Golden, BC, offering a range of rooms from lodge suites to self-contained cabins such as the Columbia and Kicking Horse Cabins. Guests consistently highlight the spectacular mountain views, a hot tub, and home-cooked breakfasts served at the lodge. Its secluded, wooded setting makes it a characterful overnight option for cyclists exploring the Rocky Mountain Trench and Kicking Horse corridor.
fbecf0f330: Edgewater Motel provides overnight accommodation in Penticton on Skaha Lake Road. It serves as a standard stopping point for travelers passing through the area, including touring cyclists.
267abe3119: Glacier Lodge is a vacation rental condo property in Whistler managed through WhistlerAccommodation.com (Blackcomb Peaks), which specializes in ski-in/ski-out rentals on Blackcomb Mountain. The three-storey building offers self-contained units typical of Whistler's condo-hotel market, with at least one unit (212) listed as an active rental. Its location near Chateau Boulevard places it within easy reach of Whistler Village and the surrounding trail network.
9d985023d3: Middle Beach Lodge is a secluded oceanfront retreat spectacularly set on 40 acres of West Coast wilderness, featuring two lodges, twenty rustic self-contained cabins, and newly added treehouse accommodations perched in the forest canopy. The property includes nearly a mile of private beach, rugged headlands, and a hand-cut forest trail system for quiet nature walks. An on-site lounge serves lunch and dinner, and Tofino's eclectic village is just 3km away.
661d4e31a9: 5000 Motel is a roadside accommodation located on Main Street in Penticton. It offers basic guest rooms in a cycling-friendly region. Specific amenities and bike-friendly features could not be verified due to website unavailability.
b82fc7f0a2: Harrison Beach Hotel is a newly renovated boutique property managed by True Key Hotels & Resorts, situated steps from Harrison Lake in scenic Harrison Hot Springs. The hotel offers lake-view and mountain-view suites with kitchenettes, an indoor pool, outdoor hot tub, and fitness room. Its central location—within walking distance of the beach, shops, and restaurants—makes it a practical base for cyclists touring the Fraser Valley.
987881ab64: The Bedford Regency is a 40-room European-style boutique hotel housed in one of Victoria's cherished heritage buildings near Bastion Square, with roots going back to the Garrick's Head Saloon of 1867. It sits on Government Street in the heart of downtown Victoria, steps from the Inner Harbour, Royal BC Museum, and Beacon Hill Park. Two on-site English pubs — Garrick's Head Pub and The Churchill — serve traditional pub fare and nearly one hundred craft and import beers.
d7bf316f8b: A Marriott Fairfield Inn & Suites hotel in Penticton offering standard modern accommodation for traveling guests. Located on Eckhardt Avenue West, it provides a chain-hotel option for touring cyclists passing through the Okanagan region. Bike storage and handling procedures remain unconfirmed.
0704009cd4: A four-time TripAdvisor Traveler's Choice Award winner, the Executive Suites is a full-service, all-suite hotel in the Burnaby/Brentwood area with 125 spacious suites, each equipped with a fridge, microwave, and sink. The on-site Acqua Restaurant & Bar, outdoor heated pool, hot tub, and fitness centre provide solid infrastructure for a multi-night stay. The hotel sits minutes from a SkyTrain station, giving car-free or bike-and-transit cyclists quick access to downtown Vancouver.
124f45b8c1: The St. Regis Hotel is an independent, 100% Canadian-owned boutique hotel that has operated in the heart of downtown Vancouver since 1913, housed in a heritage building that has been extensively renovated. With 65 luxuriously appointed rooms and suites, it is steps from the Convention Centre, cruise ship terminal, and major shopping. A recipient of TripAdvisor Travellers Choice and Forbes Recommended Hotel awards, it includes complimentary full breakfast and Wi-Fi with every stay.
ceebdcea4d: North House Tofino is a luxury vacation rental company offering five self-catering properties on the rugged west coast of Vancouver Island, ranging from oceanfront hotel suites to a spacious six-bedroom oceanview home. Properties are positioned near Pacific Rim National Park Reserve and Clayoquot Sound, putting guests within reach of world-class surf beaches, ancient rainforests, and whale-watching opportunities. As a self-catering rental model, guests have private use of full accommodation units rather than traditional hotel services.
9cd6dbd7e9: The Best Western Plus Country Meadows is a full-service hotel in Aldergrove, BC, situated in the Fraser Valley between Langley and Abbotsford, about 45 minutes from Vancouver. Independently owned and operated by a family-run hospitality group with eight properties across BC and Alberta, the hotel features an indoor pool, fitness centre, and a variety of room types including Jacuzzi suites and accessible rooms. An on-site White Spot restaurant and complimentary hot breakfast make it a practical overnight base for touring cyclists moving through the Fraser Valley corridor.
f7ac84d015: Nancy Greene's Cahilty Lodge is a 168-room ski-resort hotel in the heart of Sun Peaks village, managed by Bear Country Property Management and named after Olympic skiing legend Nancy Greene. The property offers a range of unit types from standard hotel rooms to 3-bedroom suites, with ski-in/ski-out access directly onto the runs in winter. Its central village location puts guests steps from dining, shopping, and spa amenities, making it a convenient base for both winter and summer mountain activities.
846d3d5728: Key-oh Lodge is a 42-room hotel on the Yellowhead Highway (Hwy 16) in Burns Lake, open since 2017, making it one of the newer accommodations in the area and a natural stopover for cyclists travelling between Prince George and northern BC communities. The lodge offers 24/7 front desk service, daily housekeeping, and a spacious parking area large enough for transport trucks and RVs. A sister property downtown (Key-oh Hotel) includes a restaurant and pub.
0910e48ccc: Cherry Tree Inn is a quiet, family-owned motel set in 1.6 acres of gardens on the Saanich Peninsula, about 10 minutes north of downtown Victoria. It sits near the Galloping Goose Trail, a major multi-use cycling corridor, and is conveniently positioned for cyclists arriving or departing via BC Ferries, Washington State Ferries, or the Coho Ferry from Port Angeles. The property is pet-friendly and all rooms are non-smoking, offering a low-key countryside feel close to urban amenities.
bdac43d75b: Days Inn & Suites by Wyndham Langley is a franchise chain hotel in Langley, BC, part of the broader Wyndham Hotels & Resorts family. Located on Logan Avenue, it serves travelers passing through the Fraser Valley corridor east of Vancouver. Touring cyclists will find it a recognizable budget-tier overnight option in a community with urban services nearby.
eb35a00cab: A 7-level Holiday Inn located on Cambie Road near Vancouver Airport in Richmond. Standard chain hotel offering reliable corporate amenities and free Wi-Fi. Touring cyclists can expect standard hotel services in a convenient location for airport access.
67aba5bcb2: Arbutus Inn is a 52-room, 3-story affordable hotel centrally located on Douglas Street in Victoria at the crossroads of Burnside Road East and Dunedin Street. Offering renovated rooms with free parking and a National Car & Truck Rental kiosk on site, it sits within easy reach of downtown Victoria, Mayfair Mall, and the Gorge Waterway. Guest reviews consistently praise the friendly and accommodating staff, including willingness to hold luggage after checkout.
50e41d2949: Executive Inn Whistler is a boutique hotel situated directly on Village Stroll in the heart of Whistler Village, part of the Executive Hotels & Resorts group. The property markets itself as a year-round adventure base with amenities including a heated outdoor pool, cardio fitness centre, and secure ski and bike storage. Its central village location gives touring cyclists immediate access to Whistler's trail network, restaurants, and services.
1fdeeea82c: Buckinghorse River Lodge is a hotel on the Alaska Highway in northern British Columbia. Located in a remote community, it provides accommodation for highway travelers. The Alaska Highway is a major cycling touring route.
d4075bb4b7: The Sandman Hotel Castlegar is a mid-size chain hotel on Columbia Avenue in Castlegar, part of the national Sandman Hotels group. Amenities include an indoor pool, fitness centre, free parking, and pet-friendly rooms, making it a comfortable layover for cyclists passing through the Kootenay region. The property has earned Bronze Certification from GreenStep Solutions under Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards.
643beba32d: Grandpa's Heart at Nicklen Lake is a lakefront cabin resort set on two acres of Okanagan territory near Vernon, BC, offering seven named cabins of varying sizes from bunks to deluxe two-bedroom units. Guests can relax in a large gazebo overlooking Nicklen Lake, rent rowboats, or participate in occasional wellness and cultural programming. The property is dog-friendly and promotes a personalized, retreat-style experience away from city life.
10b1389152: Built in 1928 and listed as a heritage property, The Plaza Hotel anchors downtown Kamloops with renovated rooms that blend preserved historic character with modern comforts. It operates an explicitly cyclist-focused program, offering a locked interior bike storage room, a dedicated bike cleaning station, and a biking-specific room rate. An on-site restaurant featuring locally-raised steak, complimentary hot buffet breakfast, and complimentary YMCA access make it a well-rounded base for multi-day touring.
1c477fcf32: A Victoria landmark since 1913, the Strathcona Hotel sits in the heart of downtown and combines a hotel with nine bars, a live music venue, and a liquor store under one roof. Known locally as 'The Strath,' it draws visitors and locals alike with BC's largest pub, the Sticky Wicket, offering food and live entertainment. A touring cyclist would find it conveniently located in the urban core with on-site evening dining and vibrant nightlife immediately available.
0d672f2cda: Standard Quality Inn & Suites chain hotel in Vernon, BC, offering conventional guest rooms. Located on 32 Street in the local area. A typical accommodation option for touring cyclists passing through the Okanagan region.
8346efbdaa: Mulvehill Creek Wilderness Inn is a small inn situated on Highway 23 South outside Revelstoke, a route that carries touring cyclists toward the Shelter Bay ferry and the Columbia River valley. Its name references the creek and wilderness setting along Upper Arrow Lake. It is the kind of remote roadside accommodation that touring cyclists on multi-day routes through the Selkirks would rely on.
830f4db6d4: Dutch Lake Motel is a motel accommodation in Clearwater, BC, located in the Thompson-Nicola backcountry. It provides lodging for cyclists and other travelers passing through the region.
66c5e12ca4: Prestige Inn Nelson is a full-service hotel on Front Street in Nelson, part of a family-owned British Columbia chain of 19 properties spanning the province from the Kootenays to Vancouver Island. Nelson sits at the heart of the Kootenay Rockies cycling region, making this a natural base for touring cyclists passing through or staging multi-day rides. The property is explicitly dog-friendly and offers a loyalty rewards program for repeat stays.
88c0cf8195: Established in 1983, Granville Island Hotel is a boutique three-storey waterfront property perched on Vancouver's Granville Island, with direct views of False Creek and the downtown skyline. It has been recognized by Condé Nast Traveller, TripAdvisor, and Travel + Leisure as one of Vancouver's best hotels, and its location puts cyclists within walking distance of the seawall, False Creek Ferries, and the Granville Island Public Market. The surrounding neighbourhood offers artisan shops, live music, and waterfront dining right at the doorstep.
d56827ae1d: Wahous Wilderness Lodge is an Indigenous-owned floating retreat resting in the sheltered waters of Quait Bay within Ahousaht territory, deep in Clayoquot Sound. The lodge features 16 private guest rooms with waterfront decks, four secluded cabins, a cedar longhouse, a shoreline spa, and tide-to-table dining at its on-site restaurant. Stays are all-inclusive and immersive, centred on Nuu-chah-nulth cultural experience and soft adventure in old-growth rainforest.
1ef4727e56: The Maq Hotel is a recently reimagined boutique hotel sitting in the heart of Tofino with harbour views, locally commissioned art in every room, and a lively on-site scene that includes a café, bierhaus, and pub. With decades of history behind it and a self-described 'one-stop hub' ethos, it draws both travellers and locals alike. Touring cyclists finishing a west coast ride will find a centrally located, dog-welcoming base steps from Tofino's surf beaches and amenities.
c7f9cc75f7: The Ambassador Hotel is a three-storey hotel on Granville Street in downtown Vancouver, situated in an area with dense transit links and walkable amenities. Its Granville Street location places it near the entertainment district and close to the Granville Bridge cycling corridor. The hotel's current operational status is uncertain as its domain has lapsed and been taken over by a third-party hosting company.
8fb1a8d576: WILDPOD is a luxury glamping site on the Tofino waterfront consisting of six geodesic domes at the tip of Grice Point, each with panoramic views of Clayoquot Sound and the 5,000-year-old Tla-o-qui-aht village of Opitsat. The site is adults-only and couples-focused, with each self-contained dome featuring an ensuite bathroom, kitchenette, propane fireplace, and a private cedar deck with Adirondack chairs. Its position at the edge of Tofino's downtown core puts restaurants, shops, kayaking, and bike rentals within minutes on foot or by bike.
9ed65ccf1d: Gravity Haus Revelstoke is a boutique adventure-lifestyle hotel positioned as a basecamp for skiers, riders, and outdoor explorers in Revelstoke, surrounded by the Selkirk and Monashee ranges. Formerly a Motel 6 and later known as Gateway Inn, it has been reimagined as part of a North American network of mountain-town hospitality properties. On-site amenities include hot tubs, the Lüft après bar, gear rentals, and access to nearby trails and bike paths.
44210ac9d9: Seaview Suites is a family-owned premium suite property on Cordova Bay Road offering fully furnished one-bedroom suites with ocean views overlooking Haro Strait and towards Mount Douglas Park. Each suite comes with a full kitchen, ensuite washer/dryer, and complimentary Wi-Fi, making the property well-suited for self-catering stays of a week or longer. Located near the Cordova Bay area and a straightforward 20-30 minute ride from BC Ferries' Swartz Bay terminal, it sits at a natural entry point for cyclists arriving on Vancouver Island.
e90c454c57: Travellers Motel is a 12-room motel in Cranbrook, BC, winner of a 2022 Traveller Review Award, offering standard and kitchen-equipped rooms alongside an on-site launderette and BBQ facilities. Situated 7 minutes from the airport, it lies close to the Mara Trail and within easy reach of Fort Steele and the Canadian Museum of Rail Travel. Its central East Kootenay location makes it a practical overnight base for cyclists passing through or exploring the region.
9c04c42170: Super 8 by Wyndham is a budget-friendly motel chain property situated on Victoria Street West at the western approach to Revelstoke, a town that serves as a natural hub for cyclists exploring the Columbia River valley and the surrounding mountain routes. As part of the Wyndham Rewards program, guests can earn points toward future stays. The motel offers standard roadside accommodation in a community well-positioned between Rogers Pass and the Okanagan.
b355302e35: A small 8-room motel in Woss, BC. Website unreachable; bike storage and touring amenities could not be verified. Direct contact recommended for cycling-specific inquiries.
75ba96c8b3: Rivermount Motel is a year-round motel, campground, and RV park on the North Thompson River near Little Fort, BC, serving as a natural staging point for Wells Gray Provincial Park — 'Canada's Waterfall Park' — located 66 km away. The property doubles as a hummingbird sanctuary, with hundreds of birds from multiple species visiting May through August. An on-site fully licensed restaurant offers Chinese dine-in and takeout, and the surrounding corridor is renowned for fly fishing, hiking, hunting, and access to Sun Peaks Resort in winter.
585423735c: The Days Inn by Wyndham Penticton Conference Centre is a branded chain hotel located on Riverside Drive in Penticton, a hub community between Okanagan and Skaha Lakes on one of BC's most popular cycling corridors. The property includes conference facilities, positioning it as a mid-scale option for both leisure and business travellers. Penticton's location between two lakes makes it a natural overnight stop for cyclists touring the Okanagan region.
2008a59879: Vance Creek Hotel & Conference Centre is a boutique hotel situated in the heart of Silver Star Mountain Village, a four-season resort renowned for its mountain biking trail network. Guests can ride directly to and from the hotel door, with shopping and restaurants steps away in the village core. The property also offers suites with full kitchens and a range of vacation condos for longer stays.
4bdabfce08: Canada's Best Value Inn & Suites Vernon is a budget-oriented hotel operated under the Sonesta brand family, positioned off Highway 97 at 32nd Street in Vernon's North Okanagan corridor — a common through-route for cyclists travelling between the Lower Mainland and the Rockies. The property offers standard motel-style rooms with in-room appliances, a guest laundry facility, and truck and bus parking, making it functional for travellers with gear. A dense cluster of restaurants within 0.5 km provides easy access to evening meals.
abdd5a3155: Hotel Grand Pacific is a 10-storey full-service hotel on Belleville Street in downtown Victoria, steps from the Inner Harbour and the BC Legislature. The property offers multiple on-site dining venues, an Athletic Club, and event facilities, making it one of the more substantial independent hotels in the city core. Touring cyclists will find it centrally placed for exploring Victoria's extensive waterfront cycling routes.
c5b42895ed: A Fairmont luxury hotel located at Vancouver International Airport. Provides convenient overnight accommodation for touring cyclists at the airport terminal. As a major international hotel chain, it offers reliable service standards and amenities typical of upscale airport hotels.
ff266e7576: The Snowbird is a collection of slope-side, multi-level townhomes in Whistler's Blackcomb Benchlands, offering 2–4 bedroom units sleeping up to 10 people. Each unit includes a full kitchen, gas fireplace, in-suite laundry, private deck, and access to a shared outdoor hot tub. A free shuttle to Whistler Village is provided, and the property sits steps from ski-in/ski-out access and close to Whistler's extensive summer mountain biking trail network.
837f0d001c: Reef Point Cottages is a collection of self-contained cottage rentals scattered across the rainforest-meets-ocean landscape of Ucluelet on Vancouver Island's wild west coast, with unit sizes ranging from studios to a three-bedroom cottage. Several units feature private hot tubs and forest or waterfront views, and the property is pet-friendly. It sits minutes from the Wild Pacific Trail and Pacific Rim National Park, making it a practical base for touring cyclists exploring this stretch of the coast.
1ee09a9719: Kumsheen Rafting Resort has operated on the Thompson River near Lytton since 1973, hosting over 300,000 guests on whitewater trips down the Thompson and Fraser Rivers, including the iconic Hell's Gate section. The resort offers a range of accommodations from power campsites to king cabins, anchored by a central pool and hot tub area with views of White Canyon. Located in one of BC's hottest, driest regions just three hours from Vancouver, it functions as a full-service vacation destination with on-site dining and live weekend music.
cafa77a8b4: Middle Beach Lodge is a secluded oceanfront resort set on 40 acres of rugged West Coast headland, featuring two lodges, twenty self-contained cabins, and treetop treehouse accommodations overlooking the Pacific. The property includes nearly a mile of private beach, hand-cut forest trails for quiet nature immersion, and kayaking excursions — all roughly 3 km from the village of Tofino. The on-site Headlands Lounge serves lunch and dinner, making it a self-contained wilderness retreat with direct access to the Pacific Rim National Park Reserve area.
0c3138f05a: Sparkling Hill Resort is a luxury adults-only 4-Diamond wellness resort perched on a granite ridge overlooking Okanagan Lake near Vernon, BC, founded by the Swarovski crystal family and decorated with over 3.5 million Swarovski crystals throughout its 149 rooms. The 40,000 sq. ft. KurSpa draws on the European hot-cold-rest healing philosophy and offers over 100 treatments. Touring cyclists arriving after a long day on the Okanagan will find multiple on-site dining venues, including a fine-dining restaurant and a casual café.
6f6e0a98e9: Days Inn Victoria on the Harbour is a four-storey harbourfront hotel situated steps from Victoria's Inner Harbour, Parliament Buildings, and waterfront cycling trails. The property offers a range of rooms including kitchenette suites alongside a full harbourfront restaurant and bar with garden patio seating. Complimentary on-site parking is available for guests, making it a convenient downtown base for cyclists arriving by vehicle or needing secure car storage during a tour.
eb7842b4bd: A Best Western Premier hotel located just off the TransCanada Highway in Kamloops, offering views of the Thompson River Valley and surrounding mountains. The property sits close to Thompson Rivers University and key area businesses, making it a practical stop for cycle tourists passing through the interior of BC. An on-site restaurant serves all three meals.
a8e84d9acf: A family-operated hotel in downtown Castlegar, in business since 1953 and run by German-Canadian hosts who speak five languages. The property features an on-site restaurant specializing in authentic German and European cuisine, a licensed sunny patio, and a self-serve continental breakfast included with rooms. Touring cyclists will find it a characterful stop with free parking and proximity to Castlegar amenities.
8a13ccd968: A Best Western Plus property in Valemount, BC, positioned at the gateway to Mount Robson Provincial Park and the Rocky Mountains. The hotel features an indoor pool, waterslide, and hot tub, along with suites offering kitchenettes and mountain views — useful for cyclists needing to dry out and recover after a long day on Highway 5. Valemount is a key overnight stop on the Icefields Parkway corridor and this is one of the town's most prominent full-service lodging options.
75abd4920c: Travelodge by Wyndham Langley is a two-storey budget hotel situated on Fraser Highway in Langley, BC, part of the nationally recognized Travelodge chain. It sits along a major highway corridor in the Fraser Valley, making it a practical overnight stop for cyclists travelling between the Lower Mainland and the Interior. As a branded chain property it offers a standardized lodging experience with predictable amenities.
417bbbf334: A 50-room hotel in Vancouver's West End. Offers free wireless internet. General-purpose accommodation useful for touring cyclists; bike-specific amenities could not be verified.
b49319c047: Duffin Cove Resort is a private oceanfront property in Tofino offering studios, waterfront cabins perched at the edge of a private cove (accessed via 50 stairs), and a full condo suite — all set against ancient rainforest and the rugged Clayoquot Sound shoreline. Operated under The MAQ Hotel group, it sits just steps from central Tofino while feeling distinctly removed from the bustle. A touring cyclist stopping here will find a genuine west coast retreat with free parking, though the cliff-and-staircase geography of the cabins would make loaded bike handling logistically demanding.
61f1f31d39: A Delta Hotels property (Marriott brand) located on Water Street in Kelowna's downtown waterfront. This full-service resort and conference centre is a midrange accommodation option for touring cyclists passing through the Okanagan region.
eec8246288: A family-owned and operated motel in the village of Harrison Hot Springs, named after the Belgian town of Spa in tribute to its founding owner — a nod to the hot-springs resort tradition stretching back to Roman times. Situated steps from Harrison Lake with views of snow-capped mountains, the 24-room property sits at the intersection of outdoor adventure and lakeside relaxation. Two on-site restaurants (Basecamp Burger Joint and Picnic Cafe) offer guests a discount, making it a convenient base for cyclists exploring the Fraser Valley.
2b26dee866: Pendray Inn & Tea House occupies a stately Queen Anne mansion originally built in 1897 for industrialist William Joseph Pendray, making it one of Victoria's most historically distinctive hotels. The property sits steps from the Inner Harbour and Fisherman's Wharf, and is anchored by a signature Tea House serving Afternoon Tea, Scottish High Tea, and Traditional Sunday Roast Dinners. Rooms are individually appointed with heritage furnishings and named for figures in the mansion's history, offering an upscale immersion in the Victorian era.
38f8dc3b2c: The Wedgewood Hotel & Spa is a family-owned boutique luxury hotel that has anchored downtown Vancouver's entertainment district for over 40 years, situated directly across from Robson Square and the Vancouver Art Gallery. As a distinguished Relais & Châteaux member and Michelin Key property, it offers 83 recently refurbished rooms, suites, and penthouses alongside the award-winning Bacchus Restaurant. The hotel operates a named 'Wedgewood Bicycles' concierge service, signalling cycling is part of its guest offering.
5757630494: Sandman Inn is a hotel chain located in Cache Creek on Highway 1 South, a major cycling route through BC. It provides standard hotel accommodations for travelers. The highway location makes it a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists in the region.
e860263e49: The Vista Inn is a locally owned, recently renovated motel in Kamloops offering unobstructed views of the river confluence and Mount Peter and Mount Paul. The building has been fully updated with new furnishings and no carpet, and rooms feature Nespresso machines, air conditioning, and balconies. It bills itself as centrally located with free parking, dog-friendly rooms, and a sustainability focus including recyclable coffee pods.
5c0eb96e09: Gage Apartments at UBC offers studio, one-, and two-bedroom self-contained suites with full kitchens on the University of British Columbia's forested Vancouver campus, available year-round to the general public. The property is carbon-neutral, with heating and hot water supplied by biomass generation and hydroelectricity, and select suites are pursuing LEED Gold Certification. A major bus exchange is located on campus, putting downtown Vancouver roughly 25 minutes away.
e0d0da3578: Azur Legacy Collection Hotel is a 5-star luxury boutique property in downtown Vancouver, and the first and only hotel in Western Canada to join the Leading Hotels of the World. The Art Deco-inspired building houses 104 rooms, suites, and penthouses across 14 floors, with a lobby restaurant (Dahlia) and a rooftop Middle Eastern restaurant and skybar (Lavantine) on the 14th floor. It sits in the heart of the Financial District, a short walk from the waterfront and Stanley Park.
92db674c7b: The Bonniebrook Lodge is the Sunshine Coast's oldest and longest-running accommodation provider, an oceanfront heritage inn in Gibsons with roots going back nearly a century. Rated 4.5 stars (Inn category) by Canada Select, it occupies a dramatic shoreline setting with views over the Strait of Georgia. The on-site Chasters Restaurant is a well-regarded fine-dining destination offering seasonal farm-to-table menus, making it a notable overnight stop for cyclists touring the Sunshine Coast.
7b1309aace: The Royal Anne Hotel is a historic boutique property in the heart of downtown Kelowna, tracing its origins to 1905 and rebuilt on the same Bernard Avenue site after a 1971 fire. It sits within steps of Okanagan Lake, City Park, and a wide range of restaurants, making it a convenient base for cyclists exploring the region. The nearby Kettle Valley Rail Trail is specifically called out by the hotel as a scenic cycling destination.
81cabfedd7: Embassy Inn is an 80-room hotel occupying a five-storey building in Victoria's James Bay neighbourhood, within easy walking distance of the Inner Harbour, Beacon Hill Park, and the BC Legislature. Rooms range from traditional queens to suites with full kitchens, all with balconies and in-room safe. The hotel offers a complimentary hot buffet breakfast and surface or underground parking, making it a comfortable downtown base for cyclists exploring the city.
d5025da1e3: Maple Leaf Motel is a renovated motel and RV campground in Oliver, BC — Canada's self-styled Wine Capital — situated along Highway 97 close to more than 40 wineries. The property offers a range of room types, many with full kitchenettes, plus a heated outdoor pool shared with the RV campground. It is a practical overnight stop for cyclists touring the Okanagan wine corridor.
518df05a0c: Super 8 Cranbrook is a franchised budget motel on the main commercial strip of Cranbrook, part of the Wyndham Hotels family. Cranbrook serves as a gateway to the East Kootenay region and the surrounding mountains, making it a natural overnight stop for touring cyclists on Highway 3 or the Columbia Valley corridor. As a nationally recognized chain property, it offers a predictable, no-surprises stay in a town with good access to services.
5d19d0445e: Whistler Village Inn & Suites is an independent hotel spread across two lodges (Powder and Keg) tucked in a quiet cul-de-sac at the heart of Whistler Village, within 150 yards of the Excalibur Gondola and mountain bike trail access. The property offers a range of standard rooms and kitchen-equipped suites, a pool, and is dog-friendly. It is managed by Atlific Hotels and carries a short-term rental registration.
53b98cea38: Listed in OSM as a hotel at 10100 Francis Road in Richmond, BC, this property was branded under the 'Elevate Rooms' company. The 'by Elevate Rooms' suffix in the name suggests it was part of a managed accommodation brand, though the brand's domain is currently listed for sale. No independent details about the property's facilities or character are available.
8dbedbc006: Beachside Motel is part of Skaha Lake Motels, a trio of family-friendly properties clustered on Parkview Street mere steps from Skaha Lake in Penticton's Okanagan Valley. It serves as the central check-in point for all three motels in the group. Guests have direct access to Skaha Lake Park's extensive public amenities including volleyball courts, a waterpark, and a public gym directly opposite the motels.
0dd03ea4a0: The Rosewood Hotel Georgia is a beautifully restored 1927 heritage landmark in the heart of downtown Vancouver, operating as a full-service luxury hotel with a spa, fitness centre, pool, and six distinct dining and bar venues on-site. The property is steps from Vancouver's shopping, entertainment district, and offers quick access to Stanley Park.
