Touring cyclists would find it a high-end urban base with extensive in-house dining options.
61bc200a73: Hyatt Place Prince George is a branded mid-scale hotel situated in downtown Prince George, a major waypoint city for cyclists travelling the interior of British Columbia. As part of the global Hyatt Place chain, it offers a consistent, full-service lodging experience in a city that anchors connections between several long-distance touring routes. Touring cyclists passing through Prince George will find it a convenient urban base with access to city services.
a4ab8ac2b8: Kingston Hotel is a family-run, century-old budget boutique hotel in the heart of downtown Vancouver, describing itself as Vancouver's Best Budget Boutique Hotel. The 25-room property offers a mix of private and shared-bathroom rooms, an on-site sauna, and a business centre, appealing to travellers seeking affordable accommodation steps from major city attractions. Its central Richards Street location puts a touring cyclist within easy reach of the seawall, transit, and urban amenities.
71abea502b: The Sidney Pier Hotel is a contemporary seven-storey waterfront hotel situated on Sidney's vibrant harbour, designed around coastal aesthetics and the natural rhythm of the Salish Sea. The property includes an on-site farm-to-table restaurant (10 Acres at The Pier) and a full-service spa and salon (Haven Spa & Salon) that has served the community for over 15 years. Sidney's coastal cycling routes are highlighted by the hotel as a local attraction, making it a natural base for touring cyclists exploring the Saanich Peninsula.
834b819549: The Poco Inn & Suites is a 99-room full-service hotel in Port Coquitlam, situated about 30 minutes from downtown Vancouver and minutes from two SkyTrain stations. The property spans two wings offering a range of room types including kitchen suites and themed rooms, plus a fitness centre with sauna, on-site restaurant, lounge, and conference facilities. It sits near five golf courses, shopping, and dining, and has hosted at least one organized cycling fundraiser group (Tour de Fox Pacific Northwest).
8c1912c721: HI Kelowna is part of the Hostelling International Canada network, one of ten HI hostels in British Columbia and a well-established budget option on the Okanagan cycling corridor. Situated on Harvey Avenue, Kelowna's main arterial road, it is within reach of the city's lakefront, wineries, and the Kettle Valley Rail Trail. As a dedicated hostel, it caters to independent travellers including touring cyclists passing through one of BC's premier cycling regions.
7df85592af: Long Beach Lodge Resort is an award-winning luxury boutique hotel perched on the beachfront of Cox Bay in Tofino, recognized by Condé Nast Traveler and World Travel Awards as BC's leading boutique hotel. The property blends oceanfront lodge rooms and self-contained Rainforest Cottages with on-site surf lessons, a cedar sauna and hot pool, and a full-service spa. It is a full-amenity base camp for exploring the Pacific Rim coast, with e-bike rentals available through the Surf Club.
a06c1a4bad: Level Yaletown – Seymour is a boutique extended-stay hotel in Vancouver's Yaletown neighbourhood offering spacious furnished suites and townhome-style accommodations with fully-equipped kitchens and in-suite laundry. The property features over 11,000 sq ft of indoor and outdoor amenities including an outdoor heated pool, hot tub, and a 2,000 sq ft fitness centre with sauna. It sits steps from Yaletown's dining, shopping, and nightlife, and within minutes of beaches and outdoor recreation.
a7c5f0209c: A family-owned waterfront hotel in Sidney, BC, operating since 1963 and situated at the foot of Beacon Avenue with direct beach access — the only hotel on Southern Vancouver Island with that distinction. Cyclists will find dedicated secure bike storage with e-bike charging, on-site laundry, and complimentary continental breakfast included with every room. The property sits close to the Sidney ferry terminal and is surrounded by shops, restaurants, and ocean-discovery attractions.
03936a697a: Okanagan Seasons Resort is a family-friendly motel on Highway 33 West in Kelowna that has been operating since 1969, offering 68 rooms from standard queen units to three-bedroom suites with full kitchens. The property features both indoor and outdoor pools, a children's playground, outdoor volleyball, and picnic areas, making it a practical overnight base for groups and families. Its multicultural team and range of suite sizes — including kitchenette options — give touring cyclists flexibility for longer stays.
ae4fab8e2a: Tigh-Na-Mara is a long-established seaside resort nestled among trees on Vancouver Island's central coast, offering accommodation ranging from pet-friendly rustic cottages to spa bungalows and oceanview rooms. The property includes the Grotto Spa and two on-site dining venues, making it a self-contained destination well suited to multi-night stays. Parksville's beaches and central island cycling routes are immediately accessible from the resort grounds.
5e9bdd8ac6: Gold Dust Motel is a motel in Gold Bridge providing overnight accommodation for travelers.
de6efa3d80: The Fairmont Vancouver Airport is a luxury hotel physically integrated within Vancouver International Airport (YVR) in Richmond, BC, making it one of the few in-terminal airport hotels in Canada. Its location on Grant McConachie Way puts it at the heart of a major Pacific gateway and steps from the Canada Line rapid transit. For touring cyclists flying in or out of BC, it offers a premium on-site option at the region's busiest air hub.
1f934ac09f: Delta Hotels by Marriott is a 4-star hotel with 124 rooms in Delta, BC, offering non-smoking accommodation with free Wi-Fi. A mainstream chain hotel providing reliable lodging for touring cyclists passing through the region. Specific bike storage and handling procedures are not documented in available sources.
2bf6266932: Hilton Vancouver Metrotown is a full-service, 4-star hotel with 283 rooms situated in Burnaby's Metrotown district, one of Metro Vancouver's major urban centres. The property carries the Hilton brand flag, includes a bar on-site, and is wheelchair accessible. Its location adjacent to Metrotown Station makes it a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists navigating the Greater Vancouver urban corridor.
9c71ed7f85: Rosedale on Robson Suite Hotel is an all-suite property in downtown Vancouver where every room includes a fully-equipped galley kitchen and a separate living area, making it well-suited for multi-night stays. The hotel features an indoor pool complex with a lap pool, hot tub, and dual saunas, alongside an on-site breakfast room. It sits close to Pacific Central Station and Vancouver's sports and entertainment district.
76b9cb4492: A motel in Ucluelet offering overnight accommodation to travelers. No additional amenities or cyclist-specific facilities could be verified.
7eddd3c800: Prestige Hotel Kamloops is an 87-room modern hotel in Kamloops' Aberdeen neighbourhood, part of a BC family-owned chain of 19 properties. Guests have access to an indoor pool, waterslide, hot tub, fitness centre, and on-site dining at restaurant Isagani. Its location near Sun Peaks Resort and surrounding hills makes it a practical base for cyclists exploring the Thompson Plateau region.
abcae39079: Coast Capri Hotel is a full-service hotel on Harvey Avenue — one of Kelowna's main cross-city routes — making it a practical base for touring cyclists exploring Okanagan wine country, downtown waterfront, and nearby parks. The hotel offers on-site dining at Vintners Restaurant and a Coffeecopia coffee bar in the lobby, plus a seasonal heated outdoor pool. Its location near Capri Centre Mall keeps a range of services within easy reach for cyclists resupplying or resting between legs.
4b30b51637: Holiday Park Resort is a sprawling 67-acre RV and vacation condo resort situated between Kelowna and Vernon in Lake Country, BC, featuring 570 RV sites and 117 vacation condos. Founded in 1983 and open year-round, the resort is surrounded by championship golf courses, award-winning wineries, and ski hills. An on-site convenience store and bike rentals make it a practical staging point for touring cyclists exploring the Okanagan.
1ebf2a5946: The Sunshine Inn Houston is part of a four-property Northern BC chain strung along the Highway 16 corridor between Prince George and Prince Rupert, and is described as the newest of the four properties. It offers kitchenettes and air conditioning and positions itself as a comfortable stop for travellers heading to or through the Yellowhead region. Free parking and free Wi-Fi are standard across all chain locations.
caf66d8ff3: Built in 1896 during the Salmo River Valley mining boom, Hotel Ymir is one of the oldest surviving buildings in the West Kootenay region and has been fully restored as a country resort with a licensed dining room (Pau Hana), a lounge (Cowichan), and a remarkable world art collection. The hotel sits directly across from the old Burlington Northern Railway corridor, now a 50+ km converted rail trail ideal for hiking and cycling along the Salmo River. Accommodation ranges from hostel-style bunk rooms on the third floor to en-suite queen rooms and two suites with gas fireplaces.
7ccd7523da: The Orca Inn is a historic inn in Alert Bay dating to the 1930s, occupying two former buildings from the community's fishing-industry heyday. It offers a range of rooms and suites — several with ocean views where Orca whales are sometimes spotted — along with an on-site pub featuring live music. The inn is run by a hands-on owner and sits in one of BC's most culturally rich island communities, home to the U'Mista Cultural Centre.
da63892290: Cape Carraholly Retreat is a boat-access-only oceanfront sanctuary on 75 acres along the Burrard Inlet, reached by a complimentary boat shuttle from Rocky Point Park in Port Moody. Just 14 km from Vancouver, the property offers four three-bedroom lodges, five yurts, and a dome, each with a fire pit and hot tub, alongside shared amenities including a dry sauna, kayaks, and a beach shack. It borders Belcarra Regional Park, giving guests direct trail access — though the boat-only entry means touring cyclists must transport their bikes by boat.
8a6d55c732: The Haida Way Motor Inn is Port McNeill's largest hospitality complex, offering 70 guestrooms and suites on the northern end of Vancouver Island near the harbour and BC Ferries terminal. The property includes a full-service restaurant, a lively pub, and a liquor store all on site, making it a convenient one-stop overnight for cyclists arriving by ferry or heading toward Port Hardy. It is approved by BCAA and Tourism BC.
46817d00c5: The Riverside Inn is a historic boutique hotel, restaurant, and liquor store perched on the Cowichan River in Lake Cowichan, recently under new ownership with extensive renovations blending rustic and modern charm. Guest suites range from standard rooms to a full-kitchen suite, several with private balconies overlooking the river. The on-site River Cafe serves breakfast and lunch, and the property also houses the Best Buy Liquor Store — the largest beer, wine, and spirits selection in town.
fe03365901: Valemount Vacation Inn is one of the largest hotels in Valemount, offering 71 fully renovated rooms ranging from standard doubles to multi-room family suites sleeping up to eight. Situated near Highway 16 in the Robson Valley with mountain views, the property features on-site amenities including a restaurant, sauna, and hot tub. It serves as a practical base for year-round outdoor recreation in the Canadian Rockies, with hiking, rafting, and salmon fishing close by.
6d2eda2cc7: Cariboo Lodge Resort is a rustic log hotel in the heart of historic Clinton, BC, operating for over 41 years at the base of the Limestone Marble Range along the historic Cariboo Highway between Vancouver and Prince George. The property features an on-site pub and restaurant serving homestyle comfort food in a Western-themed atmosphere complete with a wood-burning fireplace, pool table, and outdoor patio. It sits close to multiple BC Provincial Parks offering hiking, mountain biking, fishing, and canoeing, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists traversing this stretch of the Cariboo.

c6a829f9fe: The Thompson Hotel is a full-service hotel and conference centre in downtown Kamloops offering a range of room types from Double Queen to Family and Double King Suites. The property features an indoor heated pool, fully equipped fitness room with cardio equipment, a 24/7 games room, and an on-site Breakfast Bistro. It is pet-friendly and welcomes guests with dogs, making it a comfortable base for touring cyclists exploring the Thompson Valley.
3eadd1e591: A family-run motel nestled on the shores of Skaha Lake in Penticton, steps from Skaha Lake Park with views of the surrounding mountains. Rooms range from a basic queen to three-bedroom suites, all with full bathrooms and most with in-suite kitchens — practical for touring cyclists wanting to self-cater. A seasonal outdoor pool and BBQ area add to the appeal for warm-weather visitors.
ac9fd23597: Kitoki Inn is a boutique forest retreat on Bowen Island offering bright, modern cabins and a private open-air onsen-style bathhouse, reached by ferry from Horseshoe Bay in North Vancouver. The inn is deliberately designed around digital detox and nature reconnection, with no televisions but an entertainment library of books, games, and puzzles. It operates with a two-night minimum and a fully contactless check-in process, making it a quiet, self-contained base for cyclists exploring Bowen Island.
d9a2ced9a3: Vogue Hotel is a downtown Vancouver hotel located on Granville Street, one of the city's main commercial corridors. The hotel's own website highlights the Granville Street area with a walking tour video, suggesting its appeal is largely tied to its central urban location. For a touring cyclist, the Granville Street position places it within walking distance of the dense restaurant, grocery, and entertainment options of Vancouver's downtown core.
356be6d411: The Sandman Signature Kamloops Hotel is a multi-storey full-service hotel in downtown Kamloops offering rooms and suites ranging from standard kings to full-kitchen suites. On-site amenities include an indoor pool, fitness centre, seasonal outdoor patio, and two dining venues—Moxies Restaurant and the Shark Club Sports Bar & Grill—making it a convenient overnight stop for cyclists needing a hot meal after a long day. The property is pet-friendly, smoke-free, and offers free overnight parking.
965138a93b: A mid-scale chain hotel in Cranbrook operated by Wyndham Hotels and Resorts, located at 600 Cranbrook Street North in the heart of the East Kootenay region. The property includes a conference centre, making it one of the larger lodging options in the area. Cranbrook sits at the crossroads of several touring routes through the Rockies and Purcell Mountains, making this hotel a practical overnight stop for cyclists passing through southeastern BC.
61972bdcd7: Super 8 by Wyndham Kamloops On The Hill is a franchise motel situated on the hill above Kamloops at 1521 Hugh Allan Drive, part of the well-known Super 8 budget chain under the Wyndham Hotels umbrella. It offers standard motel-style accommodation in a city that sits at the crossroads of several major touring routes through the BC Interior. Touring cyclists passing through Kamloops would find it a familiar, no-frills overnight base close to the Trans-Canada and Coquihalla corridors.
0cd2b04126: Tiki Village Inn is a Polynesian-themed motel and suite property in Vernon, BC, offering standard rooms, executive suites, and kitchenette units arranged around an inner courtyard with a heated pool. The property caters to short visits and extended stays alike, with free parking, on-site laundry, BBQ and picnic facilities, and a fenced dog park. Its location near major Okanagan thoroughfares and within walking distance of Vernon Jubilee Hospital makes it a practical overnight base for touring cyclists passing through the valley.
33e22fee62: The Shore Kelowna is a luxury all-suite property on Okanagan Lake in the Lower Mission neighbourhood, offering fully furnished studio through three-bedroom suites with in-suite kitchens, private balconies, and shared outdoor spaces. The property sits steps from Gyro Beach and connects to Kelowna's lakeside paths, with the website featuring a dedicated cyclists' guide to the city among its blog content. It also offers vacation-stay options alongside its primary long-term rental offering.
18a08c2ca2: The Coast Bastion Hotel is a 14-storey full-service hotel perched on the downtown Nanaimo waterfront, offering harbour and ocean views from every room via Juliet or full-size balconies. Part of the Coast Hotels chain, it features on-site dining at Minnoz Restaurant + Lounge and is steps from the Harbour Air terminal, making it convenient for cyclists arriving or departing by seaplane. The hotel explicitly welcomes bikes and offers storage, and its city-centre location puts cyclists within easy reach of Vancouver Island's ferry connections and trail network.
3572f62dbc: Holiday Inn Express branded hotel near Vancouver Airport in Richmond. A standard mid-range chain hotel offering free Wi-Fi. Part of the IHG group with typical business-hotel amenities.
783190ba9c: Riverland Inn & Suites sits directly on the Thompson River with Mount Peter and Mount Paul as a backdrop, roughly a 20-minute walk from downtown Kamloops. The property offers nearly 60 rooms including kitchenette suites, jacuzzi rooms, and a family suite sleeping six. An outdoor BBQ and sun terrace facing the river gives touring cyclists a practical place to clean up and cook.
f946cb83a4: Coast Tsawwassen Inn is a contemporary, suite-style hotel operated by the regional Coast Hotels chain, positioned just minutes from the BC Ferries Tsawwassen terminal — a natural overnight stop for cyclists crossing to Vancouver Island or the Gulf Islands. Rooms feature mini fridges, microwaves, and free wi-fi, and the property includes a fitness centre and on-site Browns Socialhouse restaurant. The hotel offers free parking and free electric vehicle charging stations on site.
e56b40aa08: The Josie Hotel is an Autograph Collection property located in Rossland, British Columbia, a mountain community in the province's Interior. Part of Marriott's distinctive brand portfolio, the hotel provides accommodation for visitors to the area.
06d4b5d6c1: MacKenzie Beach Resort is one of Tofino's oldest beach resorts, substantially renovated since 2017, offering a mix of vintage Airstream trailers, surf bungalows, cabins, and forest campsites steps from the Pacific Ocean. The resort leans into a laid-back West Coast 'Drifter Code' atmosphere with hot tubs, a sauna, beach rentals, and cocktails on-site. It sits on the Pacific Rim Highway about 2.5 km from downtown Tofino, connected by a dedicated bike path — making it a convenient base for touring cyclists exploring the area.
85636731ea: A Quality Inn branded hotel located in Victoria's downtown Inner Harbour area on Blanshard Street. As a chain hotel property, it offers standard lodging services for visitors to the region. A resource for touring cyclists passing through Victoria.
3dae598de5: Waters Edge Shoreside Suites occupies its own small spit of land within Ucluelet Harbour, offering self-contained condo suites with full kitchens, private entrances, and many featuring outdoor soaker tubs on decks overlooking the inlet and marina. The property sits minutes from the Wild Pacific Trail and serves as a natural launching point for Pacific Rim National Park, storm watching, and marine wildlife tours. An on-site Aveda day spa adds a distinctive amenity for guests looking to recover after time on the road.
4701ac1704: Days Inn Nanaimo is a 79-room mid-range hotel positioned midway between the Duke Point and Departure Bay Ferry Terminals, making it a convenient overnight stop for cyclists arriving or leaving Vancouver Island by ferry. The property is one of the few hotels in Nanaimo with an indoor pool and hot tub, and it offers an on-site full-service restaurant (Ricky's All Day Grill) as well as a complimentary continental breakfast. Pet-friendly and kitchenette rooms are available, and the front desk is staffed around the clock.
94ae3c03a6: The Aspens on Blackcomb is a slope-side condominium complex in Whistler's Upper Village offering ski-in/ski-out access directly to Blackcomb Mountain. Managed by Blackcomb Peaks Accommodations, it features over 60 fully-equipped one- and two-bedroom condos with full kitchens, a heated outdoor pool, and three hot tubs. The complex sits about a 5–10 minute walk from Whistler Village, providing convenient access to restaurants, services, and the valley trail network.
ac4b76b148: A mid-scale chain hotel and suites property in Williams Lake offering standard rooms, studio suites, and multi-bedroom kitchen suites across several floors. The property holds GreenStep Silver Certification for sustainability practices benchmarked against Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards, including linen-reuse, recycling, and an EcoFund contribution program. On-site amenities include an indoor pool, fitness centre, and a Denny's Restaurant with room service.
aa3943c2f2: The DoubleTree by Hilton North Vancouver is a full-service hotel situated in North Vancouver's Capilano area, part of the globally recognized Hilton family of brands. It sits within easy cycling distance of the North Shore trail network, Capilano River, and the Lynn Valley corridor, making it a practical base for cyclists exploring the area. Touring cyclists can expect the standard amenities of a large hotel brand, though specific cyclist-focused services are unverified.
ad84e3f26a: Delta Hotels Kamloops is a Marriott-branded hotel located on Victoria Street in downtown Kamloops, one of the region's established chain accommodations. As a full-service property, it serves both business and leisure travelers and provides reliable lodging in a central location. Touring cyclists will find this property conveniently situated within Kamloops city center.
7aef8c786a: Motel 6 is a budget accommodation chain with a location in Fort St. John on 100 Street. It provides straightforward overnight lodging for travelers and cyclists passing through the area. As part of a widely available chain, it offers consistent, affordable accommodation.
45dc27a654: Beach Grove Motel is a small 15-room independently-run motel in the Tsawwassen neighbourhood of Delta, nestled beside Beach Grove Golf Club and within walking distance of Centennial Beach and Boundary Bay. Guests on their way to or from the BC Ferries terminal in Tsawwassen find it a convenient and unpretentious stopover, and reviews consistently highlight the friendly hands-on owners and clean, recently-refreshed rooms. Room types range from basic queen rooms to family rooms with full kitchenettes, catering to longer or self-catered stays.
425c6f8eb6: The Villa Motel is a 30-unit motel perched beside Nelson's iconic Big Orange Bridge with direct views of Kootenay Lake and the surrounding mountains. Eight room types — including full kitchenette suites — make it a practical base for longer stays in the Kootenay region. Downtown Nelson's Baker Street is a five-minute drive away, and Lakeside Park with its beach is a short walk across the bridge.
13daadeb3c: Wildwood Cabins is a cluster of four handcrafted post-and-beam cabins set on a 5-acre forested property on Bowen Island, built from local and reclaimed timber and boasting panoramic Pacific Ocean views from rock bluffs. With a 4.98-star Airbnb rating across over 3,000 reviews, the property includes a Nordic wood-fired barrel sauna, an outdoor firepit, an on-site yoga loft, and trails through old-growth forest. Cyclists arriving by ferry will find themselves within walking distance of two cideries and a farm market, with beaches and trails a short ride away.
d75586b4ad: Toad River Lodge is a family-owned full-service complex on Reflection Lake at Mile 422 of the Alaska Highway, offering motel rooms, lakeside cabins with kitchenettes, and a 23-site RV park — all open year-round. The lodge is famous for its ceiling-mounted hat collection of over 7,200 hats from around the world, and includes an on-site restaurant, laundromat, Canada Post outlet, and a service garage with tire repair, gas, diesel, and propane. For cycle tourists riding remote northern BC, it is one of the few full-service stops in a very long stretch of highway.
15478a28aa: The Marquise is a six-story condominium lodge perched on Blackcomb Benchlands in Whistler, offering ski-in/out access across the street. It features a large hot tub under a glass dome with mountain views, a heated outdoor pool open year-round, and a fitness room. Touring cyclists will find it a comfortable base in the heart of the Whistler corridor.
f6ce04d028: The Wickaninnish Inn is a celebrated boutique hotel perched at the edge of Chesterman Beach between ancient rainforests and the Pacific Ocean, and a member of the prestigious Relais & Châteaux collection. The inn features multiple on-site dining venues including The Pointe Restaurant, On the Rocks Bar, and a seasonal Driftwood Café, as well as the Ancient Cedars Spa and an art gallery. Its location adjacent to Pacific Rim National Park Reserve makes it a compelling base for cyclists exploring Tofino's beaches and trails.
1ef813c438: The Sunshine Inn Hotel is one of four properties in a small Northern BC chain strung along the Highway 16 corridor between Prince George and Prince Rupert — a common long-distance cycling route. The Smithers location sits in downtown Smithers at the foot of Hudson Bay Mountain, making it a convenient base for the Bulkley Valley. Continental breakfast is included, parking accommodates vehicles of all sizes including RVs and trailers, and 24-hour front desk service is available.
3d02603ef2: A 6-level Marriott-branded hotel on the Trans-Canada Highway in Revelstoke. Provides standard hotel accommodation for touring cyclists passing through this mountain community.
66fe3c7bcb: Mountain View Motel & Restaurant sits at Mile 100 on the Alaska Highway in the small community of Wonowon, northern BC, a strategically placed stop on one of North America's great long-distance cycling routes. The two-storey motel includes an on-site restaurant, offering both a bed and a hot meal in a section of highway where services can be widely spaced. Its Alaska Highway milepost location makes it a natural landmark and resupply waypoint for cycle tourers heading to or from Alaska.
670b8397f9: Star Lodge is a motel in Kamloops positioned near Thompson Rivers University, with rooms featuring mountain and river views and balconies overlooking the South Thompson River valley. The property caters to a broad range of travellers with bus and truck parking, pet-friendly rooms on request, and proximity to outdoor activities including mountain biking, hiking, and fishing. A picnic area, guest laundry, and ample parking make it a practical stop for those passing through or exploring the Kamloops region.
7b3222301e: The Delta Burnaby Hotel and Conference Centre is a 189-room, 4-star hotel operated by Marriott on Dominion Street in Burnaby, BC. It includes a dedicated conference centre, making it a major venue for events and business travel in the Metro Vancouver area. Cyclists staying here are within reach of Burnaby's urban trail network and the broader Lower Mainland cycling infrastructure.
238dba8f96: New Royal Inn is a hotel located on Twelfth Street in what appears to be New Westminster, BC. Its website is live but contains almost no descriptive content, making it difficult to assess what the property offers. A touring cyclist would have no way to confirm bike-friendly services from publicly available information.
c316298bb8: Lemon Creek Pioneer Campground (OSM-listed as 'Lemon Creek Lodge') is a 26-site campground in the Slocan Valley near Winlaw, BC, offering both RV hookups and treed tenting sites with firepits, indoor washrooms with hot showers, and a covered gazebo. The property sits in a quiet, non-commercial setting and is within reach of the Slocan Rail Trail and Galena Trail, two popular cycling corridors in the West Kootenays. It also accommodates small group events such as family reunions and weddings.
0121dfaf20: The Polson Park Motel is a mid-sized motel sitting directly opposite Polson Park in central Vernon, BC, on Highway 97. Rooms range from standard queen configurations to kitchenette units, and the property features a courtyard with barbecue and an outdoor pool. Its central location puts cyclists within easy reach of downtown Vernon, restaurants, and the Vernon Jubilee Hospital.
2993739ba8: Three-level motel located on Belleville Street in Victoria. Provides lodging for touring cyclists visiting the area.
af4091bc68: Harrison Lake Hotel is a pet-friendly hotel on a quiet side street in Harrison Hot Springs, just steps from the Harrison Hot Springs Public Pool and the village town centre. The surrounding region offers an abundance of outdoor pursuits including hiking, biking, canoeing, kayaking, and golfing, making it a natural base for touring cyclists exploring the Fraser Valley. The hotel includes a Courtyard Cafe serving a continental breakfast buffet as part of its Bed & Breakfast package.
fbd9fb1cdc: Marland Motel is an 18-room property on the quiet edge of Powell River on BC's Sunshine Coast, offering a range of room types from simple sleeping rooms to one-bedroom family units and standalone cottages, most with full kitchens for longer stays. It sits within walking distance of restaurants and the beach, and is close to outdoor attractions including the Sunshine Coast Trail, salmon fishing charters, and scuba diving sites. Pets are welcome, making it a practical base for touring cyclists exploring the northern Sunshine Coast.
622e0341b3: The Canadian Princess Lodge is a historic 46-room waterfront lodge and marina perched on the edge of the Ucluelet Boat Basin, halfway between Long Beach and the Wild Pacific Trail. All rooms include private balconies, fridges, microwaves, and free WiFi, with most offering water or garden views. The lodge makes an excellent base for touring cyclists exploring Pacific Rim National Park Reserve, the Wild Pacific Trail, and the surrounding west coast scenery.
d9409f623f: Level Furnished Living is the Yaletown–Richards outpost of the Level Hotels chain, offering upscale furnished suites positioned between short-term hotel stays and longer monthly rentals. Located in Yaletown, one of Vancouver's most walkable and transit-connected neighbourhoods, it targets urban travellers who want home-like space in a boutique hotel setting. The brand emphasises spacious layouts and 'lifestyle amenities,' though the specifics of those amenities are not detailed on the public homepage.
f756f5548e: The Best Western Plus Baker Street Inn is the only full-service hotel on Nelson's storied Baker Street, placing cyclists at the heart of this eclectic Kootenay mountain town celebrated for its arts scene and outdoor recreation. The property includes a convention centre and offers amenities such as free breakfast and kitchenette-equipped rooms, catering to a wide range of guests. Nelson sits at the confluence of several popular cycle-touring routes through the West Kootenay region.
fffc829f41: A motel in Surrey offering accommodation to travelers. Current amenities and services cannot be fully verified without access to current website information.
ac99c0cb70: A Sandman brand hotel located on Douglas Street in Victoria. As a mid-range hotel chain, it serves as potential overnight accommodation for touring cyclists.
d0619d7c79: Rivendell Retreat Centre is a Christian contemplative community and place of retreat situated on Bowen Island, a short BC Ferries ride from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver. The centre offers individual and group retreats across several sacred spaces — a Lodge, Cottage, Hermitage, and writers' cottage — set amid forest trails with views of mountains and sea. Retreatants bring their own food and share a communal kitchen, and the grounds include a network of walking trails through old-growth forest.
ddc29f6751: Carmana Hotel is a Canadian-owned, 96-suite boutique high-rise in Vancouver's downtown financial and shopping district, offering spacious one- and two-bedroom suites with full kitchens and floor-to-ceiling windows. Originally opened in 1999 as Carmana Plaza, it caters strongly to extended-stay guests and corporate travellers, with long-term rates available for stays of 90 days or more. It sits steps from the Stanley Park seawall, making it a practical base for cyclists exploring the city's premier waterfront cycling routes.
2e8a940f51: Pemho Pub is Pemberton's main nightlife venue, hosting regular live music acts ranging from BC blues bands to folk-pop groups, along with specialty performance nights. The pub features arcade games and a full bar, with active event programming through at least mid-2026. The name 'Pemho' appears to be a contraction of its historical identity as the Pemberton Hotel, though the current website makes no mention of accommodation.
bb3350060b: Woodrun Lodge is a ski-in/ski-out condominium-style property on the slopeside of Blackcomb Mountain in Whistler's Upper Village area, managed as vacation rentals by WhistlerAccommodation.com. Units feature fully equipped kitchens, washers/dryers, gas fireplaces, and wifi, with access to a shared heated outdoor pool and hot tub. A touring cyclist would find it a well-appointed mountain base with slope views and convenient access to both the Upper and Main villages.
c3a9ccd0a1: Best Western Inn at Penticton is a full-service hotel on Skaha Lake Road, positioned between Skaha Lake and downtown Penticton in the heart of Okanagan cycling country. The property features an indoor pool and hot tub, complimentary breakfast, and rooms with kitchenette options. It sits near the Kettle Valley Rail Trail and the Penticton waterfront, making it a practical base for multi-day touring cyclists.
076dec7d5c: The Cove Lakeside Resort is a full-service lakefront resort on Okanagan Lake in West Kelowna, offering spacious one-, two-, and three-bedroom condo-style suites with fully equipped kitchens, in-suite laundry, and private balconies. The resort features two seasonal outdoor pools, hot tubs, a spa, tennis and pickleball courts, and direct waterfront access with paddleboards and boat rentals. Its location near West Kelowna wineries and within a short ride of grocery stores and downtown amenities makes it a comfortable base for touring cyclists exploring the Okanagan.
e86fff0054: A 16-unit mountain-view hotel in Radium Hot Springs offering studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom units with or without kitchenettes. Located on the Banff-Windermere Parkway in a mountain recreation area.
38f2acabbb: The Buccaneer Inn is a harbour-front motel situated directly across from Newcastle Channel, steps from Nanaimo's Harbourside Walkway and a short distance from the Departure Bay Ferry Terminal — a practical staging point for cyclists crossing to or from the Mainland. The inn offers a range of suites with full kitchens, ocean views, and an outdoor BBQ area, giving touring cyclists a self-catering option in a waterfront setting. It is operated under the Evergreen Hospitality Group umbrella despite marketing itself as a family-run inn.
7856c084d0: Crystal Cove Beach Resort is a highly-rated oceanfront property on MacKenzie Beach in Tofino, offering 34 modern log cabins, serviced RV sites, and glamping trailers with 5th-wheel RVs — rated #1 Resort in Tofino and #1 in Canada for Families on TripAdvisor. The resort sits directly on a kilometre of sandy coastline with tidal rocks and small islands accessible at low tide, making it a destination in itself. An on-site café, Bean at the Cove, and fully stocked cabin kitchens round out the self-contained experience.
7b46e6615d: August Jack Motor Inn is a motel on Squamish's main downtown strip, Cleveland Avenue, positioning itself as a base camp for Sea-to-Sky outdoor adventures including cycling, hiking, kitesurfing, and skiing. The property sits within walking distance of the town's restaurants, coffee shops, breweries, and civic amenities. It markets mountain or garden views, a fire pit, and BBQ facilities alongside its standard room offerings.
41fdb9bb81: Château Okanagan is a European-inspired luxury estate on the shores of Okanagan Lake in Kelowna, BC, comprising two distinct properties — the Grand Residence and the Estate Villa — across 44 acres with a kilometre of private shoreline and on-site vineyards. Featured on Netflix's 'Million Dollar Secret,' it accommodates up to 24 guests across 12 rooms and offers a private spa, beach access, tennis court, and wine country setting. The Estate Villa allows individual room bookings, making it the more accessible option for solo cyclists or couples touring the Okanagan, though the entire estate is gated and advance reservation is required.
3c57b401c2: Hampton Inn Vancouver Airport is a mid-scale Hilton-brand hotel situated in Richmond close to Vancouver International Airport, making it a practical stop for cyclists arriving or departing by air. As part of the Hampton by Hilton chain it offers standardized amenities expected of a full-service airport hotel. Its Bridgeport Road location places it near the Canada Line rapid transit corridor and within the broader Richmond cycling network.
8fe9a6d692: Tyndall Stone Lodge is a 12-unit condo complex in Whistler Village North managed by Whiski Jack Resorts, offering two-bedroom and two-bedroom plus loft suites with fully equipped kitchens and powerful air conditioning. Located adjacent to Olympic Plaza and steps from Whistler's world-class restaurants and nightlife, it serves as a convenient base for cyclists exploring the area's renowned mountain biking trails. The free Village shuttle stops nearby, putting both the Whistler and Blackcomb lift bases within easy reach.
4ea5b8e7a5: Prestige Aberdeen Lodge Kamloops is a 39-room lodge property in the Aberdeen area just off the Trans-Canada Highway, part of BC's family-owned Prestige Hotels & Resorts chain. The lodge offers an onsite restaurant, fitness centre, and coin laundry, and guests have access to the indoor pool and waterslide at the adjacent Prestige Kamloops Hotel. A complimentary continental breakfast is included with all stays, making it a practical and comfortable base for cyclists passing through Kamloops.
bc62274b0a: A motel in Tofino providing overnight accommodation on Campbell Street. Details about cyclist-specific amenities and services could not be verified due to website unavailability.
1df1bf0a18: Happy Day Inn is a hotel-motel hybrid in the heart of Burnaby, about 20 minutes from Downtown Vancouver, offering a range of room types from standard to suites, some with fully equipped kitchenettes. The property includes free secured parking, complimentary continental breakfast, a fitness room and sauna, and coin laundry. Its central location near multiple transit options makes it a practical base for exploring Vancouver and the Lower Mainland.
55cb78c76b: Alpine Inn & Suites is a family-owned motel in Nelson, BC offering 30 newly renovated rooms — from standard queens to full-kitchen family suites and a jacuzzi suite — in a European-style hospitality setting. It sits one minute from downtown Nelson and 20 minutes from Whitewater Ski Resort, making it a practical base for cyclists exploring the Kootenay region. The variety of room configurations, including suites sleeping up to six guests, suits both solo tourers and small cycling groups.
13ba8b6e5d: The Prestige Beach House Kelowna is a contemporary lakeside hotel situated steps from Hot Sands Beach and directly across from City Park on Okanagan Lake, with easy walking access to downtown Kelowna. Part of a family-owned BC collection of 19 properties, it sits close to the Myra Canyon trestle cycling route and Okanagan waterfront paths that touring cyclists frequent. Guests have access to an indoor pool, hot tub, fitness centre, and an on-site restaurant.
0f8e5c115e: SoLo Suites is a modern condo-hotel in Langford on BC's Westshore, roughly 25 minutes from Victoria's Inner Harbour. Its 40 suites across six concrete-and-steel storeys each include a full kitchen and in-suite laundry, making it well-suited to multi-night touring stays. The property sits near outdoor recreation areas and provides easy access to both Westshore amenities and greater Victoria.
0b193ee323: Pangea Pod Hotel is Canada's first pod hotel, placing private capsule-style sleeping pods inside a designer, social setting minutes from Whistler's gondolas. It occupies a hybrid niche between hostel affordability and hotel privacy, with an on-site restaurant and bar (The Living Room) and a rooftop patio that the hotel bills as Whistler's only. The property is explicitly inclusive and welcomes guests of all genders, backgrounds, and sexual orientations.
dce4061828: Ace Western Motel is a motel in Clearwater, British Columbia, providing accommodation for travelers in the area. Website verification was not possible at time of review due to connectivity issues.
681b1145c2: A Sheraton hotel located near Vancouver International Airport in Richmond, providing standard hotel accommodations for travelers. Specific bike storage and amenity details could not be verified due to website access restrictions.
1f7bb5644d: The Georgian Court Hotel is a boutique 4-star property in downtown Vancouver with 180 guest rooms, executive suites, and penthouse suites, situated steps from BC Place Stadium, Rogers Arena, and the city's extensive cycling network. The hotel runs a named Bicycle Service program — one of the few Vancouver hotels to list it as a formal amenity — providing guests with complimentary loaner bikes with helmets and locks, plus e-bike rentals arranged at the front desk. Its location near the Seawall and Stanley Park routes makes it a practical base for urban cycling exploration.
2b097cdced: Pomeroy Inn and Suites is a full-service hotel in Fort St. John offering air-conditioned rooms and internet access. Located on Alaska Road North, it welcomes guests with bicycles. Specific bike storage arrangements and other cyclist-specific amenities should be confirmed directly with the hotel.
1adf3f1ab0: A mid-range motel operating under the Sonesta/Canada's Best Value Inn brand, positioned at the historic 'Mile 0' landmark in Lillooet — a natural gateway to the BC Interior for cyclists travelling the Gold Rush Trail or Fraser Canyon corridor. The property offers a range of room types from standard rooms with mini-fridges and microwaves to a family suite and a honeymoon suite with jetted tub, all in a compact Main Street location within easy walking distance of several restaurants. Truck and bus parking is listed as a property feature, suggesting the site can accommodate larger vehicles and loaded bikes.
2b77559ae5: Royal Victoria Suites is a timeshare resort property operated by VI Resorts (Vacation Internationale / Westgate) in a fully renovated heritage building in the heart of Victoria. It sits on Government Street within walking distance of major sights, restaurants, and the Inner Harbour. A rooftop deck with BBQ is available for guests.
4750fe57f7: Evolution Whistler is a modern, pet-friendly condo-style hotel in Whistler's original Creekside Village, offering spacious one-to-three-bedroom suites with full kitchens, fireplaces, and in-suite laundry. Located steps from the Creekside Gondola, it features year-round outdoor heated pools, hot tubs, and a eucalyptus steam room. The property is operated as part of a small collection of Creekside hotels and appeals to couples, families, and adventure-focused travellers seeking self-contained suite accommodation.
1220369f85: L'Hermitage is a 60-room luxury boutique hotel at the corner of Robson and Richards Streets in the heart of downtown Vancouver, blending European chic with West Coast sophistication. It offers a range of rooms and suites, including studio units with fully equipped Eggersmann kitchens and in-unit washer/dryers, alongside a rooftop heated outdoor pool, 24-hour fitness studio, and the on-site L'Orangerie dining room and lounge. The property caters primarily to business and leisure travelers seeking a high-end boutique experience in a central urban location.
3c923935af: Seaside Hotel is a boutique waterfront property on the North Vancouver shoreline, operated under the Executive Hotels & Resorts group, with panoramic views of the Pacific Ocean and Vancouver skyline from signature rooms featuring natural Pacific Northwest-inspired design. The hotel includes an on-site Italian restaurant (Provisions Italiana) and a third-floor spa with floor-to-ceiling ocean views. Located steps from the Lonsdale Quay SeaBus terminal, it offers straightforward transit access to both North Shore outdoor recreation and downtown Vancouver.
990dc5af1b: Fairfield Inn & Suites is a mid-range Marriott hotel in Kelowna, housed in a 4-level building on Powick Road. The property offers conventional hotel accommodations for business and leisure travelers. Specific bike storage arrangements and cycling-focused services are not documented in available sources.
f99ce6ead7: Quality Inn & Suites Downtown Vancouver is a mid-range Choice Hotels property on Granville Street, centrally positioned between Gastown, Yaletown, and Stanley Park. The hotel houses The Morrissey, a full-service pub and restaurant with a rock-and-roll theme, directly on the premises. Its downtown location puts guests within easy reach of Vancouver's seawall and mixed-use cycling paths.
212c092541: The Spot is a tech-forward boutique hotel in Nanaimo offering keyless smart locks, contactless mobile check-in, and minimalist modern rooms with rainfall showers and in-room mini-fridges. Located on Terminal Avenue North, it sits within easy reach of the Departure Bay Ferry Terminal, making it a convenient overnight stop for cyclists crossing between Vancouver Island and the mainland. Free parking is available for all guests and a 24/7 virtual concierge provides around-the-clock support.
74aabafe87: The Quality Inn Waddling Dog is a charming Tudor-style hotel positioned just minutes from the BC Ferries Swartz Bay terminal, Victoria International Airport, and Butchart Gardens—making it a natural staging point for cyclists arriving or departing Vancouver Island. The property houses the award-winning Waddling Dog Pub and an onsite beer, wine, and spirits store, so food and drinks are steps away after a long day in the saddle. It is dog-friendly and includes a complimentary hot breakfast each morning.
3ff8304f59: Stork Nest Inn is a family-owned boutique inn a short walk from downtown Smithers in the Bulkley Valley, operating since 2018. All rooms include a private washroom, bar fridge, flat screen TV, WiFi, and air conditioning units installed in 2023. A hot made-to-order breakfast starting at 6am is included with every stay, making it a practical base for early-starting cyclists exploring the region.
6265c44293: Comfort Inn & Suites Surrey is a four-storey chain hotel in Surrey, BC offering room types ranging from standard queen rooms to Jacuzzi suites, pet-friendly rooms, and suites with kitchenettes. The hotel provides a complimentary hot breakfast buffet, free on-site parking with oversized vehicle spaces, a fitness centre, and an outdoor patio. It sits directly across from the Surrey Sports & Leisure Complex, giving touring cyclists convenient access to Olympic-sized indoor pools and additional fitness facilities.
43164d87bd: A motor inn located in Duncan, BC. Provides accommodation for travelers, though specific amenities and bike policies could not be verified.
a488785e8c: Century Plaza Hotel is a 3-star all-suite downtown Vancouver property offering studio suites and one-bedroom suites ranging from 400 to 650 square feet, many with full kitchens. The hotel features an indoor pool, on-site steakhouse (C|Prime Modern Italian Steak and Wine), and a café (Beyond Coffee). Situated on Burrard Street, it is a short walk from Vancouver's main entertainment and shopping districts and approximately 1.5 km from BC Place.
459f6ed56e: A Sandman Hotel franchise location situated near Vancouver Airport in Richmond, providing hotel accommodation for travelers in the airport area and surrounding region.
47b82953c7: Predator Ridge is a master-planned four-season resort community in the Okanagan Valley, about 15 minutes south of Vernon, offering vacation home rentals amid 36 holes of championship golf and an extensive trail network. Touring cyclists can rent bikes on-site and access trails connecting to Ellison Provincial Park and the Okanagan Rail Trail, with a shuttle service also available. The resort serves as a natural basecamp for Okanagan wine country, with eight award-winning wineries on the nearby Scenic Sip Wine Route within a short ride or drive.
a5d5646454: Creston Valley Motel — self-described as the 'Clean to the Corners' motel — sits just east of downtown Creston within walking distance of pubs, coffee shops, and restaurants, making it a convenient overnight stop on BC's southern interior routes. The property offers a range of room types from single-bed units to full kitchen suites, a drive-through parking lot that accommodates trailers and RVs, and free high-speed Wi-Fi throughout. Pet-friendly rooms are available on request, and the about page notes walking distance to Creston's hospital for any emergencies.
be6021e4f2: Embarc Vancouver is a Hilton Grand Vacations (formerly Diamond Resorts) vacation ownership resort situated in downtown Vancouver, offering studio and one- and two-bedroom suite accommodations with kitchenettes or full kitchens. The property is steps from Stanley Park, the Seawall, Granville Island, and the Vancouver Art Gallery, making its location appealing to cyclists exploring the city. As a vacation membership product, it is unclear whether the property accepts standard overnight bookings from independent travellers.
6c960eaac1: Fairfield Inn & Suites West Kelowna is a Marriott-branded hotel located on Carrington Road in West Kelowna. It offers the standardized mid-range service typical of the Fairfield Inn chain. A familiar accommodation option for touring cyclists seeking reliable chain hotel service.
c5ceaf8df4: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Langley is a 3-level hotel providing standard chain accommodation in Langley. The property offers Wi-Fi access. Touring cyclists should contact the hotel directly to discuss bike storage and handling options.
d15464c8b9: A motel in Oliver, BC offering overnight accommodation to travelers in the South Okanagan region.
cd5ee609cc: OPUS Vancouver is a 96-room boutique luxury hotel in Yaletown, recognized by Condé Nast Traveler (Top Hotel in Western Canada 2025) and Forbes Travel Guide. The property features on-site Italian dining at Capo and a cocktail bar (The Spritz), along with spa bathrooms, digital check-in, and dog-friendly policies. A touring cyclist overnighting here would find an upscale urban base steps from Vancouver's restaurant and shopping district, though no cycling-specific services are advertised.
d822e0e29a: A small, family-operated oceanfront motel built in 1960, perched on Dallas Road with 180-degree views of the snow-capped Olympic Mountains across the Strait of Juan de Fuca. All rooms include kitchenettes, oceanfront balconies, and free off-street parking. The motel is within walking distance of Victoria's Inner Harbour and Beacon Hill Park, and sits on a main bus route.
03cb26a3a7: Artisan Suites on Bowen is a smoke-free, pet-free, self-check-in boutique hotel offering four individually designed suites on Bowen Island, located in the commercial hub of Artisan Square roughly 800 m from the ferry dock. The property is accessible by ferry from Horseshoe Bay in West Vancouver, making it a natural stopover for cyclists touring the island. Guests staying more than one night are asked to leave upper parking spaces free for day shoppers, suggesting some awareness of visitor turnover.
6343e30ba9: Holiday Inn Express is a chain hotel in Golden, BC offering accommodation to traveling cyclists. The hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi access. Specific services and facilities for touring cyclists could not be verified from available sources.
2e702e738f: The EXchange Hotel Vancouver is a luxury boutique hotel occupying the former Vancouver Stock Exchange building, recognized as Vancouver's first LEED Platinum heritage conversion. The historic Art Deco structure has been transformed by an international architectural collaboration and is now listed in the Michelin Guide and featured by Condé Nast Traveler. Situated in the core of downtown Vancouver, it is less than 200 metres from Waterfront SkyTrain station and 350 metres from the cruise ship terminal.
467aeaeec0: Whale's Tail Guest Suites offers condo-style vacation rentals in the heart of Ucluelet, with one, two, and three bedroom suites featuring full kitchens that provide a genuine home-away-from-home experience. The property sits within walking distance of the Wild Pacific Trail, restaurants, and local tour operators, making it a convenient base for exploring Pacific Rim National Park and the coast. Guests have complimentary access to the adjacent West Coast Fitness Centre, a 3,000 sq ft facility with indoor pool, sauna, and harbour views.
0fcff9a12a: Holiday Inn Express & Suites is a 147-room chain property in Richmond's Riverport area on Number 6 Road. It offers convenient overnight lodging for touring cyclists traveling through the Lower Mainland.
f8b8020bc2: The Barclay Hotel is a 3-storey heritage-style property with 85 guestrooms on Robson Street in downtown Vancouver, positioned between Stanley Park, the Vancouver Art Gallery, and Pacific Centre Mall. It markets itself as a comfortable, affordable base in the heart of the city, steps from the Seawall — a major cycling route. The Den cocktail bar is on-site, and Cora's Restaurant sits immediately next door for meals.
3295d2ca29: Four Seasons Resort Whistler is a luxury hotel in central Whistler, operated by the Four Seasons brand. It provides free wireless internet access to guests. The property serves as full-service accommodation in the heart of Whistler.
00d844eeba: Budget motel chain location on the Trans-Canada Highway in Kamloops. Basic roadside accommodation convenient for travelers on the highway corridor.
8e686dfa42: Clayoquot Retreat is a three-bedroom cedar A-frame cabin set on a private 0.4-acre old-growth property just a two-minute walk from South Chesterman Beach and its surf break. The rustic but updated cabin features a wood-burning stove, outdoor hot tub, fire pit, and a surf/wetsuit drying rack, making it a comfortable base for beach-going, surfing, and exploring the Tofino coastline. It is a fully self-catering rental listed on Airbnb, VRBO, and the local BlueCrush platform.
a71e84efbe: The Auberge Vancouver Hotel occupies the historic Terminal City Tower in downtown Vancouver, rising above Burrard Inlet with sweeping views of the harbour and North Shore mountains. It is a full-service luxury property featuring a 25-metre indoor pool, fitness centre, squash courts, saunas, and steam rooms, positioned steps from the Canada Place seawall and cycling paths leading toward Stanley Park. Touring cyclists will find the central location convenient to Vancouver's main waterfront cycling corridors and the historic streets of Gastown.
aabeee4769: Middle Beach Lodge occupies 40 acres of secluded West Coast oceanfront just outside Tofino, offering two lodges, twenty self-contained rustic cabins, and distinctive treehouse accommodations perched in the forest canopy. The property encompasses nearly a mile of private beach, rugged headlands, and a hand-cut forest trail system designed for slow, quiet exploration. Touring cyclists are 3 kilometres from Tofino's village services and can dine on-site at the Headlands Lounge.
d803a12097: First Tracks Lodge is an upscale ski-in/ski-out hotel in Whistler's Creekside neighbourhood, offering spacious designer suites ranging from one to four bedrooms, each with full kitchens. The property sits at the base of the Whistler Gondola and features four-season pools, hot tubs, and a lobby library, making it one of the more refined lodging options in Creekside. Touring cyclists visiting Whistler's world-class trail network would find it a quiet, well-appointed base away from the bustle of Whistler Village.
6e6fe67119: Hidden Cove Lodge is an off-the-grid, ocean-front eco-lodge nestled in the rainforests of Northern Vancouver Island on Johnstone Strait, powered by wind, solar, and generator. The property offers ocean-side cottages and a dining room, and has held TripAdvisor's Certificate of Excellence since 2013. It sits in a remote and spectacular wildlife corridor — orca, humpback whales, and grizzly bears are common draws — making it a notable destination lodge for cyclists exploring the northern Island Highway corridor.
eda7092b0e: Apple Tree Inn is a family-oriented motel tucked between Okanagan and Skaha lakes in Penticton, BC, offering kitchen suites and sleeper units alongside a seasonal outdoor heated pool and free barbecues. Its location on Skaha Lake Road puts cyclists within a short ride of the beach, wine country, and the broader Okanagan Valley touring network.
102fbbf8c4: Howe Sound Inn & Brewing Company is Squamish's original craft brewery, founded in 1996 with the help of John Mitchell — the 'grandfather of micro-brewing' — and has since won awards at the Canadian Brewing Awards, North American Brewer's Awards, and BC Beer Awards. The 20-room boutique inn occupies the upper floor of the brewpub building in Downtown Squamish, giving guests immediate access to craft beer and a full kitchen without leaving the property. Pet-friendly rooms are available, and the location puts guests within walking distance of the Stawamus Chief and Sea to Sky trail networks.
067ebaa3e9: Super 8 by Wyndham Abbotsford BC is a budget motel on Sumas Way, well positioned along the Trans-Canada corridor as a practical overnight stop for cyclists travelling through the Fraser Valley. The property includes a swimming pool and in-house laundry. Guests benefit from a noted 10% discount at the adjacent Abbey Road Taphouse.
ac7b45d059: Lakeside Villa is an owner-operated boutique motel tucked between Skaha and Okanagan Lakes in Penticton, featuring a private on-site Nordic Spa ('Skahä Nordic') with hot/cold therapy. Renovated suites range from studios to one-bedroom units, many with full kitchens and glimpses of Skaha Lake. The property includes private access to Barefoot Beach and explicitly provides storage for bikes, kayaks, and paddleboards — a practical stop for multi-day touring cyclists in the Okanagan.
37f602a063: Christian Cove Lodge is a secluded group retreat tucked away on Pitt Lake, designed for gatherings such as weddings, family reunions, and corporate retreats. It accommodates groups of 10 or more, with a private suite available for smaller parties, and an onsite caretaker to ensure a smooth stay. Its remote lakeside setting and modern comforts make it a distinctive stop for cyclists exploring the Pitt Meadows area.
d9aac068f1: The Craigmyle is a heritage boutique hotel with 15 individually decorated rooms and suites, situated two minutes' walk from Craigdarroch Castle in Victoria's Rockland neighbourhood. It operates on a no-daily-housekeeping model, emphasises environmental sustainability (chemical-free laundry, linen reuse program), and offers flexible self-check-in/check-out — practical for cyclists arriving on their own schedule. The property explicitly warns of many stairs throughout the building, which is worth noting for cyclists travelling with heavily loaded bikes.
dbea49329b: Wingate by Wyndham Kamloops is a mid-scale Wyndham-brand hotel situated on Rogers Way in Kamloops, a city that sits at the confluence of the North and South Thompson Rivers and is a common overnight stop on the TransCanada touring route. As part of the Wingate chain, the property targets business and leisure travellers with extended-stay-style amenities. Its location on the eastern edge of the city provides reasonable access to the Trans-Canada corridor.
d49a233510: Oasis Inn is a family-run motel on Gordon Drive in central Kelowna with over 25 years of continuous operation at the same location. All rooms include A/C, fridge, microwave, and wireless internet, and the property offers on-site coin-op laundry. Its central Kelowna position puts cycling tourists close to the city's beaches, wineries, and Okanagan trail networks.
633e8de2e4: Woodlands Inn & Suites is Fort Nelson's locally owned hotel at Mile 300 on the Alaska Highway, a natural waypoint for cyclists traversing northern British Columbia. The four-storey property offers spacious pet-friendly rooms—many with full kitchens and living areas—alongside complimentary breakfast, an on-site restaurant and lounge, a fitness centre, and a steam room. A 24/7 lobby store stocked with snacks, frozen meals from M&M Food Market Express, and personal care items, plus an on-site liquor store, adds practical convenience for long-haul travelers.
81fd6bd7b4: Western Lodge is a boutique hotel in Kimberley, BC, situated close to the ski hill and a short distance from downtown. The property hosts The Porch, an on-site restaurant and bar located downstairs offering home-cooked meals and cocktails. The hotel also markets itself as a flexible event venue and appears to be run by LPI Hospitality Group.
845e6a0156: A two-storey pet-friendly hotel situated in the heart of Sidney-by-the-Sea, a short walk from the waterfront, local bookshops, and restaurants of this charming Vancouver Island town. The property offers complimentary cruiser bicycle rentals so guests can explore the Saanich Peninsula without their own wheels, alongside a fitness centre stocked with Peloton equipment. It serves as a natural staging point for cyclists arriving or departing via the nearby BC Ferries Swartz Bay terminal.
3f13cf8c1c: A family-owned budget motel on the Trans-Canada Highway in Kamloops, operating since the 1970s with 34 ground-floor rooms. Kitchenettes with microwaves and fridges make it practical for self-catering travellers, and a heated outdoor pool and whirlpool offer a welcome end-of-day recovery option. It sits next door to restaurants and five minutes from downtown, making it a convenient overnight base for cyclists passing through the Thompson Valley corridor.
45da377321: A motel on Penticton's West Lakeshore Drive offering standard overnight accommodation. The location on a main waterfront road may be convenient for cycling tourists traveling through the Okanagan.
ee6a579039: A compact motel in Clinton along the Cariboo Highway. Basic roadside accommodation for travelers passing through the Cariboo region.
ea594eb5e3: The Sandman Signature Hotel & Suites Langley is a full-service hotel offering a range of room types from standard rooms to loft and jacuzzi suites, many with kitchenettes or full kitchens. It holds a GreenStep Silver Certification for sustainability practices measured against Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards. Touring cyclists will find an on-site restaurant (Moxies), indoor pool, 24-hour front desk, and free parking, though bike-specific services are not documented online.
6d61c4167d: Port-O-Call Inn & Suites is a 42-unit motel on Terminal Avenue North in Nanaimo, positioned minutes from the city's ferry terminals and major highway routes. Part of the Roadside Hospitality portfolio, it offers four room categories ranging from standard queens to family suites, all equipped with mini fridges, microwaves, and coffee machines, with suites adding a full kitchenette. The property markets itself to ferry travellers, road trippers, and extended-stay guests including snowbirds, making it a practical stopover point on Vancouver Island.
d886de81ec: A 16-storey full-service Hilton property situated in Richmond adjacent to Vancouver International Airport. The hotel serves travellers connecting through YVR and sits within Richmond's extensive cycling network, making it a plausible overnight stop for cyclists arriving or departing by air. As a flagship Hilton brand hotel it offers a broad range of on-site services, though specific cyclist-oriented amenities could not be confirmed.
6ba7f75ef4: Grandview Motel is a family-owned and operated two-storey motel situated on a quiet street about 700 m from downtown Kamloops in the Thompson Valley. Guests enjoy rooms with fridges, coffee makers, flat-screen TVs, and optional kitchenettes, plus a seasonal heated outdoor pool, gas BBQs, and a shaded picnic area. Pet-friendly and centrally located near Thompson Rivers University and Royal Inland Hospital, it offers a practical and affordable overnight base for cyclists moving through the interior of BC.
77dccf498d: Built in 1897 at the height of Vancouver's Gold Rush era, the Victorian Hotel is the oldest hotel in the city, a meticulously restored four-story brick heritage building in the heart of downtown. Its 42 rooms blend original exposed brick walls, Victorian mouldings, and grand ceilings with Canadian oak hardwood floors and contemporary furnishings. Ideally situated steps from Gastown, Yaletown, and BC Place, it offers touring cyclists a historically rich and centrally located base in one of Canada's most cycling-friendly cities.
5ac14f8e97: Penticton Lakeside Resort & Conference Centre sits on the shores of Okanagan Lake, offering a private licensed beach, marina, boat rentals, pool, hot tub, and a floating sauna. Three on-site restaurants — The Bufflehead Cafe, The Barking Parrot Bar, and The Hooded Merganser — all have pet-friendly patios, and the resort is steps from Okanagan Lake Park and surrounding trail networks. It serves as a full-service base for cyclists exploring the South Okanagan wine country and rail trails.
725e743ec4: The Tower Inn is described as the finest full-service hotel in Quesnel, located in the heart of the historic Cariboo Gold Rush country. It was selected as the overnight stop for the Rocky Mountaineer train on its Whistler-to-Jasper route, reflecting its standing as the city's premier lodging option. Touring cyclists staying here are a short walk from downtown shopping, restaurants, and local attractions.
0af5369578: A 3-star Radisson Hotel in Fort St. John, part of the Choice Hotels chain. This mid-range hotel provides standard overnight accommodation for travelers passing through northern BC. It offers a convenient stop for cyclists touring the Alaska Highway corridor.
b407d7be9e: The 2400 Motel is a mid-century motor court dating to 1946, set on 3.5 acres of landscaped grounds along Vancouver's Kingsway corridor in the Collingwood neighbourhood. Its 65 rooms and bungalows follow a detached layout with private entrances and free parking right at the door — an atmospheric alternative to high-rise hotels and a recognizable filming location for movies and TV. Touring cyclists will find it conveniently placed near transit, restaurants, and a mall, with pet-friendly rooms and full kitchens available in select units.
7b24c6d5a9: Greystone Lodge is a boutique ski-in/ski-out accommodation at the base of Blackcomb Mountain in Whistler, BC, offering individually owned and styled one- and two-bedroom suites managed on-site by Acer Vacation Rentals. It is a practical summer mountain-biking base as well as a winter destination, with secure bike storage, a heated saltwater pool, two hot tubs, and free underground parking in a building of only 50 units. Whistler Village is roughly a 7–10 minute walk or a short bus ride away, putting restaurants and grocery stores well within reach.
be119e868a: Best Western Plus Carlton Plaza is a six-storey full-service hotel in the heart of downtown Victoria, steps from the Inner Harbour, shops, and dining. The property offers a range of room types from traditional rooms to family suites with full kitchens, catering to both short stays and extended visits. Valet parking with EV charging is available on-site, and guests note the walkable location and attentive front-desk staff.
489bfe39a2: A Four Points by Sheraton hotel in Surrey. As a branded mid-market hotel, it offers standard commercial accommodation services to business and leisure travelers passing through the region.
49c9d7a888: Hotel Rialto is a family-owned heritage boutique hotel in the heart of downtown Victoria, built on a dream by Italian immigrant Danilo Danzo who first visited in the late 1960s and later transformed the building into a love letter to his homeland. The five-storey property sits at the edge of Canada's oldest Chinatown, surrounded by eclectic local shops and walkable to Victoria's main attractions. The on-site Palms Inspired Kitchen and Cocktails is cited as one of the city's top restaurant and lounge experiences, with Vintage Spirits next door.
3ab277560e: The Sundial Hotel sits 75 metres from the Whistler Village Gondola in the heart of Whistler Village, with direct access to over 80 mountain biking trails and a prime position during events like Crankworx. Guests stay in spacious, fully-equipped suites — some with private hot tubs — designed for multi-day adventure stays. A dedicated ski and bike valet service handles equipment storage and heavy lifting throughout a guest's stay.
753f21eea5: Malahat Bungalows Motel is a roadside motel on the Trans-Canada Highway serving the Sidney area. It operates as bungalow-style accommodation, a format that can provide flexible overnight lodging for touring cyclists.
44413a453c: Operated by the University of British Columbia, Loon Lake Lodge & Retreat Centre is a year-round retreat and conference destination tucked inside the Malcolm Knapp Research Forest, less than an hour east of Vancouver. The property can accommodate up to 195 guests across several distinct buildings ranging from Whistler-style lodge facilities to dormitory-style student housing. A touring cyclist looking for a remote forest setting with on-site dining and multiple accommodation tiers would find this a distinctive overnight option near Golden Ears Provincial Park.
f384788182: Sandman Hotel & Suites is a branded chain hotel in Kelowna offering standard overnight accommodation. The property provides Wi-Fi access to guests.
799c63124d: Executive Suites Hotel & Resort is an all-suite, condo-style resort on the Sea to Sky Highway, 40 minutes from both Vancouver and Whistler, making it a natural stopover for cyclists riding the corridor. The property actively courts mountain bikers with a dedicated Stay & Bike package, front-desk trail maps, and suites large enough to bring bikes inside. With 111 studio, one-, and two-bedroom suites each featuring full kitchens and private balconies, it offers touring cyclists more living space than a typical hotel room.
0aa1210f47: A 5-level Holiday Inn Express & Suites franchise hotel in Colwood near Victoria. Standard mid-range hotel accommodation offering free wireless internet. Suitable as a basic overnight stop for touring cyclists in the greater Victoria region.
fb65f7a00a: Old Towne Inne is a Western-themed motel and restaurant in Boston Bar, set at the heart of the Fraser Canyon on the Trans-Canada Highway. The property offers four self-contained cabins with kitchen facilities and private bathrooms, plus three additional rooms above the restaurant, making it one of the only lodging options in this small canyon town. The attached Chuckwagon Bar & Grill is a well-reviewed local institution famed for its burgers, homemade soup, and over-21 burger varieties.
e9fd5c5dab: Meares Vista Inn is a family-owned and operated motel on Campbell Street in Tofino, open since 2012 and self-described as 'simply clean and comfortable.' It offers four room configurations — Single Queen, Queen Suite, Upper Double Queen, and Lower Double Queen — and bills itself as an unpretentious, relaxed base for exploring Tofino's beaches and surrounding coastal wilderness. The owners also support local staff by providing space for RV living on the property.
4108819cf4: Mountain Retreat Hotel & Suites is an 87-room full-service hotel in Squamish, BC, positioned on Progress Way near Highway 99 along the Sea to Sky corridor between Vancouver and Whistler. The property features an indoor heated pool with waterslide, hot tub, fitness centre, an on-site restaurant and cocktail lounge (Timberwolf Restaurant and Lounge), and an attached Beer and Wine Store. It is dog-friendly and offers free parking including space for RVs, making it a comfortable and self-contained base for cyclists exploring the region.
6b4367ba78: The Coast Metro Vancouver Hotel is a newly rebranded, fully renovated property in Burnaby sitting directly beside the HWY 1 on-ramp and within walking distance of Rupert SkyTrain station, offering a 20-minute transit ride to downtown Vancouver. The two-level, elevator-free building features an open-air courtyard and garden, a 24-hour guest lounge with coffee station, and pet-friendly rooms with private balconies and views of the North Shore mountains or Vancouver cityscape. Its position at the Vancouver–Burnaby boundary makes it a practical base for cyclists exploring the Lower Mainland or staging longer trips east toward the Fraser Valley or west toward the North Shore and BC Ferries terminals.
19193e3490: Lodestone Flats is a boutique-style motel under new ownership in the small community of Tulameen, positioned just steps from Otter Lake and the Tulameen River in the Similkameen Valley. The property operates with self check-in and keyless entry—no front desk—and sits within walking distance of local trails and the community general store. Cyclists passing through the Similkameen will find it a convenient and low-fuss base for exploring the region's riding and outdoor recreation.
d1c01b0294: Osborne Bay Resort is an oceanfront camping and cottage resort perched along the shores of Crofton, BC, offering full-service RV sites, log cottages with fully-equipped kitchens, a rentable 40-foot oceanfront RV, and beachside camping. Open year-round, it sits close to the Crofton ferry terminal—a convenient jumping-off point for Salt Spring Island—and within easy pedalling distance of the Cowichan Valley trail network and the Chemainus murals town. The resort's laundromat, free hot showers, and diverse lodging formats make it a practical multi-night base for touring cyclists exploring southern Vancouver Island.
24a9c7be9e: A renovated boutique motel in the heart of Naramata village, offering 9 micro-suites—4 with kitchenettes—arranged around a xeriscaped courtyard. Originally one of Naramata's earliest roadside motels, it has been reimagined as a self-catering retreat with keyless check-in and modern comforts. The property sits minutes from the Kettle Valley Rail Trail and is within walking distance of the beach, local cafes, and Okanagan wineries.
56cd313c6b: SureStay by Best Western is a mid-range hotel on Capilano Road in North Vancouver, situated roughly 22 miles from Vancouver International Airport and 16 miles from downtown Vancouver. It offers standard rooms and suites under the Best Western loyalty umbrella, with complimentary breakfast and free high-speed internet included. Its location near the base of Capilano makes it a convenient base for cyclists exploring the North Shore or using the area as a staging point before or after crossing into Vancouver.
86cbea7011: Noble House Suites is a two-room boutique bed & breakfast perched on the bank of the Granby River in Grand Forks, offering a Romance Room with a king bed and wheelchair accessibility and a Daly Room with two queen beds, each with an electric fireplace and soaker tub. Guests have full access to shared amenities including a hot tub, movie theater, full kitchen, and laundry facilities, and the property backs onto riverside walking trails. Hosts Sean and Kathy Noble also operate an on-site confectionery, Noble House Sweets, whose treats are offered to overnight guests.
73b30a88c6: Villa Eyrie Resort is a luxury mountain resort perched high above Finlayson Arm on the Malahat, with panoramic views stretching to the Olympic Mountains and Mount Baker. Inspired by Lake Como and Italian alpine architecture, the property features elegantly appointed suites, the Alpina Restaurant, a Tuscan Spa, and curated experiences including mushroom foraging and winery visits. Named among TripAdvisor's top 10% of hotels worldwide, it sits directly on the Trans-Canada Highway corridor between Victoria and the rest of Vancouver Island — a natural overnight stop for long-distance touring cyclists.
0cd0482057: Sandman Hotel Langley provides accommodation in Langley, BC with complimentary Wi-Fi for guests. As a hotel chain property, it offers standard lodging services to touring cyclists passing through the area. Specific details about bike storage and other touring-specific amenities cannot be verified due to website access issues.
9fee751feb: A family-owned motel established in 1960 in the heart of Lillooet, 4 Pines Motel spans three buildings offering everything from budget rooms to honeymoon suites with jacuzzi and fireplace. Its downtown location puts touring cyclists within walking distance of Lillooet's services, and the motel sits along the scenic Highway 99 corridor connecting Whistler and the Interior. Rooms range from simple queens to full two-bedroom kitchen suites suited for longer stays.
cab6f6fdbd: Horstman House is a boutique collection of one-to-three bedroom condominium-style residences perched on Blackcomb Mountain, steps from the Home Run trail and Lost Lake Park. Touted as one of Whistler's only true luxury private residence accommodations, it offers ski-in access and a free shuttle to both Whistler and Blackcomb lifts. The property sits close to Whistler Village and features in-unit full kitchens and washer/dryers, making extended stays comfortable for active travellers.
b80046b287: Eagle Lodge is part of the Town Plaza Suites complex in Whistler Village North, offering studio, one- and two-bedroom condos with fully equipped kitchens, gas fireplaces, and in-suite washer/dryers. It sits a short walk from both mountain gondolas and the Whistler Conference Centre, making it a convenient self-catering base for cyclists exploring the Sea to Sky corridor. The surrounding Village North puts restaurants, shops, and nightlife immediately at hand.
9db7525ce2: A budget motel centrally located in Nanaimo, just five minutes' drive from the Departure Bay BC Ferries terminal — a key arrival and departure point for cyclists on the Vancouver Island route. Rooms include kitchens or kitchenettes and standard amenities including free WiFi. Restaurants and grocery stores are described as a short walk away.
c0b955d181: Kokanee Glacier Resort is a resort-motel situated just outside Nelson, BC on Highway 3A, offering suites with full kitchens, living rooms, and bedrooms for a comfortable multi-night stay. It serves as a basecamp for the Kootenays' outdoor offerings—mountain biking, hiking, fishing, hot springs, skiing, and golf at several nearby courses. The property has an on-site restaurant and partners with local activity operators to round out a touring itinerary.
