3586b6c4e8: The Round-Up Motel is a two-storey property sitting right on Highway 97 (Cariboo Highway) at the south end of Clinton, making it a natural overnight stop for cyclists riding the historic Gold Rush Trail corridor. Rooms range from standard queen beds to full kitchen suites, and free parking accommodates vehicles towing trailers up to 50 feet. Clinton's small downtown — restaurants, pubs, a liquor store, grocery stores, and the Cariboo-area Clinton Museum — is all within easy walking distance of the motel.
fb9861329e: The Fairmont Hotel Vancouver is a landmark luxury property in the heart of downtown Vancouver, a grand chateau-style building that has anchored West Georgia Street since 1939. Part of the Fairmont Hotels & Resorts portfolio, it offers upscale accommodations alongside on-site dining, a spa, and fitness facilities. Its central location places touring cyclists within walking distance of the city core, the seawall, and major transit connections.
dbaa01bf1b: The Vancouver Airport Marriott is a full-service hotel in Richmond, located near Vancouver International Airport. It provides accommodation for cycling tourists and other travelers.
e0f83a7723: Waterfront Inn is one of three beachside motels under the Skaha Lake Motels group, situated steps from Skaha Lake in Penticton's Okanagan Valley. Rooms include air conditioning and kitchen or kitchenette options, and the motel is pet friendly. It sits directly across from Skaha Lake Park, which offers volleyball courts, a waterpark, and other public amenities. Note that check-in for all three properties is handled at the Beachside Motel at 3624 Parkview Street.
8d47648d14: Holiday House Seaview Motel is a pet-friendly motel located on Esplanade Avenue in Ladysmith, a small harbour town on Vancouver Island's east coast roughly midway between Nanaimo and Duncan. The 'Seaview' name suggests ocean views over Ladysmith Harbour and the southern Gulf Islands. Its Esplanade Avenue address places it close to Ladysmith's waterfront, making it a convenient stop for cyclists on the Island's east-coast touring corridor.
1b9cc17872: Premiere Suites Victoria is an extended-stay furnished apartment property aimed at corporate and relocation guests needing stays of 30 nights or more. Located on Johnson Street in downtown Victoria, it is part of the national Premiere Suites Alliance network of 10,000+ furnished suites across Canada. A touring cyclist staying here would have access to a fully equipped kitchen, in-suite laundry, and a dedicated workspace in a residential-style setting.
2740018886: The Adara Hotel is a modern boutique hotel in the heart of Whistler Village, steps from the base of Whistler and Blackcomb Mountains. It features a rooftop heated outdoor pool, hot tub, and firepit open year-round, along with an in-house dining partnership with Stonesedge Kitchen. The hotel holds a Green Key Eco-Rating and is dog-friendly, making it a practical and comfortable base for cycling and multi-sport touring.
ae6273fe2f: Riviera Plaza & Conference Centre is a hotel and conference facility in Vernon, BC. Website suspension prevents verification of current operations and cyclist amenities.
faffaffe59: A motel in Chilliwack offering overnight accommodation to traveling cyclists and other guests. Provides complimentary Wi-Fi to guests.
71e34b50a7: The Douglas is an upscale hotel in downtown Vancouver offering full-service accommodation. Located on Smithe Street in the city core, it provides a central base for cyclists exploring Vancouver.
a5e01f85f5: Swiss Sunset Inn is a motel located on Skaha Lake Road in Penticton, a popular cycling destination in BC's Okanagan region. Positioned near Skaha Lake, it sits along a corridor frequently used by touring cyclists on routes such as the Kettle Valley Rail Trail and Okanagan wine country loops. The motel format typically offers ground-floor rooms and on-site parking, which can be convenient for cyclists with loaded bikes.
9fe2f6f4eb: Retasket Lodge & RV Park is a 20-room motel and 8-site RV park set on a hilltop above Lillooet, proudly owned and operated by the T'it'q'et First Nation, with 360-degree views over the Fraser River and surrounding mountains. The property also offers Seton Lake Cabins — four separate lakeside cabins with full kitchens, sleeping up to six — a short distance from Seton Lake's beach and boat launch. Lillooet sits at a crossroads of several major cycling routes and the amenities page calls out mountain biking, hiking, and gold panning among nearby activities.
69b33542da: The Best Western Cowichan Valley Inn is a full-service hotel in Duncan on Vancouver Island, positioned along the Cowichan Valley corridor as the area's flagship Best Western property. The on-site CVI Restaurant and Lounge provides sit-down dining, making it a convenient stop after a day of riding. As a well-established branded hotel it draws repeat visitors to the region north of Victoria.
d462718e1d: Summerland Motel is a beachside property in Summerland, BC, billed as the town's closest motel to Okanagan Lake and sitting right off the main highway. The motel offers a range of room types from standard doubles to three-bedroom suites with full kitchens, plus a seasonal heated outdoor pool and inner courtyard garden. It is a practical base for cyclists touring the Okanagan, with local dining, wineries, and a grocery store all nearby.
de69f3240c: Shoreline Resort (marketed as Shoreline Condo Resort) sits directly adjacent to the sandy beach of Okanagan Lake in Penticton, offering studio through three-bedroom suites and condos. The property is within easy walking distance of downtown restaurants, wineries, breweries, and the South Okanagan Events Centre. Its beachfront location makes it a practical base for cyclists touring the Okanagan, with free parking and an outdoor pool rounding out the stay.
cc7aa95c54: Located two minutes' walk from Whistler Village and five minutes from the Whistler and Blackcomb Mountain gondolas, Aava Whistler markets itself as Whistler BC's bike-friendliest hotel, offering a dedicated bike vault, bike valet service, and a wash-and-tool station all at no charge. The hotel also features a heated pool, hot tub, and underground parking, making it a well-equipped basecamp for multi-day cycling adventures in the Sea-to-Sky corridor. It is dog-friendly and has accessible rooms, broadening its appeal to a wide range of touring cyclists.
9ee93b64e4: Hotel Squamish is a hotel in Squamish, British Columbia, a popular stop for touring cyclists in the province. The property is located on Second Avenue in the town center.
7682eee1a8: The Executive Plaza Hotel is a 140-room boutique luxury hotel in Coquitlam, consistently ranked as a top TripAdvisor property and certified as a 3 Green Key Global sustainability partner. It offers contemporary rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows, an on-site restaurant and bar (The Wild Fig) with room service, and a rooftop pool deck with hot tub, steam room, and tennis court. Situated near Lougheed Mall, Highway 1, and public transit, it serves both business and leisure travellers in the Burnaby/Coquitlam/New Westminster corridor.
6c89e0534b: Woodside Inn is a small, independently owned boutique motel on Mount Woodside near Harrison Mills, operating since 1958 and offering four individually decorated one-bedroom suites, each with a private entrance, kitchenette, full bathroom, and parking. The property sits above the confluence of the Harrison and Fraser rivers in a scenic Fraser Valley location renowned for salmon fishing, eagle watching, and paragliding. It is about 15 minutes from Harrison Hot Springs and 1.5 hours from Vancouver.
22bf6eedd7: Strawberry Island is a unique floating-cabin resort located on a small island just 30 seconds by water taxi from downtown Tofino, offering three rentable cabins (Halibut House, Seabass Suite, Yellow House) as well as ocean fishing charters and island adventure tours including Hot Springs Cove. The operation has over 15 years of experience and is a distinctly West Coast experience combining private island accommodation with guided ocean activities. Access is exclusively by water, so touring cyclists would need to arrange bike transport to reach the cabins.
5fd2c2901c: Sunshine Lodge is a small hotel located on North Road in Gibsons on BC's Sunshine Coast, a popular cycling destination accessible by ferry from Horseshoe Bay. The property is tagged in OpenStreetMap as offering Wi-Fi, though this cannot be independently confirmed. Its status and current operation are uncertain as the registered website now resolves to an unrelated personal blog.
7e7f33939b: The Inn at Tough City is a distinctive waterfront boutique hotel in Tofino built largely from salvaged materials, including over 45,000 bricks from Vancouver's Gastown and stained-glass windows imported from Scotland. Its 8 individually decorated rooms look directly onto Clayoquot Sound, and the property includes an eclectic on-site sushi bar with an extensive menu of fresh local seafood. Founded roughly 30 years ago by 'Crazy Ron' and Johanna Vanderkley, the Inn is known for its relaxed, home-style atmosphere that stands apart from chain or resort hotels.
0e765cfad3: Harrison Hot Springs Resort is a landmark lakeside resort in Harrison Hot Springs, BC, built around five natural mineral pools averaging 1,300 parts per million of dissolved mineral solids — among the most concentrated in North America. The property includes a full-service spa, multiple restaurants ranging from a casual lakeside family restaurant to fine dining with nightly live entertainment, and wedding facilities. Touring cyclists arriving here encounter a classic BC resort destination on the shores of Harrison Lake with the coastal mountains as a backdrop.
33e45800aa: A 5-star luxury hotel located in Vancouver's Canada Place waterfront development. A major chain property offering standard hotel amenities to touring cyclists, though specific bike storage and handling arrangements are unverified.
215d799f9b: The Sandman Hotel Quesnel is a newly renovated, full-service hotel in Quesnel, BC, part of the national Sandman chain, featuring an indoor pool, fitness centre, on-site Denny's Restaurant with room service, and 24-hour front desk. It has earned Silver GreenStep Sustainability Certification through a formal evaluation against Global Sustainable Tourism Council standards. For touring cyclists moving through the Cariboo region, it offers practical amenities including coin-operated laundry, free parking, and complimentary Wi-Fi across all room types.
eca14e1b36: Brentwood Bay Resort & Spa is a 33-room adults-only luxury boutique resort perched on the edge of a glacial fjord on the Saanich Inlet, a short ride from downtown Victoria. The property is built around water-based experiences — a full marina with boat tours and a shuttle to The Butchart Gardens — alongside a spa with heated outdoor pools, thermal sauna, and cold plunge. Multiple on-site dining venues serving local Vancouver Island ingredients make it a self-contained recovery destination for touring cyclists exploring the Saanich Peninsula.
d039758979: Crystal Cove Beach Resort is a long-established oceanfront resort on MacKenzie Beach in Tofino, offering 34 modern log cabins (several beachfront, with hot tubs and fireplaces), year-round fully serviced RV sites tucked under old-growth trees, and glamping in 5th-wheel trailers. Rated the #1 resort in Tofino by TripAdvisor, it sits steps from a kilometre of sandy coastline with an on-site coffee shop (Bean at the Cove). It is 100% pet-friendly, making it a welcoming base for cycle tourists exploring the remote western coast of Vancouver Island.
6776ae16f6: Valemount Hotel is located on the main street of Valemount, a small community in north-central BC along the Yellowhead Highway. The hotel provides overnight accommodation for touring cyclists and other travelers passing through this remote region. Its main-street location makes it accessible to cyclists navigating regional tour routes.
8b9b54431e: The Cabins at Terrace Beach is a west coast cabin resort established in 2002, perched above Terrace Beach in Ucluelet with direct access to the Wild Pacific Trail's Lighthouse Loop. The property offers a range of accommodation from contemporary passive-built oceanfront cabins with Pacific views to rainforest loft cabins nestled in old-growth forest, most of which are pet friendly and include private parking stalls. Touring cyclists riding the Pacific Rim corridor would find it a scenic basecamp with immediate trail access and a full kitchen in every unit.
20b012131c: A hotel in Langley providing overnight accommodation for touring cyclists. Located on 88 Avenue in a semi-rural area, it serves as a convenient rest stop for cyclists traveling the region.
fe62207bc6: Coal River Services RV Park & Lodge sits at the confluence of the Coal and Liard Rivers on the Alaska Highway in the Northern Rockies of BC, roughly 30 minutes north of Liard Hot Springs. Originally built in 1949, the property offers lodge rooms, full-hookup RV sites, dry camping, and an on-site cafe famous for bison burgers. It is one of the few full-service stops for long-haul travellers on this remote stretch of the Alcan.
4364a3c36f: Arundel Mansion is a heritage building constructed in 1910 in downtown New Westminster, offering Edwardian-era furnished suites decorated in craftsman style with bay windows, high ceilings, hardwood floors, and vintage claw-foot tubs. The property also manages the adjacent Towle House Victorian rental homes and a rentable restaurant suite, giving it an unusually eclectic character. New Westminster's SkyTrain connections place central Vancouver about 20 minutes away, making this a historically rich base for cyclists exploring the Lower Mainland.
559d1a4fe8: The Inn at the Union Club is the guest accommodation wing of the Union Club of British Columbia, a heritage private members' club founded in 1879 and situated in the heart of downtown Victoria near the inner harbour. The inn offers 22 guest rooms and suites and is open to Union Club members and their guests, as well as members of more than 400 affiliated clubs worldwide. Guests receive access to the club's Executive Fitness Centre, billiards room, rooftop terrace, and dining facilities as part of their stay.
5a2fa94b8b: Reynolds Hotel is a historic boutique hotel built in 1941 in Lillooet, BC, set against the backdrop of the Coast Mountain Range and Fraser Canyon. Extensively renovated with locally cut and milled wood floors and antiques throughout, it blends period character with modern room amenities. Rated one of the top 10 sleeps on the Sea-to-Sky Corridor by 99 North Magazine, it also features an on-site restaurant and pub serving home-cooked meals.
0c2a44776e: Le Chamois is a boutique ski-in/ski-out hotel in Whistler's upper Village, situated steps from Blackcomb Mountain's Wizard and Magic chair lifts. Rooms feature in-suite kitchenettes, mountain or courtyard views, and European-inflected décor. It positions itself as a four-season base camp — summer guests have direct access to mountain biking and hiking trails alongside on-site bike rentals through lodge shops.
daf117f64d: Now operating as Hilton Grand Vacations Club Whistler, this landscaped resort sits adjacent to a designated nature preserve with views of Blackcomb Mountain. It offers suite-style accommodations ranging from studios to 3-bedroom units, each with kitchenette or full kitchen facilities and private balconies. The surrounding area provides direct access to Whistler's trail network, and the concierge material specifically references cycling through the area's winding trails.
2903854099: Chute Lake Lodge is a historic mountain resort perched above the Naramata Bench, situated directly along the Kettle Valley Railway corridor — one of BC's most celebrated multi-day cycling routes. Originally built around 1920 as a logger's bunkhouse and rail water stop, it now offers a range of accommodation from rustic cabins and lodge rooms to yurts and glamping tents. The lodge rents e-bikes and offers cycling distance information to Penticton and Kelowna, making it a natural basecamp for KVR touring cyclists exploring the Okanagan highlands.
7d74e28f0c: The Moby Dick Inn is a 63-room family hotel in Prince Rupert, strategically located minutes from the BC and Alaska Ferry Terminals and the Via Rail Station, making it a natural staging point for cyclists arriving or departing by ferry. The property offers a fully licensed on-site restaurant with room service and a reputation for breakfast, plus guest laundry and kitchenette rooms. Prince Rupert sits at the northern terminus of the BC Ferries Inside Passage route, a key gateway for cycle-touring the north coast.
bffc7722ce: Pan Pacific Whistler Village Centre is a luxury full-service hotel situated at the heart of Whistler Village on Blackcomb Way, part of the international Pan Pacific Hotels Group chain. Its village-centre location places guests steps from Whistler's extensive trail network and the Valley Trail multi-use path. The property is undergoing elevator maintenance through mid-2026 but remains fully operational.
caa8f14a49: Shawnigan Lake Beach Resort is a privately owned and operated lakefront condo resort on six and a half acres along Shawnigan Lake on Vancouver Island, about 30 minutes north of Victoria. It is the only beach-side resort on the lake, offering direct beach access, watercraft mooring, an indoor pool, and a range of lawn and court sports. Accommodations are individually owner-managed condos, each fully self-contained with a kitchen and private deck with barbecue.
96131aa2b9: Cox Bay Beach Resort is a 40-suite beachfront property on the Pacific Rim Highway just outside Tofino, offering one- and two-bedroom self-contained beach house suites with full kitchens and in-suite laundry. The resort sits steps from Cox Bay Beach, a world-class surf break, and features an infrared sauna, outdoor hot tub, fitness centre, and lookout pavilion overlooking the Pacific. It caters to surfers, families, and outdoor travellers seeking a base for exploring Pacific Rim National Park Reserve.
d0cbf736db: A three-storey Best Western hotel in Golden, BC, positioned as a gateway to Yoho and Kootenay National Parks and the Trans-Canada Highway corridor through the Rockies. The hotel features a lobby fireplace, indoor pool, business center, and complimentary breakfast included with every stay. Touring cyclists passing through the Columbia Valley will find it a comfortable full-service base in a town well-placed between major mountain passes.
e778cddc0d: A full-service 135-room hotel and conference centre situated on Harvey Avenue in central Kelowna, offering a range of room types from standard rooms to themed and loft suites. The property includes Mickie's Pub & Patio, an on-site sports pub and restaurant, and conference facilities capable of hosting up to 350 guests. Its location near the Okanagan Valley's wineries and the region's largest shopping mall makes it a convenient overnight stop for touring cyclists exploring the interior.
9a323cf664: A hotel in Richmond. Specific amenities and cyclist services could not be verified due to website access failure.
90217f1ad6: Hope Inn and Suites is a hotel in Hope on Old Hope-Princeton Way, providing overnight accommodation for travelers passing through the community.
d2ed9f3ba5: Holiday Inn Express Vancouver-Metrotown is a chain hotel in Burnaby's Metrotown commercial district offering standard accommodations. It provides a reliable overnight option for cycling tourists traveling through the region.
1cf6a9eb0a: Skwachàys Lodge is Vancouver's Indigenous boutique hotel, transformed from a derelict SRO into a social enterprise that pairs 18 uniquely designed guest rooms with on-site housing and studio space for 24 Indigenous artists. Each room is a collaboration between a top hotel designer and an Indigenous artist, making the hotel itself a functioning gallery. It sits at the crossroads of Gastown, Chinatown, and Railtown, placing guests in the heart of Vancouver's historic east side.
c35a3e86f4: The Prestige Rocky Mountain Resort is a full-service 111-room hotel in Cranbrook offering a range of room types including kitchenette suites and the novelty of sleeping in a repurposed train car. The property features two on-site restaurants (Fire and Oak and BRIXX Brewhouse), a spa, indoor pool, hot tub, and athletic centre. Positioned just off the main highway, it serves as a well-appointed base for cyclists exploring the East Kootenay region.
479d8ee072: The Best Western Plus Chateau Fort St. John is a modern, full-service hotel positioned directly on Alaska Highway 97, making it a natural overnight stop for cyclists travelling the iconic highway corridor through northeast BC. The property offers kitchenette-equipped rooms and a complimentary full hot breakfast, giving touring cyclists options for self-catering and a hot start to the day. Fort St. John bills itself as the 'Energetic City' and serves as the main service hub for the Peace Country, so most supplies and services a cyclist might need are close at hand.
00af020ca5: The Sutton Place Hotel is a full-service luxury hotel located in downtown Vancouver's Burrard Street corridor, offering room tiers ranging from standard Sutton Rooms to multi-bedroom suites with soaker tubs and wet bars. The property features an indoor heated pool, Vida Spa, a dedicated wine merchant, and the on-site Boulevard Kitchen & Oyster Bar. Touring cyclists would find a full concierge, onsite laundry, and free Wi-Fi throughout the property, though no cycling-specific facilities are advertised.
6e5a208f24: The Westin Bayshore is a Marriott chain hotel located in Vancouver's Bayshore neighborhood. It's a full-service hotel providing standard accommodations to various travelers. For a touring cyclist, it represents a mainstream hotel option in Vancouver.
569660d532: A newly renovated Best Western Plus hotel on Kingsway in central Burnaby, positioned minutes from Metropolis at Metrotown — the Vancouver area's largest shopping mall. The property markets comfort and convenience for travelers exploring Greater Vancouver, with easy access to transit and urban amenities. Its location on a major arterial corridor makes it a practical overnight stop for cyclists navigating the Greater Vancouver region.
ff53d4f062: Divya Sutra Suites is an 11-story boutique hotel on Robson Street in Vancouver's West End, offering 41 rooms ranging from queen suites to multi-bedroom penthouses, many with full kitchens suitable for self-catering touring cyclists. The location places guests within walking distance of Stanley Park and the world-class seawall cycling network. The hotel is pet-friendly (dogs under 20 lb) and offers 24-hour self-parking with both outdoor and basement options, plus EV car charging.
feb01ad5c3: Accent Inn Kelowna is a family-owned BC motel in downtown Kelowna running a dedicated 'Bike Love' program that treats cyclists as first-class guests rather than an afterthought. Touring cyclists can bring their bike directly into their room, access a professional-grade 37-piece tool kit, and use an on-site bicycle wash and tuning station. The hotel is Rainbow Registered, pet-friendly, and sits within a 20-minute drive of over 40 Okanagan wineries with abundant trail and beach access nearby.
7f08300622: The Grand Park Hotel Vancouver Airport is an independently branded mid-scale hotel in Richmond's Golden Village, a few minutes from YVR with a complimentary shuttle running every 30 minutes. It sits on the city's 'Food Street' with over 50 restaurants within walking distance, directly across from Lansdowne Mall, and near a Canada Line station for quick access to downtown Vancouver. The hotel has 140 rooms, an onsite restaurant, a 24-hour fitness centre, EV charging stations, and an open parking lot without height restrictions.
13bc9957f7: Greenbrier Hotel is a three-level hotel located on Robson Street in downtown Vancouver. The hotel provides free Wi-Fi access to guests.
4d617d4d93: Hampton Inn & Suites by Hilton Kelowna Airport is a 140-room mid-scale hotel situated directly adjacent to Kelowna International Airport in the Lake Country/Winfield area. Part of the globally recognized Hampton by Hilton brand, it serves both air travellers and regional visitors exploring the Okanagan. Its location on Innovation Drive puts cyclists within reach of Kelowna's trail networks and wine country routes.
8a91a8f74d: Wells Gray Inn is a 34-room hotel centrally located on Highway 5 in Clearwater, positioned as a base for exploring Wells Gray Provincial Park's mountains, rivers, and waterfalls. The inn features on-site dining through a diner with room service, Monroe's Fine Dining Restaurant and Lounge, and a bar and grill, as well as an outdoor hot tub, infrared sauna, and massage therapist for post-ride recovery. Summer activities in the area include biking, rafting, canoeing, and hiking.
a9681b45fb: The Best Western Plus Regency Inn & Conference Centre bills itself as Abbotsford's largest full-service hotel, with a conference centre, two indoor pools, a fitness centre, and an onsite restaurant (Ricky's Country Restaurant). The property specializes in group and corporate travel and has won the Best Western Director's Award. Touring cyclists will find it a comfortable, amenity-rich base for exploring the Fraser Valley.
bed9d433f7: Tofino Resort + Marina is a 63-room waterfront hotel and adventure basecamp situated in the heart of Tofino on unceded Tla-o-qui-aht First Nation territory, with harbour-view rooms and direct marina access. The property runs an on-site Adventure Centre offering kayaking, whale watching, bear watching, and guided fishing, making it a natural hub for cyclists who want to mix riding with West Coast wilderness experiences. Shelter Restaurant, the on-site dining room specialising in local wild-caught seafood, and a complimentary gym round out the amenities for a multi-day stay.
5121c76483: Sandman Inn Princeton is a hotel located on Frontage Road in Princeton, British Columbia. As part of the Sandman Inn hotel chain, it provides accommodation for travelers. Contact the hotel directly for information about current services and amenities.
a2b0073678: Recreation Inn & Suites is a family-owned hotel situated beside Highway 97 on the edge of Kelowna, offering a range of room types from standard queens to a three-bedroom apartment suite sleeping up to eight. The property features a seasonal outdoor pool, dry sauna, heritage gardens with BBQ and picnic areas, and a complimentary continental breakfast included with every stay. Its location adjacent to parks, an on-leash dog park, and walking-distance restaurants makes it a comfortable and convenient base for touring cyclists exploring the Okanagan.
c1ad1a5e88: Grizz Hotel is a centrally located hotel in downtown Revelstoke, within walking distance of the Revelstoke Aquatic Centre, museums, and Grizzly Plaza. The hotel features an in-house pub, The Last Drop, with 14 beers on tap, live entertainment, and daily specials. A free shuttle runs to Revelstoke Mountain Resort during winter, and the property is undergoing room renovations.
8a8aed281b: Tin Wis Resort is an 85-room beachfront hotel perched on the secluded tinwis (MacKenzie) Beach in Tofino, owned and operated by the Tla-o-qui-aht First Nation and situated within their traditional territories. It holds the distinction of housing the largest conference centre on the Pacific Rim and offers direct oceanfront access, making it one of the most culturally rooted lodging options in the region. Touring cyclists arriving via the Pacific Rim Highway find themselves steps from the ocean with surf and paddle equipment available and an on-site restaurant for refuelling.
29388e3e48: The Queens Hotel is a historic boutique property in Queensborough and the only hotel in this New Westminster neighbourhood, offering multiple room types from twin beds to a family suite. The hotel features a covered patio with BBQ, pet-friendly rooms, and multilingual staff (Cantonese, Japanese, Vietnamese, Mandarin, Spanish). Its central Lower Mainland location gives cyclists easy road access to Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, and Surrey.
a13202e0bf: Hotel BLU is a 4-diamond boutique hotel in the heart of downtown Vancouver on Robson Street, noted for personalized service and a stated commitment to sustainability. The property features an indoor pool, Jacuzzi, sauna, fitness centre, and an onsite breakfast lounge, and offers loaner electric and traditional bicycles for exploring the city. Its central location is steps from dozens of restaurants and grocery options, and less than a kilometre from the Canada Line SkyTrain.
157a41a25d: Deer Lodge is a self-catering vacation rental by owner tucked in the heart of Whistler Town Plaza, offering a one-bedroom suite sleeping four and a studio suite sleeping two. Both units feature full kitchens, gas fireplaces, in-suite laundry, and access to a shared hot tub, making them well suited for self-sufficient travellers. Restaurants, shops, golf courses, and ski lifts are all within easy walking distance.
813f0a685f: James Bay Inn is Victoria's second-oldest continuously operating hotel, opened in 1911 in Edwardian style and located in the quiet James Bay district a short walk from the Inner Harbour, Beacon Hill Park, and Fisherman's Wharf. The property carries a Green Key Global Eco rating of 3 and is explicitly marketed as bicycle-friendly. An on-site Art Deco cafe, restaurant, and pub round out the experience for touring cyclists seeking a historic, characterful base.
3ebdff01f5: The Sandman Signature Vancouver Airport Hotel & Resort is an upscale full-service hotel located near YVR in Richmond, BC, operated under Northland Properties' premium Signature tier. It offers standard resort-class amenities including free parking, room service, and free Wi-Fi. Its airport-adjacent location makes it a potential stopover point for cyclists using YVR, though no cycling-specific services have been confirmed.
d8f8c13968: Rocky Inn is a motel-style property in Valemount situated just off Yellowhead Highway 5 and surrounded by three mountain ranges. George Hicks Regional Park is a short walk away, and the Valemount Bike Park is listed among nearby attractions. The property offers free WiFi, on-site parking, and laundry service, making it a functional base for cyclists passing through the Robson Valley corridor.
435ca3d5cd: The Oswego is a boutique all-suite hotel in downtown Victoria, steps from the Inner Harbour and BC Parliament Buildings, with every room featuring a full kitchen and most offering a private balcony. It explicitly markets itself to active travellers and offers secure bike storage alongside an on-site restaurant, fitness facilities, and a quiet outdoor zen garden. The hotel is both dog- and child-friendly, and its central location on a quiet residential street makes it a practical and comfortable overnight base for touring cyclists arriving in or departing from Victoria.
fc03a11775: A Surrey landmark since 1967, Turf Hotel on King George Boulevard has grown from a modest roadside inn into a lively community hub combining budget-friendly guest rooms with an entertainment complex that includes Mojito's Pub (Latin nights, 200-person capacity), the intimate Turf Lounge (live bands, karaoke), and Kanin + Ulam, an on-site Filipino kitchen. An on-site Beer & Wine Store stocked with beer, wine, spirits, and convenience snacks rounds out the self-contained offering. The hotel was recently refreshed with updated rooms while retaining its retro, neighbourhood-gathering-place character.
2ec43756c7: A 4-star Sheraton hotel with 279 rooms serving the Surrey area. Standard mid-range chain accommodation typical of the Sheraton brand. A substantial property offering reliable lodging for touring cyclists.
d39ccef060: Buffalo Inn is a motel situated at Mile 143 of the iconic Alaska Highway in northern British Columbia, placing it squarely on one of the world's great long-distance cycling routes. The Alaska Highway corridor sees steady traffic from touring cyclists making multi-week journeys between Dawson Creek and Alaska, making roadside lodging at this milepost a meaningful stopping point. The commercial building and highway-side location suggest a classic roadhouse-style motel serving travellers in a remote stretch of BC.
d8fbb02be0: Westview Centre Motel is a recently refurbished 20-room hillside motel on Marine Avenue in Powell River, with panoramic views of Malaspina and Georgia Straits and the Salish Sea. It sits half a block from the ferry terminal serving Comox and Texada Island, and is walking distance from Willingdon Beach and the trailhead network that connects to the 180-km Sunshine Coast Trail. The motel proactively arranges discounted cycling and kayak rentals from local businesses for guests who book direct.
8e40ed9777: Black Rooster Inn & Apartments is a multi-room lodging in Prince Rupert offering hotel-style rooms, kitchenettes, and fully furnished 1–4 bedroom apartments with a maximum occupancy of 99 guests. Sitting about 400m from downtown and 5 minutes from the ferry and train terminal, it is well-positioned for cyclists arriving or departing via BC Ferries on the North Coast. The property has ample parking for RVs and boats, a BBQ patio, entertainment room with pool table, and locker rentals.
95bf55e03e: Hotel 19 is a recently restored oceanfront hotel in Port Hardy operated by two local women who transformed a long-vacant historic building into a modern boutique property. All rooms include private decks with ocean views and a coffee bar, and an attached sushi restaurant serves guests on-site. The property is still undergoing phased renovations, with a basement pub planned as a future addition.
f40b45f684: Eagle's Nest Resort sits on a secluded 10-acre peninsula along the shores of Anahim Lake in the remote West Chilcotin, just 1 km off Highway 20 between Williams Lake and Bella Coola. Guests choose between log cabins with wood stoves and elegant suites with satellite TV and wireless internet, and can dine in a licensed lakefront dining room with views over the lake. The resort is noted as a birding hotspot on a major inland migration route and offers canoe rentals, day-hike access to volcanic canyons, and arrangements for floatplane tours into Tweedsmuir Park.
2acb67520e: Ainsworth Hot Springs Resort is a historic hotel on the shores of Kootenay Lake in the Selkirk Mountains, centered on natural mineral hot spring pools including a remarkable 150-foot horseshoe cave that has been used for healing by the Ktunaxa people since time immemorial. The resort combines indigenous cultural heritage with modern accommodation across a four-story main building and the newer Yaqan Nukiy Suites, all overlooking the lake and Purcell Mountains. For a touring cyclist, the therapeutic soaking pools offer genuine muscle recovery after a long day on Highway 31.
236fc6581d: Imperial Motel is a motel in the Okanagan region offering overnight accommodation for travelers. Located on Riverside Drive, it represents a potential overnight stop for touring cyclists in the area.
ac071f5a10: The Hecate Inn is a motel and local landmark in Daajing Giids on Haida Gwaii, BC's remote island archipelago, where it has been operating for over 30 years. Rooms come with handmade furniture, full kitchens or kitchenettes, private bathrooms, and WiFi — practical features for touring cyclists who need to resupply and recover after arriving by ferry. Its location on Oceanview Drive puts it within the small community centre of Daajing Giids.
1d238c53ce: Aurora Park Inn & Suites is a highway-side hotel in Dawson Creek, BC, located off Highway 2 about 2.8 km from the airport and near the Encarna Event Center. Rooms and suites include microwaves, minifridges, and TVs, with some featuring kitchenettes or whirlpool tubs, and the property offers a business lounge and a game room with gaming consoles. Free continental breakfast, 24-hour front desk service, coin laundry, and free parking with car plug-ins make it a practical base for travelers passing through northern BC.
9ac251f62e: The Spanish Fiesta Resort is a lakefront resort in the heart of Osoyoos, BC, situated on Main Street steps away from a private sandy beach on Osoyoos Lake, widely cited as Canada's warmest lake. The property offers a variety of room types—many with full kitchens—alongside two outdoor heated pools and an indoor jacuzzi. Restaurants are within walking distance and the resort sits at a natural waypoint for cyclists touring the South Okanagan.
411cdfe177: Totem Lodge Motel is a smoke-free motel in Prince Rupert on BC's North Coast, situated just minutes from the BC and Alaska ferry terminals and the VIA Rail station — making it a practical base for cyclists arriving or departing by ferry. The lodge is surrounded by coastal rainforest and most rooms include fully equipped kitchenettes, offering self-sufficient stay options. Prince Rupert itself sits on Tsimshian traditional territory and is a gateway to wilderness adventure including kayaking, bear-watching, and whale-watching charters.
06983eb673: A mid-range hotel chain location in Campbell River on Vancouver Island. Offers standard accommodation in a commercial area, accessible to touring cyclists passing through the island.
4d5b98f292: The Microtel Inn & Suites by Wyndham Kitimat is a modern budget-oriented chain hotel situated in Kitimat, a remote industrial town on the Douglas Channel in BC's North Coast region. As part of the Wyndham family, it offers standardized amenities in an area with limited accommodation options, making it one of the more reliable lodging choices for cyclists traveling through this part of the province. Kitimat sits at the end of a long fjord with limited onward cycling routes, so the hotel serves primarily as a destination rest point rather than a through-touring waypoint.
397d224cda: The Grand Forks Inn is a highway-side hotel on the Crowsnest Highway (Hwy 3) in Grand Forks, BC, offering air-conditioned rooms with in-room fridge and microwave, a seasonal outdoor pool, and 24/7 front desk service. An on-site Japanese restaurant (Sushi Ocean Dream) provides evening dining options within steps of the door. The inn is a practical base for exploring the Boundary region, with Christina Lake about 20 minutes away by road.
00c05d3c9d: Naturally Pacific Resort is an award-winning boutique hotel in Campbell River recognized on Travel + Leisure's 2025 It List, as a Michelin Guide PLUS hotel, and holding an AAA Four Diamond designation. It sits at the edge of Vancouver Island's wilderness corridors and offers on-site dining, a luxury spa, golf, and an indoor pool — positioning it as a full-service base for exploring the region's cycling, fishing, and wildlife routes. Dog-friendly rooms and a dedicated dog-washing station add a practical touch for touring cyclists traveling with pets.
a899cfb1d0: Hillview Guest Rooms is a small, family-run motel on the eastern edge of Vanderhoof along the Yellowhead Highway (Hwy 16), a major transcontinental cycling route. The property has operated for over a decade and earned a 2024/25 Travel & Hospitality Award, positioning itself as the best-value lodging in town. Rooms include microwaves, refrigerators, and optional kitchenettes, and select units are pet-friendly — practical features for self-sufficient touring cyclists on a long-haul trip.
a8836f45d1: Lakeview Motel is a family-owned, year-round property on Highway 3 (Crowsnest Hwy) in Christina Lake, BC, in the Kootenay Boundary region. The 12 recently renovated rooms include seven fully equipped kitchen units, and the grounds feature a shared barbecue and fire pit under a log gazebo — good for swapping stories with fellow travelers. The motel sits five minutes on foot from one of Canada's warmest lakes and 1 km from the Trans Canada Trail, making it a convenient staging point for cyclists exploring the Boundary country.
f819f05706: Airport Inn is a combined motel and year-round RV park located in Quesnel, BC, on the Cariboo Highway near the airport. With 20 ground-floor motel rooms and over 50 pull-through RV sites, it caters to a range of travellers. Amenities like on-site laundry, a playground, and a walking trail make it a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists passing through central BC.
dd3a9e6114: The Regent Hotel is a family-owned boutique heritage hotel in downtown Revelstoke, operating continuously since 1945 and originally built in the 1920s as two separate hotels (the Windsor and the Selkirk). Its unique, character-filled rooms, on-site pub, restaurant, sauna, and outdoor hot tub make it a full-service base for exploring Revelstoke's world-class mountain biking, hiking, and outdoor adventures. Pets are welcome, and the downtown location puts guests within easy reach of the town's shops, cafés, and trailheads.
0cb6a4c171: Johnny's Motel is an award-winning, family-run budget motel set on the banks of the Granby River at the crossing of two rivers in Grand Forks, BC — a location the property calls the best in the city. Rooms open directly onto the riverbank and the motel sits just minutes from downtown shops and restaurants, making it a practical overnight stop for cyclists on the Crowsnest Highway (Hwy 3) corridor. Grand Forks is noted on the website as a base for cycling the Kettle Valley Trail.
dcbe1c6214: Bella Villa is an off-highway, lakefront motel situated on the shores of Osoyoos Lake in the southern Okanagan. Units feature fully equipped kitchens, and guests can use a grass courtyard with outdoor dining and gas barbecues. The quiet, beach-adjacent setting would appeal to cyclists seeking a relaxed base for exploring the Okanagan's wine-country roads.
69ae17803d: The Riviera Motel is a motel in the Okanagan region offering overnight accommodation. Specific details about amenities and bike storage cannot be confirmed due to website unavailability.
6af7e7c41f: A Comfort Inn & Suites hotel in Salmon Arm, part of the Choice Hotels chain. A standard mid-range hotel providing accommodation to touring cyclists passing through the Okanagan.
dce007c005: Riverside Court RV & Cabins is a small, family-owned property on the Granby River just outside downtown Grand Forks, operating on a site with roots going back to 1948. After severe 2018 flooding, the property was reinvented into two cabin units and ten RV sites, with a sandy beach and green space along the river. It is one block from downtown Grand Forks, making it a convenient overnight base for cyclists passing through on Highway 3.
0b6dbb4d30: Ocean Sands Resort is a condominium-style resort set on 4 acres of oceanfront property overlooking Rathtrevor Beach in Parksville, offering one- and two-bedroom suites with fully equipped kitchens, gas fireplaces, and ocean or pool-view balconies. The resort sits above one of Vancouver Island's most celebrated beaches, reachable on foot in about five minutes. Nearby activities listed on the resort's website include mountain biking, kayaking, hiking, and wildlife viewing tours, making it a natural staging point for cyclists exploring the east coast of Vancouver Island.
64e4f98573: Meziadin Junction is a full-service rest stop on Highway 37N in remote northern BC, operated as an Indigenous-owned business on Gitanyow territory and recipient of the 2014 BC Aboriginal Business Outstanding Achievement Award. It combines motel rooms, a restaurant, a general store, and industrial camp services in one complex, making it a rare oasis for travelers — including cyclists — heading toward Alaska or exploring the Cassiar Highway corridor. The surrounding area offers access to Meziadin Lake Provincial Park, Bear Glacier, and salmon-spawning creeks.
16e220d7eb: A Super 8 by Wyndham franchise motel located on Alaska Road North in Fort St. John, a major service centre near the start of the Alaska Highway. For northbound touring cyclists, Fort St. John represents one of the last substantial urban stops before the more remote stretches of the highway corridor. The property participates in the Wyndham Rewards loyalty program.
a0e72dac2f: Glenwood Inn & Suites is a 38-room motel in Trail, BC, sitting close to the Columbia River, local parks, and downtown Trail in the heart of the Kootenays. The property offers indoor and outdoor pools, a whirlpool spa, a fitness centre, and BBQ common areas, making it a well-equipped base after a long day on the road. It is fully disability-accessible and offers free on-site parking.
28c6fa3c41: Crown Mansion is a fully renovated heritage boutique hotel in Qualicum Beach, dating to 1914, with an elegant past that once saw celebrity guests including Bing Crosby, John Wayne, and the King of Siam. The property retains its original grandeur through rare wood panelling, crystal chandeliers, heritage fireplaces, and sweeping staircases. Accommodation options span boutique hotel rooms and separate villas, with an on-site restaurant rounding out the experience.
ea64dd70d1: Pioneer Inn is a long-established motel situated on the Quatse River bank in Port Hardy, North Vancouver Island, with over 40 years in business and a setting where forest and river meet the edge of town. It is the closest motel to the BC Ferry terminal (about 5 minutes' drive), making it a natural stop for cyclists arriving or departing via the Inside Passage route. The property offers 36 rooms including kitchenette suites, 25 RV sites, a coin laundry, a dedicated drying room, and an on-site sushi restaurant, along with the Quatse River Loop Trail running directly in front.
358798bd26: Vista del Mar is a motel on South Island Highway in the Vancouver Island area, providing lodging to passing travelers. The motel offers Wi-Fi access to guests.
f673c4f5ed: A European-style mountain lodge in Blue River, BC, situated in a natural valley between the Monashee and Cariboo Mountains on the border of Wells Gray Provincial Park — roughly equidistant (about 590 km) between Vancouver and Edmonton, making it a natural overnight stop for long-distance touring cyclists on that corridor. The lodge offers 35 rooms with in-room fridges, microwaves, and a complimentary continental breakfast, plus an indoor hot tub and an on-site food shack (Grizzly Food Shack) serving burgers, wraps, and breakfast. Mountain biking, hiking, and canoeing are among the listed local activities.
7bb251e6e4: Super 8 by Wyndham Salmon Arm is a nationally branded budget hotel situated on the northeast side of Salmon Arm in the Shuswap region of British Columbia. As part of the Wyndham Rewards network, it offers a familiar, consistent lodging option for travellers passing through a community that sits along the Trans-Canada Highway corridor. Touring cyclists riding through the Thompson-Okanagan region will find it a straightforward overnight stop near the commercial centre of town.
d60fcac610: Days Inn by Wyndham 100 Mile House is a mid-range chain hotel situated in 100 Mile House, a service hub in BC's Cariboo region along Highway 97. It sits at a natural stopping point for cyclists travelling the Interior plateau between Cache Creek and Williams Lake. As part of the Wyndham Rewards program, it offers the typical Days Inn suite of standard room amenities.
e3c6bb9cca: Spirit Bear Lodge is British Columbia's most remote wildlife viewing lodge, owned and operated by the Kitasoo Xai'xais First Nation in the heart of the Great Bear Rainforest near Klemtu. Named a World's Best Adventure by National Geographic in 2025, the lodge offers all-inclusive multi-day packages focused on spirit bear and grizzly bear viewing, cultural immersion, and wilderness exploration within Kitasoo Xai'xais Traditional Territory. It was founded in 2001 and has become a widely cited model for Indigenous-led, conservation-based ecotourism.
3b79ce1d3f: King Edward Hotel & Motel is a full-service small-town accommodation in Stewart, BC, a remote border community at the end of the Portland Canal across from Alaska's Misty Fjords National Park. The property offers multiple room types from standard queens to kitchenette suites, and operates an onsite pub and café, making it a practical overnight base in one of northwestern BC's most dramatically scenic corners. The surrounding area offers glacier access, bear viewing at Fish Creek, and estuary boardwalk walks within minutes of the front door.
1206308ae3: The Stagecoach Inn is a 52-room motel in Chetwynd, BC, offering fully renovated rooms with drive-up access, fridges, microwaves, and kitchenette options — a practical setup for cyclists hauling loaded bikes. An on-site restaurant and laundry facilities add to its appeal as an overnight stop. Chetwynd sits along the Hart Highway corridor, positioning this motel as a natural resupply and rest point for touring cyclists moving through northern BC.
d204866012: Walnut Beach Resort is a full-service lakefront suite resort on Osoyoos Lake, set against Canada's only desert landscape with vineyard and mountain vistas. Suites feature fully equipped kitchens and kitchenettes, and the property includes a private beach, heated outdoor pool, hot tubs, and on-site dining at Pointe 49 Kitchen & Bar. It is a prominent destination resort in one of BC's sunniest regions, close to wine tours, cycling routes, and the US border.
5bd697ee9e: The White Crystal Inn is a ski-resort hotel located within the Big White Ski Resort controlled recreational area, roughly 56 km southeast of Kelowna in BC's Okanagan highlands. As part of a major destination ski resort, it sits at high elevation in a village-style mountain setting that also offers summer eBike tours and trail activities. The resort operates on a seasonal model, closing in spring and reopening for summer and winter seasons.
61970c29f9: A motel on Vancouver Island offering overnight accommodation. The status of facilities and amenities for touring cyclists is unverified.
b0d80c9820: Jade City is a world-famous jade mining destination on the Cassiar-Stewart Highway (Hwy-37) in the Cassiar Mountain Range, founded in 1985 and featured on Discovery Channel's Jade Fever. The motel offers 4 rooms with an open veranda, shared shower facilities, and a dining area, all set amid jade boulders and mining equipment with mountain views. It is one of very few accommodation options on this remote northern highway, making it a key stop for touring cyclists traversing the Cassiar corridor.
4bd0b878c8: Bella Coola Grizzly Tours & Adventure Resort is a family-operated wilderness destination in the Great Bear Rainforest offering guided grizzly bear and marine wildlife tours out of Bella Coola. Guests stay in private post-and-beam chalet log cabins set into the timber, or aboard the 42-foot vessel MV Nekhani during multi-day fjord expeditions. The resort sits at the end of the famously steep Highway 20 descent into the Bella Coola Valley, making it a dramatic destination for cyclists tackling one of BC's most remote routes.
712d69b2e6: Nimpo Lake Resort is a small, historic lakefront cabin resort on Nimpo Lake in BC's West Chilcotin, sitting directly on Highway 20 roughly midway between Williams Lake and Bella Coola. The property dates to the late 1960s and offers a mix of year-round and seasonal cabins ranging from a two-bedroom unit to a five-bedroom lodge. For cyclists riding the Highway 20 corridor, it is a natural overnight stop with lake access for paddling and fishing, and notably has invested in dedicated fiber-optic internet infrastructure.
3dbc7eb6d3: Sunnycrest Motel offers overnight accommodation on Gibsons Way with WiFi access. Further amenities and services require verification due to website unavailability.
a1ab8d77a9: Ramada Limited Merritt is a mid-scale Wyndham-branded hotel located on Voght Street in Merritt, a highway town at the junction of the Coquihalla and the Okanagan connector routes. As part of the Ramada Limited tier, it is a straightforward lodging option for travellers passing through the Thompson-Nicola region. Touring cyclists riding the interior plateau routes will find it a conveniently situated overnight stop in an otherwise spread-out town.
6a3feae1e0: The Stoke Hotel is a SureStay Collection property by Best Western situated in Revelstoke in the Selkirk Mountains, directly across from the Revelstoke Suspension Bridge with mountain views. Rooms feature décor celebrating Canadian heritage, and the property offers pet-friendly accommodations with kitchenettes and jetted tubs. It sits a short distance from downtown Revelstoke, making it a convenient base for cyclists exploring the area.
6aacad9eb6: Pomeroy Inn and Suites Prince George is a hotel providing standard accommodation in the city, part of a chain operating across British Columbia. As a mid-sized chain hotel, it represents a conventional lodging option for touring cyclists passing through the region.
38d9689f5c: The Clydesdale Inn is a three-storey hotel located in the Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley region of British Columbia. Its website is currently in maintenance mode, so details about rooms, services, and facilities are not publicly available. Touring cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley corridor may find it a useful overnight stop, pending confirmation of amenities.
63551c3d01: Shiraz Villa is a family-owned boutique hotel nestled within a 25-acre vineyard on the outskirts of Osoyoos, offering ten private villas and a two-bedroom guest house with panoramic views of Osoyoos Lake and the surrounding mountains. Each villa features a private patio, Jacuzzi tub, and rain shower, while the guest house includes a fully equipped kitchen with washer and dryer. Located roughly five minutes from Osoyoos town centre, it sits in the heart of the Okanagan wine country along Highway 3, a popular cycling corridor.
0d5e88d005: Chateau Big White is a hotel offering studios and suites slope-side at Big White Ski Resort, located in BC's Okanagan highlands southeast of Kelowna. The resort operates year-round, with a ski season in winter and a summer season featuring eBike tours, fat biking trails, and mountain activities. Guests are within walking distance of on-mountain restaurants, a market, and the full range of resort services.
1a8a1c058e: The Nimpkish Hotel is a historic waterfront property in Alert Bay on Cormorant Island, reached by ferry from Port McNeill on Vancouver Island. Its nine rooms overlook the Broughton Strait, and the deck is a well-known spot for watching whales, eagles, and seals. The hotel is surrounded by First Nations cultural sites, 15 km of woodland trails, and activities like kayaking and salmon fishing.
f37834455c: North Country Inn & Suites is a family-run motel established in 1984, situated in the heart of downtown Vanderhoof — the geographical centre of British Columbia — along Highway 16 between Prince George and Prince Rupert. The 40-room property spans four buildings and includes an on-site restaurant locally known as the 'Log House,' serving Canadian-European cuisine from breakfast through dinner. Its central location puts guests within walking distance of shopping and parks, making it a practical overnight stop for touring cyclists on the Highway 16 corridor.
2454c90f6d: A renovated heritage boutique hotel originally built in 1896, perched on the shores of Kootenay Lake between the Purcell and Selkirk Mountains in the village of Kaslo. The elegantly updated property features spacious rooms with walk-out balconies, penthouse suites with full kitchens, and the on-site Waypoint Restaurant and Bar. Kaslo holds BC Green Business certification at the 'Green' level — the highest available — reflecting a genuine sustainability commitment.
eee5ded397: Beach Gardens Resort & Marina is a full-service oceanfront resort situated on Malaspina Strait in Powell River, on BC's Sunshine Coast. Each guest room features a private ocean-view patio, and the property includes a 55-slip marina, the award-winning Seasider Bistro, an on-site craft distillery, and a cold beer and wine store. A shuttle service to the Town Centre Mall is available upon request, making the resort a self-contained base for exploring the region.
aff6eddad1: The Pacific Inn is a locally owned and operated 3-star hotel in the heart of downtown Prince Rupert, BC — a key terminus for touring cyclists arriving or departing via BC Ferries. Ferry, train, and airline terminals are only minutes away, making it a natural first or last stop on a North Coast tour. The hotel offers complimentary continental breakfast and elevator access across three floors.
5216416163: The Best Western Maple Ridge Hotel is a full-service chain hotel on the Lougheed Highway in Maple Ridge, sitting minutes from Golden Ears Provincial Park and Whonnock Lake — two major outdoor destinations in the Fraser Valley. The property is pet-friendly and offers rooms with kitchenette options, making it a practical base for cyclists on multi-day touring routes through the Lower Mainland. Its position along the Lougheed corridor puts it close to the mountain gateways northeast of Vancouver.
cf588c68e0: Avalon Inn is a motel located on Main Street in the Okanagan region. It offers overnight lodging for touring cyclists and other travelers.
4d375ee288: Park Place Lodge is a locally-owned, independent hotel that has been operating in Fernie, British Columbia since 1981 under the Sombrowski family. The 64-room property includes an indoor pool and hot tub, a fitness centre, a cold beer and wine shop, and two on-site dining venues — a Bistro Restaurant and a Pub Bar & Grill. Situated on Highway 3 in the centre of Fernie, the hotel positions itself as an alternative to chain properties, with a stated commitment to environmental practices and support for local arts and culture.
4a5ab651c9: Road Runner Motel is a motel situated on Nicola Avenue in the Nicola Valley / Thompson region of British Columbia, a corridor used by touring cyclists travelling between the Interior and the Lower Mainland. As a roadside motel it offers basic overnight accommodation along this route. No further details about the property could be verified at this time.
75260142f2: Gold Pan Motel is a budget-friendly 20-room motel on Front Street in Quesnel, a town at the heart of BC's historic Gold Rush country along the Fraser River. The property is open 24 hours, is pet-friendly, and sits within walking distance of several riverside parks including Fraser River Park and LeBourdais Park. It offers free parking and free WiFi, making it a straightforward overnight stop for travellers moving through the Cariboo region.
ea9d0857e2: Tatla Lake Manor / Motel is a family-run motel sitting approximately halfway along the remote Highway 20 corridor in BC's Chilcotin region, 220 km west of Williams Lake — a natural stopping point for cyclists riding toward Bella Coola or back east. The property offers a range of accommodation from basic motel rooms to multi-bedroom fully-equipped kitchen suites, all with private bathrooms. It sits within walking distance of fuel, a post office, health centre, and local shopping, which is a meaningful convenience in this sparsely serviced stretch of the Chilcotin.
c51a0113a6: The Chalet is a long-established motel in the heart of Kitimat, BC, serving the community through generations of celebrations and special occasions — describing itself as a 'home away from home.' The property includes an attached restaurant, offering an on-site dining option for touring cyclists passing through the North Coast region. An amenities page exists on the website but its full content was not captured in the fetch.
f0ef272644: Econo Lodge is a budget motel chain providing basic room-based accommodation in Prince George. Specific amenities and bike storage arrangements could not be verified due to website access restrictions.
fd7c7a6278: Timberlane Beach Resort sits directly on sandy Saratoga Beach on Vancouver Island, offering six oceanview suites and four cabins tucked among old-growth Douglas firs, plus an RV park. Guests walk a tree-lined laneway to reach the Pacific shoreline, and the resort is open year-round. The property offers bike rentals and can arrange local activities including trail riding, fishing, and golf.
290401553b: A small motel with 17 rooms in Ashcroft, BC, providing accommodation for travelers in the Interior. Situated in a regional location useful for touring cyclists needing overnight stops.
1b19130d6c: Tyee Village Motel is a full-service motel in Port Alberni offering a range of units from standard rooms to full kitchen apartments sleeping up to six, making it a practical base for cyclists tackling the Pacific Rim Highway. The property features an outdoor pool (summer), an independently operated family restaurant open year-round, and free wireless internet. Its central location puts a 7-Eleven one block away and easy highway access within reach.
a4ef0c695c: Echo Landing is a collection of contemporary ski-in, ski-out townhomes and condos located in the quieter east village of Sun Peaks Resort, BC's second-largest four-season mountain resort. Units range from 2 to 4 bedrooms and include full kitchens, with select units offering private hot tubs. The property sits adjacent to the Orient chairlift and Sun Peaks' extensive bike park and trail network, making it a convenient base for mountain biking in summer.
00c2a15c14: Best Western Plus Revelstoke sits on Laforme Boulevard and positions itself as an adventure basecamp for visitors to the region, with direct access to the TransCanada Highway corridor and proximity to Revelstoke Mountain Resort and the Revelstoke Highline suspension bridge. The lobby is anchored by a hand-carved grizzly bear, and the property offers complimentary breakfast and free high-speed internet. It is a well-situated overnight stop for TransCanada touring cyclists passing through Revelstoke.
131439f089: The Cache Hotel and Lodgings is a hotel in the Kootenays region. As overnight lodging, it provides accommodation to travelers including touring cyclists exploring the area.
123632cecc: Island Lake Lodge is a world-class backcountry mountain resort near Fernie, B.C., comprising three timber-frame lodges — Tamarack, Cedar, and Red Eagle — with 26 guest rooms set within 7,000 acres of wilderness in the Lizard Range. Famous for legendary catskiing in winter, the property opens for summer stays from mid-June to mid-September, offering a spa, gourmet dining, guided hikes, and foraging experiences. The lodge operates off-grid with no TVs or fridges in guestrooms, though WiFi and cell service are available throughout.
0d98ce45ad: New Horizon Motel is a family-run, 25-room property in Christina Lake, BC, situated directly on Highway 3 (Crowsnest) and the Trans Canada Trail. The motel offers a range of room types from standard sleeping units to two-bedroom suites with full kitchens, and serves a complimentary continental breakfast to guests. It sits at a natural crossroads for cyclists exploring the Kettle Valley Railroad Trail, Grand Forks Community Trail, and Paulson Pass routes, with Christina Lake—one of the warmest lakes in Canada—just minutes away.
417c54dcfc: Handsome Dan's is a vacation rental management company offering over 30 unique cottages and homes in Port Renfrew and beyond, ranging from oceanfront properties to modern inland retreats. Originally founded by 'Handsome Dan and The French Girl' and taken over by Ken and Joy in 2020, the company manages self-catering properties with fully-equipped kitchens and coastal character. Port Renfrew sits at the trailhead of the Juan de Fuca Marine Trail and is a popular endpoint on the West Coast cycling route, making a self-catering cottage a practical base for touring cyclists in the area.
69a40249f1: Fortune's Landing Motel is a 30-room courtyard-style property in Enderby with an on-site restaurant, pub, and liquor store — an unusual all-in-one stop for touring cyclists passing through the Shuswap/Okanagan corridor. Guests walk through the restaurant and lounge to reach rooms that overlook a central courtyard with a swimming pool. The property regularly hosts large adventure groups (hikers, skiers) and has received consistent praise for friendly staff and clean rooms.
938ca080e1: Lizard Creek Lodge is a full-service luxury mountain lodge sited slopeside at Fernie Alpine Resort, offering ski-in/ski-out and bike-in/bike-out access directly from the property. The lodge comprises 14 suites in the main building plus 85 residential-style condominiums with full kitchens, gas fireplaces, and private balconies, making it well suited to multi-night touring stays. On-site amenities include the Cirque Restaurant & Bar, the Névé Day Spa, an outdoor heated pool, and hot tubs with mountain views.
2ce079a465: Noralee Resort is a waterfront resort on Francois Lake, 70km from Burns Lake in BC's Lakes District, offering year-round cabin rentals, RV sites with full or partial hookups, and tent camping on one of BC's purest lakes. The resort is a destination for sport fishing — rainbow trout, kokanee, Dolly Varden, char, and burbot — with annual fishing derbies all summer and boat rentals available on site. An on-site store stocks forgotten supplies, and the remote lakeside setting puts guests amid eagles, osprey, bears, moose, and deer in the Cariboo Chilcotin backcountry.
512657e713: Moutcha Bay Resort is a remote oceanfront fishing resort on the shores of Nootka Sound, roughly two hours by road from Campbell River through Strathcona Park and the village of Gold River. It offers a range of accommodation from two-storey lodge suites and luxury cedar yurts to waterfront chalets and 24-site RV and tent camping with full hook-ups. An on-site licensed restaurant (Conuma Grill), a full-service marina with boat rentals, kayak and paddleboard hire, and guided fishing round out the experience on Vancouver Island's wild west coast.
46e1ee59b1: West Coast Trail Lodge is a 20-suite, fully renovated motel in Port Renfrew, sitting just two kilometres from the Juan De Fuca Marine Trail and operated under the Wild Renfrew brand. Room options range from standard king rooms with balcony to a two-bedroom suite with a full kitchen, and all rooms are pet-friendly. On-site food and drink are available at the Renfrew Pub and Coastal Kitchen, making it a convenient base for multi-day coastal wilderness trips.
433f5e1046: White Cap Motel is a retro-themed motel in the historic town of Wells, BC, offering rooms ranging from single-occupancy doubles to two-bedroom kitchenette suites, including a step-free accessible room. Owners live on-site enabling 24/7 check-in, a practical feature for touring cyclists with unpredictable arrival times. The property is associated with Diggy's Diner and is situated near Bowron Lake and Barkerville, making it a convenient base for multi-day Cariboo touring.
b00ac0b8fb: Crown Isle is an 871-acre Canadian-owned full-service resort and residential golf community situated in the Comox Valley near Courtenay on Vancouver Island, centred on an award-winning Platinum-rated 18-hole championship golf course with views of the Beaufort range and Comox Glacier. The resort complex includes 114 suites, villas, and cottages, plus the Timber Room Bar & Grill overlooking the 18th green and a fitness centre within the clubhouse. Touring cyclists exploring the Comox Valley will find a polished, amenity-rich base with on-site dining in an accessible location.
57479dd5d0: Kitimat Lodge is a full-service fishing and adventure lodge in Kitimat, BC, offering guided fly fishing, saltwater, and freshwater fishing trips on the Skeena, Kitimat, Nass, and Kalum rivers. Accommodation ranges from single and double suites to deluxe cabins with well-equipped kitchens, with all-inclusive fishing packages available. Beyond fishing, the lodge arranges helicopter tours, hot springs visits, whale watching, and kayak transport into remote coastal Northwest BC.
421a2f6d93: Corbett Lake Lodge is a historic fly-fishing resort built in 1942, sitting on 300 acres of sub-alpine grassland near Merritt, BC, with an international reputation for trophy catch-and-release trout fishing. The property offers rustic cedar cabins and lodge rooms with self-catering kitchen facilities, surrounded by working cattle ranches, wildlife habitat, and recreational lakes. Cycling is explicitly listed among the outdoor activities available at or near the property, making it a potential rest stop for touring cyclists on Highway 5A.
db20677816: Timberline Lodges is a sprawling 168-suite condo complex at Fernie Alpine Resort, developed across six buildings between 1989 and 2008 and managed by Fernie Lodging Company. Located on Timberline Crescent at the ski resort base, it places guests within easy reach of Fernie's celebrated mountain bike trail network and the lively historic downtown. The property offers shared resort-style facilities including a heated outdoor pool, six hot tubs, sauna, games room, and fitness room spread across the buildings.
ec2428cdf2: Kye Bay Cottages is a historic beachfront cottage resort on the east coast of Vancouver Island that has hosted families since 1923, offering cedar-built 1- and 2-bedroom cottages with direct access to miles of sandy shoreline on the Georgia Strait. The property sits in the Comox Valley, a region known for cycling, including proximity to Cumberland's 80+ km of legendary mountain bike singletrack. Cottages are fully self-catering and the property operates year-round, including winter off-season retreats.
a75b94fbb7: Winston Lodge is an intimate 11-room boutique lodge situated steps from Kicking Horse Mountain Resort and 13 km from Golden, BC, making it a natural base for mountain bikers, hikers, and ski tourers exploring the Canadian Rockies. The property features a dedicated equipment room for bikes, ski storage, and a boot dryer, alongside a barrel sauna and hot tub for post-ride recovery. Guests describe attentive, knowledgeable hosts and a cozy common area with a floor-to-ceiling fireplace — the kind of place a touring cyclist remembers.
88efa68cf1: The 28 Inn Hotel is a small, independently operated hotel in New Hazelton, BC, situated at a strategic junction for travellers heading toward the Yukon, BC's Pacific Coast, or the Rocky Mountains. The property offers standard, kitchenette, and family rooms with refrigerators, microwaves, and air conditioning. Grocery stores, restaurants, a gas station, a bank, and a post office are all described as within walking distance of the hotel.
c339c7e358: Barnabas Landing is a Christian retreat centre founded in 1986, situated on the north side of Keats Island off BC's Sunshine Coast and operated by Barnabas Family Ministries. The property hosts curated year-round retreats for families and leaders, as well as group bookings for non-profit, ministry, and corporate organizations ranging from 20 to 80 guests. Reaching the centre requires a boat or ferry crossing from the Gibsons/Langdale area, making it an unusual but scenic island destination.
69d753aa4b: Northwinds Lodge is a 20-unit motel in Dawson Creek, British Columbia, operated as part of The Lodge Motor Inn group serving the Peace Country region. Rooms are fully modernized and include kitchenettes, individual climate control, and in-room fridges, making it practical for both short stopovers and extended stays. The property caters to a wide range of travellers including tourists and long-haul truckers, with large-vehicle parking and winter engine plug-ins available on site.
538e045077: Airport Inn is a renovated motel situated just minutes from the Port Hardy Airport and the BC Ferries terminal — a critical gateway for cyclists completing a Vancouver Island tour or connecting to Prince Rupert. The property offers a range of room types including kitchenette units suited for extended stays, along with an on-site restaurant, liquor store, and meeting rooms. Its location near the northern terminus of Island cycling routes makes it a strategically important stop in an area with limited accommodation options.
75b4b0b80d: Inn Towne Motel is a mountain-setting motel in Hope, BC, situated along the Trans-Canada Highway close to Coquihalla Canyon Provincial Park and the Othello Tunnels. Rooms are individually furnished and range from standard kings to pet-friendly double queens and kitchenette suites — practical options for cyclists who need to do laundry or cook after a long day. The property also features a Jacuzzi and swimming pool, and guest reviews consistently praise the cleanliness and hospitality of the hands-on management.
2c8642dd7c: Twin Valley Inn is a hotel on Yellowhead Highway in the Smithers area. It provides overnight accommodation for traveling cyclists and others. Specific amenities and services require direct contact with the business for verification.
70805a7e3a: Gracie's Place is an accommodation in the North Coast region of British Columbia. The business also provides car rental services, making it a multi-service facility for travelers in this remote area. It serves as a potential stop for cyclists exploring the northern coast and Haida Gwaii regions.
bc5751dd84: The 94 Mile Motel is a family-run property established in the early 1970s, situated on 15 private acres of Cariboo wilderness bordering crown land about 5 minutes south of 100 Mile House near the Highway 97 and Highway 24 junction. The motel offers 10 renovated suites averaging 340 sq ft, eight of which include full kitchens, plus seasonal RV sites with full water, electricity, and sewer hookups. Trails accessible directly from the property and proximity to some of North America's best sport fishing lakes make this a natural stop for touring cyclists exploring the Cariboo region.
3144a8ab95: Rocky Mountain Springs Lodge is a hilltop motel in Radium Hot Springs, BC, marketed for its panoramic Rocky Mountain panorama—the 'Million Dollar View' that names its website—with a licensed patio and private balconies on upper-floor rooms. The property operates Peak Horn Hotpot & Bubble Tea as its on-site restaurant, offering guests an evening dining option without leaving the premises. It sits close to Kootenay National Park and the Columbia Valley cycling corridor, making it a convenient overnight stop for cyclists travelling the region.
422ff20c25: Wild Bear Lodge is a small, intimate luxury wilderness retreat set among six private log cabins along the Lardeau River in BC's Central Selkirk Mountains, within the world's largest inland temperate rainforest. The lodge specializes in guided grizzly and black bear viewing holidays, leading small groups into remote valleys with experienced naturalist guides. Cycling travellers on the remote Highway 31 corridor near Poplar Creek would find modern cabin comfort — hot showers, comfortable beds, and high-speed internet — in an exceptionally wild setting.
79b7c9b532: A 20-unit roadside motel in New Hazelton, northern BC, sitting just off the Yellowhead Highway corridor on the route toward Alaska and serving a mix of seasonal workers, fishing tourists, and long-distance road travelers. The property positions itself as a quiet, practical alternative to hotel chains, emphasizing convenience for those recharging between legs of a long journey through Skeena Country. The email domain stay@robbersroost.ca still carries the legacy brand name, suggesting a rebrand rather than a complete ownership change.
28c4626ee0: Passage View Motel is a 30-room oceanfront property in Campbell River, BC, positioned directly on the ocean side of the Island Highway with unobstructed views of Discovery Passage, Quadra Island, and the Coastal Mountains from every room. Guests have private access to the rocky shoreline below, where seals, Orcas, dolphins, and a variety of seabirds are regularly spotted. The motel offers pet-friendly rooms and serves as a convenient base for salmon fishing, Strathcona Provincial Park hiking, and ferry day trips to Quadra and Cortes Islands.
5e9246d98e: Mile Zero Motel is a small, owner-operated motel in Midway, BC, sitting just metres from the Kettle Valley Railway Trail — one of BC's premier long-distance cycling routes. Hosts Vickie and Tracy have welcomed touring cyclists, hikers, and outdoor enthusiasts for over 16 years, with immaculate rooms and a quiet Kettle Valley setting that makes it a natural overnight stop on a KVR tour. The motel provides free on-site parking for guests leaving bikes while they ride the trail and enforces a clear, cyclist-oriented bike-storage policy.
3ee2f5597d: The Inn at Big White is a hotel accommodation option situated within Big White Ski Resort, one of BC's largest mountain resorts located in the Okanagan highlands east of Kelowna. The resort operates in both winter and summer seasons, with summer offerings including eBike tours, fat biking trails, Nordic activities, and on-mountain dining. A touring cyclist staying here would be at a full-service mountain resort with shuttle transport, wellness services, and a range of dining options on site.
a29411e032: Taseko Adventures is a remote wilderness lodge and resort on Taseko Lake in British Columbia's Chilcotin region, reachable by 3+ hours of off-road travel or floatplane transfer from Whistler. Guests stay in deluxe log cabins and can choose between fully guided all-inclusive wilderness packages or self-contained cabin rentals, with activities ranging from jet boat excursions to guided hunting. The lodge emphasizes rustic authenticity, organic cuisine, and a wood-fired sauna and hot tub in an untouched backcountry setting.
add6a4bfae: The Reid Hotel is a 9-room boutique hotel in Vanderhoof, BC, occupying a landmark 1916 building that was famously relocated to its current site by a team of horses in the 1930s — originally known as the Egan, then the Mayo. The interior has been substantially reimagined with premium finishes including heated bathroom floors, Frette Italian linens, Nespresso machines, and Victoria & Albert freestanding bathtubs in select rooms. For touring cyclists on the long central-interior corridor of BC, it offers an unusually upscale overnight stop in a small northern community.
80173e3406: Premier Creek Lodging is the oldest hotel in Haida Gwaii, established in 1910 and situated in the heart of Daajing Giids (Queen Charlotte). It offers a range of rooms from large oceanview suites to a private cottage and quieter garden rooms, all with private bathrooms and free Wi-Fi. The hotel is a short walk from the marina, a laundromat, an ATM, and several village restaurants — making it a practical base for cyclists exploring the islands.
6385835d28: Days Inn by Wyndham Chetwynd is a branded mid-range hotel situated in Chetwynd, a small northeastern BC town at the junction of Highways 97 and 29 in the Peace River region. It is part of the Wyndham Hotels network and participates in the Wyndham Rewards loyalty programme. For cycle tourists riding through the remote northern interior, it represents one of the few branded accommodation options in the area.
1694dc08fa: Motel Bavaria is a motel in the Kootenays region located on McKay Street. The business maintains contact information for guest inquiries and reservations.
83f0688259: A 24-hour motel on 3rd Avenue serving travelers and cyclists throughout the Vancouver Island region. The round-the-clock operation provides flexibility for cycling tours with variable arrival times.
