40574978c2: Prestige Mountain Resort is a full-service hotel in the mountain town of Rossland, tucked between the Monashee and Selkirk ranges and five minutes from some of BC's best ski and mountain bike terrain. As part of the family-owned Prestige Hotels & Resorts chain, it provides a professionally managed, amenity-rich base for touring cyclists exploring the Kootenays.
34d5ac0676: Lakeview Inn & Suites is a full-service hotel in Chetwynd, part of the western Canada Lakeview Hotels and Resorts chain, positioned along the North Access Road in this small Northern BC resource town. Touring cyclists passing through Chetwynd — a common stop on routes through the Peace River country — will find a professionally run property with standard hotel amenities.
a945b3093d: The Griz Inn is a ski-in/ski-out hotel and condominium complex situated at the base of Fernie Alpine Resort, originally built in 1983 and a fixture of the resort for over 30 years. b11bad71cc: Skylite Motel is a family-run motel centrally located in Parksville on Vancouver Island, offering standard queen rooms, deluxe kitchenette suites, and private cottages. 253792424f: The Great Divide Lodge is a hotel located in the Kootenays, a popular cycling region in British Columbia. Website access issues prevent verification of what facilities and amenities it offers to cyclists.
034656aa67: Parklane Resort & Motel is a motel-class lodging in the Okanagan region. Specific amenities and cyclist facilities could not be verified as the business website was unavailable during assessment. The property appears open and publicly accessible as overnight accommodation.
f2728bee40: A family-owned, 25-room motel on Highway 5 in Barriere, BC, operated by the Blanke family since 1995 and positioned roughly halfway between Vancouver and Jasper—making it a natural overnight stop on a long-distance touring route. 4d4c5c5fbb: King Pacific Lodge is a luxury floating sport fishing resort moored at Milbanke Sound on BC's remote Central Coast, reachable only by floatplane or boat. afbc71c215: Riverhaven RV Park and Motel sits on the banks of the Similkameen River at Hedley along Highway 3 (Crowsnest Pass), offering 22 full-service RV sites plus four motel rooms for those wanting an indoor stay. It occupies a strategically useful position on a major BC interior touring corridor through the scenic Similkameen Valley.
df44301e5e: Genellehouse Apartments is a small accommodation in Genelle, British Columbia, in the Kootenay region, offering at least two rental units including a Queen Room with garden and mountain views, hardwood floors, and luxury bedding. b66031d35a: Best Western Terrace Inn is a fully renovated, 100% non-smoking hotel on Greig Avenue in Terrace, BC, described by the property as the town's finest hotel with personalized service. 807b9b354d: Motel 6 Fort Nelson is a budget motel franchise in northern British Columbia. It serves as a lodging option for touring cyclists passing through the Fort Nelson area.
ec50c15f6f: Saddle Mountain Lodge is mapped in OSM as a motel in the Blue River area of BC's Cariboo/Central Interior region. 8b98eafdfb: Sunshine Inn is a Northern BC motel chain with four locations along Highway 16, positioned as a popular stop for travellers between Prince George and Prince Rupert or heading to Alaska. The front desk operates 24 hours and staff will store luggage for guests who arrive early or need extra time after checkout.
19a1800182: Three Valley Lake Chateau is a large 200-room lakeside hotel on the Trans-Canada Highway near Revelstoke, set against rugged mountain scenery on the shores of Three Valley Lake. Room types range from standard guest rooms to multi-level specialty suites, most with private balconies or patios overlooking the gardens and lake.
9648c5e491: The Travelodge by Wyndham McBride is a branded chain hotel situated on the North West Frontage Road in McBride, a small community in BC's Robson Valley along Highway 16. 4f415be22d: The Carmel Inn is a renovated motel in the heart of central Prince George offering a range of room types from standard queens and kings to family suites and jacuzzi suites, all with kitchenette facilities. The property includes an adjoining full-service restaurant — the Carmel Restaurant — making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through or based in Prince George. The inn has a long history of hosting travellers on Highway 97, a major north-south touring route through British Columbia's interior.
5298ed339e: Arbutus Grove Motel provides overnight accommodation on East Island Highway on Vancouver Island. Positioned on a main island transportation corridor, it is accessible to touring cyclists exploring the region.
db06de4715: Malei Island Resort is a remote, off-grid, 45-acre wilderness lodge on Malei Island, reachable only by water taxi from Port Hardy. The surrounding area was featured in the Netflix documentary 'Island of the Sea Wolves.'
b550d7842c: The Old House Hotel & Spa is an all-suite hotel set along the Courtenay River Estuary in the Comox Valley, comprising two West Coast-inspired buildings named Maple and Cedar. It offers a full-service spa, outdoor heated pool and hot tub, gym, kitchenette-equipped suites, and a 24-hour refreshment centre. Centrally located a few blocks from downtown Courtenay, it is well-positioned for cyclists exploring Vancouver Island's east coast and the broader Comox Valley.
a1c268b81d: Glacier Mountaineer Lodge is listed as a hotel on Kicking Horse Trail within the Kicking Horse Mountain Resort area of Golden, British Columbia. Golden sits at the gateway to Yoho, Glacier, and Banff National Parks, offering year-round access to alpine terrain and road cycling in the Canadian Rockies. The associated Kicking Horse Lodging portfolio includes several on-mountain and in-town properties managed by Bellstar Resorts.
41f7f19784: Pender Harbour Hotel is a family-owned coastal property in Madeira Park on the Sunshine Coast, offering west coast-style guest rooms alongside the Grasshopper Pub and Restaurant, a liquor store, and a marina dock. The pub features a generous patio overlooking Madeira Park harbour, making it a natural stopping point for cyclists travelling the Sunshine Coast Highway. The marina dock also accepts short and long-term moorage, reflecting the property's role as a hub for both land and water travellers.
27c2539ffc: Casa Grande Inn is a three-storey oceanside inn in Qualicum Beach, situated on the Oceanside Highway midway between Victoria and Tofino on Vancouver Island. The inn offers 17 rooms and suites all facing the ocean, some with jacuzzi tubs, private decks, and kitchenettes. It is a short ride from downtown Qualicum Beach and 12km north of Parksville, making it a convenient overnight stop for cyclists touring the Vancouver Island corridor.
ed9136a8e6: Causeway Bay Hotel & Conference Centre is a full-service hotel in Sparwood at the heart of the Elk Valley, steps from the famous Titan Truck landmark. The property includes an on-site restaurant and lounge alongside three conference and event spaces ranging from an 18-person boardroom to a 130-person ballroom. It sits within 30 minutes of world-class skiing and close to hiking trails, making it a practical overnight stop for cyclists touring the Kootenay region.
f27a647968: Days Inn Golden is a franchise hotel operated under the Days Inn by Wyndham brand, located in Golden, BC — a gateway community to Yoho and Glacier National Parks and a stop on several major cycling routes through the Rocky Mountains. As a full-service roadside hotel it offers standard room accommodation in a town with limited lodging options for touring cyclists. The Wyndham Rewards loyalty program is available for guests booking direct.
497933860f: Wild Renfrew (OSM: Wild Coast Wilderness Resort) is a multi-unit wilderness resort in Port Renfrew at the western terminus of the West Coast Road, where forest, river, and sea converge roughly two hours from Victoria. An on-site waterfront pub — the Renfrew Pub — offers draught beer and food year-round, making it a natural end-of-day stop for cyclists finishing a long coastal ride.
0f84c0a861: Deerview Lodge & Cabins is a family-run property on the Crowsnest Highway in Princeton, BC, offering rooms, suites, and pet-friendly cabins with fully equipped kitchens in every unit. Touring cyclists passing through on the Crowsnest route would find a functional overnight stop with full kitchen access and Wi-Fi, though the property's services and marketing are firmly oriented toward workforce accommodation.
dd1c66d10d: A motel on Highway 31 in the Kootenays region of southeastern British Columbia, positioned along a major cycling touring corridor. Serves as overnight accommodation for travelers and cyclists passing through the area. The location provides a convenient rest stop for bicycle touring routes in the region.
2292662612: A family-run motel nestled in the UNESCO Global Geopark in the remote community of Tumbler Ridge in Northern BC, offering a rare concentration of on-site amenities for such a remote location. The property includes a café and dining room, the Coal Bin Pub, an attached liquor store, pet-friendly rooms, kitchenettes, and an on-site hair salon. Touring cyclists riding through Northern BC will find it a well-equipped stop with access to world-class hiking, fishing, and wildlife viewing in the surrounding wilderness.
be9f1002f9: Langara Island Lodge is a remote, fly-in all-inclusive luxury fishing resort on the northern tip of Haida Gwaii, reachable only by charter flight from Vancouver to Masset followed by a 15-minute helicopter transfer to the island. The lodge is widely regarded as one of BC's premier saltwater salmon fishing destinations, operating 17 fully equipped 25-foot guide boats with professional staff and offering packages for couples, families, and corporate groups. Three accommodation options — Chinook Lodge, Eagle Lodge, and Raven Cottage — provide guests with what the lodge describes as relaxed luxury in a strikingly isolated Pacific setting.
c31b5d2b63: Safari Beach Resort is a lakefront condominium resort on the shores of Lake Osoyoos — the warmest lake in Canada — in the sunny South Okanagan. Shops, restaurants, golf courses, a water park, and wineries are all within walking distance or a short ride, making it a practical and scenic stop for touring cyclists passing through the Okanagan.
4dd02f6152: The Gold Bridge Hotel is a historic hotel and pub in the remote gold-rush town of Gold Bridge, nestled in BC's Bridge River Valley — one of the few services in a region defined by rugged backcountry and mining heritage. The current building was originally the Legion hall from the nearby ghost town of Bralorne, relocated and reimagined; the current owner has renovated it since 2018 while preserving its small-town character. Guests can unwind in the hot tub or sauna after a long ride, and the on-site pub and restaurant make it a natural gathering point in an area with very limited alternatives.
0424aad775: Bear Country Inn is a modern boutique hotel/motel in the heart of downtown Terrace, BC, offering 57 recently renovated rooms across six configurations including kitchenette suites and an executive jacuzzi suite. The property features a fully-licensed on-site restaurant, a 24-hour front desk, and cardlock electronic room keys. Its central downtown location is within walking distance of shopping centres, banks, and medical services — a practical base for cyclists needing resupply or rest.
5810fcfb79: Big Rock Motel is a 22-room oceanfront motel on Campbell River's Seawalk, facing Discovery Passage in the self-described 'Salmon Capital of the World.' The motel is located just south of downtown Campbell River on the scenic Oceanside Route (Highway 19A), making it a convenient stop for touring cyclists travelling Vancouver Island's east coast.
6bb157375a: The Coach Light Motel & RV Park sits on Highway 16 about one hour west of Prince George in Vanderhoof, serving travellers crossing through BC's Central Interior. It offers two-bedroom suites with kitchenettes and self check-in via passcode, making it well-suited for independent travellers arriving at odd hours. The property also has full RV hook-ups and spacious parking designed for large vehicles, giving touring cyclists ample room to maneuver with trailers.
e94fb03af5: Moosehaven Resort is a seasonal lakeside retreat on Hathaway Lake near 100 Mile House, offering heated lakefront cabins with full kitchens and 33 serviced RV sites along popular touring routes toward Banff, Whistler, and Alaska. The resort has operated for over 20 years and is known for its quiet, wildlife-rich setting and explicitly inclusive, everyone-friendly culture. Touring cyclists will find laundry, strong fiber-optic Wi-Fi across the whole property, and on-site kayak and canoe rentals.
61e7fe34a9: Park Inn by Radisson Osoyoos is a contemporary hotel in the heart of Osoyoos town centre, positioned in Canada's only desert region at the southern tip of the Okanagan Valley. The property features a seasonal outdoor pool and hot tub, BBQ and picnic areas set against desert landscapes, and mountain and pool-view rooms. With 24-hour reception and free on-site parking (including accessible spaces), it is a practical overnight base for cyclists touring the Okanagan.
fbc1f06e36: Echo Landing is the newest ski-in, ski-out property at Sun Peaks Resort, positioned between the 15th fairway of BC's highest-elevation golf course and the Orient chairlift. The development offers contemporary 2- to 4-bedroom townhomes and condos with full kitchens, and select units include private hot tubs. It sits in the quieter east village, just a short walk from the main village and directly adjacent to Sun Peaks' extensive mountain-bike trail network.
b7a113b171: Island Silver Sands Cottages is a small beach resort on Saratoga Beach near Black Creek on Vancouver Island, offering 1- and 2-bedroom cottages with fully equipped kitchens and oceanfront RV sites with full hookups. The property sits steps from a safe sandy beach with a campfire pit and sweeping ocean views, and is surrounded by provincial parks, a marina, and trails. Cycling is explicitly called out among the activities accessible from the resort, making it a plausible base for touring cyclists exploring the east coast of Vancouver Island.
811b6517a4: Taylor's Sandy Beach Resort sits on a hard-packed sandy beach on Saratoga Beach, on the east coast of Vancouver Island between Courtenay/Comox and Campbell River. The resort offers a mix of log cabins, beachfront condominiums, and RV/tent sites, all with ocean views and access to beachfront fire rings and a children's play area. It is within walking distance of a marina, fishing, golf, and hiking trails, making it a convenient base for exploring this stretch of the Island.
6af80ebf99: Intown Inn & Suites is a standard motel offering basic overnight accommodation. The facility provides Wi-Fi access to guests. It serves as a convenient lodging option for touring cyclists traveling through the region.
82e01aefbd: Valley Motel is a 29-room, two-storey motel situated directly on Highway 3 in Sparwood, in the heart of the Elk Valley coal-mining region of BC's Kootenays. The property shares a building with the Arrowana Restaurant, an award-winning Chinese and Western cuisine eatery that has been a local favourite. Sparwood sits on a key Crowsnest Pass touring corridor, making this an accessible and convenient overnight stop for cyclists traversing the region.
69ffb9b887: The Mighty Fraser Motel is a roadside motel on the Trans-Canada Highway in the Okanagan region. The business's website is a placeholder indicating pre-launch status, with no substantive information available about amenities or services.
25c1eb2c4b: Shorewater Resort is a self-contained, condo-style beachfront resort in Qualicum Beach, perched directly on a natural sandy and pebble beach overlooking the Strait of Georgia and the coastal mountains. Guests stay in individually owned, fully equipped suites ranging from garden-view units to oceanfront chalets, all with private patios and full kitchens. f532f24f74: Holiday Inn Express & Suites Terrace is a mid-range hotel chain location situated on the Yellowhead Highway in Terrace. 7e98f87f27: Sandy Beach Suites is a family-run lakefront resort on a quiet sandy bay of Osoyoos Lake, welcoming guests since opening as Sandy Beach Motel in 1962. Guests have access to a private beach, kayaks, paddle boards, and a sports court on a large smoke-free property.
010fe78342: The Old Courthouse Inn is a boutique heritage hotel occupying a 1939 Tudor-style building in Powell River's National Historic District — once the town's courthouse, police station, and jail. f7ba0803cf: Sandman Inn Blue River is a chain motel situated directly on Highway 5 in Blue River, a small Central Interior community that serves as a key waypoint on routes through the Monashees and toward Jasper. 1aca6c4fde: Big White is a large, self-contained mountain resort in BC's Okanagan highlands offering full on-mountain accommodation alongside both winter and summer activities. The village includes restaurants, grocery ordering, medical services, and a range of lodging from hotels to self-catered units.
9ab740b8c5: Located directly on Osoyoos Lake in the South Okanagan, this beachfront resort offers accommodations ranging from basic studio suites to three-bedroom lakefront condos, many with full kitchens and lake-view balconies. It sits within easy reach of several restaurants, wineries, and golf courses that define the Osoyoos region.
b0c59fc565: Prestige Inn Golden is a hotel located on the Trans-Canada Highway in Golden, British Columbia. It provides overnight accommodation for travelers, including cycling tourists passing through the Kootenay region.
1a7d738917: The Frontier Motel sits on the Nakusp-Mica Creek Highway in the Okanagan & Thompson region of British Columbia, a rural corridor connecting the Arrow Lakes area to Mica Creek. 374eddd1b5: The Pine Point Resort is a lakeside resort located near Nimpo Lake in BC's remote Cariboo, Chilcotin and Central Interior region. de750368bf: Bayview Hotel is a full-service hotel situated in the heart of Courtenay's commercial district in the Comox Valley, just off Highway 19. It positions itself as a convenient stopover along the Highway 16 corridor, with grocery stores and restaurants within walking distance. The property also offers a Ski & Stay package and is pet-friendly, reflecting the outdoor-oriented character of the Bulkley Valley region.
a4a954a5d8: Marine Inn is a hotel on Marine Avenue offering wireless internet access. Located in the Vancouver Island and Gulf Islands area, it provides overnight accommodation for travelers including cycling tourists exploring the region.
b9a82ca1b8: Nootka Sound Resort is a luxury all-inclusive floating fishing lodge moored at Galiano Bay in Nootka Sound, reachable only by boat or floatplane. Operated by Nootka Marine Adventures, it offers private suites, gourmet meals, guided salmon and halibut fishing, kayaking, and stand-up paddleboarding in sheltered waters. The resort is open June through August and caters primarily to fishing groups and corporate retreats.
d7c8ce0109: Crown Columbia Hotel BW Premier Collection is a newly designed all-suite boutique hotel in the heart of downtown Trail, situated along the Columbia River. Every suite comes with a full kitchen and deluxe amenities, well-suited for touring cyclists needing a comfortable multi-night base. The central downtown location puts guests within easy walking distance of restaurants, coffee shops, the Cominco Arena, and the riverfront.
6ab20d989d: Riverside Resort is a 7-acre resort on the Little Qualicum River near Parksville/Qualicum Beach on Vancouver Island, offering accommodations ranging from studio suites and standalone cabins to two-story condos and full hook-up RV sites with 30 and 50 amp service. The property features private riverfront access, a seasonal waterpark with pools and waterslides, an 18-hole mini-golf course, and an on-site R&R convenience store, all within a 5-minute walk of the ocean. RV sites are available year-round with extended stay options, making it a potential base for longer touring visits to the Oceanside region.
275f7c5e74: The Travelodge Golden Sportsman Lodge is a branded Travelodge by Wyndham property in Golden, BC, a hub town for cyclists tackling the Rocky Mountains or connecting between Banff and the Kootenays. As a mid-scale chain hotel it offers a familiar, reliable overnight stop on one of BC's most demanding touring corridors. The 'Sportsman Lodge' name suggests an outdoor-recreation orientation, though specific cyclist services are not confirmed from available sources.
fbb870b066: Rivers Edge Cabins offers two private riverfront cabins on the Nahatlatch River near Boston Bar, BC, situated 1 km from Nahatlatch Provincial Park with access to hiking, fishing, rafting, and wildlife viewing. The property reopened after a wildfire and now also offers one RV/camping spot, with eco-friendly shared washroom facilities including flush toilets, on-demand hot water, and solar-powered lighting. It is a deliberately quiet, off-the-grid-style retreat well-positioned for cyclists exploring the Fraser Canyon corridor.
069b8c8161: The Canterbury Inn is a motel in downtown Invermere, a town on the western shore of Lake Windermere at the foot of the Rocky Mountains in southeastern British Columbia. It offers single, double, and family room configurations and sits close to regional draws including Panorama Mountain Resort, Radium Hot Springs, and Kootenay National Park trails. The inn's central location in Invermere puts touring cyclists within easy reach of local dining, shops, and the Columbia Valley Trail corridor.
a071e3f3ea: Baymont By Wyndham Gold River is a branded motel in Gold River on Vancouver Island, situated in one of the more remote communities accessible to touring cyclists on the island's western interior. As part of the Wyndham chain it offers a standardised mid-range stay with loyalty programme integration. Gold River is a small resource town with limited accommodation options, making this property a notable overnight option for cyclists riding the interior routes. The hotel is owned by the Mowachaht/Muchalaht First Nation, who reopened it in 2024 with Nuu-chah-nulth language and artwork throughout.
d86383df40: A motel in the Cariboo-Chilcotin region of northern BC. Situated on West 1st Street, it serves as a convenient rest stop for touring cyclists traversing this remote region.
da25c331e2: The Tuwanek is a small, adult-oriented luxury waterfront B&B on the Sunshine Coast just north of Sechelt, offering two themed king-suite rooms (African Queen and Casablanca) with ocean views, wood-burning fireplaces, and private decks. The property sits directly on the water and includes a spa, hot tub, steam cave, sandy beach, kayaks, canoe, and stand-up paddleboards. It is accessible via the Horseshoe Bay–Langdale ferry followed by a 40-minute drive up the coast.
a095bcf551: A family-operated, pet-friendly motel in Chase on the Trans-Canada Highway 1 corridor, situated in the Shuswap region between Kamloops and Salmon Arm. The property includes an on-site Chinese restaurant for evening meals and offers guests a complimentary seasonal breakfast during the warmer months. Its location on a busy touring route makes it a practical overnight stop for cyclists travelling the Thompson-Shuswap corridor.
a7d0ea0450: Chilko Lake Lodge is a remote wilderness retreat on the shores of Chilko Lake in BC's Chilcotin, offering privately appointed lakeside and riverside cabins, guided activities such as horseback riding, kayaking, fly fishing, and ATV tours, plus on-site dining featuring locally inspired cuisine. The lodge caters to exclusive-use holidays, corporate retreats, and family gatherings, set against towering mountains and turquoise glacial waters. Its River's Edge cabin alone sleeps up to eight guests, giving it capacity for larger cycling groups venturing deep into the Chilcotin.
5e74a011ee: The Lodge at Arrow Lakes is a 47-room motel tucked into the small town of Nakusp in BC's Arrow Lakes region, a natural waypoint for cyclists exploring the quieter Kootenay back roads. The property includes the Arrow Lake Tavern with an indoor dining room and outdoor patio serving food seven days a week. The surrounding area offers road cycling, lakeside walkways, and access to Valhalla Provincial Park in the Selkirk Mountains.
d43b11d45d: Langara Fishing Lodge is a remote floating fishing resort on Langara Island at the northern tip of Haida Gwaii, operated by Langara Fishing Adventures. Guests arrive by charter jet from Vancouver and helicopter transfer, with all meals, beverages, and guided Pacific salmon and halibut fishing included in packages. The lodge bills itself as North America's premier destination for ocean-run Chinook, Coho, and Halibut fishing across a May–September season.
cb848ba5db: The Nitinaht Lake Motel is a year-round, nine-room motel operated by the Ditidaht First Nation on the remote west coast of Vancouver Island, reachable via roughly 62 km of active logging road from Lake Cowichan. It sits at the gateway to the West Coast Trail's third entrance and the famed windsurfing fjord of Nitinaht Lake, making it the sole covered accommodation in this otherwise roadless stretch of coastline. Rooms range from simple queen-bed units to two-bedroom suites with kitchenettes, offering a functional base for cyclists tackling this wild corner of the island.
ba1001a4de: Echo Landing is the newest ski-in, ski-out property at Sun Peaks Resort, a major four-season mountain destination in the Thompson-Okanagan region. The contemporary townhomes and condos range from 2 to 4 bedrooms, each with a full kitchen, and sit in the quieter east village near the Orient chairlift and BC's highest-elevation golf course. Sun Peaks also operates a full bike park with rentals, lessons, and a pedal-access trail network directly accessible from the resort village.
2042a3fa9b: The Quilchena Hotel is a historic boutique property built in 1908, set in the Nicola Valley as part of the Douglas Lake Cattle Company's ranch operations. Originally established by the Guichon brothers, the heritage building features period antiques and rooms with pedestal wash-sinks, evoking turn-of-the-century ranching history. A touring cyclist arriving here will find a working ranch landscape, an on-site general store with gas, and a bar and grill, all in a remote and scenic Thompson-Nicola setting.
8153046f60: Bear's Claw Lodge is a 2-level motel on Cariboo Highway in the Okanagan region of British Columbia.
63830171fb: Red Tree Lodge is a 43-room hotel in Fernie, BC, situated on Highway 3 near downtown and a short drive from Fernie Alpine Resort in the Canadian Rockies. The lodge explicitly caters to cyclists with a dedicated bike amenities program, bike storage, and tuning tools alongside a heated boot room, indoor pool, hot tub, sauna, and fully equipped guest kitchen. Staff are described as outdoor enthusiasts with strong local knowledge of activities in the area.
40a7887efc: Klahoose Wilderness Resort is an award-winning, all-inclusive Indigenous-owned luxury retreat set in BC's Desolation Sound, operated by the Klahoose First Nation in their traditional territory. Guests stay in one of seven accommodations — four lodge rooms and three private oceanfront cedar cabins — and join guided wildlife and cultural experiences including grizzly bear viewing, whale watching, and kayaking. The resort is described as off-grid and is situated on Homfray Channel, making it a remote fly-in or boat-access destination rather than a road-accessible stop.
c00bc1dc88: Super 8 by Wyndham is a national budget motel chain located on Alaska Avenue in Dawson Creek, the southern terminus of the Alaska Highway and Mile Zero of one of cycling's most iconic long-distance routes. For touring cyclists completing or beginning the Alaska Highway journey, this motel offers a recognizable, consistent lodging option at a significant milestone destination. As a Wyndham property it participates in the Wyndham Rewards loyalty program.
30db4bc458: Ramada Limited Golden is a motel-style property in Golden, BC, operating under the Wyndham Hotels umbrella in the heart of the Kootenays. Golden sits at the confluence of the Kicking Horse and Columbia Rivers and serves as a gateway to Yoho National Park and the Trans-Canada cycling corridor. As a nationally recognized mid-range brand with a fixed address in a small mountain town, it is a predictable overnight option for long-distance touring cyclists passing through.
dc97414a31: Shearwater Resort & Marina is a Heiltsuk Nation-owned wilderness resort and fishing lodge on Denny Island, a short water taxi from Bella Bella on BC's Central Coast. The resort offers rooms, a marina, and a restaurant, and serves as the main service hub for visitors exploring the Great Bear Rainforest.
d881a6aeb8: Crooked Lake Resort is a remote, off-grid wilderness resort in the Cariboo Mountains that has operated since the early 1960s, offering rustic cabins, RV sites, and campsites accessed via Forest Service roads from 100 Mile House or Horsefly. The resort runs on solar and generator power with limited satellite communication and explicitly lists mountain biking among its surrounding recreational activities. It appeals to self-sufficient travellers seeking solitude, with a central wash-house featuring showers and a dishwashing station serving all accommodation types.
13f186430f: Coast Sundance Lodge is a full-service hotel belonging to the Coast Hotels chain, a network of properties spanning Canada and the United States. Located in BC's Thompson-Okanagan region, it serves as a base for visitors to the surrounding mountain and resort terrain. Touring cyclists passing through will find a branded hotel experience with the consistency of a managed chain property.
4f32dffd5e: Apple Tree Inn is a family-owned, ground-level motel in Radium Hot Springs at the edge of the Rocky Mountains, offering 1- and 2-bedroom suites with fully equipped kitchenettes. It is pet-friendly and positioned within walking distance of the town's restaurants and shops, with the Radium Hot Pools just two minutes away. Guest reviews highlight attentive ownership and clean, affordable rooms that suit both solo travellers and family groups.
5ae48c2aff: Truffle Pigs Bistro & Lodge is a 12-room mountain lodge in Field, British Columbia, situated in the heart of Yoho National Park just 20 minutes west of Lake Louise. Founded in 2000 as a café and general store, it expanded into its current lodge-and-bistro format in 2008 and has built a reputation for passionate, creative cooking alongside warm Rocky Mountain hospitality. Touring cyclists will find hearty on-site meals and rooms with sweeping views of the surrounding peaks.
c83fc91ca9: Port Augusta Inn is a hotel located on Comox Avenue in the Comox Valley on Vancouver Island. The business offers wireless internet access according to OSM records. Further details about bike facilities and amenities could not be confirmed due to website access failure.
3b792658a4: The Sandman Hotel Revelstoke is a two-building chain property (Selkirk and Monashee buildings) with an indoor pool, fitness centre, and an on-site Denny's restaurant. It holds Silver Certification from GreenStep Solutions for sustainability and offers a seasonal shuttle to Revelstoke Mountain Resort. Free overnight parking and pet-friendly rooms make it a practical base for travellers arriving by various means.
89472f1ea3: A Bamfield Inn (Flora's Stays) in Port Desire.
ab0063919d: Duncanby Lodge is a remote, all-inclusive salmon and halibut fishing destination in Rivers Inlet on BC's breathtaking Central Coast, family-owned by the Keay family since 2003. Guests arrive by chartered floatplane from Vancouver and can choose between self-guided and guided fishing in a fleet ranging from 18.5-foot centre consoles to 23–26-foot Grady Whites. The surrounding wilderness offers wildlife encounters with humpback whales, bears, and eagles across 40 kilometres of ocean and mountain scenery.
c707604a71: Alpine Lodge Fernie is an award-winning, purpose-built inn-style lodge at Fernie Alpine Resort — the largest lodge at the resort, accommodating groups of up to 18 guests across eight ensuite rooms on two floors. The lodge blends private-lodge warmth with resort amenities including a steam room, jacuzzi, drying room, laundry, and a great room with a large log fireplace. Summer activities highlighted include mountain biking, river rafting, fly-fishing, and hiking, making it a natural base for cyclists exploring the Fernie area.
0defe749eb: Rockwater Secret Cove Resort is a luxury coastal retreat perched above the Pacific near Halfmoon Bay on BC's Sunshine Coast, offering iconic suspended Tenthouse Suites, renovated Oceanview Cabins, and lodge rooms — all with uninterrupted ocean views. The resort features an on-site oceanfront restaurant (TuBird), a spa, and complimentary kayak rentals exclusively for resort guests. It is a distinctive destination property for cyclists seeking upscale accommodation while touring the Sunshine Coast.
426f3d7434: Mansion on Main is a hotel accommodation on Main Street in the Cariboo region. The property's specific amenities and facilities for touring cyclists require verification through direct contact, as the website is currently unavailable.
63ec12d76d: Days Inn by Wyndham Terrace is a branded chain hotel on Lakelse Avenue in Terrace, BC, a regional hub in the Skeena River corridor of northwestern British Columbia. It is one of the more recognizable lodging options in a community that serves as a gateway to the Coast Mountains and Nisga'a territory. Cyclists touring Highway 16 or the Nisga'a Highway would find Terrace a natural overnight stop.
80e4f7f584: Prince Motel is a 45-room independently operated motel in central downtown Prince George, offering newly renovated rooms ranging from standard queens to kitchenette suites. The property is pet-friendly and provides cold-weather electrical plug-ins in the parking lot—a practical feature for travellers in northern BC. Its downtown location puts guests within easy reach of multiple restaurants and grocery stores.
2c74401e86: Pomeroy Inn & Suites is a hotel in Chetwynd, Northern BC, providing accommodation along North Access Road. Part of the Pomeroy Inn & Suites chain, it serves as a commercial lodging option for travelers in the northern region. Contact the hotel directly for information about bike storage and services for cycling tourists.
999f261f4f: Powder Mountain Lodge is a motel in Fernie, BC that has been operating since 1970, offering six room types from economy queens to five-bedroom kitchen suites with full kitchens. It sits centrally in town off Highway 3 at 9th Street, placing guests within a short walk of downtown pubs, restaurants, and shops, and a short drive from Fernie Alpine Resort and mountain biking trails. The lodge has an outdoor courtyard pool, indoor hot tub, guest kitchen, BBQ area, common room with pool and snooker tables, and a fireplace lounge.
f134eabf46: Cactus Tree Inn is a privately-owned motel on Highway 97 in Oliver, BC, situated in Canada's only desert and surrounded by over 40 wineries, making it a natural base for cycling the South Okanagan wine trails. Under new management since 2021, it offers a range of room types from standard queens to family suites with kitchenettes. The outdoor pool and BBQ patio provide a comfortable place to recover after a day in the saddle.
63ce9593c1: Falcon Resort is a lakefront motel in Osoyoos, BC, situated directly on over 300 feet of private sandy beach on Osoyoos Lake — Canada's warmest lake. Units range from single rooms to two-bedroom suites with kitchens, and the property features two outdoor heated pools and an indoor spa. It operates alongside the adjacent Spanish Fiesta Resort under shared management, together forming a well-established family-friendly beach destination in the South Okanagan.
444ec7ba13: Wakepilot is a watersports rental and charter company operating from three locations on Osoyoos Lake — Canada's warmest lake — with over 20 years serving the South Okanagan. They offer Sea-Doo, pontoon, deck boat, SUP, kayak, and e-foil rentals as well as fully guided wakeboard and surf charters aboard Supra SA wake boats. A cycling tourist passing through Osoyoos could use Wakepilot for a half-day water activity before continuing on the route.
61f88443b7: Madrona Beach Resort is a waterfront self-catering resort set directly on Rathtrevor Beach near Parksville, offering fully furnished condos ranging from ocean view studios to two-bedroom beach-level suites with full kitchens and private balconies or patios facing Georgia Strait and the north shore mountains. Units are well-equipped for extended stays and the property includes a tennis court, basketball hoops, children's adventure playground, propane barbecues, and coin-operated laundry. The famously long sandy beach at Rathtrevor is steps away from beach-level units, making this a comfortable base for exploring the Oceanside region by bike.
149f653100: Ray Lyn Motel is a small motel on the outskirts of Trail, BC, offering standard queen-bed rooms and kitchenette units suited to multi-night stays. It sits a short drive from downtown Trail and is roughly 15 minutes from Red Mountain Ski Resort, placing it in the heart of the Kootenay region. Rooms include in-room fridge and microwave, and the property has a seasonal outdoor BBQ area and gazebo.
e45ac30952: A family-owned motel in Osoyoos situated directly across the street from a public beach on Canada's warmest freshwater lake, in the heart of BC's only desert region. The property offers standard motel rooms, suites, and a separate 3-bedroom vacation cottage, with a seasonal heated saltwater pool and complimentary BBQ facilities on-site. It sits walking distance from downtown Osoyoos restaurants and pubs, close to wineries, the Haynes Point campground, and the US border crossing.
74e880f6fb: Manning Park Eastgate Lodging is a motel situated near the eastern entrance to E.C. Manning Provincial Park along Highway 3, a key route for touring cyclists riding the Crowsnest corridor between the Fraser Valley and the Okanagan. Its location in one of BC's most scenic mountain passes makes it a logical overnight stop for cyclists tackling this demanding route. The motel sits in a remote area where accommodation options are sparse, which adds to its value for self-supported touring.
f500401fea: Kookaburra Lodge is a condo-suite property centrally located in the Sun Peaks village, offering 1- to 4-bedroom units with fully equipped kitchens and in-suite laundry overlooking McGillivray Creek. Situated directly across from the Sports Centre and steps from the resort's trail network and bike park, it caters to both weekend visitors and extended-stay guests. On-site restaurants, retail shops, and underground parking make it a convenient base for cycling the Sun Peaks network.
d1e75b9b1a: Sal-Crest Motel sits in Salmo, BC on Highway 3, making it a natural overnight stop on the Selkirk Loop and a base for exploring the southern Kootenays. The owners offer a large backyard with barbecues and picnic tables for socializing. Room options range from single queens to two-bedroom units with full kitchens, all with a microwave, fridge, and coffee maker.
f4429d93c6: A hotel and RV park offering accommodation in Northern British Columbia. The property provides lodging alongside RV parking facilities for touring cyclists and other travellers.
b1059dbfaf: Swiss Chalet Motel is a locally owned, non-chain motel in the heart of Revelstoke, BC, a mountain town celebrated for deep-snow skiing, hiking, and year-round outdoor adventure. The property has 22 recently renovated rooms ranging from cozy standard queens to deluxe kings with jetted tubs and balconies, and takes genuine pride in its connection to the town's Swiss alpine-guide and CPR railway heritage. Its active-traveller focus is evident in dedicated ski and bike lockers, a resort shuttle, and exclusive Tourism Revelstoke deals available to direct-booking guests.
4b2115cb4b: West Coast Fishing Club is a luxury all-inclusive fishing resort on Langara Island, Haida Gwaii, operating since 1988 and offering guided salmon and halibut fishing from two lodges (The Clubhouse and The Outpost). Guests reach the property exclusively via a charter jet from Vancouver's South Terminal to Masset, followed by a helicopter transfer to the lodge. The resort is renowned for its conservation programs and high-end wilderness hospitality in one of BC's most remote corners.
998869efc2: Summit Lake Resort is a seasonal lakeside resort on the continental divide between the Pacific and Arctic watersheds, set 50 km north of Prince George just off the Alaska Highway. The resort offers RV and tent sites, rental cabins (double occupancy, no washrooms), a boat launch, and picnic facilities on a lake with over 40 km of undeveloped shoreline. Nearby attractions include Teapot Mountain hiking trails and the historic Giscome Portage Trail, making it a scenic stop for touring cyclists on the Highway 97 corridor.
87db3180c8: The Powell River Town Centre Hotel bills itself as Powell River's only full-service hotel, with 71 air-conditioned guest rooms and suites ranging from standard courtyard-view rooms to executive suites with Jacuzzi tubs. Centrally located in the city hub on BC's Sunshine Coast, it sits near shopping, transit, and recreation areas. On-site amenities include a licensed restaurant, a pub serving dinner, and banquet facilities for up to 300 guests.
06d9ee05ff: Northern Motor Inn is a full-service, rustic-style hotel situated on the Yellowhead Highway (Highway 16) in Thornhill, just outside Terrace, BC, with an onsite restaurant, pub (George's Pub), and liquor store all under one roof. The property has a long local history and caters to a wide range of travelers, offering room types from basic queens to suites with kitchenettes, plus pet-friendly and accessible rooms. The hotel explicitly highlights cycling as one of the outdoor adventures available from its doorstep in northwestern BC.
9a33f819f2: A Holiday Inn Express hotel in Fort St John, BC, providing standard midrange accommodation in a 3-level property. Suitable as a rest stop for touring cyclists passing through Northern BC.
84c79a6b3e: Friendship Inn Motel & RV Park is a combination motel and RV park located along the Island Highway in Campbell River, BC. The property offers both motel rooms and RV accommodation, and sits near beaches and hiking trails in the Campbell River area. It serves both short-stay road-trippers and longer-term guests, with an RV component that suggests basic outdoor infrastructure on site.
03a52c8d42: Vagabond Lodge is an exclusive boutique inn perched steps from the gondola at Kicking Horse Mountain Resort, about 10 minutes from Golden, BC, in the heart of the Canadian Rockies. The property is known for its cozy character — river rock fireplace, split-log bar, Douglas fir floors, and floor-to-ceiling mountain views — along with warm, host-led hospitality and a communal living-room atmosphere. Summer guests are well-placed for mountain biking and hiking, with easy access to Yoho, Banff, Kootenay, and Glacier National Parks.
993d7d05d2: A hotel located in McBride, a small village on the Yellowhead Highway (Hwy 16) between Prince George and Jasper in the Robson Valley. McBride is a common overnight stop for touring cyclists riding across northern BC, and this property is part of the Sandman Hotels chain. The hotel sits along the frontage road just off the highway.
ee150cf23f: The Pinewood Inn is a small, owner-operated 8-unit motel at the north end of Golden, BC, offering 1- and 2-bedroom kitchen suites equipped with modern appliances and designed for stays of any length. Golden sits at the confluence of the Kicking Horse and Columbia Rivers, making it a natural hub for cyclists tackling the Rocky Mountains or the Columbia Valley route. The hands-on ownership style and fully equipped kitchens give the property a self-sufficient, home-like character well suited to touring travellers.
0405bd33a2: Shannon Motel is a 3-star, approximately 60-room property situated along the Alaska Highway in Fort Nelson, a key waypoint for cyclists traversing northern British Columbia. Rooms include kitchenette or full kitchen options, making it well-suited for touring cyclists who need to cook or resupply. The motel is pet-friendly, offers ample parking including space for RVs and large vehicles, and is steps from the Fort Nelson Heritage Museum and recreation centre.
fae1d01931: Green Gables Beach Resort is a family-run lakeside motel on Osoyoos Lake operating since 1975, known for its private sandy beach considered one of the finest on the lake and a loyal multigenerational guest following. Located in Osoyoos—Canada's only desert region—the resort is steps from shops, restaurants, and the town centre, making it a convenient base for cyclists exploring the Okanagan wine country and surrounding trails. The property has an old-school character appreciated by guests who return for the personalized service from on-site managers.
80abfe180e: A hotel serving the Nakusp community in British Columbia's Kootenays region. Offers Wi-Fi connectivity for guests.
5a2e57863c: Royston Retreat is a self-catering apartment accommodation located on Marine Drive in Royston, a small community on the east coast of Vancouver Island between Courtenay and Campbell River. The area sits along a popular cycling corridor on Vancouver Island and is close to the waterfront. As an apartment-style rental, guests typically have access to private, home-like amenities rather than shared hotel facilities.
5be5b0fd97: Takysie Lake Resort is a secluded, family-run lakeside retreat in BC's Central Interior, sitting on a 514-hectare rainbow trout lake whose name means 'lake of many fishes.' The resort offers rustic lakeside cabins, RV and tent sites, a boat launch, guest docks, and floatplane docking, making it a self-contained base camp for fishing, paddling, and exploring the remote Southside backroads. On-site amenities include a café, general market, hardware store, 24-hour pay-at-pump gas station, and a mechanic shop — an unusually full-service stop for such a remote location.
83f65bd764: A hotel located in Port Alberni, British Columbia, providing overnight accommodation for travelers and tourists. Cyclists can contact the hotel directly to arrange lodging and discuss bike storage options.
f03c55d867: Bobbie Burns Lodge is a legendary backcountry heli-skiing lodge in the Kootenays operated by Canadian Mountain Holidays, famous for massive peak-to-valley vertical runs and a fast-paced, expert-focused atmosphere. One of the original heli-skiing lodges in British Columbia, it is accessible only by helicopter as part of a booked CMH program. In summer it serves as a base for guided heli-accessed hiking in remote alpine terrain.
3f12acd552: The Highliner Hotel & Conference Centre is a newly renovated 17-storey high-rise occupying a prominent position in downtown Prince Rupert, with 97 guest rooms and sweeping ocean views. It sits minutes from both the BC Ferry and Alaska Ferry terminals, making it a natural staging point for cyclists arriving on or departing to Vancouver Island, Haida Gwaii, or Alaska. An on-site restaurant, First Avenue Bistro, serves the local community as well as hotel guests.
f18bf274cc: Green View Motel & RV Park sits on Highway 3, one kilometre east of Greenwood — reputedly Canada's smallest city — making it a practical overnight stop for cyclists on the Southern Trans-Canada route. The property offers renovated motel rooms with kitchenettes and family units alongside a full-service RV park with pull-through sites (60+ ft), tent camping, water/sewer hookups, and 30-amp electrical service. It is open year-round and accepts multiple payment methods including Interac.
f506293c79: Spirit Ridge Vineyard Resort & Spa is a Hyatt Unbound Collection property situated among the vineyards and desert landscape of the Okanagan near Osoyoos, BC. The resort offers a full-service spa and overlooks Osoyoos Lake in one of Canada's warmest and driest regions, making it a notable destination stop for cyclists touring the South Okanagan wine country. Rancher Creek Road places it at the edge of a working vineyard estate.
e5af5db424: Motel Tyrol is a family-owned motel in the Village of Radium Hot Springs, situated in the Columbia Valley between the Rocky and Purcell Mountains along Highway 93/the Banff-Windermere Parkway. The property is 2 km from the famous natural mineral hot springs pool and offers mountain views from every room, plus its own year-round swim spa and seasonal heated outdoor pool and hot tub. Guests receive a complimentary breakfast voucher to Screamers Cafe, 800 m away, and the Juniper Trail trailhead is a five-minute walk from the motel.
a82b083f6f: The Prestige Harbourfront Resort is Salmon Arm's only resort situated directly on Shuswap Lake, with views of the Columbia Mountains and waterfront access. It operates as a WorldHotels Luxury property under the BWH Hotels umbrella, drawing visitors for events like the Roots & Blues Festival and lakeside weddings. Touring cyclists finishing a day on the Shuswap routes will find a full-service resort experience in a notable scenic setting.
10f1458ee3: Super 8 by Wyndham Golden is a roadside motel situated directly on the Trans-Canada Highway in Golden, BC, a hub town for cyclists travelling through the Rocky Mountain Trench between Yoho and Glacier national parks. As part of the Super 8 by Wyndham brand it offers standardised budget accommodation in a location that sees heavy touring-cyclist traffic on the TransCanada corridor. The motel is well-positioned for resupply and rest between the challenging mountain passes on either side of Golden.
423c81585f: Colonial 900 Motel is a motel located on Old Hope Princeton Way in British Columbia's Lower Mainland & Fraser Valley region. Specific amenities and policies for cyclists are not available online; contact the motel directly for information about bike storage and facilities.
70cc18fb9c: Copper Point Resort is Invermere's premier upscale destination in the Columbia Valley, offering accommodations ranging from standard queen rooms to two-bedroom loft suites. The resort serves as a four-season base with access to golf, skiing at nearby Kootenay Rockies resorts, and outdoor adventures — making it a comfortable stopping point for touring cyclists on routes through the Columbia Valley. On-site dining, a spa, and full event facilities give it a full-service resort character.
700b9bd557: Houston Motor Inn is a family-run motel on the Yellowhead Highway (Hwy 16) in Houston, BC, operating since 1993. The two-storey property offers basic rooms alongside an on-site restaurant, making it a practical overnight stop on one of northern BC's main touring corridors. Pet-friendly policies and an RV area reflect its orientation toward travellers passing through the region.
ba09cab193: Inn On Canyon is a family-owned boutique hotel in the heart of Radium Hot Springs, operating from a 10,000-square-foot Victorian-style building just 200 metres from the famous Radium Hot Springs pools. The age-restricted property (12+) serves a warm homestyle breakfast each morning in a shared dining room and is ideally placed at the gateway to Kootenay National Park, with the Columbia Valley's extensive biking trail network — including Panorama Mountain Resort, Kloosifier-Johnson, and Sinclair Creek trails — easily accessible. Pubs, restaurants, and trails are all within walking distance, and Banff is a scenic one-hour drive north on Highway 93.
ca7b554927: The Westridge Motor Inn is a fully renovated 32-room motel sitting at the junction of Highway 3 (Crowsnest Highway) and Highway 97 in Osoyoos, at the heart of Canada's warmest desert. It offers a range of room types from courtyard queens to king suites with new Serta mattresses, kitchenettes in all suites, and a seasonal outdoor pool and BBQ patio. Located directly across from the Osoyoos Visitor Information Centre, it is a natural stop for cyclists riding the Crowsnest route through the South Okanagan wine country.
b1086c95c4: Ocean Trails Resort is a 78-unit self-contained condo resort spread across seven wooded acres immediately adjacent to Rathtrevor Beach in Parksville, rated #1 specialty lodging in Parksville on TripAdvisor. Suites range from one to three bedrooms and come with fully equipped kitchens, private entrances, and free parking, making extended stays practical. 94406b7989: The Northway Motor Inn is a 43-room motor inn in Dease Lake sitting along the Stewart-Cassiar Highway (Hwy 37), one of only two BC routes leading to the Yukon and Alaska — making it a key resupply and rest stop for cyclists tackling this remote corridor. 83cf296505: A Travelodge by Wyndham situated directly on the Trans-Canada Highway in Salmon Arm, a key stop in the Shuswap region for cyclists travelling between Vancouver and the Rockies. 575c83aa7b: A Fairfield Inn & Suites hotel in Salmon Arm offering standard chain hotel accommodations along the Trans-Canada Highway route. Specific cyclist amenities could not be verified due to website access issues.
190445bbfb: Bell 2 Lodge is a full-service wilderness resort perched on the Stewart-Cassiar Highway (Hwy 37) at kilometer mark 248, making it one of the very few services stops on the long haul between Meziadin Junction and Dease Lake for cyclists riding the Alaska Highway corridor. 6ee70f28e9: Canyon Alpine Motel is a roadside motel located on the Trans-Canada Highway in the Okanagan & Thompson region of British Columbia. db14a99304: The Rodmay Heritage Hotel (listed in OSM as 'Rodway') is a heritage-style hotel located in Powell River, BC, a community on the Sunshine Coast accessible by ferry and popular with cyclists riding the Sunshine Coast Trail region. ff83988814: Park Motel is a freshly renovated motel in Hope, BC, offering rooms and suites ranging from standard singles to family suites sleeping up to six guests. bfa56904d1: Sea Raven Motel is the largest accommodation in Daajing Giids (Queen Charlotte) on Haida Gwaii, offering 30 rooms including ocean-view suites overlooking Skidegate Inlet. 4c2e9c271f: A large adult-oriented RV park just off the Trans-Canada Highway at Hope, offering full-hookup sites with showers, cable TV, and wi-fi included; no tent rate is listed and the park caters primarily to RV travellers.

433dd65159: Urban campground on Tk'emlúps te Secwe̓pemc land in central Kamloops, within easy reach of all town services; the setting is an events-centre facility rather than a natural site, but showers are included with tent sites.
86fdf381ca: A full-service lakeside RV resort on spring-fed Dutch Lake in Clearwater, with flush toilets, showers, an on-site restaurant, and dock access for swimming, fishing, and paddling; note there are no dedicated tent sites — cyclists must book a full-hookup RV pad. 167163a900: A 30-site resort campground on Monte Lake in BC's dry interior, priced at the premium tier; amenities are unconfirmed as the website returned no content.
4f43765342: Vehicle-accessible BC Parks campground on Galiano Island in the southern Gulf Islands, set among shell-midden beaches, tidal lagoons, old forest, and 130+ bird species; reaching it requires a BC Ferries crossing to Sturdies Bay followed by a 10 km signed ride on Montague Park Road.
d0cb3536bc: A resort campground in Penticton bearing a beach-focused name, likely on Okanagan or Skaha Lake — details on facilities and exact location are unconfirmed as the website was unreachable.

eaed4683d1: Walk-in tent camping in grassy meadows along 7 km of rocky Salt Spring Island shoreline, with sweeping views over Swanson Channel and strong wildlife watching; potable water is shut down November 1–March 15 and all sites require carrying gear from the parking lot.

6c1cb0a5b5: A small, free, rustic drive-in campground on a subalpine lake in the Callaghan Valley, reached via 8 km of rough gravel FSR where high-clearance vehicles are recommended; active grizzly habitat, no garbage facilities, and the access road is gated from November to early June.

7acfc32544: Coastal campground on the Strait of Juan de Fuca along Highway 14, popular with surfers and wind-sport enthusiasts; exposed oceanfront setting with basic facilities and no confirmed amenities from available sources.

b2122018dc: Campsite within the SilverStar Mountain Resort village, perched at high elevation above Vernon with access to resort amenities, restaurants, and a bike park; the access road is a long paved climb of roughly 900 m from the valley, and the campground operates only during the summer season.
a38844f84d: City-run campground in a forested setting on High Street just east of downtown Nelson, within walking distance of shops, parks, and the beach. Amenities include showers, laundry, and cooking facilities; open May 1–October 16 with tent sites from $26/night.

b4750926d1: RV-focused resort on sheltered Pedder Bay near Sooke, primarily catering to RVs and boaters with marina access; tent-camping suitability and facilities are unclear as the site was unreachable.

abab3d8bd0: A privately operated 50-site campground on Williamson Lake at the edge of Revelstoke, with showers, device charging, and potable water; handy for resupply and Revelstoke's trail network.
e8e5684251: A large, supervised riverside campground on the banks of the Chehalis River in BC's Fraser Valley, reached by paved road; the main draw is steelhead and salmon fishing, with a forest trail down to the river.

fb97aeb7ed: Family-owned private campground on the Squamish River with an expansive sandy beach and glacier views; no drinking water or showers on site, and the 14 km approach up Squamish Valley Road is a long haul for a loaded bike.

48d87e914f: A caravan-oriented campground near Chilliwack with almost no detail available online; suitability for loaded touring bikes and tent campers is unclear from available sources.

ee63646fc9: A year-round commercial campground on 4 acres in the heart of Coldstream, BC, with a creek on site and a 5-minute walk to Kalamalka Beach; free hot showers and laundry on site, though open fires are not permitted and rates apply.
91c8b12a71: A free BC Hydro reservoir campground beside Jones Lake in the mountains above Chilliwack, with washrooms on site; access is via a gravel forest service road that will be rough for loaded touring bikes.
a24f10a84f: A family-oriented private campground on Highway 97 at Monte Lake offering showers, laundry, and WiFi for tent and RV campers; recreational amenities such as pickleball and volleyball are still coming online and wood fires are not permitted.
8f9e1fd6dd: A group campground on the Cowichan River — a BC and Canadian Heritage River internationally renowned for salmon and steelhead — directly adjacent to the Trans Canada Trail rail corridor, making it a natural anchor for cycling groups; group-site pricing applies a minimum charge for 15 adults.
3fa62a244f: A family-oriented private campground nestled along the Sooke River and De Mamiel Creek, 45 minutes from Victoria on paved Highway 14, with flush washrooms and coin showers, river access for paddling, wildlife watching, and a playground — open seasonally late March to mid-October with tent sites priced at the higher end of private campground rates.
6ddb52b926: Clear Creek is one of four campgrounds within Cultus Lake Provincial Park, set among forested mountains beside a large warm freshwater lake prized for swimming and watersports; expect crowds in peak summer as this is one of the busiest park destinations in the Lower Mainland.

4d4c9ab2b0: Maple Bay is one of four campgrounds at Cultus Lake Park, a busy Lower Mainland favourite set beside a large warm freshwater lake about 10 km from Sardis via paved highway; showers and full services, but expect crowds in summer.
a7987ab60e: Free municipal campground right on Burns Lake in the town centre, with swimming, a 24/7 kayak rental shack, and two lakeside restaurants steps away; no hookups on-site and paid showers at the nearby Lakeside Multiplex are the main catches.
6b1441bd54: A small, quiet private campground three minutes from downtown Lillooet offering mountain views, flush washrooms, and a cozy cabin explicitly pitched at cyclists; no tent sites are listed, no dogs allowed, and the season opens May 1st.
c0783a5fe1: A small wooded RV park off Highway 4 near Parksville, with 15 grassy treed sites on 3 acres at the foot of Mount Arrowsmith. a24da3e1f4: Ruckle Park's group campsite on Salt Spring Island sits in a grassy meadow overlooking Swanson Channel with rich wildlife and shoreline; access requires a BC Ferries crossing from Swartz Bay, group fees apply to a minimum of 15 adults, and potable water is off November through mid-March.
1fb23c2ea0: Gardenside Acres is a small, family-run tent-only campground on the Harper family farm in Brentwood Bay, a short walk from the world-famous Butchart Gardens and the village waterfront. 295260c6a8: A commercial RV resort in Whistler operated by Parkbridge, likely positioned along a river corridor; the scraped pages are Parkbridge corporate content only and contain no details specific to this property, so facilities, tent availability, and amenities are unconfirmed.

943d1ab88f: A Toquaht Nation-operated bayfront campground on Barkley Sound with 67 sites, a marina, and a dedicated kayak launch — the main land base for paddlers heading into the Broken Group Islands; well-developed with a pump track and playground but seasonal (May 15–Sept 15), $55/night, no cell service, and a busy booking calendar.
a074968a4a: Sandspit campground anchors Kokanee Creek Park's kilometre of sandy Kootenay Lake beach, 19 km east of Nelson on paved Hwy 3A, with full amenities including showers and e-bike charging. bf5f272ab0: Seven tent sites sit directly along the Tamihi River in the Chilliwack Valley, offering a genuine riverside wilderness feel; access is via Forest Service Roads, it's cash-only on arrival, and there is no garbage service — pack in, pack out.
86e2558c54: Treed, family-oriented campground sitting directly on the Arrow Lakes shore near Burton, BC, with sandy beaches, a boat launch, and full modern washrooms with showers; reached by paved Highway 6 then a short run down Lakeview Park Road, open May 1–October 15.

86e96c317d: A forested campground on Vancouver Island's wild west coast midway between Ucluelet and Tofino, with private wooded sites, a hot tub, sauna, and on-site surf school — not on the beach but a short drive to Pacific Rim's surf breaks. Open April to mid-October only.
4b7121d292: A family-run campground sitting between the Cascade Mountains and the Fraser River, 7.7 km west of Hope on Hwy 1, with grassy tent sites, free hot showers, flush washrooms open 24/7, and an explicit cross-Canada cyclist welcome; highway-adjacent and open year-round.
72965d395b: Third Beach is a basic backcountry campsite within Nuchatlitz Provincial Park, situated on the northwest tip of Nootka Island on the remote west coast of Vancouver Island. Access to the park is by boat or float plane only, with the nearest communities being Zeballos, Tahsis, and Gold River.
736ba84118: Surf Grove sits at Cox Bay — Canada's top-rated surf beach — 7 km south of Tofino, with forested semi-serviced tent sites featuring 15-amp power, showers, and wi-fi just a short walk from the sand. 4e9eefcc56: Redfish Campground sits within Kokanee Creek Provincial Park on Kootenay Lake, reached by a walking bridge and connected to over a kilometre of sandy beach, old-growth cedar, and a kokanee salmon spawning channel; full amenities but busy in summer and closed by gate off-season.
3ac0d96ef7: A quiet, remote fishing lake ringed by pine and fir hills northwest of Summerland, reached via 16 km of gravel road; no potable water on site, so arrive self-sufficient.
f833b15ec3: Family resort on the shore of Burn Lake, a quiet non-motorized wilderness lake in the South Cariboo Interlakes area, with 145 acres of forest and meadow trails; well-serviced with flush showers but priced at resort rates.
c37721cc94: A First Nations-run campground on historic Cheam fishing grounds along the Fraser River, with 52 sites, a boat launch, and prime salmon and sturgeon access; for 2026 the site operates as private group bookings only — individual touring cyclists cannot reserve a site.
275b5f2257: A well-equipped 71-site provincial park campground on Tyhee Lake near Telkwa, with showers, potable water, and e-bike charging; closed by gated access outside the summer operating season.

61a7c82f80: A 76-site rainforest campground on a golf-course property midway between Tofino and Ucluelet, a 2-minute drive or 30-minute walk to Long Beach in Pacific Rim National Park; flush toilets and free showers on-site, but tent rates are steep at $55–$70/night.
6b2f6571dd: LGBTQ+, adult-only (19+), clothing-optional campground near Harrison Mills with flush washrooms, coin-op showers, electrical hookups on tent sites, and a packed calendar of community long-weekend events from Victoria Day through Labour Day.
e7abc6d5e1: Sandy beach campground on the Saanich Peninsula east of Sidney, set along a broad tidal shore with views across Haro Strait toward the Gulf Islands; paved access makes it easy to reach by bike, and the fee-required sites draw families and beach campers through the summer season.
c7fb8d440b: Indigenous-owned full-service RV resort and marina on Esquimalt Harbour with waterfront views of Victoria's inner harbour, less than 4 km from downtown; designed exclusively for large motorhomes with no tent sites and RV rates starting at $82/night, making it a poor fit for most cycle tourists.
56cdf3a35b: Friendly private RV park right off Highway 3 on the Similkameen River, with shaded grassed sites, a sandy beach for swimming and tubing, flush showers, and coin laundry; primarily hook-up-oriented and open April 15 to Thanksgiving.
25e4161344: A seasonal fishing and hunting resort on the shore of Loon Lake, open May long weekend through October, with tent and RV campsites, boat rentals, and deliberately no WiFi or reliable cell service. Access is via Loon Lake Rd off Hwy 97; phone reservations recommended as sites fill fast.
3bb72b350a: A highway-convenience KOA Journey campground on Mission Road, 4.8 km off Hwy 95A north of Cranbrook, with premium tent sites and well-lit late check-in; primarily an RV park but a reliable paid overnight for cyclists passing through the Cranbrook–Kimberley corridor.
87bc32c837: A private, full-service campground on the Cowichan River near Duncan with 25 grassed and shaded tent sites, flush washrooms with showers, and river swimming; well-positioned as a base for Cowichan Valley cycling, fishing, and trail riding.
b7250aaf74: Full-service private campground on the edge of Golden, BC, a convenient base for day trips into Yoho and Banff National Parks; tenting sites include fire pits and picnic tables, with flush showers and coin laundry open seasonally (Apr 15–Oct 15) — washrooms and office close through winter even though the site stays open.
3ca2ad2261: Family-run campground on open grassy fields amid South Cowichan Valley farmland, with coin showers, laundry, and a direct trail to Mill Bay Nature Park beach; primarily a basecamp for exploring southern Vancouver Island's wineries, trails, and towns rather than a scenic destination in itself.
bbe0cd5d23: Lemon Creek Pioneer Campground is a small, tranquil campground in the Slocan Valley near Winlaw, BC, offering 26 well-groomed sites arranged in a horseshoe layout with a mix of serviced RV spots and treed tent sites with firepits. It is a natural rest stop for cyclists riding the Frog Peak Loop.
79f4a7dcbb: A well-run riverside RV park on the edge of Stewart with glacier-capped peaks rising on all sides, offering cyclists clean showers, laundry, and a proper tent area — a natural stopping point for anyone riding the Cassiar toward Alaska, open May through September.
40f37306ae: Small 10-site year-round recreation site directly beside Grace Lake, with a floating dock for fishing and outhouse facilities; cash-only and first-come first-served, sharing a staging area with motorized-trail users from the West Harrison Riding Area.
b72d5d0ce5: A small islet on the BC Marine Trails network near North Vancouver, reachable only by kayak or boat; free and primitive with no confirmed amenities, making it a non-starter for loaded cycle tourists.
1d49f23d27: An RV and caravan resort in Whistler operated by Parkbridge, likely riverside given the name, in one of BC's premier mountain towns with easy highway access. Specific site amenities and facilities are not detailed on the corporate website, so confirm services before arrival.
d084b75878: A suburban RV park situated near the Tsawwassen ferry terminal and US border crossing, making it a convenient overnight for cyclists catching an early sailing or staging a border crossing; no amenity details were retrievable from the website.
1a749680ad: Ellison sits on the northeastern shore of Okanagan Lake with rocky headlands, sheltered coves, and three warm-water beaches — plus western Canada's only freshwater dive park. 734d487292: Family-owned guest ranch on Watch Lake's lakeshore in the South Cariboo, with 8 tent and trailer sites in a park-like setting, firewood included and rainbow trout fishing steps away; the resort feel means more amenities than a typical campground but also more cost, and the 20-mile drive east of 70 Mile House is on rural BC road.
868d1c918f: A Soowahlie First Nation campground nestled between Sweltzer Creek and the Vedder River under old-growth cedar, with a family atmosphere and flush facilities; access is via a short downhill gravel road, and the site runs May through Labour Day only.
d6f804b010: A walk-in island campground reached by a 10-minute passenger ferry from Maffeo Sutton Park in downtown Nanaimo; no road or vehicle access, so loaded bikes ride the ferry over. 18 walk-in tent sites a 5-minute walk from the dock, plus 5 group sites. First-come first-served, but reservations through camping.bcparks.ca are recommended.
be21b1b528: Alpine backcountry shelter camp in Garibaldi Park reached by an ~11 km hike with significant elevation gain from the Diamond Head trailhead; expect spectacular volcanic-peak panoramas and fully self-sufficient conditions — no road or bike access, no resupply.
ba097e1d2c: A 94-site private campground in Squamish sitting along the Sea to Sky corridor, offering a functional base for cyclists between Vancouver and Whistler with easy highway access and device charging on-site. e153a367f7: Family-run lakefront campground on Christina Lake with 300 feet of sandy beach, swim dock, hot showers, and boat moorage — sites sit close together and facilities are self-described as old-school but clean, drawing loyal summer regulars for decades. a69b9b33b6: A family-oriented lakeside resort on Fraser Lake, directly off Highway 16 between Prince George and Prince Rupert, with forested and open lake-view tent sites, a shower house, boat launch, and direct waterfront access. Open May 1–October 15; tent sites from $32/night.
aebffa2137: A Snaw-naw-as First Nation-operated campground on the Nanoose Bay shoreline north of Nanaimo, with sweeping views across the Salish Sea toward the Winchelsea islands; the park skews heavily RV with hookups, but non-serviced tent sites are available and full amenities (showers, flush washrooms, store) are on-site.
9aeb0cf6a7: Delta Grove is one of four campgrounds at popular Cultus Lake Provincial Park, set beside a large warm freshwater lake ringed by forested mountains about 90 minutes from Vancouver.
