The tasting room pairs wine flights with a food menu of local charcuterie boards, warm brie, and seasonal accompaniments sourced from valley producers. Summer evenings bring live music and Sunday DJ sessions in the outdoor pavilion, making this a lively destination stop for cyclists exploring the Kootenay wine route.
6a4081d45b: LaStella Winery is an Italian-inspired boutique estate winery perched beside Osoyoos Lake in the sun-drenched South Okanagan, crafting Tuscan-style blends named after musical terms — Allegretto, Maestoso, Vivace — from one of Canada's hottest and driest wine regions. The winery features outdoor sit-down tastings and a picnic area where visitors can enjoy their own snacks alongside a flight of wine. A portion of tasting fees is donated to the Canucks Autism Network, and 5% goes toward tree-planting to offset the winery's full carbon footprint.
0b56b02b9e: SouthEnd Farm Winery & ClearCut Distilling Co. is a small-batch winery and distillery on Quadra Island, crafting wines from organically grown grape hybrids suited to the island climate and spirits from botanicals grown or foraged on the farm. The multi-purpose tasting room doubles as the winery itself, so visitors are essentially on a farm tour the moment they walk in, with sheep, chickens, and goats nearby. A vacation 'Shack' on the property is also available for overnight stays via Airbnb, making it a potential overnight stop for cycle tourists.
c2abc0c368: Cassini Cellars is a boutique estate winery situated on the Golden Mile Bench—described on its own site as the finest grape-growing region in Canada—halfway between Oliver and Osoyoos on Highway 97. The winery has accumulated an impressive awards haul including Lieutenant Governor's Awards of Excellence, Double Golds at the Canadian Wine Championship, and a Platinum at Wine Press Northwest, making it one of the most decorated small producers in the South Okanagan. Cyclists riding the popular Okanagan wine-route corridor will pass directly in front of the property on HWY97 and can stop at the tasting room to sample celebrated Cabernet Franc, Malbec, and other estate reds.
267b59fa3a: Seven Stones Estate Winery sits on a sun-drenched bench overlooking the Similkameen Valley and is known for bold red wines aged in underground cave cellars carved into the hillside. Founded by winemaker George Hanson, the estate practices sustainable viticulture and small-lot winemaking, earning recognition for blends like the award-winning Legend. Cyclists on the Crowsnest Highway can stop for a tasting, explore the cave tours, and take in panoramic vineyard views from the patio.
325741d868: Empty Keg Brew House is a family-friendly craft brewery established in May 2019 in Merritt, BC's Nicola Valley, featured on the Southern Interior Ale Trail, with over 67 handcrafted beer varieties created since opening. The brewhouse pairs a rotating tap list of unfiltered ales, lagers, stouts, and hard seltzers with a food menu of burgers, chicken, charcuterie, and pub fare ordered at a self-serve front bar. A recent solar installation and an expanded patio reflect the owners' community-minded ethos in this small-town gathering spot.
9262ec4ccf: Kismet Estate Winery is a family-owned estate winery in Oliver, BC — the self-proclaimed 'Wine Capital of Canada' — rooted in the Punjabi-Canadian heritage of the Dhaliwal family, who farm 600 acres of South Okanagan vineyards. The winery pairs its estate wines with Manzil, an on-site restaurant reimagining vibrant Indian cuisine using locally sourced Okanagan ingredients and fresh spices from India. It sits squarely in the heart of the South Okanagan wine-route cycling corridor and offers wine club memberships, vineyard tours, and bookable tasting experiences.
d95fe70d89: Clos du Soleil is a small artisan winery and estate vineyard on the Upper Bench of the South Similkameen Valley, producing ultra-premium Bordeaux-inspired wines from organically farmed, biodynamic vineyards since 2006. The tasting room invites visitors to tour the vineyard and taste wines that express the rocky, sun-drenched character of this distinctive Similkameen microclimate. A natural destination stop for cyclists touring this scenic valley corridor, the winery's organic credentials and welcoming hospitality ethos set it apart from larger commercial operations.
670b522d27: Beach Fire Brewing is Campbell River's own craft brewery and taproom, producing award-winning beers such as the gold-medal Ember Red Ale and the locally beloved High Tide Pale Ale alongside a kitchen stocked with ingredients from regional farmers. The brewery is a community partner of the River City Cycle Club and even names one of its year-round beers 'WheelBender Stout,' giving it a natural affinity with the cycling crowd. Growlers, howlers, and cans are available to go, making it a convenient stop for touring cyclists looking to restock before the next stretch of Vancouver Island road.
2ed42a8b3d: Seabreeze Take-out is a takeout food business located in the Vancouver Island and Gulf Islands region of British Columbia. Its name suggests a coastal setting, making it a potential stop for cyclists touring the island's scenic routes. No further detail is verifiable from available sources.
e9fbd9097b: True North Distilleries is a craft distillery in Qualicum Beach on Vancouver Island, producing Canadian whiskeys (including the 54-40 and 54-40 10 reserve series), gin (Djinneh), and absinthe. They offer bookable tasting experiences for both whiskey and absinthe, and run a Barrel Buyers Club allowing enthusiasts to purchase shares in aging barrels with custom-labeled bottles at maturity. A retail store on site sells their spirits range.
4dc1d93560: Northern Lights Estate Winery is BC's most northern and largest fruit winery, built on the banks of the Nechako River at the base of Prince George's famous cutbanks. The estate grows gooseberries, raspberries, apples, rhubarb, black currants, cherries, and blueberries on-site, crafting award-winning wines from 100% BC-grown fruit. Visitors can enjoy tours and tastings, a full riverside restaurant (RiverHouse), and the distinction of sipping carbon-neutral, fully vegan wines at a destination unlike any other in northern BC.
e85a2d0101: Moon Curser Vineyards is a boutique Osoyoos winery named after gold-rush-era smugglers who dodged moonlight on the Dewdney Trail, just shy of the US border. It specializes in rare old-world varieties like Touriga Nacional, Carménère, and Tannat — grapes seldom grown elsewhere in Canada — and has earned recognition seven times on Top Winery lists at the WineAlign National Wine Awards of Canada. Cyclists on the Crowsnest Highway (Hwy 3) will find a welcoming tasting room with vineyard and Osoyoos Lake views, plus a seated 'Smuggler's Sitting' experience on select days.
72b182ddfc: Rust Wine Co is a boutique estate winery on the Golden Mile Bench in Oliver, BC, drawing grapes from five vineyards — some planted as far back as 1963 — to produce small-lot, single-vineyard wines that reflect distinct Okanagan and Similkameen terroirs. The property includes a tasting room with sweeping views over Black Sage Bench toward Osoyoos, and a restored 19th-century heritage bunkhouse available as vacation accommodation. Regular live music events make it a social stop on a corridor that is one of BC's most popular cycling routes.
72ce43a812: Phantom Creek Estates is a premium winery and estate restaurant on the Black Sage Bench in Oliver, BC, one of Canada's most celebrated wine sub-regions. The gravity-flow facility sources fruit from four estate vineyards and produces up to 50,000 cases annually using biodynamic farming and optical-sorting technology. Touring cyclists riding the South Okanagan's wine-country roads can stop for seated tastings, guided estate tours, and full restaurant dining with seasonal chef's pairings.
2baf55ceed: Dubh Glas Distillery is a craft spirits producer in BC's Okanagan region, making single-malt whisky, gin, and VSOP brandy. The distillery operates an online shop and, based on its Square payment integration, likely has a physical tasting room or retail counter where cyclists can sample and purchase local spirits. It sits in one of Canada's premier wine and spirits corridors, making it a noteworthy detour for touring cyclists passing through the South Okanagan.
0c0912f801: Gehringer Brothers Estate Winery is a family-owned estate winery established in 1985 on the Golden Mile Bench near Oliver in the South Okanagan, where Walter and Gordon Gehringer — BC-born winemakers trained in Europe — produce an extensive range from sparkling and whites to icewines. Their Minus 9 Icewine has earned Double Platinum 'Best of the Best' recognition from Wine Press Northwest, and the winery has been described as 'one of the finest wine producers anywhere on the west coast.' Wine can be purchased at the on-site wine shop or ordered online for Canadian delivery.
b534b012eb: Backyard Vineyards is an award-winning BC VQA winery in the Township of Langley, marketing itself as the bountiful backyard to Vancouver. Visitors can enjoy wine flights, charcuterie, and wine by the glass in the tasting room, or take bottles out to the casual first-come-first-served picnic area, which welcomes outside food and leashed dogs. The winery offers bubble tours, private event bookings, and a wine club, making it a destination rather than a simple tasting stop.
b30f4e6dc4: Antidote Distilling Company is a craft distillery in Port Alberni, Vancouver Island, producing award-winning artisanal spirits — including a Black Gin that earned Double Gold at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition — made with locally sourced grains and wild-foraged ingredients. They operate an on-site restaurant serving cocktails and food, and offer a 'Gin Academy' experience where visitors distill and bottle their own personalized gin. With a sustainability focus on recycled glass bottles and a low carbon footprint, they describe themselves as a postcard for the Alberni Valley.
d147821e21: Hidden Chapel Winery is a small boutique winery nestled in the pines near Oliver in the South Okanagan, producing estate wines from sandy loam soils at the northern tip of the Great Basin Desert. The winery ages its wines in a unique underground cellar overlooked by the namesake hidden chapel, surrounded by beautiful gardens. Visitors can explore a range of whites, rosés, and reds — including estate-grown Cabernet Sauvignon — at the cheerful tasting room and wine shop, located only 5 km from Oliver and 3 km from the District Wine Village.
dc7753c302: Trench Brewing & Distilling is a craft brewery and distillery in Prince George whose entire identity is rooted in the Rocky Mountain Trench — every beer named after a local natural landmark. The taproom pairs a rotating lineup of flagship and small-batch pilot brews with a food menu built around house-smoked meats and gourmet tacos, making it a substantial sit-down stop. Beers can also be purchased to take home, and the brewery distributes widely across BC.
fa09f2d630: Raven's Moon is a farm-based estate winery and cidery near Courtenay on Vancouver Island, producing handcrafted ciders and fruit wines from organically grown local blueberries and apples. The operation blends old-world fermentation traditions with farm experimentation, offering still, sparkling, and fortified styles alongside farm foods like jams and honey. A past customer review specifically calls it out as a highlight of a multi-farm cycle tour, making it a natural stop for touring cyclists on the Island.
9194feceeb: Nk'Mip Cellars is the first Indigenous-owned winery in North America, operated by the Osoyoos Indian Band on their 32,000-acre Sonoran Desert reserve at the southern end of the Okanagan Valley. The winery produces international award-winning wines across multiple tiers and is home to the Sweetgrass @Nk'Mip Cellars restaurant, offering lunch in a setting rich with Syilx cultural history. For touring cyclists on the Okanagan wine route, it is a distinctive cultural and culinary destination unlike any other stop in the region.
b9c6000477: Vasanti Estate Winery is a family-owned estate winery on the northern edge of Oliver opened in June 2024 by the Sidhu family, who have farmed the South Okanagan for over 40 years. The winery offers guided tastings of small-lot, award-winning wines paired with locally inspired small plates and cocktails served on a patio overlooking the estate vineyards. Sitting directly on Highway 97 in the heart of Okanagan wine country, it is a natural stop on the classic Oliver–Osoyoos cycling corridor.
b0598412d1: Burrowing Owl Estate Winery is a family-owned premium VQA wine estate in Oliver, at the heart of the South Okanagan cycling corridor, operating since 1993. The property encompasses a wine shop, the Sonora Room fine-dining restaurant, and an 11-room guest house, all situated within the northernmost reach of the antelope brush ecosystem. It is a natural destination stop for cyclists exploring Black Sage Road and the broader Okanagan wine country.
6416a8885a: Mount Arrowsmith Brewing Company is a family-run craft brewery in Parksville producing a wide range of award-winning hand-crafted beers, from crisp lagers and hazy IPAs to a spruce-tip brut IPA made with locally foraged Sitka tips. Their west-coast themed tasting room pours pints, flights, and cans to go, while the newly opened Arrowsmith Smokehouse adds Southern-style BBQ with house-smoked meats, pizzas, and handhelds. The brewery is a genuine community hub on mid-Vancouver Island, regularly hosting live music nights and an annual craft beer and mini-putt festival in Parksville.
a2a3f2a9c2: Maverick Estate Winery occupies the Golden Mile Slopes appellation on Highway 97, sitting roughly halfway between Oliver and Osoyoos in the heart of South Okanagan wine country. Founded in 2009 and releasing its first vintage in 2011, the winery follows slow-wine principles—biodynamic and organic farming, natural fermentation, and minimal cellar intervention—producing small-lot wines that aim to express the character of the site. Guests can taste in a tasting room, on a patio, or in the Villa Tasting Garden, and the winery also runs intimate dinners and wine-education Flight School sessions.
448af79e59: Silver Sage Winery is a family-owned, award-winning estate winery established in 1996 by Romanian immigrants Anna and Victor Manola, drawing on four generations of winemaking tradition in Oliver, BC's Golden Mile region. Set on the banks of Oxbow Creek with mountain views, the winery produces premium Okanagan grape wines alongside distinctive fresh-fruit dessert wines — claimed to be a Canadian first. Beyond tastings, the property offers three on-site guest suites and event hosting, making it a potential overnight stop for cycling tours through the Okanagan wine country.
a1bc9a94b5: Locality Brewing is a family-owned farm brewery on MacInnes Farms in North Langley that grows its own barley and hops, malts its own grain, and brews entirely on-site — a true field-to-glass operation. The taproom opens onto outdoor picnic areas and hiking trails, giving visiting cyclists a rural farm setting to relax in. An on-site food truck (Stampede Burger) serves burgers, poutine, and salads alongside the house-brewed beers.
fab1e6c023: Tradish Ancestor Cafe & Indigenous Food Truck is an Indigenous-owned food business operating in the Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley region of BC. It combines a cafe concept with a mobile food truck, making it a culturally distinctive stop for touring cyclists seeking locally rooted food experiences. The food truck format suggests flexible locations and takeout-focused service.
a1a9b0cb4d: Oak & Sparrow Estate Winery is a family-owned small-batch winery perched on the Golden Mile slopes of the Okanagan Valley near Oliver, BC — one of the most celebrated cycling wine routes in Canada. The estate produces wines including Pinot Noir, Chardonnay, and Rosé from its own vineyard, and recently completed a tasting room and large patio with vineyard views where tastings can be booked in advance or taken as walk-ins.
c762602ba4: Township 7 Vineyards & Winery is a distinguished BC winery founded in 2000 with two locations; this South Langley Fraser Valley outpost sits in a serene rural countryside setting where visitors can witness a working winery in action and meet the winemakers. The winery is known for small-lot, hand-harvested wines crafted from sustainably grown estate and local grapes, blended from over 15 single vineyards. The tasting room encourages guests to linger over a glass and enjoy a picnic on the property.
a6d676a187: Singletree Winery is a small, family-operated vineyard in the Mt. Lehman area of Abbotsford, producing VQA wines crafted by second-generation winemaker Andrew Etsell from Fraser Valley grapes. Visitors can choose between guided indoor tastings, outdoor wine flights at fire tables, private Wine Cabanas, or themed Di Vine Domes set in an Enchanted Forest or Canadian Cabin setting. The winery also hosts regular live-music events and is available for weddings, making it a notable destination stop along Fraser Valley cycling routes.
e2641b2111: The Fort Wine Co. is a winery and wine shop located on 84 Avenue in the Langley area of the Fraser Valley, a region known for its agricultural heritage and cycling routes. Tagged in OpenStreetMap as both a craft winery and a wine retail shop, it would represent a farm-gate style destination for cyclists exploring the valley. No current website content is available to confirm operating details.
3cf524ea50: Launched in 2023, Sharpe Distillery is a family-owned craft distillery in Cawston honouring three generations of the Sharpe family's roots in the Similkameen Valley. The distillery produces whisky, botanical gin, vodka, and pisqu using water drawn from the nearby Similkameen River, with a tasting room open seasonally on select weekends and by appointment. Situated on the unceded territory of the Syilx, Nlaka'pamux, and Secwépemc Peoples, it offers touring cyclists a genuine taste of place on the Similkameen corridor.
066ab8d849: Mountainview Brewing Co. is a family-friendly craft brewery and taproom in Hope, BC, brewing with fresh Fraser Valley mountain water and a mandate to be a welcoming, inclusive community gathering space. The rotating tap list spans everything from hoppy IPAs showcasing BC-grown hops to barrel-aged mixed-culture saisons aged on golden plums picked locally in Hope. Sitting at the junction of the Crowsnest Highway corridor and the Fraser Valley, it is a natural refuelling stop for cyclists on multi-day tours through the region.
f6a6541cff: Tinhorn Creek Vineyards is a landmark South Okanagan estate winery with over 30 years of history on the Golden Mile Bench near Oliver, BC, recognized as Canada's first carbon-neutral winery. The property includes the full-service Miradoro Restaurant with sweeping valley views, a guest house, guided wine tastings, and an outdoor amphitheatre that hosts a summer Sunset Concert Series. It is a natural destination-stop for cyclists exploring the Okanagan wine country route.
4e58daf026: The Patch Brewery is a farm-to-table craft brewery and taproom situated on Laity Farms in Maple Ridge, brewing with BC-sourced hops and barley grown on the property — a true farm-to-glass operation rooted in a family farming heritage dating to 1879. Alongside a rotating tap list, the brewery serves artisan pizzas, coffee drinks, and has a picnic area that welcomes dogs. It is a notable stop for cyclists exploring the Fraser Valley, blending a working farm setting with a full kitchen and a well-stocked taproom.
4680f0d381: River Stone Estate Winery is a small, family-owned estate winery perched on a rocky knoll in the South Okanagan, just south of the landmark McIntyre Bluff and north of Oliver — BC's self-styled Wine Capital. The winery is celebrated for big, bold Bordeaux-style reds and aromatic whites grown on deep glacial rock and gravel soils at River Rock Vineyards. Cyclists riding the Oliver wine route can stop at the open-air tasting garden, with walk-ins welcome or bookable tasting sessions available.
96009dff4a: Monashee Spirits is a small family-run craft distillery and cocktail lounge on Revelstoke's main Mackenzie Avenue strip, hand-distilling award-winning spirits with local ingredients and pure mountain spring water. Their Ethos Gin was named Best in Class Gin in Canada and Canadian Artisan Spirit of the Year 2019, and the bar was ranked #42 in Canada's 100 Best Bars. They also boast one of the largest whisky collections in Canada with over 700 bottles.
d998839f80: Vanessa Vineyard is a boutique estate winery perched on the rocky hillside of the Similkameen Valley in Cawston, growing premium red wine grapes on 75 acres of sloping, mineral-rich terrain along the Crowsnest Highway. Named for the Greek word for butterfly, the estate has earned national recognition for bold reds crafted under Master Winemaker Howard Soon, an Order of Canada recipient. The on-site tasting room offers curated guided experiences, making it a compelling destination for cyclists touring one of Canada's most scenic wine corridors.
09104a0304: Homura Yakiniku is a Japanese yakiniku restaurant on the second floor of a building on West Broadway in Vancouver, where guests grill their own meats tableside. The menu spans lunch courses, à la carte cuts, a drinks list, and a happy hour, with both pick-up and delivery available. The name 'Homura' means flame in Japanese, and the restaurant leans into that identity through its emphasis on the shared warmth of grilling together.
6a99df565d: Freshslice Pizza is a BC-founded pizza chain known for its any-toppings flat-price model, serving pizza by the slice and whole pies for dine-in or takeout. This Burnaby location on Royal Oak Avenue is a strip-mall fast-food stop with indoor seating and no drive-through. For a touring cyclist it offers a quick, filling, and affordable calorie stop in a suburban Burnaby corridor.
a61d889f74: Halston Pub & Liquor Store is a combined neighbourhood pub and off-sale liquor retailer in Kamloops, BC. The dual format means touring cyclists can grab a meal or drink on-site and stock up on take-home beverages in one stop. Its commercial building footprint suggests a full-service venue rather than a kiosk or pop-up.
8bcd7e5013: Firehouse Subs is a Canadian sandwich chain built around hot, steamed subs and a charitable mission: its Public Safety Foundation of Canada has donated over $6.3 million in equipment grants to first responders nationwide. The Pitt Meadows franchise sits in the Meadowtown retail area along the Lougheed Highway, a key east–west corridor for cyclists connecting the Lower Mainland to the Fraser Valley. It is a no-drive-through, takeout-friendly counter-service stop with a gluten-free roll option available.
99b66378d9: The Marigold Cafe is a chef-driven cafe and bakery operated by a husband-and-wife team — Ryan, a Red Seal Executive Chef, and Jenny — situated directly on the Lochside Trail in Saanichton. The cafe explicitly serves trail users and invites cyclists to stop in for specialty coffee, freshly made gourmet paninis, soup, and baked goods. Guests can eat in the industrial-inspired interior or relax on a covered outdoor patio overlooking a garden and water feature.
39a2e13fb2: Sooke Oceanside Brewery is a craft microbrewery and taproom on the southern tip of Vancouver Island, pouring a rotating lineup of west coast-style beers brewed on-site — from blonde ales and IPAs to seasonal schwarzbiers and hard seltzers. The taproom features an ocean-view patio and a lively events calendar including Open Mic Nights and stand-up comedy. Cyclists passing through Sooke on the Westshore or heading toward the Juan de Fuca Trail will find the Grilled To The Mac food truck stationed in the courtyard, serving locally sourced food alongside the house brews.
646a1e8545: Big Way Hot Pot is a growing Chinese hot pot chain offering an individual self-serve dining experience with over 100 premium ingredients and more than 18 broths, from rich Signature Mala to light Tomato with vegan options. The Kingsway location in Burnaby is one of several BC outposts in a chain that now spans across Canada and into the US. Diners select their own broth and cook ingredients tableside in individual pots.
16dc411bf8: Wood N Frog Coffee Company is a cozy café in Tsawwassen (Delta, BC) positioned close to the BC Ferries terminal—a natural refuelling point for cyclists arriving or departing by ferry. The café is known for artisan espresso drinks, freshly made sandwiches and wraps, and homemade baked goods including scones, croissants, and coconut cake. Gluten-free and vegetarian options are woven throughout the menu, and the welcoming atmosphere has earned it a loyal following among both locals and ferry travellers.
fe2f15c0a8: Anita's Bread & Coffee is an organic cafe and bakery housed inside the Anita's Organic Milling facility on South Sumas Road in Chilliwack, operated by Nature's Path Organic Foods. The bakery follows a rotating daily sourdough schedule — producing loaves such as country white, medium rye, miche, vollkornbrot, einkorn, and seasonal fougasse — all baked fresh each morning. It also serves as a baking education centre showcasing Anita's Organic Milling grains and flours, alongside organic coffee and a range of vegan-friendly pastries.
1ee454e71f: Marilena Cafe & Raw Bar is Toptable Group's first Victoria location, bringing the same team behind Blue Water Cafe, CinCin, and Araxi to the heart of BC's capital. Executive Chef Kristian Eligh, trained at Jean-Georges and The French Laundry, leads a menu centred on local and globally sourced seafood alongside a Japanese raw bar offering nigiri, sashimi, and sushi rolls. The restaurant has earned national acclaim including No. 1 Fine Dining in Canada on Tripadvisor's Best of the Best 2025 and Best Restaurant in Victoria from Vancouver Magazine 2025–2026.
55ef4ec423: Divine Sandwich is a fast-food restaurant in Richmond, BC specializing in sandwiches. It offers quick-service meals suitable for cyclists seeking convenient nutrition stops while touring the region.
303249cc05: Earls Robson is a location of the well-known Canadian casual-dining chain, situated on Vancouver's busy Robson Street shopping corridor. The restaurant offers both indoor and outdoor seating with American-influenced cuisine and caters to vegan and vegetarian diners. Its central position in the West End makes it a convenient urban stop on a popular cycling and pedestrian thoroughfare.
e4d3af5b25: Taqueria Jalisco is a Mexican restaurant situated on the second level of a building on Denman Street in Vancouver's West End, one of the city's most cyclist-friendly corridors linking the seawall and Stanley Park. The Denman Street strip is a natural refuelling stop for cyclists doing the seawall loop or passing through on tour. The taqueria format suggests a casual, quick-service Mexican menu well suited to hungry riders.
32a61b0de6: Tentatsu is a Japanese sushi restaurant on East Hastings Street in Vancouver, offering a broad menu of nigiri, rolls, robata, sashimi, tempura, donburi, and combo platters. The restaurant emphasizes fresh fish and skilled preparation as its core offering. Online pickup ordering is available, making it convenient for cyclists passing through the area.
4c36b38c70: Seahorses Café is a locally owned, family-operated restaurant perched directly over the water beside the Brentwood Bay Ferry terminal, with roughly 30 years of history on the site (current owners since 2015). The waterfront deck setting regularly draws seals, otters, a resident blue heron named Phillis, and occasional orcas. In addition to food and drink, the café also rents self-serve kayaks, making it a natural stop for cyclists exploring the Saanich Peninsula.
a25246a3e2: Pizza Pzazz has operated inside the Granville Island Public Market since 1995, serving artisanal pizzas made to order, house-made pastas, and handmade gelato from traditional Italian recipes. The team sources toppings directly from neighbouring market vendors, including local produce and charcuterie. It sits within one of Vancouver's most visited waterfront destinations, making it a natural refuelling stop for cyclists riding the seawall or exploring Granville Island.
c0bd705643: Sansho is a Japanese sushi and dining restaurant anchored by chef Hideki Yamamoto, who spent twenty years running Dharma Sushi in Halifax before bringing his thirty years of sushi expertise to North Vancouver. The restaurant sits in Queensbury Market at the foot of Grand Boulevard, offering a broad menu spanning izakaya starters, sashimi, specialty rolls, noodles, and teriyaki dinners. A dedicated gluten-free menu and online ordering make it a practical meal stop for cyclists with dietary needs.
2c9c72a4ad: Spice Hut is a restaurant located on Esplanade Avenue in the heart of Ladysmith's walkable downtown, close to the waterfront. Ladysmith sits along a popular cycling corridor on Vancouver Island, making this a convenient food stop for touring cyclists passing through town.
1eca425f50: The Kelowna Beer Institute is a craft brewery and pub situated in Kelowna's Cultural District, brewing small-batch beer unfiltered from tank-to-tap under a brewmaster with over 26 years of experience. The kitchen pairs its food menu — wings, nachos, house-made pizzas, and sandwiches — directly with the on-site brews, incorporating beer into ingredients wherever possible. It aims to be a community gathering space welcoming to all, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists riding through the heart of downtown Kelowna.
0177aa2824: A Filipino cafeteria located on Fraser Street in Vancouver. Serves Filipino cuisine, though current operational status and amenities could not be verified due to website unavailability.
0150168abc: Moo's Pizza is a local pizza shop on the Trans-Canada Highway in Cobble Hill, serving a broad menu of classic and gourmet pizzas available by phone order. With named house specials and several dedicated vegetarian pies, it offers a hearty refuelling option for cyclists riding the Cowichan Valley corridor of Vancouver Island.
78dbf02570: Asian Avenue is Vernon's long-standing Chinese restaurant situated on Highway 97, a key cycling corridor through BC's interior. The restaurant offers dine-in, takeout, and delivery, with a private banquet hall seating up to 100 guests equipped with audio/visual equipment. Its highway-side location makes it a convenient stop for touring cyclists passing through Vernon.
ded0b94aea: Olio's Pizzeria & Eatery is a sit-down pizza restaurant in Fort St. John serving the Peace River region of northeastern BC. The restaurant offers dine-in, takeout, and delivery, making it a flexible stop for cyclists passing through the area. It is one of the established local pizza destinations in a community that serves as a common resupply hub on northern BC touring routes.
db36d9a0b0: A family-owned Mediterranean restaurant operating in Vernon since 1997, The Med Vernon serves an eclectic range of cuisines from across the Mediterranean alongside an intriguing 'Modern Organic Thai' offering. The full-service dining room is open for lunch and dinner most days, with a dedicated tapas happy hour menu and a curated wine list. Touring cyclists will find a sit-down restaurant with reservations available, gift cards, and a warm European-inspired atmosphere.
8946577b73: Dookbaeki is a Korean soul food restaurant specializing in traditional stone bowl dishes — the eponymous dookbaeki — along with slow-cooked soups and stews simmered for up to 48 hours to develop deep flavour and nutrition. The Coquitlam location is part of a small chain with Edmonton outposts, situated near Coquitlam Centre mall. A touring cyclist stopping here can expect hearty, bone-broth-based meals like seolleong-tang and a variety of soontubu soft tofu soups.
33d531d48a: Pasargad has been serving traditional Persian cuisine in Coquitlam since 2010, specializing in saffron-marinated kebabs, slow-cooked stews, and authentic rice dishes. The restaurant aims to make Persian cooking more accessible in the Tri-Cities area, drawing on centuries-old recipes while using fresh local ingredients. A touring cyclist can sit down for a full dine-in meal or order takeout with free delivery across Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam, and Port Moody.
dee0d806ca: Momo Tanghulu is a dessert and juice cafe in Richmond specializing in tanghulu, the traditional Chinese candied-fruit skewer treat. Located in a commercial unit on Buswell Street, it offers a sweet pit stop for cyclists passing through Richmond's urban core. The shop's evening-friendly hours make it a viable post-ride destination.
150cdaf8b4: Enroute.cc is a performance cycling apparel shop and café hybrid in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, carrying premium brands such as Pas Normal Studios, MAAP, Rapha, and ASSOS alongside race nutrition from Maurten and Precision Hydration. The physical retail space doubles as a café — a format beloved in road cycling culture — making it a destination stop for cyclists seeking both kit and coffee on Vancouver's popular West Side riding corridors. Its location on West 1st Avenue places it directly along routes connecting the Seawall and Kitsilano to Point Grey.
02c63c69d7: Blenz Coffee is a British Columbia-born specialty coffee chain with dozens of locations across Western Canada. This Richmond location at the Garden City and Blundell Road intersection serves a broad menu of espresso drinks, whole-leaf teas, nitro beverages, and a range of food from breakfast wraps and sandwiches to baked goods and desserts. Touring cyclists looking for a quick refuel stop in south Richmond will find full café service and takeout ordering available.
c4e7ac7102: The Table Bistro is an elevated artisanal bistro in the heart of Abbotsford's Fraser Valley, putting a creative twist on familiar regional ingredients. It features a fully operational cocktail bar, a curated wine list, and a café-quality coffee program. A touring cyclist finishing a Fraser Valley ride would find a full lunch and dinner menu, weekend brunch, and a daily happy hour.
9d5667284d: Sushi U is a Japanese restaurant in North Burnaby specializing in authentic and fusion sushi and Asian cuisine, with a focus on fresh ingredients. The restaurant operates as a takeout and pickup-oriented spot, making it a practical meal stop for cyclists traveling along Broadway. It positions itself as a quality local option in the North Burnaby corridor.
c495060684: Top Notch Burgers is a gourmet casual dining restaurant located inside the historic Best Western Dorchester hotel in downtown Nanaimo. 50d4e73c4c: Smoking Gun Coffee Roasters is a specialty coffee roaster and cafe located in the District 1881 development in the heart of downtown Chilliwack. 674d26449b: Damso is a modern Korean restaurant operated by Damso Group, offering an all-you-can-eat Korean menu with dishes like Korean BBQ, pork belly, tteokbokki, and Korean fried chicken. The restaurant is card-only and uses a waitlist seating system. Online ordering is available for takeout.
3f29dc9da8: Banana Leaf is Vancouver's original Malaysian restaurant, established in 1995 and now operating five Metro Vancouver locations. ea4880393a: Twins Chinese Kitchen is a sit-down Cantonese restaurant on Vancouver's Davie Street with an extensive menu spanning congee, wonton soups, fried noodles, hot pot, combo dinners, and over 80 dishes in total. 988b4e8e9e: Beagle Pub is a classic neighbourhood pub anchoring Victoria's lively Cook Street Village, offering a wide range of beer on tap alongside food service in a welcoming, unpretentious setting. 2b5fbe90f0: Sammy J's Grill & Bar is a BC-grown casual restaurant chain founded in Langley City in 1996, now with four locations including this South Surrey outpost. 7b4ddd55ee: Marble Slab Creamery is a Canadian chain ice cream shop known for hand-mixed ice cream on a frozen marble slab. This location sits along Lougheed Highway in Coquitlam, making it an easy roadside stop for cyclists passing through the Tri-Cities area.
aeeee907ec: Merridale Eatery is the farmhouse dining room of Merridale Cidery & Distillery, a family-owned, woman-led farm operation that has been crafting ciders and spirits in the Cowichan Valley for over 30 years. cb91af7c5e: Edo Japan is a Japanese fast-food restaurant chain with takeaway service. The North Vancouver location features air conditioning. As a casual fast-food venue, it provides quick meal options for touring cyclists.
a98d417893: Minnoz Restaurant + Lounge is an elegant yet casual full-service dining room and lounge inside the Coast Bastion Hotel in downtown Nanaimo, serving breakfast through dinner plus weekend brunch. c82556d15c: Helen's Grill is a classic old-school diner on Main Street in Vancouver, a well-travelled urban cycling corridor. For a touring cyclist rolling through South Vancouver, it offers a sit-down meal in an unpretentious, no-fuss setting.
f2e2900f8c: JINYA Ramen Bar is a Japanese ramen chain known for broths simmered in-house for over 20 hours using whole pork bones, chicken, vegetables, and classic Japanese seasonings. 340686396c: Freshslice Pizza is a BC-based pizza chain offering by-the-slice and whole-pie options for takeout and delivery. The East Hastings Street location sits in a dense urban corridor in East Vancouver. It is a no-frills fast-food stop with a broad menu of customizable pizzas.
a8412f94fe: Mr Mikes is a Canadian casual steakhouse chain with roots going back to 1960, now branded as 'SteakhouseCasual' — a relaxed, unpretentious sit-down experience built around affordable premium steaks, burgers, pastas, and shareable appetizers. 6c5a10ec58: Triumph Coffee is an independent café in Vernon, BC, branding itself around 'outstanding coffee.' 0a9efd8032: The Mantra is an Indian restaurant located on Fort Street in downtown Victoria. It serves Indian cuisine and provides a place for travelers and residents to dine.
e88a36d4d1: Canadian Pizza Plus is a Burnaby restaurant blending two distinct cuisines — classic Canadian-style pizza (customizable with up to five toppings, or as gourmet fusion pies like Butter Chicken Pizza) alongside a full authentic Indian menu of curries, biryanis, and tandoori wraps. 074732637a: Grill Haven is a Middle Eastern restaurant in Fort St. John offering a menu that includes kebab wings, hummus with falafel, hummus with beef, dipping shrimp, and loaded chicken fries. dba619ea88: Van Tea Cafe is a Hong Kong-style Chinese restaurant in Richmond offering dishes including fried chicken, laksa, and seafood prepared from fresh ingredients. a898a46214: Yolks is a breakfast and brunch restaurant founded by Chef Steve Ewing, known for scratch-made dishes built around Perfectly Poached™ eggs, house-made hollandaise, and locally sourced free-range eggs from Coligny Creek Eggs in Abbotsford. ae9b97d93d: Bun & Beans Cafe is a cafe located on West Hastings Street in downtown Vancouver. 3e699d6a2b: A casual fast-food chicken restaurant in Chilliwack offering takeaway service. No drive-through or outdoor seating. Free WiFi (SSID: BBQ Guest) and on-site washrooms make it a practical quick stop for touring cyclists needing food and connectivity.
4cdc3a97bf: Pizza Factory is a long-established Coquitlam pizzeria founded in 1984 by Sam Sanghera, now operating as a franchise with locations across British Columbia. 72abe681ea: Established in 1992, Sharkey's is a long-standing Ladner waterfront institution known for fish and chips, gourmet burgers, and craft beer in an east coast-style setting. 72dbfaa0bc: Sushi Heaven is a Japanese takeout restaurant on Penticton's Main Street offering an extensive menu of sushi rolls, sashimi, nigiri, teriyaki, tempura, donburi, and specialty combo trays. 4c3ad55ba9: Cheung Hing Food Co. is a Chinese restaurant on Kingsway in Vancouver, serving as a convenient meal stop for cyclists traveling through the area.

593a3086c2: A Chinese noodle restaurant located on Dunsmuir Street in downtown Vancouver. Indoor seating is available with no outdoor seating. No smoking is permitted.
c89e94a85a: Caribbean Village Cafe is a small family-run kitchen on a quiet corner of Victoria's Quadra Street, cooking slow-simmered island dishes rooted in the owner's grandfather's recipes. 8402961901: Huong Lan is a family-owned Vietnamese restaurant that has been a Nanaimo institution since 1998, voted the #1 Asian restaurant in Nanaimo by the Nanaimo News Bulletin every year from 2013 to 2022. 3f8dc171d1: Golden Spring is a Chinese restaurant in Vancouver offering dine-in service and online food ordering. Located on Nanaimo Street, it provides a convenient stop for touring cyclists seeking a meal.
f89016a254: Bohemian Spirits is a small-batch craft distillery and tasting room perched in Kimberley, BC — self-described as Canada's highest city — producing hand-crafted, hand-corked spirits from Rocky Mountain botanicals. b3c8851233: Aqui es Mexico serves authentic Mexican food on BC's Sunshine Coast in the small community of Madeira Park on the Sechelt Peninsula. c9d0d4e65d: Caffe Fantastico is a locally-owned, family-run coffee roastery operating multiple café locations in Victoria, BC, roasting a diverse menu of sustainably sourced coffees from value staples to boutique microlots. 85e01fe135: Saxe Point Public House is Esquimalt's community-focused neighbourhood pub, serving craft beers from Victoria's local breweries alongside a seasonal menu of fresh, modern takes on pub classics. 9368aef6a7: Cantina Norte is a modern Mexican restaurant in Edgemont Village, North Vancouver, carrying forward the spirit of the neighbourhood's beloved Café Norte with house-made tortillas, bold Pacific Northwest-inflected flavours, and a full agave-forward bar program. 050b7b08c6: Sushi California is a Japanese sushi restaurant operating multiple locations in the Vancouver area. The chain provides takeout options for touring cyclists seeking Japanese cuisine.
c5cced7702: Neate Donuts is a donut shop in downtown Vancouver operated by JJ Bean, a well-known local coffee roaster. Located on West Hastings Street, it offers a takeout-friendly format that suits cyclists passing through the downtown core.
487a8143f5: Bombay Kitchen and Bar is an Indian restaurant on Vancouver's beloved Commercial Drive, self-described as the highest-rated Indian restaurant in Vancouver. d54453ac68: A Korean restaurant on Lonsdale Avenue in North Vancouver offering dine-in and takeout service. The business operates daily with online ordering, providing quick meal service for visitors and commuters. It's a convenient dining option for touring cyclists passing through the area.
9f64146bbf: HAAN Korean BBQ is an authentic Korean barbecue restaurant located in Sunwood Square near Coquitlam Centre, where diners cook their own selection of beef or pork on smokeless tabletop grills. 161cabe5eb: Momo Sushi Downtown is a sushi restaurant in downtown Kelowna. The business website currently resolves to a GoDaddy parked domain, indicating potential closure or outdated contact information.
6cc8352290: Cactus Club Cafe is a well-established upscale casual dining chain with this Coquitlam location situated near shopping and VIP cinemas on Schoolhouse Street. 45244a41d9: Mundo Novo Coffee Roasters bills itself as the first facility on Canada's West Coast to offer wholesale, private label, and co-op coffee roasting under a single roof. 5e7e31e37f: Smitty's Oyster House is an independent waterfront seafood restaurant in Gibsons on British Columbia's Sunshine Coast, self-described as 'the institution on the water.' 1edf34544d: River's Edge Clubhouse is the signature restaurant at Sandpiper Resort, situated alongside the Harrison River in Harrison Mills and widely regarded as one of the Fraser Valley's most scenic destination restaurants. a64e2d7e41: Yan's Garden (潮樓) is a well-established Cantonese restaurant in Burnaby celebrated for its daily push-cart dim sum service, live seafood, and Peking duck. ef25552f78: Tim Hortons at 463 Robson Street is a downtown Vancouver location of Canada's ubiquitous coffee chain, sitting on one of the city's busiest pedestrian-and-cyclist corridors. edf300ba92: Vera's Burger Shack is a BC-based burger chain known for hand-pressed patties made from 100% fresh Canadian beef, with every item prepared to order from fresh ingredients. As a franchise with a Hall of Fame menu and rotating daily specials, it offers a consistent and recognizable stop for hungry riders.
b7b31f27ca: Black & Blue is a Kobe-beef certified upscale steakhouse operated by the Glowbal Restaurant Group in downtown Vancouver. 3ee18d0a2d: Thomas Haas Chocolates is a celebrated artisanal chocolatier and café in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, operated by award-winning pastry chef Thomas Haas. e9a5f6ba1f: Pressato is a European-inspired sandwich shop on Vancouver's busy Robson Street, built around house-baked focaccia made daily from five simple, preservative-free ingredients. 25ceed5f1a: Pizza Garden is a BC-based Neapolitan pizza chain with over 25 years in the industry, serving wood-fired pizzas with charred crusts, sun-ripened tomatoes, and fresh mozzarella. ed94a53d92: Beijing Hot Pot (京門涮肉) is a hot pot restaurant located in a unit at 8251 Westminster Highway in Richmond, BC. 1b2fbe4b41: Sushi Bar Shu is an intimate omakase sushi bar on Granville Street, founded in 2018 by Chef Hyunki Shin, who draws on 18 years of culinary experience including training in Japan. 6c9f2ce8ff: Ipoh Malay Cuisine is a Malaysian restaurant in Vancouver's Marpole neighbourhood, taking its name from Ipoh — a city in Peninsular Malaysia's Perak state renowned for a distinct local food culture. Touring cyclists exploring the southern reaches of the city will find it a rare stop for authentic Malaysian flavours.
cc8495c4bf: Gordon Ramsay Steak is an upscale steakhouse in Richmond, BC, part of the global restaurant empire of Michelin-starred celebrity chef Gordon Ramsay. Touring cyclists looking for a high-end dinner option in the Richmond area will find this a notable stop.
5d0702b1e0: Night Owl Kitchen + Bar is a multi-location BC chain that brings globally inspired cuisine—think Baja Shrimp Tacos, Chimichurri Salmon, and Weekend Brunch—to a lively seaside setting on Marine Drive in White Rock. 7e7bfeaa2e: Paper Crane Coffee is a café on East Broadway in Vancouver. d4abc8a97a: Shen Sushi is a Japanese sushi restaurant in Burnaby with online takeout ordering. It provides a quick food stop for cyclists touring through the area.
a9d0183263: Ban Bu Xian Szechuan is a Chinese restaurant specializing in Szechuan cuisine, located on Robson Street in downtown Vancouver. 9a6a1542c2: Local Pizza is a Vancouver Island–born pizza chain with five Victoria-area outlets, including food court locations at Hillside and Mayfair malls and standalone shops on Douglas, Shelbourne, and Goldstream. 41f4966b25: Punk Rock Pastries is a Burnaby bakery founded in 2019 by Chef Hollie Fraser, a three-time Food Network champion (The Big Bake Halloween, Bake Master Battle, Halloween Baking Championship), specializing in jaw-dropping 3D sculpted cakes, moving cakes, and unconventional pastries. 74136f2c30: SunTea Canada is a fresh-brewed bubble tea chain founded in 2019, offering fruit teas and milk teas with online ordering and a rewards app. The Kingsway Burnaby location is one of several Metro Vancouver outlets, situated in a unit-style retail space with indoor seating. 887280981a: Soft Peaks Ice Cream is an ice cream shop located on Alexander Street in Vancouver, offering frozen treats to the local community. It provides a casual stop for touring cyclists seeking refreshment during their travels.
544bb06009: Momo Tea is a bubble tea café on Yates Street in downtown Victoria. It sits in a walkable, cycling-friendly part of the city close to the Inner Harbour area. A touring cyclist passing through would find it a convenient stop for a cold or hot tea drink.
d4c12a8fa6: Big Wheel Burger is a Victoria-born fast food chain and Canada's first carbon neutral fast food restaurant, open since 2011 and now operating five locations. d76970166f: Yaas Grill House is a family-owned Persian restaurant that has been serving the North Shore community for over three decades, specializing in halal kababs, traditional stews, and an extensive range of vegetarian dishes. 42a1108136: Pelican Seafood Restaurant (又一村海鲜酒家) is a family-owned Chinese seafood restaurant that has been operating in East Vancouver for over 10 years. A street-facing patio adds an outdoor dining option for cyclists passing through the area.
a6dfd29e0d: Cheng Du Street Food is a multi-city Sichuan restaurant chain with locations in Richmond, Toronto, and Montreal, serving authentic Chengdu-style cuisine including bold Sichuan peppercorn dishes and seasonal specials like spicy crayfish. d5b6a4b0e8: Alexandra's Bistro is a cozy, family-run Greek and Italian restaurant located on the upper level of Beban Plaza at the corner of Bowen and Northfield Road in Nanaimo. 29e3ddd298: Wendy's is a major North American fast food chain offering square fresh-never-frozen beef burgers, chicken sandwiches, salads, and its signature Frosty dessert. 15d0e766ab: Best Of Stone Baked Pizzeria is a full-service pizza restaurant in Fort St. John offering an unusually broad menu — stone-baked pizzas in multiple sizes, donairs, burgers, wings, pasta, and ice cream. dbf801cbe3: That Place Italian Restaurant is a long-standing neighbourhood staple in Coquitlam's historic Maillardville district, serving an extensive menu of hand-crafted pastas, stone-baked pizzas, and traditional Italian mains like marsala chicken and linguini pescatore. 70297298b8: Miso Taco is a Mexican-Japanese fusion restaurant on Vancouver's Cambie Street, serving street-food-inspired dishes like teriyaki chicken tacos and pork chashu fillings that blend both culinary traditions. 183ce81409: Rhino Coffee House is a surf-culture café anchored in Tofino's downtown core, serving espresso drinks, handcrafted matcha lattes, and a rotating lineup of fresh-baked goods including their signature savory 'Bro Nut' stuffed donut. 0fd9fe17aa: Motherlove Ferments is a Kelowna craft brewery specializing in live, unpasteurized kombucha and water kefir made with organic ingredients and whole-food flavours. 7922aae336: Folietta is an Italian restaurant from the Wentworth Hospitality Group situated in Vancouver's Grandview-Woodlands neighbourhood on the east side. 6aeeb5650a: Signature Sports Bistro is a bar and bistro located in Chilliwack. It serves as a casual dining and refreshment establishment in the community.
815079134a: Uptown Pizza is a Salt Spring Group restaurant anchored in the busy Uptown district of Ganges, serving house-made pizzas built on fresh-made dough and marinara with real mozzarella, plus burgers, wings, and Kelly's homemade desserts. a7061c73bc: Modern Cafe is a brunch-focused restaurant on Commercial Street in downtown Nanaimo, serving dishes like Ahi Tuna Poke Bowl, Smoked Chowder, and Brisket Dip alongside classic brunch fare. 364b41266f: La Forêt is a cozy café and bakery chain with roots going back to 2013, known for its spacious, forest-themed spaces and a menu spanning espresso drinks, brunch platters, croissants, and waffles.
