Touring cyclists will find a welcoming sit-down spot with substantial food options and a relaxed community atmosphere.
1bc28da5b0: The Station Taphouse is a restaurant and pub set inside Port Alberni's historic train station, blending heritage character with a modern hospitality concept. Connected to Twin City Brewing Company, it operates 24 rotating taps focused on local and regional BC craft beer, alongside a curated comfort-food menu, BC wines, and cocktails. It positions itself as a destination for both locals and travelers passing through the Alberni Valley.
aa9aa492d0: Silver Creek Cookhouse is a casual diner on Alaska Road North in Fort St. John, serving breakfast, coffee, burgers, and sandwiches — the kind of hearty, no-frills fuel a touring cyclist needs after grinding through northeastern BC. It sits along the Alaska Highway corridor, making it a natural waypoint for riders heading north toward Dawson Creek or beyond. Air conditioning provides a welcome break on hot summer days in the Peace River region.
14962a0501: Penguin Bros. is a bubble tea specialty cafe in Richmond. It offers a convenient stop for refreshments during cycling tours of the area.
1944bea808: The Pizza Co. is a pizza restaurant located in Cranbrook, BC, in the East Kootenay region. Cranbrook sits along several popular cycling routes in the Columbia Valley corridor, making it a potential refuelling stop for touring cyclists passing through. No further details about the restaurant's offerings or facilities could be verified.
bac50bd4ff: The Copper Coil Still & Grill is a locally owned, family-operated restaurant in Squamish that fuses Cajun and Louisiana cooking traditions with Pacific Northwest seasonal and regional ingredients. Hand-crafted BBQ dishes anchor a menu designed around fresh, local produce in the spirit of New Orleans cuisine. Squamish is a major hub on the Sea to Sky cycling corridor, and the restaurant sits on Cleveland Avenue near the town centre.
fe523ed2f6: Church's Chicken is a fast-food restaurant serving fried chicken with takeaway and indoor seating available. A convenient quick-meal option for cyclists passing through Burnaby.
b978292a22: Pizza Now is a pizza-focused fast food outlet in a Hillside Drive strip mall beside Canadian Tire in Kamloops. It offers delivery, curbside pickup, and a drive-thru window, making it a quick stop for a hot meal without needing to lock up for long. The menu centres on classic 12-inch pizzas ordered online or by phone.
b829d65144: Grays Cafe is a sister-owned neighbourhood café in Sidney by the Sea, opened in 2021 by sisters Lisa and Amy who built it around locally sourced ingredients — coffee from Drumroaster, local produce, baked goods, and meat. The breakfast-and-lunch menu spans wraps, bagels, salads, and smoothies with a strong vegetarian and vegan lean. It bills itself as a place for community gathering, making it a welcoming mid-ride stop in the heart of Sidney.
9271aa35d2: Yet's Cafe claims to be Vancouver's first fresh fruit boba tea and juice shop, specializing in bubble teas, fresh fruit boba teas, and a range of international juice flavors. Located on Burrard Street, the shop emphasizes fresh, real-fruit ingredients and has drawn comparisons to Persian-style juice bars. However, the business's current status is uncertain, as the Wix site appears frozen at 2021 and a rebrand to 'Place2be Cafe' has been flagged.
fd6dd8d3dd: New Owly Cade is a café located on Douglas Street in downtown Victoria, BC. It sits in a central, walkable area of the city convenient to the Inner Harbour cycling routes. OSM records outdoor seating, suggesting a patio presence that may appeal to cyclists stopping mid-ride.
1dbcdc5cef: Brackendale Bean is a café in the Brackendale neighbourhood of Squamish, a popular hub for cyclists tackling the Sea-to-Sky corridor. The café offers both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a potential rest stop for riders in all weather. OSM discovery notes suggest the business may now operate under the name Bean & Co at the same location.
eab7c7c7e8: Donair Shack is a fast-casual restaurant specializing in authentic donairs — grilled meat carved from a rotating spit, wrapped in warm flatbread with fresh vegetables and house sauces. It is part of a small regional chain with five locations across Abbotsford, Mission, and Surrey, making it a familiar refuelling stop along the Fraser Valley corridor. The menu spans several donair styles, rice and salad platters, and falafel options, offering a filling and customizable meal for cyclists on the move.
e66256ee83: Desserts Artisanaux is an authentic Cantonese dessert cafe on the Kingsway corridor in East Vancouver, specializing in handcrafted sweets made from traditional recipes — including double skin steamed milk pudding, mochi, sago soups, and seasonal specialties like pumpkin paste. The shop emphasizes 'not too sweet' flavours and slow, intentional preparation, and offers takeout with outdoor seating available.
71825389fb: Thai Pudpong is a family-owned authentic Thai restaurant operating since 2002, founded by head chef Sutthi Srilanpong whose mother cooked in the palace for King Rama the 9th's family in Bangkok. It was the first Thai restaurant in West Vancouver and earned early acclaim from the North Shore newspaper for its elegant, cozy atmosphere. The menu spans classics like Pad Thai, Red Curry, and Tom Yum, with spice levels adjustable to taste.
3a1cb5a013: 1181 Lounge is an LGBTQ-primary bar on Vancouver's Davie Street, known for craft cocktails, resident DJs, and a casual modern atmosphere. It is a well-established fixture of the city's gay village, drawing a lively crowd for music and nightlife. Touring cyclists visiting Vancouver's West End will find it near the Seawall and Davie Village.
97f7d11293: Sushi Misoya is a Japanese restaurant on Dewdney Trunk Road in Maple Ridge, serving sushi and other Japanese dishes with both dine-in and takeout options. The restaurant supports online ordering, making it easy for cyclists to place an order in advance. It sits on a major arterial road through Maple Ridge, convenient for cyclists traveling the Lougheed corridor.
549ffe715e: Koi Sushi is a freshly made sushi counter located on the first floor of the University Centre Building at UBC Okanagan, operated by the Students' Union Okanagan. It sits within the campus food services hub alongside other student-union-run outlets including a pub and an Indian cuisine counter. As a campus food outlet, it is primarily oriented toward the university community, though the campus itself is accessible from Kelowna's road network.
ea659d64d2: Flour Dance Bakery is an artisan bakery in Richmond specializing in Asian-inspired breads and desserts, including matcha, taro, sesame, and lychee loaves made with premium hard spring flour and pure milk over 16-hour fermentation. The bakery operates both a retail storefront and an online ordering system with local delivery and self-pickup routes serving Richmond, Burnaby, and Vancouver. It is a bilingual (English and Chinese) business with a loyal community following, marketing itself as the 'Flour Dance Union.'
4ceba6316a: Donair Express is a fast-casual wrap and bowl restaurant on Goldstream Avenue serving Lebanese, Halifax, and Caribbean-style donairs alongside rice bowls and sides. Chicken, beef, and vegetarian falafel are available across the entire menu, making it a flexible stop for mixed groups. The Goldstream Avenue location sits on a well-travelled cycling corridor connecting Victoria's western neighbourhoods.
3c0aa68991: PokeLani is a Hawaiian poke restaurant on Main Street in North Vancouver where customers build customizable bowls from a selection of proteins (tuna, salmon, shrimp, chicken, tofu), bases (white rice, brown rice, noodles, spring mix, kale), and an array of fresh vegetables, sauces, and toppings. The fast-casual format is well-suited to hungry cyclists looking for a fresh, filling meal assembled quickly to order. Online ordering and delivery are also available for those who want to plan ahead.
b6a07a32a7: Catelowna is a cat café on the second floor of a building in downtown Kelowna where visitors can enjoy organic, fair-trade coffee and tea while spending time with adoptable rescue cats. The café partners with local rescue organizations and has facilitated 548 cat adoptions to date. Beyond daily café visits, it hosts regular events including yoga sessions, paint-a-pet classes, and afternoon tea services.
2a9e09bfbd: Bin 4 Burger Lounge is a BC-born gourmet burger chain founded in 2011, now with seven locations including this Westshore outpost at 716 Goldstream Avenue. The menu leans on locally sourced ingredients—natural BC beef, Fraser Valley free-run chicken, and seasonal produce—paired with a wide roster of house-made aiolis and craft-inspired cocktails. The casual lounge format offers dine-in, online ordering, and a daily happy hour, making it a solid refuelling stop for cyclists passing through the Langford corridor.
ade95b38c1: John 3:16 Malaysian Delights is a Malaysian restaurant chain founded in Richmond in 2014, with the Burnaby outpost on the busy Kingsway corridor offering authentic Malaysian rice dishes, noodles, and hot beverages. The restaurant prides itself on chefs skilled in traditional Malaysian cooking and serves a broad menu from appetizers to desserts. With online ordering and a takeout-friendly format, it makes a practical meal stop on a Kingsway cycling route.
3def5a7872: Cockney Kings is a family-owned fish and chips institution that has been serving classic English-style fish and chips across Metro Vancouver since 1965. The Kitsilano location on Cornwall Avenue — steps from the Seaside Greenway cycling route — opened in 2023 and offers dine-in and takeout of battered fish, chips, and a full seafood menu. Now with four locations across Vancouver, Burnaby, and New Westminster, it remains a multi-generational local landmark.
dea08002aa: Ashiana Tandoori is a family-run Indian restaurant on Vancouver's Kingsway corridor that has been serving authentic cuisine since 1980, and is recognized by Vancouver Magazine judges for housing the city's first tandoor oven. The restaurant offers a broad menu spanning tandoori specialties, curries, seafood, and rice dishes, with dedicated vegan and gluten-free sections. Dine-in, takeout, and local delivery are all available, making it a viable meal stop for cyclists passing through the area.
98125c375e: Smitty's is a Canadian casual dining chain founded in Calgary in 1960, with over 80 locations across Canada, serving all-day breakfast, pancakes, and comfort food classics. The Fort St. John location is one of the newer additions to the chain, confirmed open via the corporate news feed. For cyclists passing through the Peace River region, it offers a full sit-down dining experience with a broad menu served all day.
0c125eb1d3: Rocky Point Ice Cream is a family-owned artisan ice cream chain that has operated in the Lower Mainland since 1997, making its own ice cream from scratch at BC's first licensed dairy plant dedicated solely to craft production. The New Westminster location is one of four storefront locations across the region and offers both indoor and outdoor seating. Visitors can choose from a rotating lineup of house-made flavours including plant-based and sorbet options.
bc74bb16f6: House of Dosas is a South Indian restaurant at the corner of Kingsway and Knight in Vancouver, a community staple for over 16 years known for its signature dosas — crispy, cylindrical crepes made from fermented rice and lentil batter served with chutneys and curries. The Kingsway flagship operates around the clock every day of the year, making it one of the few full-service restaurant options in Vancouver available to cyclists arriving at any hour. The menu spans dosas, biryanis, curries, and South Indian café drinks, with extensive options for vegan, gluten-free, and omnivore diners.
30c162adb7: Little Fox Bakehouse is an artisan scratch bakery founded by Red Seal pastry chef Eric Ho, who pivoted from a 13-year engineering career to pursue his passion for baking. Everything is handcrafted on-site using traditional French techniques with real butter — no shortening or margarine — and the menu spans croissants in a wide variety of flavours, mousse cakes, canelés, and more. An espresso bar rounds out the offering for take-out drinks.
2784711e2f: Timmy Kitchen (添味馆) is a Chinese restaurant in the Steveston village area of Richmond, a popular cycling destination at the southern tip of Lulu Island. The restaurant offers dine-in service with outdoor seating and is wheelchair accessible. Its Steveston location puts it within easy reach of the waterfront dyke cycling routes that attract touring and recreational cyclists.
d312ea83d8: Ugly Duckling is an award-winning innovative tasting-menu restaurant that opened in February 2023 in the heart of Victoria's historic Chinatown. It was named Victoria's Best New Restaurant by YAM Magazine and long-listed among Canada's Best New Restaurants by Air Canada's En Route Magazine. The kitchen produces entirely handcrafted, seasonally rotating dishes sourced from Vancouver Island's small farms and wild ingredients.
2e18c779bf: Keating Coffee is a small weekday café on the Saanich Peninsula focused on quality fair-trade organic coffee and fresh homemade food, situated next to the Co-op Grocery on Keating Cross Road. The kitchen makes soups from scratch and builds sandwiches and paninis with local produce and bread from nearby bakeries — a practical fuelling stop for a cyclist passing through Saanichton. Customers consistently rate it among the best coffee spots on the Peninsula, and the café also offers catering.
560609082c: Legendary Noodle House is a Vietnamese restaurant on Denman Street in Vancouver's West End, handcrafting noodles in an open kitchen since 1997. The compact interior is decorated with an antique wooden waterwheel at the entrance, Chinese lanterns, dark wood tables and benches imported from China, and wooden screens backlit by turquoise lights. A second location operates on West Broadway, and the English Bay location offers both dine-in and takeout.
86c3e3187c: Sushi Mura is a Japanese sushi restaurant chain founded in Vancouver in 2012, with the Richmond branch situated in the Hollybridge Way commercial area. The restaurant emphasizes daily-delivered fresh fish and authentic Japanese recipes, offering a broad menu spanning rolls, sashimi, nigiri, tempura, and cooked entrees. It is part of a growing multi-location franchise across Metro Vancouver, making it a recognizable and consistent stop for a sit-down or takeout meal.
8041fd4480: Ajisai Sushi Bar is a long-running traditional Japanese sushi restaurant on West 42nd Avenue in Vancouver's Kerrisdale neighbourhood, offering dine-in lunch and dinner as well as telephone takeout. The restaurant is known for a focused menu of nigiri, sashimi, chirashi, and donburi made with high-quality seafood. A sister grab-and-go outlet, Ajisai 2 Go, operates next door at 2087 W.42nd Ave with ready-made rolls and bento for cyclists who want a quick stop.
1b6fda93a0: Sparky Chicken is a Korean fried chicken shop on Fraser Street in Vancouver, specializing in a wide variety of sauced and grilled chicken dishes served with pickled radish and tteok (rice cake). The menu spans bone-in and boneless options in flavours from honey garlic to extreme hot, plus Korean rice bowls and samgak kimbap. Takeout and delivery are both available, making it a convenient stop for a hearty meal on a Fraser Street cycling route.
0e4d92e042: Church's Chicken (operating as Church's Texas Chicken in the Lower Mainland) is a fried chicken fast food chain at a strip-mall location in Richmond's Blundell area. This location offers drive-through, in-store pickup, and delivery via DoorDash, Skip, UberEats, and Fantuan. A touring cyclist would find it a functional, round-the-clock food stop with Wi-Fi.
bcb29a5537: Café Medina is a Mediterranean-inspired brunch destination in the heart of downtown Vancouver, open since 2008 and recognized by the Michelin Guide every year since 2022. The restaurant is celebrated for its signature Belgian waffles, eclectic bistro fare, and connoisseur-level coffee in a bright, open space with soaring ceilings and an open kitchen. It also hosts private evening events for up to 70 guests in its curated private dining room.
8aa8cc6786: Steve's Poké Bar is an authentic Hawaiian poke chain founded by Steve Huynh, who grew up between Vancouver and Honolulu and draws on family recipes and local Hawaiian poké traditions. The Canada Place location places it steps from Vancouver's waterfront and convention centre, making it a convenient stop on a harbour cycling route. With over 10,000 five-star Google reviews and a menu spanning signature bowls, build-your-own options, and catering, it has become a well-established local institution.
e4c903b622: The Ocean Beach is a historic waterfront pub housed in a building dating back to 1930 — originally part of the Blue Moon Empire and later the Ocean Beach Hotel — now rebranded in 2020 under the long-standing Veltri family. Perched on Marine Drive in White Rock with direct ocean views, the industrial-chic interior features oak décor and old-world brick, making it a natural and atmospheric stop for cyclists on the waterfront route. The menu spans craft cocktails, seafood platters, and hearty bar food with plant-based options.
baa8a7bcb8: Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen is a national fast food chain specializing in Southern-style fried chicken, located on Bridgeport Road in Richmond. This location is halal-certified according to OSM tags, which may be relevant to some touring cyclists. It offers takeout service and is situated in a commercial area of Richmond.
5974b08d6f: Fanny Bay Oyster Bar is a Michelin-recommended seafood restaurant and retail shellfish market in Vancouver's stadium district, serving freshly shucked oysters and BC shellfish farmed directly by the Taylor Shellfish family for over 40 years. Cyclists will find a full dine-in oyster bar alongside a retail shellfish market with online ordering for pickup, located near BC Place at 762 Cambie Street.
83fa760abb: Hokkaido Ramen Santouka is a Japanese ramen chain founded in 1988 in Asahikawa, Hokkaido, celebrated for its mild white tonkotsu broth and signature shio ramen served with a pickled plum in a specially designed round bowl. The Robson Street location places it in Vancouver's West End, a short ride from Stanley Park and the seawall — a natural refueling stop on one of the city's most popular cycling corridors. The menu spans shio, shoyu, miso, spicy miso, and char siu ramen varieties, all made from scratch at each restaurant.
a3c30e7437: Hiro Japan Sushi Xpress is a quick-serve Japanese food chain with a Victoria outlet inside Hillside Shopping Centre, offering fresh-made sushi, teriyaki meals, bento boxes, and Japanese noodle dishes. The concept was established in Vancouver in 2003 and prioritizes fresh, daily-made product with a focus on health and sustainability. A touring cyclist stopping at Hillside can grab a ready-made sushi or bento box to go.
0b56a3d593: PureBread is an artisan bakery originating in Whistler that has grown to multiple BC locations, including this Gastown outpost on West Hastings Street. It is known for freshly baked breads, pastries, and savoury treats, and has been featured in outlets such as the New York Times and Lonely Planet. For a touring cyclist passing through downtown Vancouver, it is a quality food stop within the Gastown neighbourhood.
b422f76032: Gelato Express is a gelato shop on Robson Street in Vancouver's West End, specializing in authentic Italian-style gelato with flavors ranging from passion fruit and blood orange to tiramisu and Ferrero Rocher. The shop features both indoor and outdoor seating in a cozy, modern space decorated with artwork and Minions paraphernalia. It's a convenient sweet-stop for cyclists riding through downtown Vancouver.
7f89667db3: Honolulu Coffee is a Hawaii-origin specialty coffee chain bringing farm-to-cup Kona coffee to its café locations, including this spot in downtown Vancouver. The brand sources its beans from its own Kona farm on the Big Island and emphasizes single-origin quality. Touring cyclists passing through the Nelson Street corridor will find indoor and outdoor seating and vegetarian-friendly options.
e0a93fde50: Shaughnessy's Cove is a premium casual lakeside restaurant on South Lakeshore Drive in Summerland, operated by Mackenzie Hospitality Group since a full gut-and-rebuild renovation in 2021. The space carries nearly 35 years of history under the 'Cove' name and features a heated patio with lake views. It serves lunch, dinner, and weekend brunch, and accommodates walk-ins as well as reservations.
f349cd222c: Olympus Ice Cream & Bubble Tea is a dessert shop on Victoria's busy Government Street, serving both ice cream and bubble tea. It sits on one of downtown Victoria's main tourist corridors, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the city centre.
6d04fc4047: The Cliff House Restaurant is a casual West Coast dining room inside Capilano Suspension Bridge Park, perched above the canyon on the site of the original 1889 Cliff House. It serves fresh local ingredients, Ocean Wise seafood, BC wines, and regional craft beer on tap, with a large summer patio and cozy historic interior. Access requires purchasing paid park admission, making it a destination experience rather than a quick cyclist stop.
b32a58a7b0: Beach Grove Golf Club is a private, member-owned coastal club near Boundary Bay in Tsawwassen, operating for nearly a century. The clubhouse hosts two dining venues—the Grille and the Bistro—serving chef-inspired menus using fresh, local, and sustainable ingredients. Guests are welcome for dining and private events, making the clubhouse accessible to non-members passing through the area.
e0a775c6b6: The Pie Hole is a Lower Mainland pie bakery founded in 2011 by Jenell Parsons — dubbed 'Canada's Pie Queen' and featured on Guy Fieri's Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives — now operating three locations including this Burnaby shop on 6th Street. The menu spans an eclectic mix of freshly made sweet and savory pies (from Fat Elvis banana-cream to Thai Chicken and Mac & Cheese) available by the slice, whole pie, or hand pie for eat-in or takeout. All pies are made from scratch using locally sourced produce and free-range eggs.
be65941b31: Rice and Noodle is a BC-based fast-casual Southeast Asian chain that has operated since 2010, specializing in cooked-to-order dishes like pad thai, curries, and noodle bowls with customizable protein and spice levels. The Lonsdale Avenue location sits in a busy North Vancouver corridor and offers dine-in, takeout, and third-party delivery. It is part of a growing franchise with multiple Lower Mainland locations.
6d2d54dc42: Rise & Grind Coffee is a cafe located in Courtenay. It provides a stopping point for touring cyclists seeking refreshment and a break during their travels.
d97d1033b3: Flavour Balance Espresso Bar is a neighbourhood café on Belmont Street in North Vancouver offering espresso drinks and vegetarian-friendly food, with both indoor and outdoor seating. The no-smoking policy and patio make it a potentially pleasant rest stop for cyclists passing through the area.
797909d256: Bread Co. is a fifth-generation Dutch-heritage bakery café whose founders began baking in the Netherlands in 1851; the current Bronswyk family owners bring those traditions to three Kelowna locations. The Pandosy Ave café serves freshly baked artisan breads made with organic flours and sea salt, house-made soups, breakfast and lunch dishes, and a rotating menu of specialty coffee and seasonal drinks. Touring cyclists will find a full-service sit-down café with a vegan bread range and online pickup ordering.
9ec5fe69b8: The Steamworks Burnaby Brewery and Taproom is a large-scale craft production facility opened in 2013, housing 32 fermentors, 3 grain silos, and a 500-foot canning line that produces thousands of barrels of beer annually. The taproom pours directly from tank to tap, rotating through core and seasonal steam-brewed beers alongside occasional test taps. A Steamworks food truck stationed outside serves burgers, wings, and poutine, and the facility also offers growler fills, cold beer sales, and keg rentals.
de115adb8b: Chubby Duck's is a casual kebab and poutine spot in Whistler Village, notable for serving exclusively certified halal meats alongside falafel and vegetarian options. Located in Village Green, it caters to a late-night crowd and offers online ordering. A touring cyclist looking for a quick, filling meal with halal or vegetarian options will find a solid selection here.
e8eb40845c: Glo Restaurant + Lounge sits on the Selkirk Waterway in Victoria, just minutes from the Galloping Goose Regional Trail, making it a natural stop for cyclists on one of BC's most popular multi-use paths. The 180-degree wrap-around patio features heaters, blankets, and umbrellas for year-round outdoor dining with unobstructed waterway views. Executive Chef Andrew Fawcett's seasonally changing menu draws on local and global inspiration, with strong vegetarian and gluten-friendly representation throughout.
47d64a9f26: Eleni's Greek Restaurant is a family-owned establishment in Downtown Mission serving a broad menu of Greek specialties alongside pasta, seafood, chicken, veal, steaks, and burgers. It has built a local reputation for generous platters, attentive service, and a welcoming atmosphere. A touring cyclist passing through the Fraser Valley would find it a solid sit-down meal option in the heart of Mission's main street.
2fa4f4fb3c: The Portuguese Club of Vancouver (PCOV), founded in 1962, claims to be Canada's oldest Portuguese club and has been a cornerstone of the Portuguese community on Vancouver's Commercial Drive for over six decades. It operates a full restaurant serving authentic Portuguese cuisine — including bacalhau, grilled calamari, and chouriço — available for dine-in, takeout, and event catering. The club also features dual big-screen TVs for live sports and hosts cultural events like Sardine Day, making it a lively neighbourhood destination.
c55cdf995b: Syren's Bistro is a restaurant located in Sidney, BC, a small seaside town on the Saanich Peninsula at the southern tip of Vancouver Island. Sidney is a popular stop on Gulf Islands cycling routes and the BC Ferries corridor. The bistro name and coastal setting suggest a nautical character typical of the Sidney waterfront area.
7bf0cd1deb: Floyd's Diner is a Victoria, BC institution established in 2004, best known for 'The Mahoney' — a large breakfast challenge that has become a local legend. The Royal Oak location on West Saanich Road is one of four family-friendly diners across greater Victoria. It offers a casual, welcoming atmosphere with a breakfast and lunch menu, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists exploring the Saanich Peninsula.
4def0884b3: Alice & Brohm Ice Cream Co. is a New Zealand-inspired real-fruit ice cream shop with two Squamish locations, blending locally sourced BC berries and dairy right in front of customers with no added colours or flavours. Both shops offer outdoor seating — the Mamquam Road location has a large patio at the Squamish Town Hub, while the Second Ave location has a patio just off the downtown main strip. It's a natural post-ride treat stop given Squamish's reputation as an outdoor adventure hub.
162736c0f4: Ora Sushi is a sit-down sushi restaurant on Moncton Street in Richmond's Steveston neighbourhood, a short ride from the waterfront and popular cycling paths along the Fraser River. It brands itself around fresh sushi and a casual, welcoming atmosphere. Touring cyclists passing through Steveston would find it a convenient option for a Japanese meal near the water.
6f8bbbf951: Niagara Pizza has been a Ladner community institution since 1975, run by the same family across two generations. Located in the Harbourside Strip Mall, it offers a broad scratch-made menu spanning homemade pizzas, classic Greek dishes (spanakopita, souvlaki, saganaki), steaks, seafood, and pasta. The 85-seat dining room can accommodate large groups, and takeout and local delivery are also available.
1f50228f43: Afghan Turkish Cuisine is a restaurant in Burnaby serving Afghan and Turkish cuisine with indoor seating. A touring cyclist can stop here for a sit-down meal on Willingdon Avenue.
1b38354b68: The Fernie Taphouse is a historic gastropub at the heart of downtown Fernie, housed in a building rebuilt after the Great Fire of 1908 with bootlegger tunnels still intact beneath it. It offers a wide menu of classic pub fare — from beer-battered fish and chips to rotating daily specials — alongside 20+ rotating BC craft beers on tap and a heated seasonal patio. The venue is actively community-connected, sponsoring local cycling events such as the Gravel Grind Post Race Afterparty and the Fernie Trails & Touring Club.
3d938b541c: Hundo-P is a health-focused smoothie and non-dairy ice cream shop that originated in Whistler Village before expanding to Burnaby. Everything is made fresh in front of you using real fruit and whole-food ingredients, with protein-packed 24oz smoothies and a full line of coconut-and-cashew-based ice cream proudly made in Canada. For a touring cyclist, it's a solid stop for a nutritious, on-the-go refuel with options to suit dairy-free and plant-based diets.
b0df0cddfb: Tokyo in April is a Japanese restaurant in Vancouver's Gastown neighbourhood specializing in premium sushi and contemporary Japanese dishes, with particular emphasis on bluefin tuna, uni, and signature omurice creations. The restaurant offers both dine-in and online pick-up ordering through its own platform. The building provides free two-hour underground parking for customers.
e5a68b8984: Coffeehouse at Shoal Point is a coffee shop tucked inside the Shoal Point condominium complex on Dallas Road along Victoria's southern waterfront. Its location puts it directly on a popular cycling corridor connecting the Inner Harbour to Beacon Hill Park and the Dallas Road seawall. OSM notes outdoor seating, making it a plausible rest stop for cyclists passing through.
7331a0bf6a: Sun Bo Kong is a fully vegetarian and vegan Cantonese restaurant that has anchored Vancouver's plant-based dining scene since 1992, built around 100% handmade dim sum and a menu of over 160 authentic dishes. Founded by Ken Chau, the restaurant has long pioneered innovative vegetarian interpretations of classic Chinese cuisine, with some of its original creations now considered mainstream vegetarian staples. Cyclists seeking substantial plant-based fuel will find a calm dine-in room alongside takeout and third-party delivery options.
82a4b64911: Terra Breads is a Vancouver artisan bakery founded in 1993, celebrated for its small-batch sourdough loaves, granola, and café selections made with locally sourced, whole ingredients and no added preservatives. The Olympic Village location sits in a waterfront neighborhood that is a natural waypoint for cyclists exploring the Seawall and surrounding routes. Visitors experience a warm, community-focused café with both indoor and outdoor seating and a menu built around hearty, quality baked goods.
3a217b992b: A sushi restaurant on Granville Street in south Vancouver. Offers sushi and Japanese cuisine to cyclists and other travelers passing through the area.
27c9141c8e: Mama's Japanese Kitchen is a small, no-reservations Japanese restaurant situated at the Harbour Spirit Centre on the corner of Madeira Park Road and Highway 101 in Madeira Park. The kitchen uses no MSG or peanuts and offers both dine-in and takeout, including a signature Big Tray sushi platter available with advance ordering. It is a locally-run spot serving authentic Japanese cuisine in a small Sunshine Coast community, making it a notable meal stop for cyclists travelling the Highway 101 corridor.
7fd5b840ca: Kozak is a Ukrainian restaurant and cafe in Langley serving homemade Ukrainian food. It presents itself as an authentic destination for traditional Ukrainian cuisine in the Fraser Valley. Online ordering is available, suggesting the kitchen can accommodate both dine-in and takeout customers.
abaebdd3fa: Woking Dragon Chop Suey House is a family-owned Chinese restaurant chain operating since 2003, offering modern western-style Chinese cuisine with a nod to traditional recipes. The Maple Ridge location sits on Dewdney Trunk Road and is one of three Lower Mainland locations. It has earned recognition as a favourite Chinese restaurant in the Tri-Cities area.
073bfae978: Non-Stop Pizza is a fast-food pizza takeout shop mapped in Tsawwassen/Ladner. Its current operational status is uncertain, as an OSM contributor has flagged a concern that it may no longer exist or may have merged with an adjacent pizza business.
08817c9c3a: Golden Smell Mee is a Malaysian-Singaporean restaurant in Vancouver's Chinatown reuniting two family culinary legacies that trace back to 1986. The menu centres on handmade noodles, laksa, roti canai, Hainanese chicken rice, and slow-cooked curries drawing on Malay, Chinese, and Indian influences. A touring cyclist stopping in the Chinatown area will find a cozy, full-service dine-in restaurant with online ordering.
ac56ac7637: Working Culture Bread is a family-run neighbourhood bakery and coffee shop in Victoria's Rock Bay area, open since 2020. They specialize in organic sourdough loaves made with just flour, water, and salt — using stone-milled BC whole grain flours — alongside rustic pastries and focaccia sandwiches. Their daily rotating bread menu and community-focused ethos make it a genuine local stop for cyclists looking for quality baked goods and a fresh coffee.
6b2ce36b12: Cherry Pit is a restaurant in Kelowna, BC, recorded in OpenStreetMap with minimal metadata. No further details about its cuisine, setting, or offerings could be confirmed from available sources.

It has both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a comfortable stop in any weather. A solid selection of canned craft beer, cider, and wine rounds out the offering for cyclists looking to refuel after a ride.
224e6faae8: Dami Sushi is a Japanese restaurant in Nanaimo specializing in sushi and Japanese cuisine. It provides both dine-in and takeout service, making it convenient for touring cyclists passing through. The air-conditioned interior and available washrooms make it a comfortable stop.
41073bcdbd: SpearHead Winery is an award-winning Okanagan estate winery recognized as the 2024 Best Performing Winery and Winery of the Year, known for its single-vineyard Pinot Noir program led by winemaker Grant Stanley. The OSM record specifically captures the winery's outdoor patio, which forms part of the tasting room experience at their Spiers Road property. Touring cyclists passing through the South Kelowna wine corridor can stop here for a wine tasting in a vineyard setting.
d9f8c5fb44: Cactus Club Cafe's Bentall 5 location is a polished downtown Vancouver outpost of a well-established BC chain, offering chef-driven international cuisine in an upbeat, stylish room. The restaurant features both indoor and patio seating and operates a full pickup and delivery service. As a high-traffic anchor in the Burrard Street office and retail corridor, it draws a broad mix of business and leisure diners.
6809a35c08: Killer Ice Cream is a Kitsilano shop serving real fruit ice cream, frozen yogurt, and vegan ice cream alongside espresso drinks and premium snacks. The shop has an events program and delivery option in addition to walk-in service.
4a01772532: Float30 is a seafood and fish-and-chips restaurant situated at Reed Point Marina in Port Moody, offering panoramic waterfront views. The kitchen serves fresh daily seafood alongside a full scratch breakfast menu, making it a substantial meal stop on the Inlet waterfront route. A covered, heated patio lets cyclists eat outside in variable west-coast weather.
6822766124: Rogue Kitchen & Wetbar is a full-service restaurant and bar anchored in Vancouver's historic Gastown neighbourhood, offering a broad West Coast-inspired menu alongside an extensive cocktail list and live tap selection. The venue has both indoor and outdoor seating and runs a daily happy hour, making it a potential mid-ride or post-ride stop for cyclists exploring the waterfront area. Online ordering with curbside pickup is available, which suits cyclists who prefer a quick grab-and-go.
13618d632a: Chieftain Pool & Pinball is a smoke-free bar on Cleveland Avenue in Squamish offering pool tables and pinball machines in an indoor-only setting. Squamish is a major hub for mountain biking, road cycling, and multi-day touring, making this a natural stop for cyclists seeking indoor downtime. The bar's game-focused atmosphere sets it apart from typical pubs in the area.
3cf3c93039: HUB Co. Brewing is a craft brewery with an expansive tasting room situated on the historic North Railway Avenue in downtown Mission, BC. The venue pours its own house-brewed beers alongside a food menu, and regularly hosts community events including trivia nights, gaming evenings, and creative workshops. Cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley corridor will find it a lively local gathering spot with a distinctly neighbourhood feel.
03afdf9b05: Tamaly Shop is a Vancouver Mexican tamale specialty shop on Main Street, crafting authentic corn husk-wrapped tamales from 100% natural ingredients with both traditional and signature fillings. 3ee214d829: Antico Pizza Napoletana is a family-owned Neapolitan pizzeria officially certified by the Associazione Verace Pizza Napoletana in Naples and ranked #1 in Kelowna and British Columbia, with a top-50 North America ranking from Top 50 Italy. The restaurant sits in downtown Kelowna with a patio one block from Okanagan Lake, placing it directly on a natural cycling route through the Okanagan.
e06a5b0ef3: Wahaha Tea is a bubble tea cafe located in a commercial retail complex in Richmond, BC. Specializing in bubble tea drinks, it offers a stop for cyclists passing through the busy McClelland Road corridor. The unit location within a larger building suggests indoor seating may be available, though this cannot be confirmed from available sources.
3b1a513d1e: Fresh Bite Food is a kebab and sandwich counter that opened its first location in 2024, backed by over a decade of culinary experience. The menu centres on grilled koobideh and chicken kebab sandwiches as well as Philly-style cheese steaks, all served in fresh pitta bread with a generous spread of toppings. 54f5e1a84b: The London Fish is a fish-and-chips restaurant on Commercial Drive, one of Vancouver's most bike-friendly and pedestrian-oriented streets. The Instagram handle 'thelondonfish1972' suggests a founding year of 1972, potentially making this a long-standing neighbourhood institution. Touring cyclists on the Commercial Drive corridor will find indoor seating available.
c8b1192035: The IKEA Restaurant is a Swedish cafeteria-style eatery on the second floor of IKEA Richmond, one of the busiest IKEA locations in Western Canada. The store is currently undergoing an expansion, signalling continued investment in the Richmond location.
974fb46268: Phonomenal Vietnamese Café is an authentic pho restaurant that has been serving Greater Victoria since November 2011, located in Shelbourne Village Square at the intersection of Cedar Hill Cross Rd. and Shelbourne St. The menu spans appetizers, large-format pho, grilled sandwiches, rice dishes, and vermicelli, with a signature 'jumble size' pho that the kitchen describes as a standout. Its location within walking distance of the University of Victoria and near Camosun College makes it a natural refuelling stop along the Shelbourne corridor.
488d2ffed8: Monaco Café is a locally owned, independent café situated in the heart of Gastown, Vancouver, blending a cozy modern interior with European café vibes. The kitchen turns out freshly baked croissants, sweet knots, and muffins daily alongside a full espresso bar and cold drink menu. The about-us page highlights it as a neighborhood gathering place with vegan, dairy-free, and gluten-free options woven throughout the menu.
0ae330476d: Fluffle Cafe is a cafe located in a commercial unit on Cambie Road in Richmond, BC. With only an Instagram presence and no dedicated website, details about its offerings are limited, but it operates in a multi-unit commercial building that may serve a surrounding business or residential community. Touring cyclists passing through Richmond's Cambie Road corridor may find it a convenient stop.
a9ce63f14a: Sandy's Bake Shoppe is a scratch bakery and café founded in 2018 by co-owners Sandy Bryhn and Adam Townsend, who bring over 16 years of combined culinary experience on BC's Sunshine Coast. The shop produces a full range of traditional baked goods — breads, pastries, tarts, cakes — alongside savory lunch items including soups, wraps, and sandwiches made on their own house-baked breads. Special orders and catering, including wedding cakes, are available by arrangement.
8daaf6a7e8: Pho 37 is an award-winning Vietnamese restaurant chain with its Commercial Drive location sitting on one of Vancouver's most bike-friendly corridors. 962ce9a600: Main Street Cafe is a downtown Revelstoke institution operating since 2003 in a beautifully converted heritage house, celebrated for creative eggs benedict variations, quality espresso, and an extensive all-day breakfast and lunch menu. A sunny street-side patio makes it a natural and welcoming stop for anyone arriving in Revelstoke by bike.
fdfd9abe68: Shamrock Storehouse is an Irish pub chain founded in 2024 by William and Laura Donnellan, immigrants from Co. Galway, Ireland, who built the brand around authentic Irish hospitality. f793197fb9: Burrata Pizzeria is a Kerrisdale neighbourhood pizzeria focused on delivering what it calls the most authentic Italian pizza to Vancouver's West Side. 395e5cd739: Carbone Pizzeria is a Nanaimo Italian restaurant specializing in traditional and American-style pizzas and pasta, helmed by a chef with over 30 years of fine dining experience. 08c2622c02: Golden Chopsticks is a Chinese restaurant on Main Street in Osoyoos, the sun-drenched South Okanagan town at the heart of several popular cycling routes including the Kettle Valley and cross-Canada touring corridors. 57d9d9a050: The Pawn Shop YVR is an East L.A.-inspired taco and tequila bar on Vancouver's Granville Street, featuring hand-painted graffiti walls, cozy bench seating, and an open-concept kitchen. 37e527e12a: LIFT Bar Grill View is an upscale waterfront restaurant in Vancouver's Coal Harbour, known for panoramic views of the harbour, Stanley Park, and the North Shore mountains from what the restaurant describes as the city's only waterfront rooftop deck. The multi-level space features floor-to-ceiling windows that open in summer and outdoor fire features, making it a well-established landmark dining destination.
832f8a39b6: Chef Hung Taiwanese Beef Noodle is the North American flagship of an international chain founded by a three-time champion of the Taipei International Beef Noodle Festival Competition (2007–2010). It sits in Richmond's dense Asian food district, offering touring cyclists a distinctive regional dining experience.
c6b6369fe3: The Duke Saloon is Victoria's premiere country music venue, established in 2014 inside a heritage brick building originally constructed in 1902 to house BC Electric Company streetcars. 1b6b89b569: Pizza 64 is a BC pizza chain with a Pitt Meadows location along McMyn Road, offering both takeout and delivery. Touring cyclists passing through this suburban community will find it a convenient refuel option.
db3ca936de: Ramen Danbo is a Japanese chain rooted in Fukuoka-style Tonkotsu ramen, with its Kitsilano location on West 4th Avenue being one of the brand's very first restaurants outside Japan. 2ced5defc2: Cowpuccino's Coffee House is a cafe in Prince Rupert, BC, on Cow Bay Road. It serves as a rest and refreshment stop for cyclists and travelers in this northern coastal community.
28384f684d: Orange Julius is a juice and fast food establishment offering takeaway service. The location provides a convenient stop for cyclists seeking quick refreshments while traveling through Fort St. John.
7533d1f28c: ARC is a West Coast fine-dining restaurant inside the Fairmont Waterfront hotel at Canada Place, helmed by Executive Chef Harris Sakalis and known for locally sourced dishes including ingredients grown in its own rooftop herb garden and beehives. Its location at Canada Place puts cyclists directly on the seawall, and offerings span breakfast through late-night lounge service.
875c717c61: Jam Cafe is a beloved breakfast and brunch institution that opened in Victoria's historic Old Town in 2012 and has since expanded to multiple BC locations. 3924087598: Ajiya Sushi is a Japanese restaurant situated on West 4th Avenue in Vancouver's Kitsilano neighbourhood, a street that serves as a major cycling corridor with dedicated infrastructure. 9254ead06f: The Old Spaghetti Factory is a Canadian chain restaurant anchoring a corner of Vancouver's historic Gastown neighbourhood, operating out of one of its earliest Canadian locations. ebb77af821: Umami Sushi is a casual Japanese sushi restaurant in Langley offering online ordering and takeout service. 55125ed773: Sushi Bar Nagomi is an authentic Japanese sushi restaurant on BC's Sunshine Coast, opened in 2008 by Tokyo-trained chef Hiro Funaki who settled in Gibsons for its natural beauty and community spirit. 57fc17a3d4: Menya Raizo is a Japanese ramen izakaya on West Broadway in Vancouver, part of the Zakkushi Group which has operated in the city for over 20 years. 11d929cbd5: Grit Studio is an independent café in Port Moody offering specialty coffee and tea alongside a rotating selection of pastries, savoury snacks, and sandwiches. d1923acc1a: Triple O's is the quick-service burger concept under the White Spot family, BC's longest-running restaurant chain operating since 1928. 9911e1a5ce: Nest at the Lake is a coffee shop cafe located at 121 Presley Place in the western communities of Greater Victoria. acc34c7e0b: Mei Le Bakery & Restaurant is a Chinese dim sum restaurant and bakery in Coquitlam, serving daily from morning through evening. 440f1c500d: Goldie's is a gourmet donut and bakery chain with a Kitsilano outpost on West 4th Avenue, celebrated for its 24-hour slow-fermented brioche donuts using a Korean-inspired technique that produces unusually light and fluffy results. a5cd20cf1f: Village Sushi is a small sushi bar in Richmond with a capacity of around 14 seats, situated on Number 2 Road near Richmond's well-developed cycling network. d759bc73dd: Holy Guacamole is an authentic Mexican restaurant on Denman Street in Vancouver's West End, co-founded by Miguel Villalobos Luna and Indalecio Xicohtencatl-Lara, both of whom bring decades of culinary experience from Mexico. 74293238cf: Founded in 2010 in Richmond, BC, Sing Yee Chinese Restaurant is a well-regarded Cantonese dining destination led by Master Chef Tony, who brings over 30 years of culinary experience from acclaimed Chinese restaurants and culinary groups. 28bee7470c: Ophelia is a Michelin Guide–recommended Mexican restaurant in Vancouver's Olympic Village, helmed by Chef Francisco Higareda and named in honour of his mother. 027e55274f: A family-owned deli operating in the historic Sapperton neighbourhood of New Westminster since 1994, serving soups, sandwiches, and salads made from fresh local produce. 1a80c41e33: The Rose Neighbourhood Public House occupies a converted 1925 heritage home in Colwood that has anchored the Westshore community as a pub under various names since 1985. 7345fd1354: Cosmos Greek Restaurant has been a White Rock waterfront institution since 1980, serving traditional family-recipe Greek dishes — souvlaki, moussaka, handmade dips, and fresh-baked pita — just steps from the ocean. b76bf84b30: Mount Currie Coffee Co is a specialty coffee shop in the heart of Whistler Village, serving premium Gradient Coffee roasted fresh in nearby Pemberton. 097f8726d9: Domino's Pizza is a national chain franchise located in a Langley strip-mall unit offering pizza delivery and carryout. ea8e634033: COCO Cafe is a mission-driven community cafe in the rural Cedar area, operated by Cedar Opportunities BC Society, a registered charity that provides supported employment and training for adults with developmental disabilities. 6cc57fbc67: Park Drive is a bar and restaurant on Commercial Drive in Vancouver that also operates The Gemm, a cocktail lounge on the same premises. b4e856ccf5: A Subway franchise on Summit Drive in Kamloops serving made-to-order sandwiches, wraps, and salads with fresh-baked bread and fresh-cut vegetables. 1613ce7808: Loon Fong Hotpot is an authentic Hong Kong-style hotpot restaurant in Richmond, BC, part of a small multi-location chain with outposts in Ontario. 1bbd453826: Christina Lake Marina is the premier marina on Christina Lake, a 20-kilometre lake known for the warmest tree-lined lake water in Western Canada. 3146aa5b3e: InGrain Pastificio is a craft pasta manufacturer in Deep Cove that makes slow-dried, bronze-extruded pasta from BC-grown grains — durum, einkorn, emmer, spelt — and Seymour Lake alpine water filtered through a five-stage reverse-osmosis system, following traditional Gragnano IGP methods. 8f0455b56e: Denny's is a well-established Canadian chain diner serving all-day breakfast, burgers, and comfort-food dinners from an extensive menu. Takeout and delivery are available for those who prefer to eat on the move.
a6cac8a0bb: Bubble Waffle Cafe is a Hong Kong-style street snack spot specializing in the classic egg waffle alongside curry fish balls, rice noodle rolls, stinky tofu, and a broad fish soup noodle combo with dozens of customizable toppings and noodle types. 6e13904cad: The Captain's Boil is a Cajun-inspired seafood boil chain where diners choose their catch — lobster, king crab, snow crab, Dungeness crab, shrimp, and more — then select a flavour sauce and spice level before digging in hands-first at the table. 894b452f4c: The Columbia Diner is a modern roadside-style diner in downtown Kamloops serving all-day breakfast alongside lunch and dinner menus built around smash burgers, fried chicken and waffles, and classic comfort food with a contemporary twist. 31bc27ec99: Tao's Kitchen is a Chinese restaurant located in the Marpole neighbourhood of Vancouver, in a unit along the busy Granville Street corridor. 0de166a928: Chili House Restaurant is a family-run fusion eatery in Cloverdale (Surrey) with culinary roots tracing four generations across China, India, and Sweden before the family settled in British Columbia in 2000. d074c5b445: Akari is a Japanese restaurant in Delta's Scott 72 Centre that has been serving fine Japanese cuisine since 1996 and is consistently voted best Japanese restaurant in the neighbourhood. 9751b6da62: Off the Hook is a neighbourhood coastal-inspired restaurant on Salt Spring Island's Fernwood Road, situated near Walker's Hook, brought to life by a couple with two decades of shared food adventures around the world. 0291cb77d6: Tomo Sushi is a Japanese sushi restaurant in Nanaimo, BC, operating under a name that means 'Friend' in Japanese. A touring cyclist passing through Nanaimo may find it a convenient stop for a hot meal, though details about the specific location remain unverified.
d4a45652cc: A casual fried-chicken restaurant in Richmond offering indoor seating. Useful as a quick refueling stop for cyclists passing through the area.
430c5a7926: BackCountry Pizza is a fast-food pizza restaurant located in Whistler, BC. It serves quick meal options for travelers and locals passing through the area.
c9567049db: Todai Sushi is a small, 7-table Japanese restaurant in the Delta neighbourhood of the Lower Mainland, offering a broad menu of sushi, rolls, tempura, teriyaki, and noodle dishes rooted in Japanese culinary tradition. A dedicated Vegetarian menu section makes it accessible to a range of dietary needs.
2c9013bab1: Sandbar Cafe & Art Gallery combines food service with a local art gallery in Qualicum Beach. Located on West Island Highway, it serves as a cafe where cyclists can rest and enjoy local art. Wi-Fi is available to customers.
03f37f447a: Bartholomew's Public House, known locally as Bart's, has been a Victoria institution since 1975 and is located one block from the Inner Harbour with its entrance on Humboldt Street. A touring cyclist finishing a day's ride near the Inner Harbour would find a lively, full-service pub serving fresh pub classics alongside a premium drinks program.
37c3c29f27: The Lido is a casual bar in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighborhood that welcomes drop-in patrons with no reservations required or cover charge. It positions itself as a relaxed social gathering space.
dbebe4b1d0: Mangia's Sandwiches is a casual Italian-style deli on Granville Street, sister restaurant to Jo's Italian Deli, where meats are sliced to order and bread is delivered fresh daily from a local bakery. b1764fb968: The Rooftop Patio is an open-air seasonal venue perched atop The Sticky Wicket, billed as Vancouver Island's largest pub, at 919 Douglas St in downtown Victoria. The venue hosts a busy schedule of live music and special events, making it a lively urban stop for cyclists passing through the city centre.
1081a883ba: Open since 1967, The Old Bavaria Haus is a nationally acclaimed German restaurant set inside a beautifully restored century-old home in the heart of New Westminster. c99dc01076: Crust N Crunch is a pizza and donair counter located inside SFU's Academic Quadrangle building (Level 3000) on Burnaby Mountain campus, part of a small Metro Vancouver chain. 3aaa24d36b: Song Huong is a Vietnamese restaurant in Vancouver offering casual dine-in and takeaway service. Located on Nanaimo Street, it provides a convenient stop for touring cyclists looking for a meal while exploring the area.

5db8238ea7: HYDE on Main is a restaurant located on Main Street in Vancouver. Without access to website content, specific details about the business's offerings or facilities cannot be confirmed.

62da9e92cb: The Polly Fox is a completely gluten-free bakery and café established in 2016 in downtown Abbotsford's Essendene Avenue corridor, free from gluten, peanuts, and sesame with extensive vegan and dairy-free options. 584fc1389a: BiblioCafe is a University of Victoria Food Services café tucked into the ground floor of the William C. Mearns Centre for Learning (McPherson Library) on the UVic campus. 81258b46f0: Cora is a well-known Canadian breakfast and lunch franchise chain with a Kelowna outpost inside Orchard Park Shopping Centre. 22175f44a7: Ba Le Deli & Bakery is a family-owned Vietnamese delicatessen that has been baking its own baguettes and crafting bánh mì sandwiches in Vancouver since 1987. 40bba95f43: The Canadian Grind is a coffee and tea café on 100 Avenue in Fort St. John, distinguished by an extensive loose-leaf tea catalog spanning over 135 varieties across categories including black, green, herbal, chai, matcha, oolong, and wellness blends. c987f0d135: Beere Brewing is a father-and-son craft brewery and tasting room on Esplanade East in North Vancouver, pouring a rotating lineup of house-brewed ales, IPAs, lagers, and sours with playful names. 15dc6d5d92: Bliss Bakery is a long-established artisan bakery and bistro founded in 2005, known for slow-fermented sourdough breads made with a starter originally cultivated from Okanagan grapes. 1e8e4556da: Little Mexico Cantina is a full-service Mexican restaurant and bar in the Steveston village area of Richmond, offering house-made tortillas, a wide taco selection, and a full bar with daily happy hour. 8c2f98a6e1: Banh Mi Saigon is a family-run Vietnamese sandwich shop on Victoria Drive in South East Vancouver, recognized for baking its baguettes in-house daily from a house recipe. c58ad1ba17: Angus T is a Belgian-inspired artisan bakery and cafe founded in 2016 around a family croissant recipe from a small village in Belgium. 319d5a26ed: Italian restaurant on Kingsway in Burnaby serving pizza and pasta, with both indoor and outdoor seating. Part of the Glowbal Group; wheelchair accessible and non-smoking.
4dfddd268d: Dosa Paragon is an Indian restaurant in Victoria specializing in South Indian dosas and traditional Indian cuisine. The menu includes vegetarian and vegan options, making it suitable for cyclists with various dietary preferences.

dcd13c00dc: Kokomo is a plant-based eatery with four Metro Vancouver locations, serving fresh bowls, salads, acai bowls, smoothies, and handhelds made entirely from plant-based ingredients. 3d1fc41d59: Donair Cafe is a fast-food spot in Sardis, Chilliwack, specializing in donairs — a Maritime-style spiced beef dish served in flatbread that is popular across Western Canada. 7ccf41ed8b: Damaskino Shawarma is a halal restaurant on Denman Street in Vancouver's West End, a neighbourhood that sits at the gateway to the Stanley Park seawall — one of the city's busiest cycling corridors. a090f02ed3: Café Crêpe is a French-style crêperie making crepes from homemade batter since 1999, located steps from the Granville SkyTrain Station entrance in the heart of downtown Vancouver. 6fbe2338d0: Mashti Cafe describes itself as the first Iranian juice and ice cream bar in British Columbia, serving fresh juices, smoothies, shakes, ice creams, and traditional Persian sweets at its flagship North Vancouver location on Lonsdale Avenue. e12a7ebfcf: Timberland Pub is a neighbourhood pub and liquor store in the Cassidy/Ladysmith area of Vancouver Island, offering dine-in and takeout with a full menu of pub classics including fresh local oysters and daily specials. bdde710782: Bin 4 Burger Lounge is a BC-grown burger chain with a South Granville location serving creative smashed-patty burgers, bowls, and salads using locally sourced ingredients including premium BC beef and Rossdown Farms chicken. 8b8a9a83e9: Embers Wine & Charcuterie Cellar bills itself as Nanaimo's only wine and charcuterie cellar, offering curated cured meats, artisan cheeses, cured seafood, and an extensive wine list in a cellar-style setting on Front Street. 8deaa33fd0: The Old Firehouse Wine & Cocktail Bar is an artisanal wine and cocktail bar opened in March 2012 by the Downie Family, located in Downtown Duncan's City Square in the Cowichan Valley. f3f135cf29: Oidé Coffee began as a small coffee window in Vancouver's Waterfall Building and has grown into a destination for specialty coffee, stocking single-origin beans from Ethiopia, Colombia, Kenya, and Brazil. 9d5365fdb4: A Chinese restaurant located in Richmond. Current operational status is uncertain due to website inaccessibility.
84ee997c12: Hot House Pizza is a locally-operated pizza chain with five or more locations across Victoria, BC, including Oak Bay, Gordon Head, Cook Street Village, Victoria West, and UVic campus. 1b7cb1c6a9: Mangos Kitchen Bar is a Latin American restaurant and bar in downtown Vancouver's Howe Street corridor, serving dishes drawn from across the continent — Peruvian ceviche and lomo saltado, Mexican birria tacos, Colombian empanadas, Venezuelan arepas, and Argentine choripán. 0c62d27a35: A sushi restaurant on Denman Street in Vancouver's West End, steps from the Stanley Park seawall cycling routes. b1f1d09c53: A restaurant on Store Street in central Victoria. Website is not currently accessible, limiting available information about the business and its services.

6979fbc7d7: Thetis Island Marina Pub is a waterfront pub and restaurant at Thetis Island Resort on Thetis Island in the Gulf Islands, reachable by BC Ferries from Chemainus or by seaplane. 9f630c1cb7: White Spot is BC's longest-running restaurant chain, founded in 1928 and celebrated for crowd-pleasing classics made with fresh Canadian beef, BC chicken, and locally sourced ingredients. d01feb9bea: Kazumi is a Japanese and Korean fusion restaurant in Langford, offering an extensive menu that spans hand-crafted sushi rolls, sashimi, aburi nigiri, donburi, noodles, hot pot, and Korean dishes like BBQ kalbi. 7a7a4ca417: Yew Street Food Hall is a vibrant indoor food hall in Kamloops' North Shore neighbourhood, bringing together ten independent food and drink vendors under one roof. 2742afa9b0: Lost Lake Passivhaus — formerly known as Austria House — is a public building located near Lost Lake in Whistler, BC. 9e41a4e170: Fast-food bar and grill located within the Vancouver Aquarium. Offers both indoor and outdoor seating, serving as a dining option for visitors to this major North Vancouver attraction.
cbbfc7f8c0: The Taco Club is a downtown Revelstoke restaurant that evolved from a retrofitted Canada Post van food truck — affectionately nicknamed Jade — into a local institution serving Latin-inspired tacos, burritos, nachos, and an extensive cocktail list. 9a7e19b1f5: 3rd Street Cafe is a cafe located in Sidney, BC, a popular stop on the Saanich Peninsula cycling circuit near the BC Ferries Swartz Bay terminal. 7edfa96741: The Kootenay Bakery Cafe Cooperative is a worker-owned organic bakery and café on Nelson's main commercial street, producing over 300 from-scratch products using certified organic and locally sourced ingredients. cada9817b9: Gateway Pizza is a long-running Surrey restaurant that merges Canadian-style pizza with an extensive Indian curry menu, including biryanis, butter chicken, and paneer dishes. Cyclists passing through the Guildford corridor would find a wide range of filling options, including a substantial vegetarian selection.
c738deb3d1: Tinhouse Brewing is a craft brewery and tasting lounge in Port Coquitlam, located directly off the Traboulay PoCo Trail — one of the Lower Mainland's most popular multi-use cycling corridors. 980b0aa9c6: Royal Crown Pizza is a family-owned pizzeria that has operated in New Westminster since 2012, offering a broad menu of specialty and supreme pizzas with locally inspired flavour combinations alongside wings, salads, lasagna, and samosas. 668039b294: Moby Dick is a family-operated, award-winning fish and chips landmark on White Rock's East Beach, open since 1975 and decorated throughout with whale memorabilia and suspended fish nets. ecaf715fe0: Kan-Yon Restaurant is a family-owned Chinese and Canadian eatery that has anchored the Hope community since 1974, making it one of the town's longest-running restaurants. 59f59a5558: The Old City Station Pub is a downtown Nanaimo sports bar that has held the title of the city's top sports bar every year since 2008. 4ed1de0c76: Aperture Coffee Bar is a neighbourhood café located in the Walden Building on Main Street at King Edward, serving espresso drinks, tea, beer, wine, and an all-day food menu of breakfasts, sandwiches, and paninis. 40e6aa20c7: Rio Brazilian Steakhouse is a family-owned churrascaria chain with three BC locations, serving all-you-can-eat rodizio-style barbecue where servers carve meats tableside from skewers in the tradition of southern Brazilian Gauchos. e47d7fdb16: El Furniture Warehouse is a casual pub-style restaurant on Whistler's Main Street, part of the multi-location Warehouse Group chain with outposts across Canada. 8d09cea75c: Taste of Tokyo is a family-owned Japanese restaurant in the waterfront town of Sidney, BC, serving authentic sushi, noodle dishes, and Japanese-Western fusions crafted by a head chef with over a decade of experience. The full-service location suits everything from quick weekday lunches to group dinners, with takeout also available.
262b60253c: ABODE is a West End Vancouver brunch destination on Robson Street, serving modern comfort classics made with local, seasonal ingredients and bold flavours. ad666c3301: Grounds for Coffee is a Vancouver institution founded in 1993, built around hand-made cinnamon buns crafted daily from locally-sourced, preservative-free ingredients. A neighbourhood-haven cafe on one of Vancouver's most prominent cycling corridors, it offers online ordering with in-store pickup.
9f2a65d623: BRGR BRGR is a burger-focused casual restaurant in downtown Abbotsford, operating under the tagline 'A Place So Nice They Named It Twice.' A loyalty club and delivery app integrations suggest an established local presence.
674841e422: Cold Front Gelato is a locally owned, handcrafted gelato shop in downtown Nanaimo whose founders trained in Bologna, Italy to master traditional production methods. Both classic dairy and fully dairy-free vegan gelato are available, along with milkshakes, affogato, and hot drinks, and pints can be taken to go.
1346221be3: Red Fish Blue Fish is a beloved seafood shack built into an upcycled shipping container perched on a wooden pier in Victoria's Inner Harbour, serving sustainable Ocean Wise-certified fish and chips, tacones, and grilled seafood since 2007. Outdoor seating on the pier puts diners front-row to seaplanes, boats, and the occasional seal passing through the busy inner harbour.
23cc78fb5a: The Mahle House is a second-generation, family-owned fine dining destination housed in a restored Heritage building on a one-acre property with an English-style garden, operating continuously since 1983. The restaurant serves Wednesday through Sunday evenings and is a well-established fixture of the Cedar community south of Nanaimo.
4473aa4025: Bonus Bakery is a 100% plant-based bakery that opened in Vancouver in December 2018, specializing in vegan cookies, cakes, donuts, and croissants designed to be approachable to all palates. 36e4bb80e3: Fresh Press Coffee Bar is an independent, locally rooted café that has been serving the Richmond area since 2012, with a focus on ethically sourced coffee brewed fresh-to-order. 5d04f02fa1: Vashti Rose is a Port Moody artisan ice cream shop that has been making both dairy and vegan scoops entirely from scratch since 2016, using organic pasteurized milk, cream, and eggs alongside house-made cashew milk for the vegan line. A touring cyclist looking for a handcrafted treat on the Tri-Cities route would find both classic and allergy-conscious options here.
df5d628754: Kokoro Tokyo Mazesoba is a Japanese franchise specializing in mazesoba — a broth-free dry noodle dish distinct from ramen or udon, originating in Tokyo. Cyclists will find a filling, carb-forward meal with takeout and delivery options available.
7dc2b9c083: Hokkaido Ramen Santouka is a Japanese ramen chain originating from Hokkaido, Japan, with this Richmond location serving its signature white tonkotsu-based broths in shio, shoyu, miso, and kara-miso styles. Cycling through Richmond's suburban grid, a touring rider will find this a reliable stop for a hot, restorative bowl with a broad menu that accommodates different dietary needs.
74dd6f281e: Red Garden Cafe is a breakfast-and-lunch cafe tucked into a commercial unit on Viking Way in Richmond, operating since before a 2022 ownership transition when founders Rose and Michael retired and passed the business to new owner Mahmoud.
